Insizwa - noma eyodwa ene-libido eqinile - angathola ukuvuswa okwanele ngokocansi ukuze kuvuswe umphumela womcabango odlulayo, noma nje ukubona komuntu odlulayo. Uma sesimile, ipipi lakhe lingathola ukukhuthazeka okwanele ngokuxhumana nengaphakathi lezingubo zakhe ukuze lilondolozwe futhi likhuthazwe isikhathi esithile. 

Ngenkathi ukuvusa inkanuko yobulili nokukhuthaza kuqhubeka, kungenzeka ukuthi ubukhazikhazi noma ikhanda lomthondo oqondile lizokhula kakhulu futhi, njengoba izitho zangasese ziqhubeka nokufakwa igazi, umbala wazo uyajula namasende angakhula afike ku-50% omkhulu. Njengoba amasende aqhubeka nokukhuphuka, umuzwa wemfudumalo ungakhula ubazungeze kanye ne-perineum. Ngokuqhubeka nokuvuselelwa ngokocansi, izinga labo lenhliziyo liyakhuphuka, umfutho wegazi uyakhuphuka futhi ukuphefumula kuyashesha.Ukwanda kokugeleza kwegazi ezithweni zobulili nakwezinye izifunda kungaholela ekuqothulweni kocansi kwamanye amadoda. 

Njengoba ukugqugquzela ngokocansi kuqhubeka, i- orgasm iqala, lapho imisipha yangaphansi kwe- pelvic, i- vas deferens (phakathi kwamasende kanye ne-prostate), ama -vesicles wesilisa kanye ne-prostate gland ngokwayo ingaqala ukuhlangana ngendlela ephoqa isidoda nesidoda urethra ngaphakathi kwepipi. Uma lokhu sekuqalile, kungenzeka ukuthi indoda izoqhubeka nokukhipha i-ejaculate ne-orgasm ngokugcwele, noma ngaphandle kokuvuselela okunye.

Ngokulinganayo, uma ukukhuthazwa kocansi kuyeka ngaphambi kwe-orgasm, imiphumela ebonakalayo yokukhuthaza, kufaka phakathi i- vasocongestion, izoncipha ngesikhathi esifushane. Ukugqugquzela okuphindiwe noma okude ngaphandle kwe-orgasm kanye ne-ejaculation kungaholela ekuphatheni kabi emasendeni (okuhambisana negama lesilayidi elithi " amabhola aluhlaza "  ).

Ngemuva kwe-orgasm kanye ne-ejaculation, amadoda ajwayele ukuhlangabezana nesikhathi sokuphika esivezwa ukulahleka kokwakhiwa kwawo, ukuncipha kunoma yikuphi ukuqhuma kocansi, ukungabi nentshisekelo kwezocansi, kanye nomuzwa wokuphumula ongabangelwa yi-neurohormones oxytocin neprolactin . Amandla nobude besikhathi sokuphikisa bungaba bufushane kakhulu ensizweni evuswe kakhulu esimweni esivusa kakhulu, mhlawumbe ngaphandle kokulahleka okuphawulekayo kokwakhiwa.Kungaba isikhathi eside njengamahora ambalwa noma izinsuku emadodeni aphakathi nendawo nangaphezulu.

Ezinye izilwane 

Ngenkathi ubulili bomuntu buqondakala kahle, ososayensi abaqondi ngokuphelele ukuthi ezinye izilwane zihlobana kanjani nezocansi.Kodwa-ke, ucwaningo lwamanje lubonisa ukuthi izilwane eziningi, njengabantu, zijabulela ubudlelwane bobulili obungagcini ekukhiqizeni.Ama-dolphins nama- bonobos, isibonelo, zombili ziyaziwa ngokusebenzisa ubulili "njengethuluzi lomphakathi lokuqinisa nokugcina izibopho."Sekuyisikhathi eside izazi ze-Ethologists zibhala ukuhwebelana ngocansi ukukhuthaza ukuhlangana kweqembu ezilwaneni zenhlalo . Ukuqinisa ubugqila bezenhlalo kungenye yezinzuzo ezikhethwe kakhulu ezikhethiwe zethiyori yokukhetha iqembu . Ochwepheshe ekuziphendukeleni kocansi njengoJohn Maynard Smith baxhasa umbono wokuthi ukushintshaniswa kwezinhloso zocansi kusiza ukujiya futhi kutholakale ukuhlangana kwama- alleles kubantu abahlala bodwa ngakho-ke kungaba namandla amakhulu ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo . UMaynard Smith ubhale kaningi kakhulu mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwe-seminal fluid swapping theory ye-assortment of alleles njengokukhonjiswa okunembe kakhudlwana komgomo we-Hardy-Weinberg ezimweni lapho abantu bezalana kakhulu.

title: Wasil Ahmad
text:
UWasil Ahmad (c. 2005 - February 2016) wayeyisosha lezingane lase-Afghanistan, owaziwa kakhulu ngokuyala uphiko lwamaphoyisa nokubulawa kwakhe okwalandela yiTaliban eneminyaka eyishumi nanye.Umalume wakhe uSamad, wamqeqesha "ekusebenziseni izibhamu zemishini i- AK-47 ne- PK , amarokhethi nodaka kanjalo nezingcingo ze-satellite nemisakazo ye-VHF ." 

UWasil Ahmad wazalelwa esifundazweni sase-Uruzgan. Isifunda sichazwe "njengeside ... isikhungo sezingxabano;" Umholi weTaliban uMullah Mohammad Omar wazalelwa lapho, futhi umongameli wakamuva wase-Afghanistan, uHamid Karzai, wahola ukuvukela kokuqala kukaPastun ngokumelene namaTaliban lapho ngo-2001.Ubaba ka-Ahmad phambilini wayebulewe elwa namaTaliban, kwathi indodana yakhe kamuva yathi ukufuna ukuziphindiselela ngokushona kukayise kwakuyisizathu sakhe esikhulu sokuya empini.  Umalume ka-Ahmad wayengumphathi wamaphoyisa endawo yase -Afghan esifundeni iKhas Uruzgan, esifundazweni sase-Uruzgan.Phambilini wayekade engumphathi wamaTaliban, kepha wayeseshintshe izinhlangothi ngo-2012, manje wayeselwela uhulumeni wase-Afghanistan.Ehlobo lika-2015, u-Khas Uruzgan- indawo yakhe yokuphatha- wavinjezelwa yiTaliban, kwathi uSamad walimala. Ngemuva kwalokho u-Ahmad uthathe isikhundla sokuphatha uphiko lukamalume wakhe.

Ukuvinjezelwa 

Ekuvinjezelweni kokuvinjezelwa kweDan Sango,u-Ahmad wayala amasosha angama-75 asekela uhulumeni ngokumelene nebutho elihlaselayo cishe "elingamakhulu" amaTaliban.  Ukuvinjezelwa uqobo kwaphela izinsuku ezingama-71, kanti u-Ahmad wayala ithimba lakhe kwabangu-43 kubo.  Labe selidubula kokubili izigqulo namarokhethi kanye izibhamu kusukela kwakwakhe ophahleni.Kanye nokulwa ngokomzimba, u-Ahmad wayebuye abhekane nezokuxhumana nezwe langaphandle, kanye nendawo yokuxhumana yamabutho akhethekile ase- Afghanistan.Ngenkathi abokugcina bephakamisa ukuvinjezelwa kwabo ngo-Agasti 2015,Ahmad namasosha asindile angama-35 bakhishwa ngendiza enophephela emhlane yizindiza ezinophephela emhlane zase-Afghanistan nezaseNATO zayiswa eTarin Kowt .  Ngokusho kuka Samad, iziphathimandla "zincome yena nomshana wakhe uWasil njengamaqhawe."

Ukufa 
Ngemuva kokuvinjezelwa, u-Ahmad wabhalisa esikoleni ebangeni lesine, ngenkathi ethola nemfundo yangasese ekhaya.  Usithuthukisile isiNgisi sakhe, yize ebengeyena "umfundi onekhono" - mhlawumbe, umakhelwane wabe esephawula, ngoba "wayekhuthazwe kakhulu yizikhulu zamaphoyisa futhi wanikezwa nezindondo ngobuqhawe bakhe" futhi kuphela "wayefuna ukudlala ngezikhali nokushayela izimoto zamaphoyisa njengokuzilibazisa. " Wagunyazwa ukuphatha isibhamu esikoleni.NgoMsombuluko, ngo-February 1, 2015, ngesikhathi wendawo asempumalanga,esendleleni eya esikoleni,edutshulwa kabili ekhanda oshayasibhamu simaskwe e isithuthuthu drive-ngokudubula, kulokho okuye kwabizwa ngokuthi "ukubulawa okuqondisiwe".Kamuva washonela esibhedlela saseKandahar  wangcwatshwa emathuneni aseShahidano endawo. 
Abazalwa nge-2005
Abafa nge-2016

text:

Ukufa 
Ushone ngokuzumayo eGallen House Medical Centre, kwaBulawayo, ngomhlaka 18 Novemba 2015.

title: Themba Mabaso
text:
UThembinkosi 'Themba' Mabaso, iState Herald, noma iNational Herald, yaseNingizimu Afrika, ungumqondisi weBureau of Heraldry yalelo zwe.

Ngokubambisana noMkhandlu weHeraldry, ihhovisi lakhe liyingxenye yeNational Archives of South Africa, ngaphansi koMnyango Wezobuciko Namasiko.

Umsebenzi 
Ngaphambi kokuba ngummemezeli, isipiliyoni sobungcweti sikaMabaso besisezikhungweni zobuciko nasekugcinweni kwezobuciko okuhle.Ngo-1999 nango-2000, wayehlotshaniswa neGoli Art Gallery eGoli futhi engusihlalo weConseil International des Musées (International Council of Museums). 

Ngo-2002 uMabaso wangena esikhundleni sikaFrederick Brownell njengoState Herald waseNingizimu Afrika.Imisebenzi yakhe kubandakanya ukubhalisa amajazi ezikhali, amabheji ezimpawu , amafulegi nezimpawu. Ubuye futhi aluleke uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika, izinkampani nabantu ngabanye ngezindaba zekhambi, umfaniswano kanye ne- vexillology . 

UMabaso ubamba iqhaza emicimbini kahulumeni ebalulekile njengokugcotshwa kukaMongameli omusha waseNingizimu Afrika futhi umele iNingizimu Afrika emicimbini yomlando emhlabeni jikelele, njenge-XXVIIth International Congress of Genealogical and Heraldic Sciences eSt Andrews, eScotland, ngo-2006. Kulomcimbi, bobabili uMabaso nephini lakhe uMarcel van Rossum, bebegqoke amathebula abonisa umklamo osuselwe ezingubeni ezintsha zaseNingizimu Afrika ezamukelwa ngo-2000 futhi ezincike kubuciko bamaKhoisan .
Abantu baphilayo

title: Themba N. Masuku
text:
UThemba Nhlanganiso Masuku (owazalwa ngo-7 Julayi 1950)  ungusopolitiki waseSwazini osebenze njengePhini likaNdunankulu wase- Eswatini kusukela ngo-2018 nanjengoNdunankulu osabambile kusukela ngomhlaka 13 Disemba 2020 kuya ku-16 Julayi 2021.  Phambilini ubesebenza njengePhini likaNdunankulu kusuka ngo-2008 kwaze kwaba ngu-2013.

Isiqalo sokuphila 
UMasuku wazalwa ngomhlaka 7 Julayi 1950.Uthole iziqu zakhe zeMasters of Science e- University of Missouri.

Umsebenzi 
Ngawo-1990, wagcwalisa izikhundla ezahlukahlukene kuhulumeni waseSwaziland, kubalwa uNgqongqoshe Wezolimo Nemifelandawonye, uNgqongqoshe Wezokuhlelwa Kwezomnotho Nentuthuko, kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezezimali kusuka ngonyaka we-1996 kuya ku-1998.Ubuye wasebenza neFood and Agriculture Organisation yeZizwe Ezihlangene, njengomqondisi wamahhovisi okuxhumana eGeneva naseNew York kamuva. Waqokwa njengePhini likaNdunankulu ngonyaka ka-2008 yiNkosi uMswati III futhi wasebenza kuleso sikhundla kwaze kwaba ngu-2013, lapho eba ngumphathi wesifunda sesifunda saseShiselweni .

UMasuku ubuyele esikhundleni sakhe njengePhini likaNdunankulu ngenkathi uNdunankulu u- Ambrose Mandvulo Dlamini ethula iKhabhinethi lakhe ngoNovemba 2018.   Waba ngundunankulu osabambile ngemuva kokushona kukaDlamini ngomhlaka 13 Disemba 2020.  Ngokomthethosisekelo wase-Eswatini, uThemba Masuku bekufanele asebenze njengoNdunankulu osabambile isikhathi esiyizinyanga ezintathu.NgoJuni nangoJulayi 2021, phakathi kwesihluku samaphoyisa namasosha, uMasuku wagxekwa ngokuphatha kwakhe Imibhikisho yango-2021 Eswatini yokulwa nobukhosi. Kwisibaya mhla ziyi-16 kuNtulikazi ngo-2021, iNkosi uMswati ingene esikhundleni sikaMasuku yabeka uCleopas Dlamini njengoNdunankulu omusha.

title: Themba Matanzima
text:

Wazalwa ngomhlaka 2 Febhuwari 1953 eCofimvaba.Ujoyine iTranskei Defence Force ngoJanuwari 1977.

Umsebenzi wezempi 
UMatanzima wadlulisela kuMbutho Wezokuvikela Kazwelonke waseNingizimu Afrika ngokuhlanganiswa ngonyaka we-1994.Ngemuva kwesikhathi eseKomidini eliDidiyelwe Lokubumbana Lamasosha ebelibheka inqubo yokuhlanganiswa, wabe eseba nguGeneral Officer Commanding Eastern Province Command ngo-1996. Ngo-1998 waba yiNduna Yezabasebenzi.

Ngo-1999 waqokwa waba yiNhloko Yezabasebenzi wakhushulelwa esikhundleni sokuba ngu-lieutenant general. Ngo-2000, i-SANDF yahlela kabusha futhi yaqokwa esikhundleni esisha esasanda kwenziwa seChief of Joint Support.

Ngo-2004 waqokwa njengeChief of Corporate Staff kwaze kwaba ngu-2005, lapho eba yiChief Human Resources.

Waqoka uMphathi Wezokusebenza Ngokuhlanganyela ngomhlaka 1 Septhemba 1, 2007 ngemuva kokushona kukaLt General Sipho Binda engozini yemoto ngo-2006.

Ngo-2010 usebenze njengebamba likaNobhala Wezokuvikela kanye ne-Acting CSANDF kaningi.

title: Themba Nkosi
text:
USimon Majola (owazalwa ngo-1968), owaziwa nge- The Bruma Lake Killer, uyisigebengu saseNingizimu Afrika futhi ungumbulali obulalayo, yena kanye noThemba Nkosi, ababebhekene nokubulawa kwabantu okungenani abayisishiyagalombili endaweni eseduze neChibi iBruma eBruma, eGauteng. . UMajola unikezwe odilikajele abawu-8, kanti njengamanje uboshiwe.

Ukubambisana 
UMajola, indoda eshadile enezingane ezimbili, ubeseke wagwetshwa phambilini ngokugqekeza, ukushaya nokweba ngaphambi kokubulala.Ngesikhathi esephathini eHillbrow, wazakhela ubungani noThemba Isaac Nkosi, waseVosloorus .Ubudlelwano babo basheshe baphenduka obobugebengu, noMajola noNkosi babamba inkunzi babulala abantu hhayi eBruma Lake kuphela, kodwa naseRhodes Park, eBezuidenhout Park nase-Observatory Rift Park.

Ababulali 
Phakathi kuka-Ephreli 2000 noFebhuwari 2001, izidumbu zombhangqwana zaziphenduka echibini laseBruma. Ekuqaleni zazithathwa njengokuhlobene nezidakamizwa,izisulu ngokusobala zantshontshwa yonke imali, ubucwebe, amakhadi asebhange, izingubo nomakhalekhukhwini, ngaphambi kokuba kuboshwe amatshe noma izitini ezinyaweni zabo futhi ngemuva kwalokho, baminzaUMajola noNkosi babezohlala besebenza njengeqembu, besabisa ababezama ngabo ngemimese nangezibhamu.Babehlala behlasela abantu ngezikhathi zakusihlwa noma ebusuku kakhulu emicimbini noma ezindaweni zepikiniki, kuyilapho izisulu bezisezimotweni zazo. Izidumbu ezimbili bezisesimeni esithuthuke kakhulu sokubola kangangokuba bezingaziwa, kanti futhi namaphoyisa akholelwa ukuthi kungenzeka abengabokufika.  

Yize le micimbi yethusa abantu bendawo, yadala ukuthi izitolo zivalwe futhi ibhizinisi lilahlekelwe yimali eningi,  iningi lezigameko azikaze zibikwe kuziphathimandla, njengoba eminye yemibhangqwana ehlaselwe ibingabobulili obufanayo noma ibingafuni ukuveza obala.Ngokushoda kwanoma yiluphi uhlobo lobufakazi, kufaka phakathi izigxivizo zeminwe, leli cala labonakala linzima kakhulu, noma ngabe labe selinikezwa uSuperintendent Piet Byleveld, i-sleuth eyaziwayo ngezinga layo eliphumelelayo lokuxazulula amacala.

Ukuthwebula nokulingwa 
NgoFebhuwari 8, 2001, kwaboshwa amadoda amabili eKensington ngokutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni. Lawo madoda amabili kwakunguMajola noNkosi. Ngenkathi aziswa ngalokhu kuboshwa, uByleveld wavele washayela esiteshini ngenhloso yokuhambisa izigebengu eBrixton . Ngenkathi esemotweni ehlukile noNkosi, wabona lo muntu onemisipha, okwakungekude kangako ukuthi ubeyiqhude futhi ethatha ukuboshwa kwakhe njengehlaya, ngokuzumayo kwase kuqale ukuthuthumela. Kamuva, lapho bebuzwa ngokwehlukana, zombili izigebengu zavuma amacala azo, kufaka phakathi ezinye ezazingasolwa kuzo: kufaka phakathi abantu ababanjwa inkunzi eRhodes Park; ukubulawa kukamshumayeli wamaBaptist ngoMeyi 15, 2000 kanye nokubulawa komngani wakhe ngesikhathi kugqekezwa. UMajola noNkosi baphinde babulala noma yimuphi umuntu ohlanganyele naye othola ukuthi bakuphi, wababulala ngendlela efanayo naleyo abenza ngayo nezinye izisulu.UByleveld ukwazile ukubaxhumanisa nokubulala okungenani okungama-21 nokuzama ukubulala. 

Laba bobabili baquliswa icala ngoSepthemba 2002. Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka lolu hlelo, unina kaNkosi, uRuth Tshehlo, unxuse inkantolo ukuthi ibe nesandla enganeni yakhe “eyizibulo”, ngoba ubethembekile. Khonamanjalo, uMajola uwaphikile wonke amacala, esola ukulahlwa kwakhe yicala ngobukhulu babamhlophe . Azange asebenze amaqhinga obugebengu, njengoba uMajola alahlwa ngamacala angu-8 okubulala, ayi-19 okuphanga kuhlonyiwe, no-5 wokuzama ukubulala; ngenkathi uNkosi etholwa enamacala amane okubulala, ayi-14 okubamba inkunzi kuhlonyiwe, amahlanu okuzama ukubulala nelokushaya intombi yakhe eyayikhulelwe ngaleso sikhathi, uJabulile Lushaba, ayekade eziqhayisa ngokuba "yiBruma Lake Killer".  Bobabili bagwetshwa udilikajele.

title: Alfred Themba
text:
Alfred Bheki Qabula (1942-2002) kwaba imbongi, umbhali kanye ukuhwebelana wezinyunyana e Durban, South Africa ngo 1980.Wayengumshayeli wokuphakamisa imfoloko futhi eyisishoshovu kwi-Metal and Allied Worker's Union.UQabula waziwa kakhulu "njengembongi yomsebenzi" owayephethe ukuguqulelwa kwezinhlobo zezinkondlo zesiZulu zibe izingqikimba zempilo yansuku zonke.

I-Biography

Iminyaka yokuqala 
U-Alfred Themba Qabula wazalelwa eFlagstaff, eMampondweni (ingxenye yeNingizimu Afrika yanamuhla ngo-1942. Uyise wayengumsebenzi wasemayini ofudukayo owashona lapho u-Alfred esemncane kakhulu. 

Qabula kwaba obambe iqhaza kwi-1959 Pondoland Rebellion.Ngemuva kokuhluleka kwayo, wabalekela ehlathini, lapho ajoyina khona i- African National Congress.

UQabula wathuthela edolobhaneni elinezimayini zegolide iCarletonville wangena kwezentengiselwano yokwakha, ephila impilo encane emahostela nasezinkomponi zale ndawo.Wayesebenza njengomuntu osebenza ngempilo ngemfoloko futhi wayekhuthele kwi-Metal and Allied Worker's Union. 

Ngo-1969 uQabula wathuthela eThekwini, lapho aqala khona ukuhlala emjondolo e- Amaouti eNanda . Wahlala kulowo muzi kwaze kwaba ngu-1985. 

Kusukela ngo-1985 kuya ku-1988, uQabula waphoqeleka ukuba acashe ngenxa yokweseka kwakhe i- United Democratic Front, okuyinhlangano eyayilwa nokuqhubeka kohlelo lobandlululo eNingizimu Afrika.

Izinkondlo 
UQabula ubengumholi oqavile weDurban Workers Cultural Local, okuyiqembu eliqubule imisebenzi ebanzi yamasiko enhlanganweni yezinyunyana ngokuxhasa imidlalo yeshashalazi, ezomculo, nobuciko bemibhalo. Qabula walo wayenguNkulunkulu ngokwakhe at inhliziyo yalesi ukunyakaza njengoba revivalist we Zulu isibongo isiko senkondlo. 

UQabula uthathe lezi zinhlobo zezinkondlo zendabuko wajova izingqikithi ezivela empilweni yansuku zonke nasemsebenzini, ebhekana nezihloko zokusinda nokulwela ubumbano emsebenzini.

Ukufa nefa 
UQabula wahlaselwa yisifo sohlangothi okhubazekile ngo-1998 nokuhlaselwa okwesibili ngo-2002 ngaphambi kokuba ashone ngo-Okthoba walowo nyaka. 

Ngesikhathi sokushona kwakhe, imbongi yakuleli u- Ari Sitas yaphawula:"Njengoba uQabula eqhubekele phambili 'emazweni omoya onamandla,' akumele sikhohlwe ukuthi washona ebumpofu nokuthi amazwi akhe okugcina asephepheni, inkondlo eyodwa eqedile namane angaqediwe, angamazwi abhalwe umunyu. Waphoxeka kakhulu ngokuthi inguquko yakhe 'yathathwa ngumhlaba womakhalekhukhwini nezikhwama. Njengoba futhi ethola ukuthi amathalente akhe njengomuntu womlomo alahleka emoyeni wenguquko, lezi zinkondlo eziphazamisayo zandulela ukuthunjwa kwakhe.

 "Ngempela, akekho noyedwa kithi owasindiswa kulezi zinkondlo - 'Umgwaqo Omude' kusigxeka sonke endleleni yethu eya engcebweni nasemandleni, sigibela emhlane wakhe ngezicathulo ezinamahliphihliphi. I-His 'Of Land, Bones kanye neMali' kungenye yezindlela ezijule kakhulu zokuhlala kwethu okuxoxiswene ngakho - okusikhumbuza 'abafileyo abangenalutho.' Futhi lezo 'zikhathi zesomiso azinayo uthingo.' "

Imisebenzi 

 "Ukufa,"  iFlagstaff, uKhisimusi 1985.
 Black Mamba Rising: izinkomo zabasabenzi base South Africa emzabalatweni. Ngo-1986.
 Impilo Yokusebenza Enesihluku Ngaphandle Kokukholelwa. I-Culture and Working Life Project, eNyuvesi yaseNatali, ngo-1989. —Isikhumbuzo.
Abazalwa nge-1942

title: Sydney Barros
text:
USydney Barros (owazalwa ngoFebhuwari 21, 2005) ungumvocavoci wobuciko waseMelika futhi uyilungu leqembu lesizwe labesifazane lokuzivocavoca lase -United States. Ubeyilungu leqembu elidle ubhedu emcimbini wokuqala weJunior World Championship .

Isiqalo sokuphila 
UBarros wazalelwa uBifredo noCarine Barros e2005 e- Atlanta, Georgia . Unezelamani ezine.

Umsebenzi weGymnastics

AMATHEMBA

2016 
Ngo-2016 iBaros yayiyingxenye yohlelo lwe- HOPEs . Wancintisana ku-2016 HOPES Championship lapho abeka khona isibili kuyo yonke indawo ngemuva kukaKonnor McClain . Uthumele amaphuzu wesithathu aphakeme kakhulu ekuzivocavoca amagumbi naphansi.

UJunior Elite

2017 
Ngo-2017 uBarros wafanelekela isikhundla se-junior elite ku-KPAC National Qualifier. Ngasekupheleni kukaJulayi wancintisana e- US US 2017 lapho abeka khona u-18 kuyo yonke indawo.Wakufanelekela ukuncintisana kumaNational Championship ka -2017 lapho abeka khona ama-23 kuyo yonke indawo.

2018 
Ngo-2018 uBarros wancintisana ekamu lokuqinisekisa lapho abeka khona isine phakathi kwabancane ngemuva kukaSelisa Lee, uKayla DiCello, noJordan Bowers .Ngenxa yokusebenza kwakhe waqokwa eqenjini elalizoqhudelana kumaJunior Pan American Championship ; ngenxa yalokho wengezwe naseqenjini lesizwe elincane .Ngasekupheleni kwenyanga uBarros waya e-Italy ukuyoqhudelana kwi- 2018 City of Jesolo Trophy ehamba nozakwabo eqenjini lakhe uRagan Smith no- Emma Malabuyo . Ngenkathi elapho uBarros wayencintisana kuphela ekuzivocavoca phansi nasegumbini lokulala njengoba alimala iqakala kulokhu futhi washiya kulo mncintiswano osele.Ngenxa yokulimala waphinde wahoxa kwiPan American Championship. 

UBarros ubuyele emncintiswaneni wokuncintisana ku- 2018 US Classic ; kodwa-ke ubencintisana kuphela ngemigoqo engalingani nebhalansi, waqeda owesi-13 nowama-31 ngokulandelana.Uqhudelane nxazonke kumaNational Championship ka-2018 lapho ngemuva kosuku lokuqala ebekwe endaweni yeshumi nesikhombisa.Uhoxile osukwini lwesibili lomncintiswano.

2019 
UBarros uqhudelane eParkettes National Qualifier lapho aqede khona endaweni yesibili ngemuva kukaMjae Frazier waphinde waqeqeshelwa ukuba yi-elite elite.NgoJuni uBarros uqhudelane kumaJunior World Championships Trials lapho alala khona isithathu kuyo yonke indawo futhi waqokelwa eqenjini ukungenela umncintiswano wokuqala weJunior World Championship kanye noSkye Blakely noKayla DiCello.

KumaJunior World Championships uBarros usize iqembu lathola ubhedu ngemuva kweRussia neChina futhi laqeda endaweni yesihlanu kuyo yonke indawo. Ufanelekele umdlalo wamanqamu wokugcina endaweni yokuqala. Ngesikhathi sokugcina komcimbi uBarros wabeka indawo yesihlanu egumbini.

Waziwa kakhulu njengomnqobi weBerlin Marathon ka-1993.Kuma- Olimpiki asehlobo e-1992, wayengu-13 kumamitha wamadoda ayi-10,000. Wabuye wamela iNingizimu Afrika kuma- Olimpiki Asehlobo ngo-1996. Kuma- 1992 Championships e-Athletics, wawina iBronze kumamitha ayi-10000.

Emqhudelwaneni kazwelonke waseNingizimu Afrika, wawina lo mjaho wamamitha ayi-10 000 amahlandla ayisishiyagalolunye (1985-1990, 1992, 1994, 1996) neHalf marathon kabili (1986 no-1988).

title: Ingvil Aarbakke
text:
U-Ingvil Hareide Aarbakke (Julayi 26, 1970 - Novemba 23, 2005) wayengumculi waseNorway.Yena nomyeni wakhe Ion Sorvin wayewukuphela amandla ezihambayo ngemuva Copenhagen ezisekelwe collective N55 ngo-1994.

Impilo 
Wazalelwa eBergen, eNorway kubazali abafundile, wafunda eRoyal Danish Academy of Art eCopenhagen kusuka ngo-1991 kuya ku-1997.Uqhubekile waba nomthelela ezweni lobuciko laseScandinavia ngokusiza ekusunguleni, ngo-1994, iqembu lobuciko eliyi-N55 . Yethiwa ngokuyinhloko ngemva eCopenhagen latitude, N55 ladalwa namalungu ayo isigamu kweshumi ukwabelana isikhala lawo lokuphumula futhi ubambe zonke izinto babezihlanganyela, nge okungenani yangasese. I-N55 ibamba ukuthi izinto ezibonakalayo kufanele zabelwane futhi zilondolozwe ezinkingeni zobunikazi bangasese.  Umbukiso wokuqala kaN55 weza ngo-1996 embukisweni owawuseDenmark eLouisiana Museum of Modern Art, esenyakatho neCopenhagen, wokugubha unyaka wedolobha njengenhlokodolobha yamasiko aseYurophu.

Ukucabanga kuka-Ingvil Aarbakke lapha kwakhiwa yisazi sefilosofi saseDenmark uPeter Zinkernagel . Wonke umkhiqizo womsebenzi weN55 utholakala ngokukhululeka; izincwadi zabo, imanyuwali, ama-manifesto nezithombe zabo kungabonakala ku-inthanethi futhi akunamalungelo obunikazi. Umbhali onekhono, u-Ingvil Aarbakke ubhale iningi lamakhasi angama-400 eN55 Book  kanye nomyeni wakhe u-Ion Sørvin.

Ukufa 
Ukufa okuzayo kuka-Ingvil Aarbakke ngenxa yomdlavuza kwasondela ngaphandle kokubheka umhlangano. Kubikwa ukuthi wayeyisibonelo sokuzola.

Washiya umyeni wakhe, u-Ion Sørvin, nendodana yabo enonyaka ubudala, uFrode, nabazali bakhe nezingane zakwabo.

title: Lora Aborn
text:
Lora Aborn Busck (30 May 1907 - 25 Agasti 2005) lwakwazi American umqambi .

Impilo 
ULora Aborn wazalelwa eNew York City futhi waqala ukufunda upiyano, ithiyori yomculo nokwakhiwa e- Effa Ellis Perfield School of Music. Uqhubeke nokufunda upiyano nezwi eCalifornia futhi wadlala eqenjini le-jazz.Ufunde e- Oberlin Conservatory lapho afundela khona ukwakheka ngaphansi kukaDkt George W. Andrews.

U-Aborn uqhubeke nezifundo zakhe e- American Conservatory eChicago ngaphansi kukaJohn Palmer futhi wanikezwa indondo yegolide yokwakheka lapho ethweswa iziqu.Uqambe imisebenzi eminingi ethunyelwe, futhi umculo wakhe udlalwe waqoshwa e-United States, China nase-Europe.Wahlonishwa ohlwini lwabaqambi besifazane abaphambili baseMelika.

Kwaphela iminyaka eminingi, u-Aborn wayengu-organist, umqondisi womculo nomqambi wezindlu e- Unitarian Universalist Church, e-Unity Temple kaFrank Lloyd Wright.Washada noHarry Busck, umthengisi wezincwadi zakudala owafa ngo-1999,futhi waba namadodakazi amabili.  U-Aborn ushone ngo-Agasti 25, 2005, eChicago. 

Uhlobo oluthile inundu owayemuhle wayebizwa ngokuthi inundu Lora Aborn sika behlonipha wakhe.

Imsebenzi 
U-Aborn uqambe amabhalethi amahlanu aphelele, ama-opera amabili, asebenzela ikwaya yasekamelweni, ama-vocal solos nemisebenzi yamakhwaya.
 
Abafa ngo-2005
Abazalwa nge-1970

title: Abu Omar al-Kuwaiti
text:
U-Ahmad Nasser Eid Abdullah Al-Fajri Al-Azimi, futhi, u- Abu Omar Al-Kuwaiti no- Abu Zaid (1972 - 16 Febhuwari 2005) wayeyi- Kuwaiti futhi esolwa njenge-ejenti ye -al-Qaeda esebenza kuqala e-Afghanistan futhi kamuva e- Chechnya nase indawo ebanzi yeCaucasus.

I-Biography 
U-Abu Zaid wasebenza njengomlingisi waseKwaiti ezinhlelweni zezingane ze-TV, waze waphendukela enkolweni futhi waqala ukusebenza njenge- Imam eSafwan Bin Omayah Mosque yaseKuwait City, yize ngokushesha waxoshwa ngenxa yokuqoqa iminikelo ngokungemthetho kulabo ababehamba ngama-mosque.Ngo-1998 uqale waya e-Afghanistan lapho kubikwa ukuthi waqeqeshwa khona ekamu lokuqeqesha i -al-Qaeda Al Farouq, kwathi ngo-Okthoba 1999 wadlulela eChechnya.Wayesolwa nguhulumeni waseRussia ngokuhlasela kwamaphekula okuningi,kufaka phakathi ukubandakanyeka ekuhleleni inkinga yokubanjwa kwabafundi esikoleni iBeslan .  

Ngo-16 Febhuwari 2005, u-Abu Zaid washona ngemuva kokuba ezungezwe amabutho akhethekile aseRussia endlini yakhe ephephile e- Ingushetia .    Ubeshade nonkosikazi waseChechen, abenamadodana amabili asindile.

title: Nina Bari
text:
Nina Karlovna Bari (19 Novemba 1901 - 15 Julayi 1961) wayeyisazi sezibalo saseSoviet esaziwa ngomsebenzi wakhe ochungechungeni lwe-trigonometric .

Impilo yokuqala nemfundo 
UNina Bari wazalelwa eRussia ngomhlaka 19 Novemba 1901, indodakazi ka-Olga noKarl Adolfovich Bari, ongudokotela.Ngo-1918, waba ngomunye wabesifazane bokuqala ukwamukelwa eMnyangweni Wezemvelo Nezibalo eMoscow State University.Wathweswa iziqu ngo-1921 — eminyakeni emithathu nje kuphela ngemuva kokungena eyunivesithi. Ngemuva kokuthweswa iziqu, uBari waqala umsebenzi wakhe wokufundisa. Ufundise eMoscow Forestry Institute, eMoscow Polytechnic Institute, naseSverdlov Communist Institute .UBari wafaka isicelo futhi wathola okuwukuphela kobudlelwano bokucwaninga obukhokhelwe obunikezwe yi- Research Institute of Mathematics and Mechanics esanda kudalwa. Njengomfundi, uBari wayedonswa eqenjini eliphakeme elalibizwa ngeLuzitania — inhlangano engakahleleki yezemfundo nezenhlalo.Wafunda uchungechunge lwe-trigonometric nemisebenzi ngaphansi kokuqeqeshwa kukaNikolai Luzin, eba ngomunye wabafundi bakhe bezinkanyezi.  Wethula imiphumela esemqoka yocwaningo lwakhe kuMoscow Mathematical Society ngo-1922 — owesifazane wokuqala ukukhuluma nomphakathi.

Ukufa 
Ngo-15 Julayi 1961, uBari wazibulala ngokweqa phambi kwesitimela esasiza eMoscow. 
Abazibulalayo eRussia

title: Sergei Bobokhov
text:
USergei Nikolaevich Bobokhov (1858-16 Novemba 1889) wayengumshisekeli wezinguquko waseRussia,owazibulala njengombhikisho wokushaywa kowesifazane waseSiberia.

Wazalelwa emndenini ocebile waseRussia, wafundiswa esikhungweni sokuvivinya umzimba eSaratov, futhi ngesikhathi esemusha wajoyina inhlangano 'yabantu' lapho abantu abasebancane abaphakathi nendawo bevakashela amadolobhana benethemba lokuthuthukisa isimo sabalimi baseRussia.Ngokungafani nabanye abaningi, wayegwema ukuboshwa, kwathi ngo-1875 wangena eyunivesithi eSt-Petersburg, kodwa waxoshwa ngo-1876 wabuyiselwa eSaratov ngokuhlanganyela embhikishweni wabafundi. Ngonyaka olandelayo, wadingiselwa e- Arkhangelsk ngenxa yokusabalalisa inkulumo-ze yabantu.Uzamile ukweqa, kodwa wabanjwa emgwaqeni.Wayesolwa ngokudubula emaphoyiseni ngesikhathi eboshwa, yize athi wayedubule emoyeni, enethemba lokuthi uzoqulwa phambi kwabantu futhi azokwazi ukusebenzisa icala lakhe ukudalula ubushiqela bomthetho wamaTsarist.Ugwetshwe intambo yinkantolo yamasosha e-Arkhangel, kodwa ngenxa yobusha bakhe - wayeneminyaka engu-19 - isigwebo sehliselwa eminyakeni engu-20 besebenza kanzima eKara katorga .Uchithe iminyaka eyishumi endaweni yamacala eKara, esebenza ezimayini.Lapho ezwa ngokufa kwesiboshwa sezombusazwe uNadezhda Sigida, owayeshaywe imivimbo eyikhulu, wayengomunye weziboshwa zesilisa ezingama-20 ezazifaka ushevu ngokubhikisha, ngomhlaka 15 Novemba 1889.Iningi lasinda, kepha uBobokhov usweleke ngosuku olulandelayo.

Abazibulalayo eRussia
Abafa nge-1889
Abazalwa nge-1858

title: Aiza Gazuyeva
text:
U-Aiza Gazuyeva (1983 - Novemba 29, 2001) wayengowesifazane waseChechen, owayaziwa ngokuzibulala okwabulala uGeneral Gaidar Gadzhiyev, umphathi omkhulu webutho laseRussia, ngoNovemba 29, 2001.Yize ebenogqozi uqobo futhi engahambisani nezepolitiki, bekungelinye lama- shahidka (i-Chechen abesifazane abazibulala ngamabhomu ) aqala ukwenzeka eRussia, futhi uGazuyeva waba ngumuntu odume kancane phakathi kwemizwa elwa neRussia emphakathini waseChechen.

Ingemuva 
U-Aiza Gazuyeva (obuye ahunyushwe njengoGazueva futhi owaziwa ngokuhlukile njengo-Aizan, Elza, Luisa noma uLuiza ) kukholakala ukuthi wazalwa cishe ngonyaka we-1983, futhi eneminyaka ephakathi kwengu-18 noma engama-20 ubudala ngesikhathi sokufa kwakhe. Kubikwa ukuthi uGazuyeva wayelahlekelwe yizihlobo eziyi-16 eMpini Yesibili YaseChechen, kufaka nomyeni wakhe (ayeshade naye ezinyangeni ezimbili kuphela ngaphambili),abafowabo ababili nomzala.Umfowabo okhubazekile, owayelahlekelwe yimilenze yomibili ngenxa yamabhomu agqitshwayo eMpini Yokuqala YaseChechen,wadutshulwa wabulawa ngaphandle kwesizathu ngamasosha aseRussia aseduzane nomuzi wakubo.Umkhuzi wamasosha aseRussia kule ndawo, uGeneral Gaidar Gadzhiyev,wayengathandwa kakhulu kubantu bendawo futhi wayevame ukusolwa ngokwenza isihluku kubantu. Ngokusobala uGadzhiyev wayebize uGazuyeva, lapho abulala khona ngesihluku umyeni wakhe oboshiwe ngommese wase edonsela ikhanda lakhe enxebeni lesisu elalivulekile.Ngokusho kolunye uhlobo, ujenene utshele uGazuyeva ukuthi wabulala umyeni wakhe ngezandla zakhe ngesikhathi ephenywa.

Ukuhlasela 
NgoNovemba 29, 2001, uGazuyeva waya eqenjini lamasosha aseRussia kubandakanya uGeneral Gadzhiyev phambi kwehhovisi lomkhuzi wamasosha (Russian : komendatura).Kubikwa ukuthi amazwi akhe okugcina athi: "Uyangibona?" noma "Usangikhumbula?" uGadzhiyev waphendula wathi: "Anginaso isikhathi sokukhuluma nawe!" .  Ngemuva kwempendulo kajenene, uGazuyeva waqhumisa inqwaba yamabhomu esandla ayefihlwe ngaphansi kwezingubo zakhe. UGazuyeva nonogada ababili bakaGadzhiyev bashone ujuqu, kwalimala namanye amasosha amabili.UGadzhiyev, obegqoke ijakhethi ye-flak, walimala kanzima (kubikwa ukuthi walahlekelwa womabili amehlo nengalo eyodwa) futhi washona ngokulimala kwakhe ngemuva kwezinsuku ezi-1 kuDisemba.

Ngemuva 
Igagasi lokujeziswa okunzima ngamasosha aseRussia kwethulwe emndenini kaGazuyeva kanye nabantu bendawo.Amasosha aqhumise ikhaya likaGazuyeva nabazali bakhe, kanye nezindlu zeminye imindeni okungenani emine, ngenkathi amadoda amaningi omndeni wakwaGazuyev eboshiwe futhi eshaywa.Ngokushesha ngemuva kwalesi sigameko, abantu abangu-72 bavalelwa edolobheni i-Urus-Martan kanti abanye babo babikwa ukuthi banyamalala . Ngosuku olulodwa ngemuva kokushona kukaGadzhiyev, abantu abaningana bagcinwa esigodini sase-Alkhan-Yurt esifundeni i- Urus-Martanovsky District, kwathi abanye babo batholwa bebulewe. NgoDisemba 13, kwatholakala izidumbu ezonakele zamadoda amaningana abulawa ngamathuluzi aqhumayo eChechnya futhi kamuva zakhonjwa njengezakhamuzi zemizi emithathu esifundeni i-Urus-Martan ezazinyamalale ekuqaleni kukaDisemba, kufaka phakathi ezine ezaziphakathi kwababoshwe e-Alkhan-Yurt: ULom-Ali Yunusov, isihlobo sakhe uMusa Yunusov, uShamel Dzhemaldayev no-Aslan Taramov.
Abazibulalayo eRussia
Abafa nge-2001
Abazalwa nge-1983

title: Julius Janonis
text:
UJulius Janonis (4 Ephreli 1896 - 30 Meyi 1917) wayeyimbongi nombhali waseLithuania.Wazalelwa emndenini wabalimi abampofu, waqala ukubhala nokuhumusha izinkondlo eneminyaka eyi-14. Ukufunda kuMaironis, wabhala ngemvelo nokuhlupheka kwabampofu. Izinkondlo zakhe zokuqala zanyatheliswa ngo-1912.Ngenkathi esafunda, waqala ukunikela ngama- athikili emaphephandabeni aseLithuania futhi wajoyina imisebenzi ye-leftist aušrininkai. Wayengumbusi wentando yeningi kwezenhlalo kepha wayencike kakhulu ebukhomanisini kanti izinkondlo zakhe zaqhubeka nokuxokozela kwezepolitiki.Imibono yakhe iba nkulu kakhulu lapho ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe I ethuthelwa eVoronezh futhi kamuva nasePetrograd . Ujoyine iRussian Social Democratic Labour Party (bolsheviks) futhi waboshwa kabili ngenxa yezinguquko. Wangenwa isifo sofuba futhi, engathandi ukuba umthwalo, wazibulala eneminyaka engu-21. Kwi- SSR yaseLithuania,uJanonis udunyiswe "njengembongi yokuqala yabasebenzi bezikhundla ".
Abazibulalayo eRussia

title: Sergei Legat
text:
USergei Gustavovich Legat (    ; 27 Septhemba 1875 - 1 Novemba 1905) wayengumdansi we- ballet waseRussia .

Ingemuva 
USergei Gustavovich Legat wazalwa ngomhlaka 27 Septhemba 1875, eMoscow.Umfowabo omncane kaNikolai Legat, wafunda esikoleni sobukhosi se-ballet noPavel Gerdt, uChristian Johansson, uLev Ivanov nomfowabo. ULegat wajoyina iMariinsky Theatre ngo-1894 futhi ngokushesha waba ngumculi. Uthathekile ngemidlalo yakhe yesitayela futhi wafundisa, nabafundi kubandakanya uVaslav Nijinsky.I-Legat iqhamuke nendima ebibili yeNutcracker / i-Prince ku -ballet odumile kaTchaikovsky . Washada noMarie Petipa (1857-1930). Ukwahlukahluka okuningi kwamadoda okwakhiwa kokuphindaphindwa kwendabuko kwe-ballet yakhelwe ikakhulukazi kuye ekuqaleni kwekhulu lama-20.

Ukufa 
Ekugqashukeni koVukelo Lokuqala LweRussia, uLegat waxabana neziphathimandla, kwathi ngo-1 Novemba 1905, wazibulala eSt.Petersburg, wamshaya umphimbo ngensingo. 
Abafa nge-1905
Abazibulalayo eRussia

title: Yelena Miroshina
text:
U-Yelena Miroshina (Juni 5, 1974 - Disemba 18, 1995) kwaba umdivi wase Russia waziwa kakhulu ngokuwina kabili wendondo yegolide ngesikhathi Championships European e yabesifazane 10 m platform. nokuwina isiliva lama-Olimpiki e-Barcelona lapho ukutshuza kwakhe okunamandla kumthathe khona kusuka ku-8 ngemuva kwemizuliswano engu-4 yamanqamu kuya ku-2.

Umsebenzi

UMiroshina wancintisana kuma- Olimpiki Asehlobo amabili alandelanayo, futhi wamela amazwe amabili: iSoviet Union (1988) neQembu Elibumbene (1992). Wayesebenzisana noSpartak ngesikhathi esebenza.UMiroshina ubengumhlanganyeli omncane kunabo bonke phakathi kwabangu-89 (amadoda angama-49 nabesifazane abangama-40) abavela emazweni angama-31 eSeoul Games, neminyaka eyi-14 nezinsuku eziyi-105.

Ukufa
Ngo-18 Disemba 1995, uMiroshina oneminyaka engama-21 watholakala eshonile ngaphansi kwamafasitela efulethi lakhe eMoscow, lapho imbangela yokufa kwakhe ingaziwa. 
Abazibulalayo eRussia

title: Aleksandr Promptov
text:
Aleksandr Nikolaevich Promptov (obuye abhalwe ngokuthi Promptoff) (27 Juni 1898, Sevastopol - 11 November 1948, Koltushi) kwaba Russian nawaseSoviet sezakhi zofuzo futhi ornithologist ababefunda inyoni izingcingo, wenza okuqoshiwe futhi wasikisela indima ucule nokuziphatha todvwa futhi speciation .

Umsebenzi 
U-Promptov wazalelwa emndenini wesikhulu esiphezulu semali engenayo yaseRussia.Waya esikoleni eKostroma futhi waphumelela esikoleni sokuzivocavoca saseNechaev eMoscow. Noma esengumfana omncane, wayezithanda izinyoni kepha wakhetha ukwenza izifundo zoology yokulinga kune-ornithology.Kucatshangwa ukuthi ukukhetha kwakhe kungenzeka ukuthi kwasizwa izibopho zomndeni kuNikolai Koltsov Omama bakaPromptov noKoltsov babehlobene futhi uKoltsov wathonya iziphathimandla ukuthi zivumele uPromptov afunde izakhi zofuzo zezinyoni ngaphansi kuka- Alexander Serebrovsky, owayengumfundi waseKoltsov, kuphrojekthi exhaswa yi-People's Commissariat of Agriculture.
Abazibulalayo eRussia

title: Nadezhda Sigida
text:
UNadezhda Konstantinovna Sigida (née Malaxiano(1862-1889), wayeyinguquko yaseRussia, iqhawekazi lenhlekelele yeKara katorga yango -1889.

Ingemuva 
UNadezhda Malaxiano wazalelwa emndenini wamaGrikhi edolobheni laseTaganrog ngo-1862.Waphumelela eTaganrog Mariinskaya Girls Gymnasium, futhi wafundisa esikoleni sesonto. Umndeni ubuhlala endlini ekuGogolevski Street 8, eduze kwendlu yomndeni ka- Anton Chekhov.UNadezhda Malaxiano wazibandakanya neqembu iNarodnaya Volya, waba ngomunye wezishoshovu zalo eTaganrog 's printshop ngomshoshaphansi ngonyaka we-1885-1886 ku- Glushko Street 6.Wenza umshado wokukhohlisa no- Akim Sigida (1868-1888) ngomsebenzi wobumbano e-printshop.

Ngemuva 
Lo mcimbi uvuse ukusabela komphakathi. Imibiko ngezehlakalo zango-1889 yashicilelwa emaphephandabeni amakhulu aseRussia nawaseYurophu, kufaka phakathi izihloko ezimbili ephephandabeni laseBrithani iThe TimesNgenxa yalokho, uKara katorga wavalwa, futhi ukujeziswa ngomzimba kwabesifazane ababoshiwe nama- dvorianins (izikhulu) kwaqedwa ngumthetho kaMashi 28, 1893.
Abazibulalayo eRussia

title: Irina Slavina
text:
Articles with hCards

U-Irina Vyacheslavovna Murakhtaeva ; née Kolebanova ; 8 Januwari 1973 - 2 Okthoba 2020), owaziwa njengo- Irina Slavina, wayeyintatheli yaseRussia evela edolobheni laseNizhny Novgorod, umphakathi kanye nezombusazwe,futhi engumhleli omkhulu weKoza.Press.

Ngo-2 Okthoba 2020, washona ngokuzilimaza phambi kwesakhiwo soPhiko Olukhulu loMnyango Wezangaphakathi eRussia eNizhny Novgorod Oblast (maqondana nesiteshi sedolobha iGorkovskaya).

I-Biography 
U-Irina Vyacheslavovna Kolebanova wazalelwa eGorky (manje eyiNizhny Novgorod), e-USSR ngomhla ka-8 Januwari 1973.

U-Irina waphumelela eNizhny Novgorod State Pedagogical University ngo-1997. Kusuka ngo-1995 kuya ku-2003 wasebenza njengothisha wolimi lwesiRussia nezincwadi zaseRussia ezikoleni zaseNizhny Novgorod.Futhi, wafundela ubuntatheli e-University of the Russian Academy of Education (URAO), futhi kusukela ngo-2003 waba yintatheli.

Imisebenzi yobuntatheli 
U-Irina Murakhtaeva wasebenzisa igama lokuqamba u-Irina Slavina ngemisebenzi yakhe yobuntatheli.

Ukuzilimaza 

Ngo-2 Okthoba 2020, ngo-15: 30 (UTC +3), uSlavina wabulawa ngokuzilimaza phambi kwesakhiwo se-Main Directorate of the Ministry of the Internal Affairs of Russia for the Nizhny Novgorod Oblast.Ekubhaleni kwakhe kokugcina kuFacebook, uSlavina ucele ukuthi "kusolwe iRussian Federation ngokufa kwakhe".

title: Seraphim Znamensky
text:
USeraphim Ivanovich Znamensky (4 Septhemba 1906 - 7 Meyi 1942) wayengumgijimi webanga eliphakathi nebanga elide waseRussia.

Ingemuva 
UZnamensky wazalelwa emndenini wompristi futhi wayenodadewabo abane nabafowabo abahlanu; omunye wabo, uGeorgy, waba ngumlingani wakhe wokuqeqesha isikhathi eside futhi waba imbangi yakhe kwezokusubatha. USeraphim waqeqeshwa ngunina njengomculi; wayengumculi ophumelelayo futhi wayekwazi ukufunda nokubhala umculo weshidi.

Ukufa 
USeraphim wazibulala ngo-1942 ngemuva kokufunda ngokushona kukanina, kanti uGeorgy wabulawa ngumdlavuza ngo-1946.

Izinhlonipho 
Ngo-1949, kwasungulwa umncintiswano waminyaka yonke wezokusubatha wokuhlonipha abazalwane, i- Brothers Znamensky Memorial.Ngo-1958 yathola isimo samazwe omhlaba futhi kamuva yaba ngumhlangano omkhulu we-IAAF.   Ngo-1961 kwaqalwa isikole sezemidlalo sama-Olimpiki kanye nenkundla yezokusubatha ehambisanayo eMoscow futhi saqanjwa ngabazalwane.Umfanekiso waseSeraphim kaSarra Lebedeva ukhonjiswa eMnyuziyamu waseRussia.
Abazibulalayo eRussia
Abazalwa nge-1906

title: Owen Benjamin
text:
Owen Benjamin Smith (owazalwa 24 Meyi, 1980) kuyinto American alt kwesokudla internet ubuntu kanye nowabe ukuma-up nosomahlaya futhi umlingisi.Uqale umsebenzi wakhe njengomlingisi wamahlaya, enendima kumafilimu afaka iThe House Bunny ne- All's Faire in Love, nakuma- sitcom wethelevishini uSullivan & Son.Ngemuva kokulandela umsebenzi wakhe ekulingiseni waba ngusomahlaya ozimele. UBenjamin ubhekane nobunzima obukhulayo emibukisweni yokubhukha ngemuva kwezehlakalo eziningana, ezibandakanya ukuchaza umuntu "njengomuntu onukubeza ingane" ngokukhulisa ingane eyeqile kanye nokusebenzisa ubuhlanga.Imibono yakhe yezepolitiki yaba yimbi kakhulu, futhi waqala ukushicilela okuqukethwe okuningi kwezepolitiki online.Ku-2019, wayevinjelwe kumanethiwekhi amaningana omphakathi nezinkundla ezibandakanya i- Twitter, i- Facebook, i- Instagram, ne- YouTube ngokwephula izinqubomgomo zabo ngenkulumo enenzondo, futhi wathuthela ezisekelweni ezithe xaxa ze-alt-tech.

Isiqalo sokuphila 
UBenjamin wazalelwa uJohn Kares Smith noJean Troy-Smith, bobabili abangoprofesa e- Oswego State University.Ufunde ePlattsburgh State College, lapho abesebenza khona esiteshini se-TV esilawulwa ngabafundi.

title: Sikhanyiso Ndlovu
text:
USikhanyiso Ndlovu wayengusopolitiki waseZimbabwe owayenguNgqongqoshe Wezokwazisa Nokushicilela kusuka ngo-2007 kuya ku-2008.Wayephinde abe yilungu leZANU-PF Politburo.

Umsebenzi wezepolitiki 
Ngemuva kokusebenza njengePhini likaNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo,uNdlovu waqokwa njengoNgqongqoshe Wezolwazi nguMongameli Robert Mugabe ngoFebhuwari 6, 2007.

Ingqungquthela ye-EU-Africa 
UMongameli Mugabe wazuza ukuvukela umbuso ngoDisemba 2007 lapho aye engqungqutheleni ye-European Union - Africa naphezu kokuvinjelwa kwama-visa kuzikhulu zikahulumeni waseZimbabwe, kusukela ngo-2001.Rngqungqutheleni, uNdlovu ubize iKhansela u-Angela Merkel " ngensali yamaNazi ".Ephendula ngokugxekwa kukaMerkel ngokuhlukunyezwa kwamalungelo abantu eZimbabwe,uNdlovu wamtshela ukuthi "avale umlomo noma athumele ngaphandle," ethi iGermany idinga inhloko yezwe njengo-Otto von Bismarck.Ngesikhathi sengqungquthela wayesevele efakwe ezijezisweni zaseMelika nasezinhlwini zojeziso lwe- European Union.

Ukubheduka kwe-cholera 
NgoDisemba 12, 2008, ngemuva kosuku uMugabe athe uhulumeni waseZimbabwe uhlule ubhadane lwekholera,uNdlovu usole i-United Kingdom ngokuthi yiyona ebangele lokhu kuqubuka “kokucwasana ngokobuhlanga”obekuqonde ukubulala abantu baseZimbabwe.

Ukuxoshwa 
I-Herald yabika ngoMasingana 3, 2009, ukuthi uNdlovu waxoshwa kwiKhabhinethi ekuqaleni kwesonto,kanye nabanye ongqongqoshe abangu-11,ngoba wayengasenaso isihlalo ePhalamende.

Ukufa 
UNdlovu ungeniswe egunjini labagula kakhulu i-Intensive Care Unit (ICU) esibhedlela iMater Dei kwaBulawayo ngemuva kokuhlaselwa yisifo sohlangothi.Phambilini wayehlaselwe yi-Asthma.Ushone ekuseni ngovivi ngoSepthemba 15, 2015.Wayeneminyaka engama-78 ubudala. 
Abazalwa nge-1963

title: Moses Ndlovu
text:
UMoses Mzila Ndlovu uyisishayamthetho saseZimbabwe, umakadebona wempi yenkululeko yango-1970 futhi uyisifundiswa esesathatha umhlalaphansi.Uyilungu le- House of Assembly eBulilima West ( MDC-M ).

I-Biography 
Wazalwa ngo-1956 noma ngo-1957 esifundeni iBulilima (esaziwa nangokuthi iPlumtree) eduze nomngcele weZimbabwe neBotswana.UMzila, njengoba aziwa kanjalo, ukhulele esigodini saseThekwane waze waphothula izifundo zobuthisha eGwelo (manje eyiGweru) Teacher's College (GTC).Ngenkathi ese-GTC uMzila waqala ukusebenza kuligi yentsha yeZimbabwe African People's Union (ZAPU) (eholwa nguJoshua Nkomo).Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uMzila waphindela kwaBulawayo lapho afundisa khona ezikoleni eziningi okubalwa iSobukhazi High School.

Yilapho eseSobukhazi lapho uMzila anquma khona ukweqa umngcele angene empini.

Ufundele ezempi eSoviet Union, eCuba nase-Angola ngaphambi kokubuyela empini njengomkhuzi wamasosha eZimbabwe People's Revolutionary (ZIPRA) osebenza emingceleni yeZambia neZimbabwe.

Demobilization kanye nempilo yomphakathi 
Ekupheleni kwempi ngo-1980, edumele ngokuthi iZANU hhayi iZAPU ithathe izintambo, uMzila wabuyela ezweni, wehliswa ebusosheni waphinde waqala impilo yobuzwe.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka iGukurahundi, uMzila wayenguthisha emaphandleni aseMatebeleland ikakhulukazi eFatima, uRegina Mundi naseSt Paul bonke abaseLupane District.Njengo-ZIPRA owaziwayo impilo yakhe yayihlala isengozini kodwa njenge-ex-guerilla wayazi ukuthi angadlula kanjani ibutho elijwayelekile.Kungalezi zikhathi lapho abakha khona isibopho esiqine kakhulu nabalimi basemaphandleni njengoba ebabona behlukunyezwa ngenxa kanembeza futhi kaningi bebuhlanga.Kamuva, uMzila wayithuthukisa imfundo yakhe futhi waba ngumfundisi wasekolishi.Ufundise eHolideide Teacher's College, eGwanda ZINTEC (manje osenguJoshua Mqabuko Nkomo Polytechnic) nase-United College of Education (UCE).UMoses Mzila wafundisa iSociology of Education e-UCE futhi abafundi abaningi babemthatha njengomfundisi ovelele.Wayegcwele icharisma futhi izinkulumo zakhe zazithokozisa.Kwakungesikhathi sakhe njengomfundisi wasekolishi lapho asiza khona ekuguqulweni nasekuqiniseni iCollege Lecturers Association of Zimbabwe (COLAZ).ICOLAZ yaba yinxusa leZimbabwe Congress of Trade Unions (ZCTU) eyaba nomthelela omkhulu ekusungulweni kweMovement for Democratic Change (MDC) ngo-1999.

Ukhetho luka-2000 
UMzila ube yingxenye yeqembu labasebenzi bakahulumeni abalwela uhulumeni futhi bahlelela obala amaqembu aphikisayo. “Kuthe uma sekuhlelwe umhlangano wokuthi sihlangane nabafundi kanye nabafundisi e-UCE, ngaya khona nabanye futhi sathola ihholo ligcwele phama. Sahlala etafuleni eliphakeme salinda abasinikelayo ukuba basazise. Ngemuva kwesikhathi eside kutholakale ukuhleleka nokuzola, kungene le nsizwa ebonakala iyinsizwa… .. izacile futhi inde. Ngokuphazima kweso ihholo lonke lathuka futhi lahlekiswa futhi wonke umuntu wahamba ngogesi. Uqale ingoma wonke umuntu esina. Ekupheleni komhlangano wazethula kithi. Kamuva ngaya ehhovisi futhi ngahlangana nePhini likaMongameli (ongasekho uGibson Sibanda) ngathi kuye 'Ngahlangana nensizwa e-UCE yangishaya njengomuntu ongasisiza ekutholeni izihlalo futhi ngiyaqonda ukuthi ubekwenza sebenza futhi ePlumtree. Konke okumele ukwenze ukumhlelela imihlangano eminingi futhi nginesiqiniseko sokuthi uzoziculela yena ePhalamende '. Ngaleso sikhathi ngangingalwazi uhlangothi lwayo lokuqonda nolwangithusa kakhulu lapho ngizwa ngalo ", kulandisa uSolwazi Welshman Ncube (manje onguMongameli weMDC kanye noNgqongqoshe kaHulumeni). Ngokunjalo, uMzila waphikisana nesihlalo sePhalamende saseBulilimamangwe South ngaleso sikhathi okhethweni lukaFebhuwari 2000 ngethikithi le-MDC wanqoba. Usigcinile leso sihlalo kuze kube manje.

Ubuholi beqembu 
UMzila wayezoba ngumuntu onethonya ku-MDC ngaleso sikhathi. Uqokwe njengosihlalo wesifundazwe sangakubo iMatebeleland South, okuyisikhundla esimenze waba yilungu leNational Executive Committee neNational Council yeqembu. Igama lakhe kungekudala laba uphawu lokuhlanganisa abantu abaningi kangangoba ngaphansi kobuholi bakhe, iqembu lakhe, ngaphambi nangemuva kokwehlukana, lihlale lithola izihlalo eziningi esifundazweni sakhe. Ingoma yakhe yophawu lokuhweba ethi 'Guerilla ilanga litshonile solalaphi' nekhodi yokugqoka kaFidel Castro kungekudala yaba yizimpawu zokumelana nokunqoba ekucindezelweni kombuso eMatebeleland South. Ezingeni likazwelonke uMzila waqokwa njengoNobhala Wezobudlelwano Namazwe Omhlaba eqenjini. Lesi sikhundla nokho samfaka ezingxabanweni ezehlukene ngezikhathi ezithile noMeluleki kaMongameli Wezobudlelwano Namazwe Omhlaba ongasekho uSolwazi Eliphas Mukonoweshuro. Ngasekuqaleni kuka-2004, kwavela udlame lokusebenzisana nabantu kwiMDC. Izishayamthetho ezinjengo-Edwin Mushoriwa (manje oyiPhini likaMongameli weMDC) noPriscilla Misihairabwi-Mushonga (manje onguNobhala-Jikelele weMDC kanye noNgqongqoshe kaHulumeni) nabanye abaholi bezwe abanjengoFrank Chamunorwa (manje oseyiphini likasihlalo weMDC) noShupikai Mandaza bonke bahlaselwa yintsha yeqembu ebelihlomile. Ikhomishini yophenyo eyakhiwe u-Advocate H. Zhou, uSenator ongasekho u-Enna Chitsa noMzila phakathi kwabanye yabekwa ukuba iphenye izimbangela nobungako bengxabano. Izishoshovu zeqembu ezaziwayo ezifana noGeorge Kawuzani ongasekho, uBertha Chokururama noTonderai Ndira phakathi kwabanye badonselwa phambi kweKhomishini kaZhou. Kwabhalwa, kwaqoshwa amavidyo futhi kwathunyelwa kuMongameli obumbene weMDC uMorgan Tsvangirai (manje osenguNdunankulu waseZimbabwe). "Ngemuva kokuthola okutholakele kwethu uTsvangirai ushaye ucingo wathi" ufanelwe inhlonipho yami. Lezi zinhlobo zokuvuma izono yilokho i-CIO (Central Intelligence Organisation) ebikufuna futhi ukube babekubeka izandla lokhu wawungeke wephulwe empilweni yakho ", kusho uMzila echaza ubuqotho nemfihlo abenza ngayo ikhomishini. "Angiqondi ukuthi kungani engazinaki izincomo zethu", uyanezela. Ngemuva kodumo lwango-12 Okthoba 2005 iMDC yahlukana noMzila wahamba neqembu 'le-pro-Senate' lapho agcina khona zombili izikhundla zikaSihlalo weMatebeleland South Provincial kanye noNobhala Kazwelonke Wezobudlelwano Namazwe. Wabamba lezi zikhundla ezimbili kwaze kwaba nguJanuwari 2011 lapho iCongress yamkhetha khona esikhundleni sokuba yiPhini likaNobhala-Jikelele.

Umsebenzi wokumela 
Kulo lonke elaseZimbabwe, uMzila usephenduke ubuso bendalo ekulweleni iqiniso, ubulungiswa nokubuyisana kwabahlukunyezwayo kanye nabenzi besihluku seGukurahundi. Lokhu ukuzuze ngokuhlanganisa imiyalezo engaguquguquki futhi ephikelelayo eseyiphawulekile emakhelini akhe kungaba emihlanganweni, emingcwabeni, emisebenzini yesonto, emihlanganweni yomphakathi ngisho nasePhalamende. Ukungaguquguquki kwakhe kumzuzele izimemo zokukhuluma ezinkundleni ezahlukene ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweZimbabwe ngakolunye uhlangothi, kanti ngakolunye uhlangothi umbeka ekuhlaselweni abaphikisi bezepolitiki kanye nochungechunge lwezicupho zombuso ekugcineni okuholele ekuboshweni kwakhe ngomhlaka 16 Ephreli 2011 eLupane. Futhi, ngokungangabazeki, ukungaguquguquki kwakhe okwamenza waba ngumlandeli wemvelo kamufi uGibson Sibanda njengoNgqongqoshe Wezwe ku-Organ for National, Healing, Reconciliation and Integration (ONHRI).

Umsebenzi kahulumeni 
Ngo-25 Febhuwari 2009, uMzila wafungiswa njengePhini likaNgqongqoshe Wezangaphandle. Ubezoba yiPhini likaSimbarashe Mumbengegwi weZANU PF, indoda abezoyichaza 'njengomuntu obesebenza kabi'. Ngaleso sikhathi uMzila wayesabambe isikhundla sikaNobhala Wezobudlelwano Namazwe Omhlaba eqenjini lakhe futhi ukuqokwa kwakhe njengePhini likaNgqongqoshe Wezangaphandle bekungaba umdlalo omuhle ukube wayengekho 'nalowo ayesebenza naye kabi'. Kodwa-ke uzame ngakho konke okusemandleni akhe ukudala ubudlelwano bezenhlalo namasiko phakathi kwabaculi baseZimbabwe basemakhaya kanye ne-Afrika okuholele ekuvakasheni kweMokis Connection (iqembu lomculo wasemakhaya iBulilima) e-Algeria.

Ngemuva kokushona kukaGibson Sibanda ngo-Agasti 2010, uMzila wangena esikhundleni sakhe njengoNgqongqoshe Wezwe ku-Organ for National, Healing, Reconciliation and Integration. Kweminye imigwamanda engaphansi kukahulumeni, uMzila usebenza njengomunye wabaxoxisana abayisithupha eSivumelwaneni Sezombusazwe Somhlaba kanye nelungu lekomidi labaphathi beKomidi LePhalamende loMthethosisekelo omusha (i-COPAC).

Ukuboshwa, ukuhlukunyezwa nokuvalelwa 
Ngomhlaka-16 Ephreli 2011, eseshayela eyokwethula inkulumo emhlanganweni womphakathi owawuseVictoria Falls ngokumenywa yi-Uluntu Ciisi Trust, ngemuva nje kokudlula emagcekeni lapho kukhonjwe khona inxanxathela kaHulumeni waseLupane wamiswa ngumgwaqo wamaphoyisa. Amaphoyisa amancane ameluleka ngokuthi abaphathi bawo abasekamu bathumele yena futhi kumele adlule.

Owayengumpi wayezobungaza i-31th Independence yezwe namanye amasonto ukulandela ngemuva kwezinsimbi nokufuna kanzima ubulungiswa. Ubebekwa icala lokwephula umthetho odumile weCriminal Law (Codification) neReform Act ngokuya emhlanganweni wokukhulekelwa esontweni eSilwane Primary School eLupane nokukhuthaza ababekhona ukuthi bakhulume ngokukhululeka ngezikhalazo zabo. Kodwa-ke ubugebengu obukhulu futhi bangempela isitayela sakhe sobuholi. Kungekudala ngemuva kokuqokwa kwakhe ngo-Okthoba 2010, uMzila wethula indlela entsha egxile kubantu emsebenzini we-ONHRI. Uqale ukuya emihlanganweni yomphakathi kanye nasemibuthanweni yamasonto ezindaweni zasemakhaya ekhuthaza izisulu zonya ukuba zikhulume ngokusobala ngezinkinga zazo futhi zinikeze nezixazululo zazo. Lokhu kucasule umbuso kwenziwa nenqwaba yeziza ezibhekiswe kuye. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukumncisha uphethiloli ukusuka eHarare elibangise eMatebeleland, angene ehhovisi lakhe, aboshwe ngomhlaka 16 Ephreli 2011, ukuhlukunyezwa nokululazwa okwalandela kanye nemibandela yebheyili yobudlwangudlwangu abe esephikisana nayo wayinqoba.

UMzila akasiye umfokazi ekuboshweni nasezitokisini. Ngaphambi kokuboshwa kuka-16 Ephreli ubedonse isigwebo sezinyanga eziyisithupha ejele elaziwa kakhulu iKhami Maximum. Lesi sigwebo safika ngo-2003 ngesikhathi umbuso ubophezela abaholi beMDC bebasola ngodlame, ukuvukela umbuso, ukushisa namanye amacala. “Ngazithola ngisesitokisini esincane sejele esigcwele abantu abasha abaseminyakeni engamashumi amabili futhi bangibuka ngobuso engangifunda ukuthi bathi 'ifunani lapha lendoda empunga?' . Abanye basheshe baqaphela ukuthi ngingubani futhi sachitha ubusuku obuningi sicula izingoma zenkululeko. Ukucindezela futhi kungalibaleki njengoba kwakunjalo, lesi yisipiliyoni esivuselele umoya wami wokulwa ", uyachaza. Ngenkathi ebheyili kulandela ukuboshwa kuka-Ephreli 16, uMzila wavalelwa isikhashana kanye noProf. UNcube, Misihairabwi-Mushonga, Paul Themba Nyathi, uNobhala Jikelele Wentsha uDescent Collins Bajila nabanye abaholi beMDC abayishumi nesithupha ngemuva kokuhambela umhlangano wendlu obuseVictoria Falls.

title: Hastings Ndlovu
text:
UHastings Ndlovu (1961 - 16 Juni 1976) wayengumfana wesikole owabulawa ngesikhathi kuvukelwa umbuso waseSoweto ngenqubo yobandlululo eNingizimu Afrika .

Impilo 
Ngo-16 Juni 1976, ngesikhathi amaphoyisa avela esiteshini samaphoyisa e-Orlando eholwa nguColonel Kleingeld evulela ngenhlamvu kubafundi baseSoweto bebhikishela ukuphoqwa kokufundiswa ngesiBhunu esikoleni, waba ngowokuqala ukushaywa.Ukushona kukaNdlovu akuzange kumenyezelwe kabanzi njengokufa kukaHector Pieterson ngoba akekho umthwebuli wezithombe obekhona ukuyiqopha. UKleingeld uthe kwiKhomishini kaCillie uHastings "ugqugquzela isixuku".Kunokungabaza ukuthi ngubani owashona wokuqala, njengoba uPieterson kwathiwa ushonile ngesikhathi efika emtholampilo, kanti uNdlovu wabulawa ngamanxeba enhlamvu ekhanda ngemuva nje kokulethwa emtholampilo.

UNdlovu ushiye emhlabeni ngabazali bakhe, odadewabo abathathu nomfowabo.Odadewabo balishiya leli ngemuva nje kukaJuni 16, kodwa babuyela eGoli ngemuva kweminyaka embalwa.

Ifa 
UNdlovu wangcwatshwa noPieterson emathuneni ase- Avalon eGoli.Indlu yakhe eSoweto yayinophawu oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka oluhlanganiswe nayo ngomhlaka 16 Juni 2012 ukukhumbula ukuzidela kwakhe.

title: Dudu Mntowaziwayo Ndlovu
text:
UDudu Mntowaziwayo Ndlovu (25 Disemba 1957 - 4 Meyi 1992), owayedume ngelikaDudu Zulu, wayengumdansi wamaZulu, owayeshaya izingoma, futhi ecula namaqembu aseNingizimu Afrika iJuluka kanye (kamuva) noSavuka.UNdlovu udanse nozakwabo uJohnny Clegg iminyaka eminingi, esiteji nasemigwaqweni yaseSoweto naseJeppestown . 

NgoMeyi 1992, ngenkathi eya kwakhe eSiphongweni esuka komakhelwane, uDudu wadutshulwa wabulawa eseduze.Lokhu kuhlasela kwenzeke emzileni othuli ngaseGreytown KwaZuluNatal.Akuqiniseki ukuthi uNdlovu wayehlosiwe yini, noma wayephutha ngomunye umuntu.Ezinye izakhamizi zidutshulwe "ngephutha" empini yamatekisi yasendaweni. 

Ngonyaka olandelayo,uJohnny Clegg noSavuka baqopha i-albhamu yokugcina ndawonye:Heat, Dust and Dreams.UClegg unikele ngevidiyo yomculo ethi "The Crossing (Osiyeza)",iculo eliku-albhamu, wayibhalela uNdlovu.
Abaculi baseNingizimu Afrika

title: Dino Ndlovu
text:

Ndlovu ekudumisa kusuka eJouberton eduze Klerksdorp.Ngesikhathi esemncane, uNdlovu waqala ukudlala ibhola emigwaqweni kwathi lapho eneminyaka eyishumi nesithupha, wanikwa ithuba lokujoyina i-Academy of Excellence.Kwakufanele enqabe lelo thuba, nokho ngoba lalizoshiya unina yedwa ekhaya.Kamuva waya eGoli lapho ayelala khona egumbini lokugezela esiteshini sesitimela izinsuku ezintathu ukuze ahambele izivivinyo zebhola nePlatinum Stars.Wanikezwa inkontileka yiqembu futhi waqala wahlaba umxhwele phambi kwamapali ezingeni lentsha.Ifomu lakhe lacwila kungekudala ngemuva kwalokho, njengoba umthombo omusha wemali waqala ukusebenza njengesiphazamiso kwathi iPlatinum Stars yakhetha ukungayivuseleli inkontileka yakhe ngo-2011.Ngaleso sikhathi wayengumondli womndeni wakhe, owawuhlanganisa nonkosikazi wakhe owayekhulelwe.

title: Kundai Benyu
text:
UKundai Leroy Jeremiah Benyu (owazalwa ngomhlaka 12 Disemba 1997) ungumdlali webhola lezinyawo odabuka eZimbabwe odlala njengomdlali wasesiswini kuVestri .

Isiqalo sokuphila 
UBenyu wazalwa ngabazali baseZimbabwe ngomhlaka 12 Zibandlela 1997 eCamden Town, eLondon . Wakhulela eHarlow, e-Essex.

Umsebenzi weklabhu

Idolobha lase-Ipswich 
UBenyu ujoyine i- Ipswich Town eneminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye,esayina inkontileka yakhe yokuqala yobungcweti ngemuva kokuhlanganisa iminyaka engu-17.

I-Aldershot Town (imali mboleko) 
Ngo-7 Disemba 2016, uBenyu wajoyina i- Aldershot Town ngesivumelwano semalimboleko senyanga eyodwa.Imalimboleko yabe seyelulwa kaningi, kwavumela uBenyu ukuba aqede isizini ka-2016-17 neqembu leNational League.

Celtic 
Ngo-29 Juni 2017, kwamenyezelwa ukuthi uBenyu usayine inkontileka yeminyaka emine neCeltic.Umdlali wasesiswini ushaye igoli ngesikhathi ebonakala okokuqala eqenjini elithuthukisa iqembu, emdlalweni wobungani belungiselela isizini ne-East Kilbride.UBenyu udlale umdlalo wakhe wokuqala wokuncintisana ngesikhathi iCeltic inqoba ngo 4-0 kuLinfield eCeltic Park.

title: Hardlife Zvirekwi
text:
UHardlife Zvirekwi (owazalwa ngomhlaka 5 Meyi 1987) ungumdlali webhola lezinyawo waseZimbabwe, odlala njengomdlali wasemuva weCAPS United neqembu lesizwe laseZimbabwe.

Umsebenzi

Iklabhu 
Zvirekwi waqala ibhola lakhe ne Gunners futhi wayinqoba Premier Zimbabwe Soccer League Isihloko 2009 njengoba Gunners eseqedile amaphuzu amahlanu ukusula ka neDynamos.Uhlale engumdlali weGunners iminyaka emine isiyonke waze wahamba ngo-2013 wajoyina iCAPS United.NgoJanuwari 2016, uZvirekwi wasayina isivumelwano seminyaka emithathu neCAPS Utd.

Okwamanye amazwe 
UZvirekwi udlale umdlalo wakhe wokuqala eZimbabwe ngowezi-9 kuNhlangulana 2013 ngesikhathi ehlulwa ngo- 2--4 bebhekene ne-Egypt emdlalweni wokuhlungela iNdebe yoMhlaba ka-2014.Eminye imidlalo emibili eyilandele lapho ibhekene neMozambique neNingizimu Afrika ngo-2013.NgoJanuwari 2014, umqeqeshi u-Ian Gorowa, wammema ukuba abe yingxenye yeqembu laseZimbabwe elizodlala ku- 2014 African Nations Championship.Usizile iqembu laqeda endaweni yesine ngemuva kokuhlulwa yiNigeria ngegoli eqandeni.

Ukuvela okuyisithupha kulandelwe ku-2014 African Nations Championship.UZvirekwi kudingeke ukuthi alinde eminye iminyaka emibili kuze kuphele umdlalo wakhe olandelayo eZimbabwe ngesikhathi eqokelwa i- African Nations Championship ngo-2016, wadlala kuyo yomithathu imidlalo yaseZimbabwe kulo mqhudelwano.

Impilo yomuntu siqu 
NgoMashi 2018, uZvirekwi wanqunywa isandla sobunxele odokotela abahlinzayo kulandela ukushayisana kwemoto eHarare.

title: Ndaba Mandela
text:
UNdaba Thembekile Zweliyajika Mandela (owazalwa ngomhlaka 23 Zibandlela 1982) ungumbhali, umeluleki, umkhulumeli, usomabhizinisi, umeluleki wezepolitiki futhi ungumzukulu kaNelson Mandela.Wazalelwa eSoweto, eNingizimu Afrika.

UMandela njengamanje ungumsunguli kanye nosihlalo weMandela Institute for Humanity 

Uyasebenza ukugcina umlando kamkhulu wakhe uphila, futhi wethula uNelson Mandela esizukulwaneni esisha. Ungumsunguli futhi ungusihlalo obumbene we-Africa Rising Foundation. Futhi ungumsunguli weMandela Project. Wayeyingxenye yeqembu leMandela Centenary ngo-2018.

Uyilungu loMkhandlu Wentsha wePan-African osebenzisana kakhulu ne-African Union.

Ungummeli omude kunabo bonke osebenza emhlabeni jikelele we- UNAIDS, i-ejensi ekhethekile yeNhlangano Yezizwe ekhankasela ukuqeda ubhadane lwe-HIV / AIDS. Bobabili abazali bakhe babulawa yilesi sifo.

Isiqalo sokuphila 
UNdaba Mandela wazalelwa emndenini wezikhulu.Umkhulu wakhe u-Nelson lalibonisa ozalweni nemicengezi of kingship of Thembu abantu futhi indlalifa ebukhosini ka eMvezo ngo ilungelo lakhe. Isithunzi sakamuva siphethwe ngumfowabo omdala kaNdaba uMandla .

Ngaphandle kwalokhu, uNdaba wakhulela kulokho okungabizwa ngokuthi yikhaya elibhidlikile.Ubaba wakhe uMakgatho Mandela wakhula engenaye ubaba. UNelson Mandela waboshwa ngenkathi umndeni wakhe usakhula, futhi waba ngumuntu ohamba emgwaqweni eSoweto.Ngemuva kokuzalwa kukaNdaba, umndeni wakhe wathuthela e-Eastern Cape.Uchithe iminyaka yokuqala yokufunda kwakhe edolobheni elincane elibizwa ngeCofimvaba .Wayeneminyaka eyisikhombisa lapho ehlangana nomkhulu wakhe uNelson Mandela.UMandela wayeboshwe eRobben Island.UNdaba wayeneminyaka eyishumi nanye ngenkathi ezohlala nomkhulu wakhe. Uchithe amashumi amabili eminyaka ehlala naye - enakekelwa, bese enakekela umkhulu wakhe. 

Ngokwesiko lamaXhosa abafana abaphakathi kweminyaka engu-18 no-21 bayiswa ezintabeni bayosokwa. UNdaba wayeneminyaka engama-21 ngesikhathi esokwa.Bafundiswa izindima nezibopho zabo ekubeni ngamadoda.Iqhaza nezibopho ezibandakanya ukushada, ukuba yindoda, ubaba, nokuba nekhaya lakho.

Umsebenzi 
UNdaba ubephuma phambili kwezesayensi yezepolitiki nobudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba e- University of Pretoria eNingizimu Afrika.

Usebenze kwiNxusa laseJapan njengomxhumanisi wezepolitiki.

I-Africa Rising yasungulwa ngenhloso yokuqhakambisa isithombe esihle nge-Afrika. UNdaba ubhalwe kwi- BET ku-inthanethi lapho ebekhuluma ngesisekelo sakhe, i-Africa Rising. UNdaba uthi isisekelo sakhe sihlose ukuqhakambisa isithombe esihle nge-Afrika ngezinhlelo, amafilimu, abezindaba nokuxhumana nabantu, ukuguqula imicabango yabantu abasha base-Afrika kanye nomhlaba wonkana.

Ngo-2014 uNdaba waqokwa njengomunye “wama-28 Men of Change”, yiBET. IMen of Change ihlonipha iNyanga Yomlando Omnyama yaseMelika. Ihlonipha amadoda aMnyama aphumelele ezimbonini noma kumaphrojekthi aqhakambisa ubuhlakani babantu abamnyama.

Washicilela incwadi yakhe yokuqala ngoJuni 2018 enesihloko esithi Going to the Mountain: Life Lessons from My Grandfather, uNelson Mandela.Uthi umkhulu wakhe wamfundisa ukuzakhela amafa kanye nokubuyisela emphakathini.UNdaba usho ngencwadi yakhe, ukuthi uthathe izifundo zokuphila umkhulu wakhe amfundise zona kanye nezinye zakhe ukuzidlulisela kubalaleli abasebancane.Ukuze abantu baqonde izindinganiso zikayisemkhulu.

Ngo-2018 uNdaba wabambisana noPrince Harry, noSir Elton John ukwenza umkhankaso wokuqwashisa nge- HIV ne-AIDS.Baqale umkhankaso womhlaba wonke engqungqutheleni yama-22 yamazwe omhlaba yengculazi e-Amsterdam.Engxoxweni abe nayo neHill eLibrary of Congress, ngoJuni 2018, uNdaba ucashunwe ethi kungani abhala le ncwadi, “Bengifuna abantu bazi uNelson Mandela ngaphandle kokuba yisishoshovu sezwe, ngaphandle kokuba ngumholi omkhulu lo abamaziyo nokumazi nje ezingeni lomuntu njengogogo. "

Izilinganiso 
"Kumele sihlukane nemibono eyiphutha ekhona ezungeze i-Afrika.I-Afrika akuyona nje indawo yezimpi, ubuphofu, izifo kanye nomashiqela. I-Afrika yindawo yokuzalwa kobuntu. "

"Anginaso isineke sakhe ngaso sonke isikhathi. Bengingeke ngichithe iminyaka engamashumi amabili neskhombisa ejele bese ngixola izitha zami ngendlela enza ngayo.Kodwa ngifunde lukhulu kuye futhi ngiyakholelwa ukuthi wabona indoda enhle kimi.Ngingase ngingakwazi ukuhamba ezinyathelweni zikaNelson Mandela, kodwa sonke singahamba ekukhanyeni kwakhe. "

“Umhlaba ubheka kakhulu iNingizimu Afrika njengezwe okulindeleke ukuthi lizimele phezu kwezindinganiso zokuziphatha kanye nokuziphatha okuhle, ngoba siyizwe elikhiqize lesi sithombe somhlaba wonke. Kodwa ugogo wayehlale esifundisa ukuthi sizenzele umlando. ” Ndaba Mandela.
Ababhali baseNingizimu Afrika

title: Jorge Acuña
text:
UJorge Cristian Acuña Concha (owazalwa ngo-31 Ntulikazi 1978 e-Ovalle ), owaziwa ngegama lakhe lesidlaliso uKike Acuña,ungumphathi webhola laseChile futhi owayengumdlali webhola lezinyawo. Wayengumdlali wasesiswini.

Umsebenzi weklabhu 
Wazalelwa e- Ovalle, esifundeni se-IV saseCoquimbo, e-Acuña wajoyina iqembu laseSantiago- elisisekelo leklabhu yase- Unión Española lapho kwamiswa khona eqenjini labantu abadala lokuqala ngo-1999.Ngemuva kokuchitha isizini nabaseSpain, ngoJanuwari 2000, wathuthela endlini yamandla iUniversidad Católica lapho asiza khona iklabhu ukunqoba i-2002 Torneo Apertura,waba ngukhiye odlala phambili ekuzuzeni isihloko.

Ngo-2002, u-Acuña wasayina inkontileka neqembu laseDashi iFeyenoord .Ngemuva komdlalo weFeyenoord Reserve ngomhlaka 15 Ephreli 2004, yena nabanye abadlali beFeyenoord, kuhlanganisa noRobin van Persie, bahlaselwa yizigebenga ze-AFC Ajax.U-Acuña uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela elimele ekhanda, entanyeni nasezimbanjeni.Ngemuva kwalokho wajoyina isikweletu kuRBC Roosendaal ukuyodlala isizini ka-2005-06 ye-Eredivisie.Ngemuva kokuphothula ukubonakala kweligi okungama-24, u-Acuña waqeda ukupela kwakhe eNorth Brabant futhi kamuva wakhululwa eFeyenoord ngoJanuwari 2006 ongazange ayivuselele inkontileka yakhe.

Ngemuva kwezinyanga njengomuntu okhululekile ubesequlwa ezinkantolo zamaNgisi iBlackburn Rovers neWigan Athletic.Kodwa-ke, ngo-23 Januwari 2007, ekugcineni u-Acuña wasayina i- Universidad de Chile,izimbangi zedolobha laseCatólica.Ufike kuleli qembu ngesikhathi kunenkinga yezikhungo, wadlala kuphela imidlalo engu-16 yeligi wase exoshwa ngumqeqeshi u-Arturo Salah ngemuva kokuphuthelwa wukuqeqeshwa.

Ngo-8 Agasti 2007, kwabikwa ukuthi u-Acuña wathuthela eMamelodi Sundowns yaseNingizimu Afrika yePremier Soccer League.Ngemuva kwamasizini amabili edlalela amaBrazilians,uthathe isinqumo sokubashiya ngemuva kokungezwani nosihlalo weqembu uPatrice Motsepe othe ngokwe-Acuña wamcwasa ngoba emhlophe.

Umsebenzi wokuphatha 
Ku-2020, waqala umsebenzi wakhe wokuphatha njengomphathi we-Unión San Felipe ezingeni elingaphansi kweminyaka engu-17.NgoNovemba 2020, ngemuva kokuthi u-Unión San Felipe eguqule abasebenzi bakhe bezobuchwepheshe,u-Acuña waba yisekela lomqeqeshi kaHéctor Roco, umphathi weqembu lokuqala.

Ngo-Ephreli 28, 2021,wathatha inselelo yokuqeqesha u-Unión San Felipe njengomphathi osabambile ngemuva kokukhululwa kukaTomás Arrotea.

text:

Umsebenzi 
Uzalelwe eLomé, u-Abraw waqala umsebenzi wakhe we-2004 ne-Académie Delta Liberty.Ku-2008 wajoyina iklabhu laseFrance iLB Châteauroux futhi wadlala isizini ka-2008-09 neqembu lentsha. Ngo-Agasti 2013, u-Abraw wadlulela kuFree State Stars kwiSouth African Premier Soccer League, wasayina inkontileka yeminyaka emibili nethuba lonyaka ozayo.

Ngo-6 Februwari 2019, u-Abraw wasayina nohlangothi lweTercera División uCaudal Deportivo. Ngemuva kwemidlalo eyisikhombisa yeqembu, uCaudal umemezele kuphrofayili yakhe esemthethweni kuTwitter, ukuthi u-Abraw uyishiyile iklabhu ngenxa yezizathu zakhe.

Umsebenzi wamazwe omhlaba 
U-Abraw wayeyilungu leqembu lebhola likazwelonke laseTogo labangaphansi kweminyaka engu-17,wadlala iNdebe yoMhlaba yeFIFA yabaneminyaka engaphansi kwengu-17 eyayiseNingizimu Korea kanye neNdebe yase-Afrika yabangaphansi kweminyaka engu-17.Wenze i-debut yakhe enkulu eqenjini lebhola lezinyawo laseTogo ngo-13 Meyi 2010 ebhekene neqembu lebhola likazwelonke laseGabon.

title: Thando Ntini
text:
UMasimphuthando Ntini (owazalwa ngo-7 Ntulikazi 2000) ungumdlali wekhilikithi waseNingizimu Afrika.Ngo-Agasti 2018, wanikezwa inkontileka ephezulu yiCricket South Africa ngaphambi kwesizini yasekhaya ka-2018-19.Uyindodana yowayengumdlali wekhilikithi uMakhaya Ntini.

Udlale umdlalo wakhe wokuqala we- Twenty20 eWestern Province kwi-2018 Africa T20 Cup ngomhlaka 15 Septhemba 2018.Ngaphambi komdlalo wakhe wokuqala we-T20, ubeyingxenye yabadlali baseNingizimu Afrika abazobamba iqhaza kwiNdebe Yomhlaba Yekhilikithi Yangaphansi Kweminyaka Engaphansi Kwengu-19 ka -2018.Wenze uhlu lwakhe lokuqala ku-Western Province ku- 2018-19 I-CSA Provincial One-Day Challenge ngomhla ka-10 kuNhlolanja 2019.Udlale umdlalo wokuqala esigabeni sokuqala eWestern Province kwi- 2018-19 CSA 3-Day Provincial Cup yangomhla ziyi-14 kuNhlolanja 2019.

NgoSepthemba 2019, waqokwa eqenjini lesiFundazwe saseNtshonalanga ku- 2019-20 CSA Provincial T20 Cup.Ngo-Ephreli 2021, uNtini waqokwa esikwatini sabesilisa abasafufusa baseNingizimu Afrika ohambweni lwabo lwemidlalo eyisithupha eNamibia.Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngayo leyo nyanga, waqokwa esikwatini saKwaZulu-Natali, ngaphambi kwesizini yekhilikithi ka-2021–22 eyayiseNingizimu Afrika.

title: Sabelo Nhlapo
text:
USabelo Nhlapo (owazalwa ngomhlaka 17 Disemba 1988 eGoli) ungumdlali webhola lombhoxo waseNingizimu Afrika osethathe umhlalaphansi, osanda kudlala neqembu IPumas.Isikhundla sakhe esijwayelekile siyi-prop.

Umsebenzi

Intsha 
UNhlapo umele uhlangothi olusekelwe eGoli IGolden Lions emqhudelwaneni we-Under-18 Academy Week ngo-2006, okwaholela ekutheni afakwe emqhudelwaneni we-CAR Under-18 ngalowo nyaka.

Ngemuva kwalokho wajoyina ISharks Academy, lapho ayedlala khona ezingeni lika-Under-19 ngo-2007 nasezingeni lika-Under-21 ngo-2008 nango-2009.Waphinde futhi wathola inhlonipho yokumelwa ngalesi sikhathi, edlalela iqembu laseNingizimu Afrika labaneminyaka engaphansi kwengu-19 ku- 2007 Under 19 Rugby World Championship nangohlangothi lwabo lwe-U20 ku-2008 IRB Junior World Championship .

Oshaka 
Wenze ibanga lakhe lokuqala ekilasini le- Oshaka XV ngesikhathi somncintiswano weVodacom Cup ngo-2009, emdlalweni wabo womzuliswano wokuqala bedlala ne- IBoland Cavaliers.Ubuye imidlalo engamashumi amabili emncintiswaneni weVodacom Cup kumasizini amathathu alandelayo, kepha wehluleka ukungena eqenjini labo leCurrie Cup, yize eqokwe esikwatini sabo esinqobe isicoco se -2010 Currie Cup Premier Division futhi wafakwa i Isikwati seSharks Super Rugby sesizini yeSuper 15 ka-2011.

Indebe yeVarsity 
Ngo-2012, ubuyele eGauteng wajoyina iqembu laseVarsity Cup elisuselwa ePitoli I-UP Tuks yaphinde yabonakala kubo izikhathi eziyishumi nane ngesizini ka- 2012 nango- 2013.I-UP Tuks iwine lo mncintiswano kuzona zombili lezi zikhathi,uNhlapo wadlala kuyona yomibili imidlalo yamanqamu.

IBoland Cavaliers 
Ingxenye yokugcina ka-2013 yambona ethuthela eWellington eyojoyina i- IBoland Cavaliers yomncintiswano weCurrie Cup First Division ka-2013.Wenze ukubonakala okuyisikhombisa kubo kulowo mncintiswano.

IPumas 
Ube esefudukela eNelspruit ukuyojoyina i- AmaPuma ka-2014.Ubeyilungu leqembu iPumas elidle umhlanganiso kwiVodacom Cup okokuqala ngo- 2015, eshaya I-Western Province ingu-24-7 kowamanqamu.UNhlapo ubonakale izikhathi ezine ngesizini.

title: Sabelo Phama
text:
USabelo Victor Phama wayeyisishoshovu se-Anti-Aparthaid, uMkhuzi Wezempi we- Azanian People's Liberation Army APLA kanye noNobhala Wezokuvikela kwi- Pan African Congress PAC.Wayengumvukeli waseNingizimu Afrika.

Isiqalo sokuphila 
USabelo Phama [owazalwa anguSabelo Gqwetha ] (31 Mashi 1949 - 9 Nhlolanja 1994) wazalelwa e- Eastern Cape, eMthatha, eNingizimu Afrika.Wazalelwa eBaziya, indawo esemaphandleni emaphethelweni eMthatha.Wayeyindodana kaCyril Thozama Gqweta noThembani (Nee Mlambo) Gqweta. Ingxenye enkulu yobuntwana bakhe wayichitha nogogo nomkhulu wakhe ababengothisha ngomsebenzi.USabelo waqala imfundo yakhe yamabanga aphansi eBaziya Mission School eneminyaka eyisithupha ngo-1955.USabelo wayexhumana nabaholi be-PAC abangaphansi komhlaba eneminyaka engu-12 no-13, futhi wayefaka ingcindezi kubaholi begatsha nabamaseli ukuthi baye eLesotho ukuyothola umcabango wezinguquko.Ngokwethimba le-PAC lama-1960s okuqala, usuku olwalubhekiswe kowe-1963 lwenkululeko enkulu nenkululeko lwalulindelwe ngokomzwelo nangenshisekelo yintsha yase-Afrika.
Abazalwa nge-1940s

title: Sibusiso Zuma
text:
USibusiso Wiseman Zuma(owazalwa ngomhlaka 23 Juni 1975)ungumdlali webhola lezinyawo waseNingizimu Afrika owayedlala phambili noma umdlali wasesiswini.

Umsebenzi weklabhu

Umsebenzi wokuqala 
UZuma, owazalelwa eThekwini, KwaZulu-Natal, uqale umsebenzi wakhe emaqenjini aseNingizimu Afrika iMighty Pa, African Wanderers ne-Orlando Pirates.

NgoJuni 2000, uZuma wajoyina iqembu laseDenmark iFC Copenhagen, lapho aqhakaza khona njengomdlali.

Ngo2001 uZuma waboshelwa endaweni yama-29 kumklomelo weFIFA World Player of the Year ngo2001.

Usize iklabhu ukuthi liwine umqhudelwano webhola webhola wesibili waseDenmark futhi wavotelwa ehholo lodumo leqembu ngemizamo yakhe evelele ngesizini ka-2004-05 ,

Ngo2006 uZuma wavotelwa waba ngowokuqala kubalandeli phakathi kwemikhakha emikhulu eyake yadlalwa eFC Copenhagen

Ngokusho kukaZuma udlale ibhola lakhe elihle kunabo bonke kuFC Copenhagen namanje okuzwakala njengekhaya lakhe lesibili.Ujabulela isimo sezinganekwane kuFC Copenhagen njengomdlali ovelele owake wadlala ekilabhini.UZuma ucabanga ukuthi ukweleta yonke into iFC Copenhagen nokuthi ubezithokozisa zonke izinsuku eba kule kilabhu.Kuyingxenye yempilo yakhe angasoze ayikhohlwa.UZuma uphinde atshele nokuthi "Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bazokutshela ukuthi uZuma uyinkosi eDenmark".

I-FC Copenhagen yanqoba ubuqhawe bayo besibili beSuperliga ngo-2001 ngemuva kweminyaka ecishe ibe yishumi ingazange ibe ngompetha,yanqoba ngo 3-1 emdlalweni wokugcina weNew Firm wesizini, eParken Stadium.Igoli le-2-0 kube ukukhahlelwa kwebhayisikili nguZuma, owathola ibhola esifubeni sakhe, lapho ayishayelela khona emoyeni, futhi ekunyakazeni okufanayo wakhipha ukukhahlela okuphezulu, wafaka ibhola ekhoneni elikude, ngaphandle kukanozinti kaBrøndby Ukufinyelela kukaMogens Krogh.Lokhu kwavotelwa umgomo wonyaka waseDenmark, futhi wavotelwa njengegoli elihle kakhulu leSuperliga eminyakeni eyishumi ngoDisemba 2009.

Ngo-2013, ukukhahlela ibhayisikili kukaZuma kwavotelwa njengesikhathi esikhulu kunazo zonke emlandweni weFC Copenhagen.Kwenziwa itshe lesikhumbuzo lokuhlonipha umzuzu omkhulu futhi ngaleyo ndlela ukukhahlela ibhayisikili kukaZuma.UZuma uqobo wamenywa yiFC Copenhagen futhi waya eParken ngomhlaka 18 Agasti 2013 lapho kwembulwa khona itshe lesikhumbuzo.Itshe lesikhumbuzo bekungukukhululeka ekukhahleleni ibhayisikili kukaZuma.

Ngosuku lokwethulwa kwale mpumuzo uZuma uthe:"Kuyintokozo ukuba lapha. Ngiyabathanda labo bafana.Ngiyabathanda abalandeli beFC Copenhagen.Ngijabule ngokumangalisayo.Olunye lwezinsuku ezihamba phambili empilweni yami".

U-Arminia Bielefeld 
Ngemuva kweminyaka emihlanu nohhafu e-FC Copenhagen,uZuma wathengiswa eqenjini laseGerman Bundesliga i- Arminia Bielefeld ngo- €1 million ngoJulayi 2005.

IMamelodi Sundowns 
Ngo-21 Juni 2008, uZuma wasayina kwiMamelodi Sundowns.Ukhululwe ehlobo lika-2009 kwathi ngo-Okthoba 2009 waba nesikhathi sokulingwa neFC Nordsjælland,wagcina esayinwe yiqembu.

I-Nordsjælland 
Ngo-16 Okthoba 2009, wasayina inkontileka yonyaka owodwa neqembu laseDenmark iFC Nordsjælland.Ngo-8 Novemba 2009 uZuma washaya igoli lakhe lokuqala  emdlalweni wekilabhu owawunqoba ngo-1-0 kuSønderjyskE.Ngenkathi uNordsjælland evakashele iFC Copenhagen ngomhlaka-24 Mashi 2010 emdlalweni weDenmark League, uZuma wadlala kahle futhi wafakwa esikhundleni seningi labalandeli beFC Copenhagen ababemshayela ihlombe.UZuma othinteke ngokusobala uthe abalandeli bekhaya bebengakholeki.

Umsebenzi wamazwe omhlaba 
Useke wamela iNingizimu Afrika amahlandla angama-67.Udlale izwe lakhe eNdebeni yoMhlaba yeFIFA ka-2002.UZuma wayengukaputeni weqembu lesizwe laseNingizimu Afrika emqhudelwaneni we- African Cup of Nations wango-2006.

Impilo yomuntu siqu

Sibusiso Zuma Foundation 
Ngo-2010, uZuma wavula iSibusiso Zuma Foundation esebenza nezingane ezincane ezine-HIV.Isisekelo sisebenza futhi "nokuvikela nokufundisa nge-HIV / Aids" kanye "nokuvinjelwa kokutheleleka nge-HIV kanye / noma nokusatshalaliswa kolwazi oluphathelene ne-HIV/Aids".

UZuma uthi: "Ngizama nje ukusiza imiphakathi eminingi lapha eNingizimu Afrika.Ikakhulu abampofu".

Isiteketiso 
Uyaziwa nangokuthi "uZuma the Puma" kubalandeli beqembu futhi "uPuma" uvela ehembe lakhe esikhundleni sika "Zuma" emdlalweni wevidiyo wePro Evolution Soccer 2009.

Amanye amagama eziteketiso ngenkathi edlala kuFC Copenhagen kwakunguSibu noma uZuma nje

Isigameko 
Ngo-25 Juni 2007, kwabikwa ukuthi uZuma wayebandakanyeka esigamekweni esenzeka ezweni lakubo iNingizimu Afrika.Ngemuva kwengxabano kube nezinsolo zokuthi wasabisa ngokudubula iqulu lamadoda emcimbini owawuseKokstad.Amaphoyisa endawo asiphenye lesi simo,uZuma wavinjelwa ukuba ahambe ezweni isikhathi esithile, kodwa akukho cala elabekwa lona.

Umndeni 
UZuma watshela kwi-documentary ka-2002 "uZuma the Puma "ukuthi ubaba wakhe akaze amsekele kakhulu ebholeni lakhe, engakholelwa kuye, emtshela ukuthi akasoze alunga, akaze eze emidlalweni yakhe futhi uhlala esebenza njalo.Ngesikhathi uZuma ethuthela kwiOrlando Pirates ngo1998,ubaba wakhe wamtshela ukuthi "Abadlali abahle badlala eqenjini lesizwe."Uyise kaZuma ushone ngosuku olwandulela olwedlule lokuthi indodana yakhe idlale umdlalo wakhe wokuqala eqenjini lesizwe laseNingizimu Afrika
