title: Sibusiso Ndebele
text:
USibusiso Joel "S'bu" Ndebele (owazalwa ngomhlaka 17 Okthoba 1948) wayenguNgqongqoshe Wezokuhlunyeleliswa Kwezimilo owasebenza kusukela ngonyaka wezi-2012 kuya kowezi-2014. Ube eseKomitini Eliphezulu Likazwelonke (i-NEC) le- African National Congress (ANC) kusukela ngo-1997, futhi waba nguSihlalo Wesifundazwe we-ANC kusukela ngonyaka we-1998 kuya kowe-2008. 

Kusukela ngo-1994 kuya ku-2004 yena waba UNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha kuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natali isifundazwe.Kusukela ngo-2004 kuya ku-2009 wayenguNdunankulu wesifundazwe saseNingizimu Afrika saKwaZulu-Natali. Kusukela ngo-2009 kuya ku-2012 wayenguNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha kuzwelonke.

Izifundo 
Uma elapho, wayeya esikoleni samabanga aphansi e- Makhaseneni, eduze eMelmoth,futhi umatric osuka eShowe Teachers 'Ukuqeqesha kanye High School eShowe .

Wathola iziqu zesayensi yomtapo wolwazi e- University of Zululand ngo-1972, wenza iziqu zeBachelor of Arts kwi-International Politics ne-African Politics e-University of South Africa ngo-1983, kanti wenza iziqu ze-honors kwi-Development Administration nePolitiki ngo-1985.

Ipolitiki yokuqala 
Wayengunobhala wezokwazisa weSouth African Students Organisation e-University of Zululand (1972).Ngokushesha ngemuva kwalokho, ngo-1974, wajoyina i-African National Congress ngomshoshaphansi waya ekudingisweni eSwazini .Waboshelwa imisebenzi ye-ANC ngoMeyi 1976 wagwetshwa iminyaka eyishumi eRobben Island ngoJuni 1977.

Ukugxekwa 
Dec 2015 - Durban - Lowo owayenguNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha uS'bu Ndebele usevele enkantolo yaseThekwini ngamacala okukhwabanisa, inkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa imali. UNdebele uqokwe njengommangalelwa wokuqala ecaleni lokukhwabanisa, ukukhwabanisa nokushushumbisa imali.

Usolwa ngokwamukela imali engaphezu kuka-R10m ukuze ahlomule ngqo. UNdebele kuthiwa wayemukela le mali ngenhloso yokwenza lula amathenda abiza ngaphezu kuka-R2bn. 

Muva nje ugxekwe kakhulu ngokunikeza umhlaba amahektha ayi-16 500 enkampanini ezinze eDubai iRuwaad Holdings ukwakha ipaki enkulu ebizwa nge 'Zulu World'. Lokhu kuzoholela ekususweni ngenkani kwemindeni ebalelwa ku-10 000 emndenini waseMacambini. Umphakathi othintekile ufunge wagomela ukuthi uzokumelana nokukhishwa kwalaba bantu futhi usola uNdebele ngokuthi "ubadayisela" kuhlobo olusha lobukoloniyali. "   Ngomhlaka 4 Disemba 2008, umphakathi waseMacambini wavimba umgwaqo onguthelawayeka u-N2 no-R102 ukukhalaza ngokungaphendulwa kukaS'bu Ndebele kwimemorandamu yabo eyanikezwa kwimashi edlule. 

Ngomhlaka 16 Meyi 2009, ngemuva nje kokwamukela isikhundla sikaNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha, uNdebele wathola u-R1,1-million iMercedes Benz S500 eqenjini lakwaVukuzakhe 'losonkontileka abasafufusa', ababethole izinkontileka ezibiza ngaphezu kuka-R400-million kulo Mnyango. Amaqembu aphikisayo athe lesi sipho kungaba ukushayisana kwezintshisekelo nokuthi iMercedes kumele ibuyiswe.  UNdebele uchaze ukuthi wasithola lesi sipho engaziswanga, isikhathi eside kade eyekile ukuba nguNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha, futhi uyaphika ukuthi kukhona ukungqubuzana kwezinjongo.

Imigwaqo ekhokhelwayo 
Ayikho imali eyanele ukulungisa imigwaqo, ngakho-ke kuzodingeka ukuthi kwakhiwe amanye ama-toll gates emigwaqweni kazwelonke, kusho uNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha uSbu Ndebele embikweni wangoLwesine. Bangaphezu kuka-4 100 Amakhilomitha emigwaqo - noma amaphesenti angama-32 oxhumano lwemigwaqo kuzwelonke - asesimweni esibi kangangoba anempilo "yesakhiwo" yeminyaka emihlanu esele.

Kungabiza ngaphezu kuka-R35-billion ukulungisa le migwaqo ngaphambi kuka-2014, kusho uNdebele ePhalamende, ngokusho kwephephandaba iBeeld. Kodwa umnyango wakhe uno-R16,8-billion kuphela ongakwenza ukwenza lokhu.

Izinsolo Zenkohlakalo Zomnyango 
Uhulumeni waseNorth West uthe ngoLwesithathu uhlaselwe yihlazo elenza izigidi zamarandi elihlobene nemisebenzi yamigwaqo okungenzeka ukuthi yaklonyeliswa ngendlela engafanele nangokukhwabanisa.

"Ngingakuqinisekisa ukuthi inqwaba yezinkontileka ezikhishwe umnyango zemiklamo eminingana esifundazweni kungenzeka ukuthi zanikezwa ngendlela engafanele futhi enobuqola," kusho uNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha uMahlakeng Mahlakeng esitatimendeni.

Uthe kulinganiselwa ukuthi ingaphezulu kuka-R1.5 billion imali eyabelwe amaphrojekthi emigwaqo eminyakeni emithathu ezayo - uhlaka lokusetshenziswa kwemali yesikhathi esimaphakathi - osekuvele kwenziwe.

Ezinyangeni ezintathu zonyaka wezimali, 2009/10, uphiko lwezemigwaqo selusebenzise lonke isabelozimali salo, kusho yena. Isabelo saso sonyaka sasingama-R525 million.

Uthe lolu lwazi luqhamuke ocwaningweni olwenziwe ngabakwa-PriceWaterhouseCoopers. Uhulumeni wayezibophezele ekubuyiseni imali.

Eminye imininingwane izokhishwa uma uhulumeni esezisusile izingqinamba ezisemthethweni zokwenza lokho.

Izinkontileka ezibalelwa ezigidini zamarandi bezikhishwe ngumnyango "ngaphandle kokulandela inqubo njengoba kuchazwe yiPublic Finance Management Act (PMFA)".

Uhulumeni uzonikeza lo mbiko wokucwaningwa kwamabhuku ophikweni lwamaphoyisa ophiko loKlebe nophiko Lokudliwa Kwempahla ukuze luphenye. - isikweletu Sapa

title: Sibusiso Duma
text:
USibusiso uDerrick Duma (owazalwa 6 Nhlaba 1984) umalugaju owagwetshwa ukubulala ababili ngo-2007 futhi ezinhlanu zokubulala-2009 base begwetshwa 8 odilikajele ejele. Ubekhuthele kakhulu eDolobheni laseMgungundlovu, KwaZulu Natali.

UDuma ngudokotela wengqondo onodlame owayedla ukweba, ukuthumba, ukuhlukumeza, ukudlwengula nokubulala . Usebenze njengomshayeli wetekisi futhi usebenzise imoto yakhe njengesikhali kwesinye isikhathi nokuthola izisulu zakhe. Ukucabanga kukaDuma, ukuhlukunyezwa kwakhe kanye nendlela yakhe yokushintsha kwesinye isikhathi kusuka kwesisulu kuye kwesisulu, okukhombisa ukuthi wayengumbulali ongahlelekile.

UDuma waqala ukubulala ngomhlaka-9 Septhemba 2007 ngesikhathi esebenzisa itekisi yakhe ukugijima ebulala unogada woMnyango wezeMfundo, uMqeku Zondi. UDuma wayeqashelwe ukushayela uMnuz Zondi lapho ehlala khona ngemali ekhokhwayo okuvunyelwene ngayo. Umqhubi wetekisi likaDuma, uMlungisi Bhengu, wethule ubufakazi bokuthi uZondi uzibophezele ekukhokheleni imali yohambo ngolunye uhambo, nokuyilapho “uDuma angena khona ekhehleni, wamgijimisa ngamasondo etekisi wabuye waguqula umzimba wakhe futhi. ".  UDuma ube esegebenga isisulu imali yakhe eyayisele kanye nesibhamu i-9mm Norinco .

Ngobusuku bango-14 Okthoba 2007, uDuma nozakwabo, uSimphiwe Khesi, babephuzile eshibhini lendawo. Besuka ngemuva kancane kuka-19: 00, la madoda abonile ukuthi ngeke abe khona amatekisi, ngakho ahlela ukuduna imoto ukuze afike ekhaya.  Ukuthola imoto efanelekile, uDuma wadubula wabulala umshayeli, isisebenzi seFirst National Bank uPatricia Kippen (39). Lokhu kudutshulwa kwaletha ukunakekela kwabahlali abaseduze, okwenza ukuthi laba badlali bayishiye imoto. Ngokushesha bathole enye imoto ebingabhekiswa kubo, badubula babulala umshayeli, owayeyintatheli yobugebengu uFakazi, u-Elaine Anderson (59). 

Ngo-19 Okthoba 2007, uDuma wadlwengula, wadubula wabulala uHlengiwe Shangase. UDuma ubelinde ngasekhaya lakhe ngaphambi kokumhudulela endaweni eyihlane emdlwengula. Wabe esingu yakhe ekhanda iphoyinti nalutho ububanzi usebenzisa Norinco isibhamu akuntshontshile kusukela Mqeku uZondi. 

Ngosuku olulandelayo, uDuma waduna, wadubula wabulala amadoda amabili; Masizane Mtshatsha noThamsanqua Mbindwane. Kwehora, manje ngemoto utshontshe yohlobo lweVW Polo, Duma bathunjwa izisulu ezintathu olunye; UTsepo Mhlongo, uLinda Jali nentombazane esakhula.Laba bobabili babanjwa inkunzi, bayalelwa ukuba baphume emotweni, badutshulwa bahamba becabanga ukuthi bafa. UDuma nozakwabo, uSimphiwe Khesi, bathathe le ntombazanyana bayiyisa emathuneni ase-Azalea lapho beyidlwengule khona. UDuma ube esehamba ngemoto eyebiwe phezu kwale ntombazane amahlandla amaningi ukuyibulala. 

Ekugcineni, ngomhlaka 25 Okthoba 2007, uDuma wathumba, waphanga, wadlwengula wabulala uthisha wasePinetown, uNoxolo Dlamini

Ekuqaleni uDuma wabekwa icala, walahlwa yicala wagwetshwa kanye noSimphiwe Khesi ngokubulala uKippen no-Anderson ngomhlaka-14 Novemba 2007.UMengameli wamaJaji uVuka Tshabalala ugwebe la madoda iminyaka engu-15 umuntu emunye ngokuzama ukubamba inkunzi u-Anderson futhi wagweba uDuma iminyaka engu-15 ngokubamba inkunzi uKippen noKhesi iminyaka engu-20, ngaphezu kwezigwebo zodilikajele ngecala lokubulala.Womabili la madoda ahleka lapho egwetshwa ethi, "Bafile manje.Bakhathazeka ngani? " 

Ngo-4 Ncwaba 2009, uDuma waphinde wabekwa amacala mayelana namanye amacala akhe.Ngomhlaka 17 Agasti 2009, iJaji elibambile uKobus Booyens laphinde lagweba odilikajele abayisithupha nokugwetshwa iminyaka ejele iminyaka engu-104.Uthe uhlose ukuthi uDuma asuswe unomphela emphakathini.

title: ISodomy
text:
Sodomy ( /s ɒ d əm i / ) noma buggery ( British English ) ngokuvamile ucansi lwendunu noma ubulili bomlomo phakathi kwabantu noma umsebenzi wocansi komuntu isilwane okungezona ezabantu ( nesilwane ), kodwa kungase futhi kusho noma ukuphi ucansi elingekho lokuzala.Ekuqaleni, igama elithi sodomy, elisuselwa endabeni yeSodoma neGomora eNcwadini kaGenesise,lalivame ukuvinjelwa ocansini lwendunu.Imithetho yeSodomy emazweni amaningi yenza lokhu kuziphatha kube yicala.Emazweni aseNtshonalanga, eminingi yale mithetho iguquliwe noma kaningi ayiphoqelelwa.

Amagama 
Leli gama lisuselwa ku- Ecclesiastical Latin  noma "isono saseSodoma",sona esivela egameni lasendulo lesiGreki elithi  (ISódoma).UGenesise (izahluko18-20) usitshela ukuthi uNkulunkulu wayefisa kanjani ukubhubhisa imizi "enesono" yaseSodoma naseGomora.Izingelosi ezimbili zimenywa uLoti ukuba ziphephele nomndeni wakhe ebusuku.

Amadoda aseSodoma azungeze indlu kaLoti futhi afuna ukuba akhiphe izithunywa ukuze "zizazi" (le nkulumo ifaka nezincazelo zocansi).ULoti ubhikisha ethi "izithunywa" izivakashi zakhe futhi unikeza abaseSodoma amadodakazi akhe ayizintombi esikhundleni salokho, kodwa-ke basongela ngokuthi "bazokwenza okubi kakhulu" noLoti kunalokho abebengenza ngezivakashi zakhe.Khona-ke izingelosi zashaya abaseSodoma izimpumputhe, "baze bazikhathaza ukuthola umnyango" (Genesise 19: 4-11, KJV ).

NgesiNgisi sanamuhla 
Ekusetshenzisweni kwamanje, leli gama lisetshenziswa ikakhulukazi emthethweniImithetho evimbela ubungqingili ibonwa kaningi emiphakathini yangaphambilini yamaJuda,yamaKrestu neyamaSulumane, kepha leli gama alisebenzisi kangako ngaphandle kwe-Afrika, i-Asia ne-United States. 

Le mithetho eUnited States iphonselwe inselelo futhi kwesinye isikhathi itholakale ingahambisani nomthethosisekelo noma yathathelwa indawo imithetho ehlukile

Igama elithi sod, ibizo noma isenzo (to "sod off") elisetshenziswe njengenhlamba, lisuselwa kusodomite.Kuyinkulumo ehlambalaza inhloso ejwayelekile yanoma ngubani isikhulumi esingamthandi ngaphandle kokubhekiswa ngqo ekuziphatheni kwabo ngokocansi. ISod isetshenziswa njenge-slang e-United Kingdom nase- Commonwealth futhi ithathwa njengecasulayo.(Igama elithi 'sod' linencazelo futhi ye "(clump of) earth" ene-etymology engahlobene,lapho kungukuthi kuyivelakancane kepha ayicasuli.

Ibona ngezinye izilimi 
Ama-cognates amaningi kwezinye izilimi, njenge- French  (isenzo  ),  yaseSpain (isenzo  ),kanye ne- Portuguese  (isenzo  ), isetshenziselwa kuphela ucansi lwendunu lokungena, okungenani kusukela ekuqaleni kwekhulu leshumi nesishiyagalolunye.Kulezo zilimi, leli gama futhi livame ukuba ngolimi lwendabuko (hhayi nje ngokomthetho, ngokungafani nakwamanye amasiko) kanye nendlela esemthethweni yokubhekisa kunoma imuphi umkhuba wokungena ngendunu;wobulili izwi liphathelene kwemvume futhi injabulo mayelana zonke abathintekayo futhi ngokuvamile uyakugwema ukusho kuwo ngqo izici ezimbili ezivamile zenhlalo Taboo-Ubulili kanye ingquza - ngaphandle nokuyeka noma isetshenziswe ngomqondo zakudala ngokusetshenziswa kwayo.

NgesiJalimane sanamuhla, igama elithi  ayinakho ukuqondaniswa nobulili bendunu noma bomlomo futhi ibhekisa ikakhulukazi ekulindeni nezilwane.Okufanayo kuya ngePoland .sodomia.Igama lesiNorway elithi  kuthwala zombili izinzwa. NgesiDanish,  Kuhunyushwa ngokuthi " ulwazi olungokwemvelo olungokwemvelo nomuntu wobulili obufanayo noma (manje) nezilwane.

Ngo -Arabhu futhi Persian, igama elithi sodomy,   Arabhu: liwāṭ ;Ukubiza amagama asePheresiya  ), itholakala emthonjeni ofanayo nasenkambisweni yaseNtshonalanga,inezincazelo ezifanayo kakhulu nesiNgisi (kubhekiswa ezenzweni zocansi eziningi ezingavunyelwe yiKurani ).Ukubhekiswa kwayo ngqo kuLoti (لوط Lūṭ ngesi-Arabhu) kanye nokuhunyushwa okungokoqobo kwegama elithi "umkhuba kaLoti",kepha ngokunembile kusho ukuthi "umkhuba wabantu bakaLoti"(abaseSodoma) kunokuba uLoti uqobo

Incazelo yezenkolo nezomthetho 
Ngenkathi inkolo nomthetho kube nendima ebalulekile encazelweni yomlando nasekujezisweni kobungqingili, imibhalo yezocansi iveza amathuba amaningi okungaqondakali nokuchazwa.I-Sodomy kokubili kuyenzeka kwangempela nesigaba esicabangwayo.Esikhathini sekhulu leshumi nesishiyagalombili,okukhonjwa njenge-sodomy kuvame ukukhonjiswa ngokusebenza komuntu ngokwesibonelo, noma ukuphikisana nenkulumo yobudoda.

Mayelana nalokhu, u-Ian McCormick ukuphikisile lokho

 "ukufundwa okwanele nokuqanjiwe kuhilela uchungechunge lokungenelela okuhlangana ngezikhathi ezithile lapho imilando iba izindaba, amanga kanye nokwakhiwa kabusha kwempikiswano enempilo kanye, naseduze," nobungqingili bobungqingili. . . Ukwakha kabusha lokho esicabanga ukuthi sikubona kungabandakanya ukuzakha kabusha ngezindlela ezimangazayo nezingalindelekile".

ITestamente Elisha 
ITestamente Elisha, njengeTestamente Elidala, likhomba iSodoma njengendawo yentukuthelo kaNkulunkulu ngokumelene nesono, kepha incwadi kaJude inikeza isigaba esithile sesono njengembangela yokubhujiswa kwaso,okushiwo okuyimpikiswano ngaso.

Incazelo kaJustinian yendaba yaseSodoma kungenzeka ukuthi yayikhohliwe namuhla (njengabanye  Uyibambe wayekade,kanye novelizations bakhe umthetho ophathelene kokuziphatha kobungqingili ngokuthi ngokushesha ngemva kokufa kwakhe) kwakungcono akazange enziwe ukusetshenziswa e inkohliso Charlemagnian capitularies bhila ngumuntu Frankish indela usebenzisa mbumbulu Benedictus Levita ("Benedict umLevi")azungeze 850 AD, njengengxenye yePseudo-Isidore.Izinduna ezintathu zikaBenedict Levita, ikakhulukazi eziphathelene nokuchazwa kukaJustinian ngendaba yaseSodoma, kwakungu:

 XXI. De diversis malorum flagitiis. ("Cha. 21: Kumacala amaningi ahlazisayo")
 I-CXLIII. De sceleribus nefandis ob quae regna percussa sunt, ut penitus caveantur. ("No. 143: On imikhuba emibi ngenxa yesono lapho imibuso iye yawa khona, ukuze senze konke okusemandleni ethu ukuba siyixwaye")
 I-CLX. De patratoribus diversorum malorum. ("No. 160: Kubabenzi bezenzo zobubi ezininginingi")

Ukushisa bekuyingxenye yesijeziso esijwayelekile sokuziphatha kobungqingili, ikakhulu okujwayele ukwenziwa kwaseJalimane(njengokusho kwezinganekwane zamaJalimane, ukuphambuka ngokocansi ikakhulukazi isifiso sobulili obufanayo kubangelwe uhlobo lobubi noma ububi obungokomoya obubizwa ngokuthi yi-nith,okwenza ukuthi labo bantu babonakale it njengoba fiends non-human, njengoba nithings).UBenedictus Levita cishe wayengowesizwe samaJalimane samaFranks

Benedictus Levita titfutfukiswe okushiwo i sodomy nazo zonke izenzo zobulili akuhlobene ukuzala ke ukuthi abangu uthathwa esiphikisayo nemvelo(ngakho Ngokwesibonelo,ngisho indlwabu yodwa bezoziphatha anal phakathi owesilisa nowesifazane zambozwa),ngenkathi phakathi lezi,wayesalokhu kugcizelelwe zonke izenzo zokuziphatha azenzeki phakathi kwabantu besilisa nabesifazane, ikakhulukazi ubungqingili.

Isizathu sikaBenedictus Levita sasiwukuthi ukujeziswa kwezenzo ezinjalo kwakuwukuvikela bonke ubuKrestu ezijezisweni zikaNkulunkulu, ezinjengezinhlekelele zemvelo zezono zenyama ezenziwe ngabantu,kodwa nangenxa yokuhlubuka,inkolelo-ze nobuzwe.Ngenxa yokuthi izimfuno zakhe ezibalulekile zokujeziswa ngokufa zazingakaze zizwakale emlandweni wezenkolo ngaphambili,kususelwa kumqondo wobuntu wobukristu wentethelelo nesihe,kwathatha amakhulu eminyaka ngaphambi kokuba izimfuno zikaBenedictus Levita zokuguqulwa kwezomthetho ziqale ukubonakala ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo ezinkulu zebandla.

Lokhu kwenzeka ngokuQulwa Kwamacala Ezihlubuki Kwangenkathi Ephakathi ngo-1184.Amahlelo amaCathars kanye namaWaldsians ayeyisisulu esivamile, futhi laba bahlubuki babengashushiswa kuphela ngenxa yezinsolo zobusathane, kepha babebekwa amacala okufeba nobudoda.Ngo-1307, izinsolo zokukhwabanisa nobungqingili zazingamacala amakhulu akhishwa ngesikhathi sokuqulwa kwecala leKnights Templar.Amanye ala macala abhekiswe ngqo kuGrand Master we-oda, uJacques de Molay.Yilo mcimbi oholele ekuzingelweni kwabathakathi bangezikhathi zasendulo nezasendulo nakho obekuhlobene kakhulu nesodomy.

Ukushushiswa kwamaCathars nehlelo lamaBogomiles eBulgaria kwaholela ekusetshenzisweni kwegama elihlobene kakhulu nesodomy:i-buggery ivela ku-French bouggerie, okusho ukuthi "kweBulgaria".Inhlangano ka sodomy nge hereticism,ubusathane, nokuthakatha sasekelwa iNkantolo Yamacala Ezihlubuki nokulingwa.

I-Book of Wisdom, efakwe ohlwini lwezincwadi zeBhayibheli ngabama-Orthodox namaRoma Katolika,kepha engafakwanga ngamaJuda anamuhla, amaProthestani,namanye amahlelo obuKristu,ikhuluma ngendaba yaseSodoma, igcizelela ngokuqhubekayo ukuthi isono sabo bebehluleka ukwamukela izihambi:

 "Futhi izijeziso zehlela izoni ngaphandle kwezimpawu zangaphambili ngamandla okuduma: ngoba zahlupheka ngokufanele ngokokukhohlakala kwazo,kangangoba zazisebenzisa indlela elukhuni nenenzondo kubantu abangabazi."
 "Ngoba abaseSodoma ababamukelanga labo ababengabazi lapho befika:kepha laba baletha abangani ebugqilini obubafanele." ( KJV

Imithetho yeSodomy ngekhulu le-18 eYurophu 

Ukuhlolwa kwezilingo zokudlwengulwa nokudlwengula phakathi nekhulu le-18 e- Old Bailey eLondon kukhombisa ukuthi ukwelashwa kokudlwengulwa kwakuvame ukuthambile, kanti ukwelashwa kwesodomy kwakuvame ukuba nzima. Kodwa-ke,ubunzima bokufakazela ukuthi ukungena nokungena kwendoda kwenzeka kwasho ukuthi amadoda ayevame ukutholwa enecala elincane "lokushaya ngenhloso yobungqingili," okwakungeyona icala lokufa.Amacala eSodomy eNgilandi angasho ukuthi "ukuhlukumeza ngokocansi ingane encane," futhi angaholela ekutheni isigwebo sokufa siqoshwe, okungukuthi, hhayi isigwebo sentambo nhlobo.

Ngekhulu le-18 eFrance, isodomy kwakusacatshangelwa ukuthi kuyicala lokufa, futhi kunamacala ambalwa lapho abulawa khona.Kodwa-ke, kokuningi kwalokhu, obunye ubugebengu babandakanyeka futhi.Amarekhodi aqhamuka eBastille nephoyisa lika-lieutenant d'Argenson, kanye neminye imithombo, akhombisa ukuthi abaningi ababoshiwe bathunjwa, bathunyelwa embuthweni, noma baboshwa ezindaweni (ngokuvamile isibhedlela) ezihlobene namacala okuziphatha (njengobufebe).Kulaba, iningi labo lalibandakanyeka ekudayiseni ngomzimba noma lalike lakhuluma nezingane, noma ngenye indlela ladlula nje ngokuba nobuhlobo bobungqingili.URavaisson(umbhali wekhulu le-19 owahlela amarekhodi e-Bastille) uphakamise ukuthi iziphathimandla zithanda ukusingatha la macala ngobuhlakani,hleze ukujeziswa esidlangalaleni empeleni kumemezele "lo mkhuba."

Izikhathi zesikhathi kwesinye isikhathi zazibizwa ngama-sodomites aziwayo, futhi kwesinye isikhathi, zaze zaphakamisa nokuthi i-sodomy yayanda kakhulu.Lokhu akusho ukuthi abesilisa abathandanayo babehlala ngokulondeka — ngokwesibonelo, izikhulu ezithile zamaphoyisa, zazibheka amaTuileries, ngisho nalapho kwakuyindawo “yokuhamba ngezinyawo”eyaziwayo.Kepha, njengokuziphatha okuningi kwezocansi ngaphansi koMthetho Omdala,ukuqonda kwakukhathazeka kakhulu kuzo zonke izinhlangothi (ikakhulukazi ngoba amalungu emindeni evelele kwesinye isikhathi ayethinteka);umthetho wawubonakala ukhathazeke kakhulu ngalabo ababengaqondakali kangako

Imithetho yanamuhla yezocansi 
Imithetho eyenza ubugebengu bobulili obufanayo kungavamisile ukuthi ichaze izenzo eziqondile zocansi, kepha ngokujwayelekile izinkantolo zihlanganisa ukufaka noma isiphi isenzo socansi esibonwa njengesingemvelo noma esingenasimilo.I-Sodomy imvamisa ifaka ucansi lwendunu, ucansi lomlomo, nokulala nesilwane.Ekusebenteni, imithetho sodomy baye akuvamile kuye iphoqelelwe ngokumelene kwabobulili imibhangqwana, futhi ikakhulukazi isetshenzisiwe target ongqingili. 

Kusukela ngoJuni 2019,amazwe angama-69 kanye neziphathimandla ezinhlanu ezingaphansi kwezwe lonke [lower-alpha 1] zinemithetho eyenza ubugebengu bobungqingili bube yicala.Ngo-2006 lelo nani lalingama-92.Phakathi kwala mazwe angama-69, angama-44 awo enza ubugebengu bobungqingili besilisa hhayi kuphela kodwa nobungqingili besifazane. Kubo abangu-11,ubungqingili bujeziswa ngesigwebo sentambo.

Izinkolo

UbuJuda 
Bheka, nakhu ukona kukadadewenu iSodoma: ukuziqhenya, ukusutha kwesinkwa, nokuchichima kokungasebenzi, kwakukuye nakumadodakazi akhe, futhi akaqinisanga isandla sabampofu nabaswelayo. Babezidla, benza izinengiso phambi kwami, ngakho-ke ngabasusa lapho ngibona okuhle khona .

 - KJV, Ezekiel 16:49–50 ).

UbuKristu 
Incazelo yendabuko ibona isono sokuqala seSodoma njengezenzo zobulili ezi-homoerotic, ehlanganisa ukulandisa kweSodoma noLevitikusi 18, okubalula ubugebengu obuhlukahlukene bezocansi, okuthi, ngokwevesi 27 no-28, bube nomphumela wokuthi umhlaba ube "kungcolisiwe":
ngoba abakhileyo ezweni, ababengaphambi kwakho, bazenzile zonke lezi zinengiso, izwe langcoliswa; ngaphandle kwalokho izwe liyokuhlanza ngokulihlanza, njengoba lahlanza isizwe esasiphambi kwakho.
Ezinye izazi, ezinjengoPer-Axel Sverker, baqondanisa lesi siqephu nencazelo yendabuko,bethi igama elithi isinengiso libhekisa ekuziphatheni okubi ngokobulili, nokuthi ngenkathi izenzo ze-homoerotic kungezona zodwa izizathu ezalahlwa iSodoma neGomora,kwakuyingxenye ebalulekile Isithombe

Abanye, bokuqala kubo kwakunguDerrick Sherwin Bailey,bathi le ndima iphikisana nencazelo yendabuko ngokuphelele. Ngokubona kwabo,izono zaseSodoma zazihlobene kakhulu nokwephula imithetho yokungenisa izihambi kunezono zocansi.Lokhu futhi kuvumelana nokuhumusha kwendabuko kwamaJuda kwale mibhalo futhi

AmaSulumane 
Ngenkathi iQuran iyilahla ngokusobala imikhuba yezocansi "yabantu bakaLoti" ("Yini, kuzo zonke izidalwa eniza emadodeni,futhi nishiye amakhosikazi eniyenzelwe yiNkosi yenu?"),indima eyodwa kuphela ngezikhathi ezithile kwahunyushwa njengokuthatha isikhundla esithile somthetho maqondana nemisebenzi enjalo:
labo abanecala lehlazo elivela phakathi kwabesifazane benu, bizani ofakazi abane (kofakazi) abane abaphakathi kwenu; khona-ke uma benikeza ubufakazi bavalele ezindlini kuze kube yilapho ukufa kubasusa noma Allah ebavulela indlela ethile (15).Kepha labo abanecala lenu phakathi kwenu, banikeleni isijeziso; khona-ke uma bephenduka futhi belungisa, bafulathele; Impela uAllah Uyabuya (Emseni) Onesihawu.

title: Izindlovukazi zasolwandle
text:
Amakhosikazi asolwandle yizitabane ezasebenza emikhunjini ikakhulu yabathengisi achazwa ngaphambi kweminyaka yama-1960.Kwakumelwe ogxile effeminate gay indoda eyayisebenza noma ukuzijabulisa noma njengoba oweta ku kufika imikhumbi, ngokuvamile ekubeni off-ogwini 'abafazi' ngoba kwabobulili amatilosi kuze kuphele isikhathi uhambo lomkhumbi.Zingatholwa futhi ngaphakathi kweNavy njenge monograph yomlando ongeyona inganekwane Sawubona Sailor!Umlando Ofihliwe Wokuphila Kobungqingili Olwandle uchaza ngezindaba kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho kwezindlovukazi zasolwandle ezivela kuNavy.Ngaphezu kwalokhu, ukusetshenziswa kolimi lwePolari kungabuyiselwa emuva ezindlovukazi zasolwandle kanye nokuzama ukuxoshwa kwezitabane, amatilosi angamadoda eNewport,Rhode Island ngemuva kweWWI.

Indaba ebhaliwe

Sawubona Sailor! Umlando Ofihliwe Wempilo Yezitabane Olwandle 
Ngesikhathi sama-1950s kanye nama-1960s amaphesenti amakhulu amadoda angama-gay aqala ukujoyina uMbutho Wezempi.KumaNavy, abesilisa abayizitabane bangakhuluma iqiniso ngobulili babo.Bayisebenzisile njengendawo yokuphuma yenkululeko lapho bengaziveza khona,noma ngabe lokho bekungezembatho ezihlukile noma ezinye izici futhi bekwazi ukwenza lokhu ngaphandle kokwesaba ukubandlululwa. Ukujoyina uMbutho Wezasolwandle kwaba ukuphunyuka kwabantu abakhonjwa njengongqingili futhi bengafuni ukufihla ubulili babo.Bangaya bayoziveza ukuthi bafuna kanjani ngokweqiniso futhi bazungezwe abanye abazizwa befana nabo.Lokhu kuphikisana nempilo amadoda athandana nawo abezobuyela emhlabeni.Emuva ngezizathu zomzimba zaseBrithani, abesilisa abayizitabane baphoqeleka ukuba bavalwe futhi bagcine ubulili babo kubo.Amadoda angamaGay angafuni ukufihla ajoyine i-navy ukuze avulekele uqobo lwawo.Njengoba izinombolo zikhuphuka,kwakha umphakathi wabantu abesilisa abayizitabane.Njengoba abesilisa abayizitabane emhlabeni bephoqeleka ukuba bahlale befihlekile, abaningi bebengeke bazi ngamanye amadoda abengabungqingili,okwenza ukuthi amathuba emiphakathi angabi njengalawo aseNavy.

Umongo womlando

I-Polari 
Izitabane  kungenzeka ukuthi zisebenzise iPolari ukuxhumana ngalezi zikhathi.IPolari kwakuwulimi olunamakhodi olusetshenziswa amadoda angama-gay asebenzisa izingathekiso nokubhala amagama noma ukwakha amagama ukukhuluma ngesihloko sobungqingili ngaphandle kwabanye abaseduze kwabo azi.Ulimi oluyimfihlo belungasetshenziswa ukukhuluma ngobulili babo ngaphandle kokuthi abanye baqoqe engxoxweni yabo babakhiphe ngokuthi bayizitabane.Kwaze kwasetshenziswa nemisakazo ethile ukusho amahlaya ezitabane ngaphandle kokuthi umuntu abone ukuthi bashayelani.Amadoda angamaGay asebenzisa iPolari ayevame ukuzibiza "ngendlovukazi" engadonswa ngokuhambisana nokusetshenziswa kwezindlovukazi zasolwandle.Kungenzeka ukuthi igama elithile kube wukwehluka kwelinye.

Ubandlululo eNewport 
Umphakathi wamakhosikazi asolwandle kanye nenani elichumayo lezitabane eMbuthweni Wezempi kwakungewona ukuphela komcimbi owawenzeka ngalesi sikhathi.Eminye imicimbi eminingi ingaxhunyaniswa nokwanda kwabantu bezitabane, kepha bekungapheli ngaso sonke isikhathi ngendaba enhle ongayitshela.Umcimbi owodwa obalulekile ungakhunjulwa kusuka esenzakalweni esiseNewport, eRhode Island lapho izitabane,amatilosi angamadoda ayekhonjwa amasosha, ecwaswa,futhi ayeboshwa uma etholakala eyisitabane.Uhulumeni waqala ukuhlasela abesilisa abayizitabane futhi wayebafuna ngamabomu.Ezimweni eziningi kwakukhona ubufakazi obuncane kakhulu obumelene nala madoda obudala ithuba eliphakeme lokuthi atholakale eyizitabane,noma ngabe kwakungukuthambekela okuncane kakhulu ukuthi angaba yisitabane.Lokhu kusho ukuthi abaningi nabo babemangalelwa ngamanga ngokuba izitabane.

title: Pride House
text:
IPride House indawo yesikhashana ezinikele ebamba iqhaza kubasubathi bezitabane, izitabane, abesilisa nabesifazane kanye nama-transgender ( LGBT ),abanikeli kanye nezivakashi ezihambela ama-Olimpiki, amaParalympics noma eminye imicimbi yezemidlalo yamazwe omhlaba edolobheni elisingethwe.Owokuqala wahlelelwa i-Vancouver 2010 Olympic Olympics.

I-Pride House Presence emidlalweni eminingi yezemidlalo

IVancouver Winter Olimpiki 2010 
Indawo yaseVancouver yePride House ibigcinwe ngaphakathi kwesikhungo saseQmunity.Ngesikhathi sama- Olimpiki wasebusika ka -2010, iVancouver neWhistler Pride Houses zazisebenza njengezindawo zabadlali bezemidlalo be-LGBT, abaqeqeshi, izivakashi nabangane babo, imindeni nabasekeli,futhi baba yizindlu zokuqala zokuziqhenya kuma-Olimpiki.Yize zombili lezi zindlu zokuziqhenya zinikela ngemininingwane nezinsizakalo kubasubathi be-LGBT nabahambele indawo, indawo yaseWhistler ePan Pacific Village Centre "inengqikithi yokugubha",ngenkathi indawo yaseVancouver igcizelela ezemfundo ngomphakathi we-LGBT waseVancouver futhi, kubadlali abangewona abaseCanada, imininingwane mayelana ukufudukela nokukhoseliswa eCanada, kufaka phakathi "izinsiza zomthetho" ezivela e- Egale Canada kanye ne-International Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Trans and Intersex Association (IGLA).

title: Thabang Lebese
text:
UThabang Johnny Lebese (24 Agasti 1973 - 22 Februwari 2012) Bekuwu mdlali webhola obabedlala amazing amazwe wonke.

Umsebenzi weklabhu 
ULebese wadlalela ibhola lentsha i-Orlando Wanderers ne-Orlando Hotspurs,waphinde waqeqesha iKaizer Chiefs, Ria Stars, Orlando Pirates, Silver Stars, Moroka Swallows, Black Leopards neDynamos.Sekukonke, wadlala imidlalo engama-279 kwiPremier Soccer League ngesikhathi seminyaka engu-13 esebenza.

Umsebenzi wamazwe omhlaba 
ULebese utholele iNingizimu Afrika isicoco esisodwa ngo-1998, emdlalweni weCOSAFA Cup neNamibia.

Kamuva impilo nokufa 
ULebese ushone ngo-22 Febhuwari 2012, eneminyaka engama-38,ngenxa yesifo esihlobene nengculazi.

title: Thabang Thabonh
text:
UThabang Thabong kwakuwuhlelo lwethelevishini lwezingane olufundisayo lwaseNingizimu Afrika olusakaza ekuseni phakathi nesonto kuSABC2.Uhlelo belunenhlanganisela yezinhlamvu zabantu nezopopayi kanye nezinye izithombe.Ayisasakazwa yiSABC.

Isiza 
Uhlelo lolu lumayelana noTumi, owesifazane ohlala endlini eThabang Thabong nentombazane eneminyaka emine uTandi, kanye nezimbila zombili uTiki noToko.UTumi unguthisha,futhi ubuye abe ngumzali ohlelweni.Abalingiswa banezigemegeme, bacule izingoma, bafunde izincwadi futhi benze imidanso nokuzivocavoca umzimba.Uma benemibuzo, bavamise ukubuza iBlob, ibumba elenziwe ngobumba, elenza ukwakheka nezinto ukuphendula imibuzo yazo ngoba alikwazi ukukhuluma.Kanye ngesonto uThembi ovutha bhe uyangena neposi evela kubalandeli.Lezi zincwadi ziyafundwa bese imidwebo ethunyelweyo iyakhonjiswa

Abalingiswa 

 UTumi: (Owesintu) Uthisha / umzali womlingiswa wohlelo.
 UTandi: (Upopayi) Intombazanyana eneminyaka emi-4 eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka enezinwele ezi-orange, ehlala eThabang Thabong.
 UTiki : (Upopayi) Umfana wemerkat ohlala nodadewabo eThabang Thabong.
 UToko : (Upopayi) Intombazane eyi-meerkat ehlala nomfowabo eThabang Thabong.
 UThembi: (Unodoli) Intombazane emnyama egqoke izingubo eziPinki ezihanjiswa ngeposi masonto onke kuThabang Thabong.
 Blob: (Clay animated) Umlingiswa wobumba owenza ubujamo nezinto ukuphendula imibuzo yabanye.
 UKevin: (Umuntu) Uvele kuphela ezinkathini zokuqala. Ujoyine izingoma nokuzivocavoca umzimba kuphela.
 UPhuti: (Umuntu) Ekuqaleni wayehlala endlini, kodwa umlingisi wabe esethathwa uTumi.

Abasebenzi 

 Umkhiqizi: Alf Montso
 Umkhiqizi Omkhulu: Johann Coetzee
 Umqondisi: UMarilyn Chauke

title: Thabang Molefe
text:
UThabang Molefe (owazalwa 11 Apreli 1979) esithathe umhlalaphansi eNingizimu Afrika football player.

Udlale iHIT Gorica, Jomo Cosmos, FC Lyn Oslo, Le Mans UC ne-Orlando Pirates.

UMolefe uphinde wadlalela iqembu lebhola likazwelonke laseNingizimu Afrika futhi waba yingxenye yeNdebe Yomhlaba yeFIFA yango-2002.

Ngesikhathi esebenza emazweni angaphandle neNingizimu Afrika, uMolefe ubhekane noDavid Beckham owehle kabi ngenselelo futhi wafakwa endaweni yokuqala esiwombeni sesibili somdlalo wobungani ngaphambi kokuphuthunyiswa esibhedlela.U-Beckham, ukaputeni wase-England ngaleso sikhathi, wahlushwa isihlakala ngenxa yenselelo.

title: Thabong
text:
IThabong (okusho ukuthi 'indawo yenjabulo' eSotho saseNingizimu ) iyilokishi lesibili ngobukhulu ngemuva kwebotshabelo esifundazweni saseFree State eNingizimu Afrika.Leli lokishi lasungulwa phakathi neminyaka yokuhlukaniswa kwabantu abamnyama kanye nelokishi laseBronville kubantu bamakhaladi abakhelene nedolobha laseWelkom, ukuze kuhlinzwe abasebenzi ezimayini zegolide ezicebe kakhulu emhlabeni.

Leli lokishi lenza ingxenye kaMasipala waseMatjhabeng kuMasipala wesiFunda saseLejweleputswa, okubandakanya iWelkom.Leli lokishi ligcwele ukwehluka kwabantu ngenxa yabantu abaqhamuka emazweni ahlukahlukene afana neLesotho, Zimbabwe,Mozambique,njll bezosebenza ezimayini zaseGoldfields.Izilimi ezikhulunywa kakhulu eThabong isiSuthu zilandelwa isiXhosa.

IJografi

 Izindawo ezinemali ephezulu
 Amadlelo omholo ophakathi

Isibalo sabantu abamnyama baseNingizimu Afrika abamnyama noma ababizwa kanjalo ngeBlack Diamonds kuleli lokishi sikhuphuke kakhulu ngamadolobha afana ne-Oppenheimer Park,Jerusalem Park,Mshongoville, Soweto kanye neLas Vegas.

Izibalo zabantu

Ukusatshalaliswa kwabantu 
Namuhla amalokishi aseThabong naseBronville anabantu ababalelwa ku200,000.Imvamisa iThabong ibhekiswa enhlanganisweni yeThabong neBronville (ilokishi langaphambili lamaKhaladi)yize iBronville ihlukaniswa njengelokishi elizimele laseWelkom.

Ezomnotho

Izimayini 
Iningi labantu lisebenza ezimayini ezicebe kakhulu zaseGoldfields selokhu leli lokishi lasungulwa ekuqaleni ukuhlalisa abantu abasebenza ezimayini.

title: Unyawo
text:
Unyawo (ubuningi: izinyawo ) isakhiwo se- anatomy esitholakala kuma-vertebrate amaningi.Kuyingxenye yokugcina yesitho esithwala isisindo futhi esivumela ukuqhuma.Ezilwaneni eziningi ezinezinyawo,unyawo luhlukile  isitho engxenyeni yokugcina yomlenze esakhiwe yizingxenye noma amathambo noma ithambo elilodwa, ngokuvamile kufaka phakathi uzipho noma izipikili.

Igama 
Igama elithi "unyawo", ngomqondo wencazelo "ingxenye yokugcina yomlenze wesilwane esinomgogodla" livela kunyawo "lwesiNgisi Esidala", kusuka ku-Proto-Germanic * fot (umthombo futhi we-Old Frisian fot, Old Saxon fot, I-Old Norse fotr, i-fod yaseDenmark, i-fot yaseSweden, i-voet yaseDashi, i-Old High fuoz yaseJalimane, i-German Fuß, i-Gothic fotus "unyawo"), kusuka kuzimpande ze-PIE * ped- "unyawo.""Izinyawo zezimo zobuningi ziyisibonelo sokuguquka komzimba."

Isakhiwo

Amathambo 

 tibia, i- fibula
 itarsus (7): i- talus, i- calcaneus, i- cuneiformes (3), i- cuboid, ne- navicular
 i-metatarsus (5): ithambo lokuqala le-metatarsal lokuqala, lesibili, lesithathu, lesine, nelesihlanu
 ama-phalanges (14)

Kungaba namathambo amaningi we-sesamoid eduze kwamalunga we-metatarsophalangeal, yize ekhona kuphela engxenyeni ye-distal yethambo lokuqala le-metatarsal.

Imengamo 
Unyawo lomuntu lunamakhothamo amabili e- longitudinal kanye ne-arch enqamulelayo enakekelwa ukwakheka kokuhlangana kwamathambo ezinyawo, imisipha eqinile, nokudonsa imisipha ngesikhathi somsebenzi.Ukuhamba okuncane kwalawa makhothamo lapho isisindo sifakwa futhi sisuswe onyaweni kwenza ukuhamba nokugijima kube ukonga ngokwengeziwe ngamandla. Njengoba kungahlolwa ezinyaweni, i-medial longitudinal arch curves ngaphezu komhlaba.Leli khothamo lisuka ethanjeni lesithende ngaphezu kwethambo leqakala "lekhiye elingukhiye" liye kuzinsimbi ezintathu eziphakathi.Ngokuphambene, i-lateral longitudinal arch iphansi kakhulu. Njengoba i-cuboid isebenza njengetshe eliyisihluthulelo sayo, isabalalisa ingxenye yengxenye yesisindo ku-calcaneus nasekugcineni kwedatha yemetararsal yesihlanu.Ama-arch amabili e-longitudinal asebenza njengezinsika zetshe elijikelezayo eligijima ngokulingana ngaphesheya kwamalunga we-tarsometatarsal.Ukuhlukumezeka ngokweqile ezintanjeni nasemigudwini yezinyawo kungabangela ukugoqa okuwile noma izinyawo eziyizicaba.

Imisipha 
Imisipha esebenza onyaweni ingahlukaniswa ibe yimisipha engaphandle,leyo evela engxenyeni yangaphakathi noma yangemuva yomlenze ongezansi,nemisipha yangaphakathi,evela ezicini zonyawo (phezulu) noma isitshalo (isisekelo) sonyawo.

Okudlulele 

Yonke imisipha evela emlenzeni ongezansi ngaphandle kwemisipha ye-popliteus inamathiselwe emathanjeni onyawo.Itibia ne-fibula kanye nolwelwesi oluhlukanisayo luhlukanisa le misipha ibe ngamaqembu angaphambili nangemuva, ngokuhlukana kwabo kwahlukaniswa kwaba ngamaqenjana nezendlalelo.

Ukuphinyiselwa 
Ku-anatomy, ukubizela kungukuhamba okujikelezayo kwengalo (ejoyinini le-radioulnar) noma unyawo (kumajoyini angaphansi nethalocalcaneonavicular).Ukuphinyiselwa senyawo kusho ukuthi umzimba ihambisa isisindo njengoba imijikelezo ngokusebenzisa Gait.Ngesikhathi somjikelezo we-gait unyawo lungaphimisa ngezindlela eziningi ezahlukahlukene ngokuya ngomsebenzi we-footfoot ne-forefoot.Izinhlobo zokuphinyiselwa zifaka ukubiza okungathathi hlangothi, ukubizelwa phansi (ukukhishwa), nokubhalwa ngaphezulu.

 Ukuphinyiselwa okungathathi hlangothi

Umuntu neutrally pronates ekuqaleni ushaya phansi phezu lateral ohlangothini isithende.Njengoba umuntu ehambisa isisindo kusuka esithendeni kuya emethatarsus, unyawo luzogingqika luye ohlangothini oluphakathi, ukuze isisindo sisatshalaliswe ngokulinganayo kuwo wonke ama-metatarsus.Kulesi sigaba se-gait, idolo ngokuvamile, kodwa hhayi njalo, lizolandela ngqo ngaphezulu kwe- hallux.

Lokhu kunyakaza kokungena ngaphakathi njengoba unyawo luqhubeka ukusuka esithendeni kuye ozwaneni yindlela umzimba ngokwemvelo omunca ngayo ukwethuka.Ukuphinyiselwa okungathathi hlangothi uhlobo oluhle kakhulu, olusebenzayo lwe-gait lapho usebenzisa isiteleka sesithende ;esitelekeni sangaphambili,umzimba umunca ukushaqeka esikhundleni ngokuguquguquka konyawo.

 Ukweqisa ngokweqile

Njengomabizeli ongathathi hlangothi, umuntu odlula ngaphezulu uqala ngokushaya phansi ohlangothini lwesithende.Njengoba umuntu ehambisa isisindo kusuka esithendeni esiya kwimetatarsus, noma kunjalo, unyawo luzogingqika kakhulu luye ohlangothini oluphakathi,ukuze isisindo sisatshalaliswe ngokungalingani kuyo yonke i-metatarsus,ngesisindo esedlulele esithwelwe ku-hallux.Kulesi sigaba se-gait, idolo ngokuvamile,kodwa hhayi njalo, lizolandela ngaphakathi.

 I-Underpronation 

Umuntu osebenzela ngaphansi uphinde aqale ngokushaya phansi ohlangothini lwe-lateral lwesithende.Njengoba umuntu ehambisa isisindo kusuka esithendeni uye emethatarsus, unyawo ngeke luzigingqe ngokwanele kusiqondisi sangaphakathi. Isisindo sisatshalaliswa ngokungalingani kuyo yonke i-metatarsus, ngesisindo esedlulele esithwalwa ku- metatarsal yesihlanu,kuya ohlangothini lwonyawo olulandelayo.Kulesi sigaba se-gait, idolo ngokuvamile, kodwa hhayi njalo, lizolandela ngemuva kwe- hallux.

Umphakathi namasiko 
Abantu bavame ukugqoka izicathulo noma izicathulo ezifanayo ukuzivikela ezingozini lapho behamba ngaphandle. Kunezimo eziningi lapho kubhekwa njengokungafanele ukugqoka izicathulo. Abanye abantu bakubheka njengokungahloniphi ukufaka izicathulo endlini kanti iMaori Marae kufanele ingeniswe kuphela ngezinyawo.

Ukusetshenziswa kokuqhathanisa nokwamasiko 

Igama elithi "unyawo" lisetshenziselwa ukubhekisa ku "...umugqa olinganiselwe wawuse-Old English (ubude obuqondile buye bahluka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi), lokhu kubhekwa njengobude bonyawo lomuntu; iyunithi yokukala esetshenziswa kabanzi futhi endulo.Ngalomqondo ubuningi buvame ukuba yizinyawo.I-intshi nezinyawo zamanje zishiwo kukalwa ku-12c. "Igama "unyawo" futhi linencazelo yomculo; a "... metric foot (sekwephuzile Old English, translating Latin pes, Greek pous ngomqondo ofanayo) kuvame ukuthathwa ukumela ukuphakama okukodwa nokuwa konyawo:ukugcina isikhathi ngokusho kwabanye, ukudansa ngokuya kwabanye."

title: Thokozile Masipa
text:
UThokozile Matilda Masipa (owazalwa ngomhla ka-16 Okthoba 1947) yijaji eGauteng Division yeNkantolo eNkulu yaseNingizimu Afrika.Wayengumphathi wecala ecaleni lika-Oscar Pistorius ngo-2014 lokubulala uReeva Steenkamp.Isinqumo sakhe sokungabi nacala lokubulala sabuye sachithwa ngemuva kokudluliswa kwecala.

Impilo yokuqala nemfundo 
UMasipa wazalelwa wakhulela e-Orlando East, eSoweto, eGoli, uyizibulo ezinganeni eziyishumi.Ngemuva kokuphothula umatikuletsheni e-Immaculata High School elokishini lase-Alexandra ngo-1966, wathola iziqu ze-BA ezaziqhenya ngeSocial Work ngo-1974 ne-LLB ngo-1990 e-University of South Africa . Wamukelwa njengommeli ngo-1991.

Umsebenzi 
Ngaphambi umsebenzi wakhe umthetho, Masipa ubesebenza njengomshayeli usonhlalakahle futhi njengoba intatheli ubugebengu, okwaholela ukuthi wayenesithakazelo umthetho.Usebenze emaphephandabeni i-The World,Post ne- The Sowetan futhi wahlela i- Queen women supplement yomagazini i-Pace.

Ngo-1998, waqokwa njengejaji eTransvaal Provincial Division (njengoba yayaziwa kanjalo ngaleso sikhathi) eNkantolo Ephakeme yaseNingizimu Afrika, eba ngowesifazane wesibili omnyama ukuqokwa njengo ijaji leNkantolo Lephakeme ngemuva kwaLucy Mailula, lobekabekwe kuMkhandlu Wetifundza waseTransvaal Wenkantolo Lephakeme (njengoba beyatiwa ngaleso sikhatsi) nga-1995. UMasipa uphinde wasebenza enkantolo yamacala abathengi eGauteng, Estate Agents Board,  naseNkantolo Yezokhetho yaseNingizimu Afrika.

Engxoxweni abe nayo ne-Judicial Service Commission ngo- 2003,uMasipa wasekela ukusebenza obala okukhulu nokuxhumana nabezindaba ukusiza umphakathi ukuthi uqonde inqubo yezokwahlulela.Ungomunye wabahluleli besifazane baseNingizimu Afrika abayisikhombisa abafakwe kwiCourting Justice, ifilimu eliyi-documentary lango-2008 eliqondiswa nguJane Lipman.

Izahlulelo eziphawuleka 
UMasipa ufake isandla emthethweni wamacala mayelana nemisebenzi yomthethosisekelo yohulumeni basekhaya ehlobene nezindlu esinqumweni sakhe sango-2009 ngeBlue Moonlight Properties v Abahlali baseSaratoga Avenue

State v Oscar Pistorius 
UMasipa wayeyijaji eliphethe ecaleni lika-Oscar Pistorius ngecala lokubulala uReeva Steenkamp kanye namacala ahlobene nezibhamu aqala eNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli ngomhlaka 3 Mashi 2014.Uqoke abahloli ababili abazomsiza ecaleni.Ngokwe okhulumela namajaji eNingizimu Afrika, wayengatholi ngokukhethekile esinikelwe umlandu ngenxa yobulili bakhe.Ngemuva kokunikezwa kwakhe leli cala elisezingeni eliphezulu, kuthiwa ozakwabo bamchaze njengomuntu ohlonishwayo, onekhono, oligagu nogodliwe.Ngokusho kwenkampani eqapha abezindaba i-ROi Africa, iningi labaphawula ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngesikhathi kukhishwa lesi sinqumo laligxeka uJaji Masipa ngemuva kokuvela kokuthi uPistorius ngeke atholakale enecala lokubulala, okuyisinqumo esaphinde sahoxiswa yiNkantolo Yokudlulisa Amacala futhi kwaqoshwa isigwebo sokubulala.IJaji uMasipa, onikezwe ukuvikelwa ngamaphoyisa kusukela kuqale ukuqulwa kwecala, ubesongelwa futhi ehlaselwa ngabantu abangahambisani nesinqumo.Esigwebeni sakhe esisha esasinikezwe uPistorius ngokususelwa ecaleni lokulahlwa yicala lokubulala, uMasipa wasinyusa isigwebo sakhe ngonyaka owodwa waba yiminyaka eyisithupha.Isigwebo seminyaka eyisithupha sokubulala sidluliswe yiNational Prosecuting Authority futhi baqinisekisa ukuthi iNkantolo eNkulu yokuDluliswa kwamaCala yaseNingizimu Afrika iyasinyusa isigwebo.Lesi sigwebo sahlelelwa ubude obuncane besigwebo sokubulala eNingizimu Afrika - iminyaka engu-15.
Abazalwa nge-1947

title: Thokozani Khuphe
text:

title: Thokozani Sekotlong
text:
Thokozani Sekotlong (owazalwa 7 Meyi 1991) ungumdlali webhola waseNingizimu Afrika odlala njengomdlali wasesiswini weqembu elidlala kwiPremier Division eNingizimu Afrika iChippa United.

Isiqalo sokuphila 
USekotlong uzalelwe eMamelodi.

Umsebenzi weklabhu 
Uqale umsebenzi wakhe e- University of Pretoria, futhi wayeyingxenye yeqembu elafinyelela kowamanqamu weNedbank Cup ngo-2008-09, ngaphambi kokuhlulwa yiMoroka Swallows.Unqobe ukukhushulelwa eqenjini neSouth African Premier Division ngo-2012.Unqabile ukunikezwa yiKaizer Chiefs nePlatinum Stars ngalelo hlobo,wadlala amahlandla ama-13 kuma-AmaTuks kuligi ngesizini ka-2012-13.Wadedelwa yi-AmaTuks ngo-2013, wase ejoyina iMaritzburg United.Uvele emidlalweni engu-36 yeligi, washaya amagoli ayisithupha, esikhathini esiyiminyaka emibili neqembu,ngaphambi kokukhishwa ehlobo lika-2015. 

Ngemuva kokuthakatha neqembu leNational First Division iCape Town All Stars engxenyeni yokugcina yesizini ka-2015-16, ujoyine iFree State Stars ehlobo lika-2016.Ushiye ikilabhu ekupheleni kwesizini. 

Ujoyine iMamelodi Sundowns ehlobo lika-2017.Ushaye igoli lakhe lokuqala eqenjini ngo-21 Okthoba 2017 ngesikhathi ehlulwa ngo-2-1 ekhaya naMaZulu .Ujoyine iBlack Leopards ebolekiswe ngoJanuwari 2019.Ushiye iSundowns ekupheleni kwesizini ka-2018-19. 

Njengoba ebengenalo iqembu selokhu akhululwa kwiMamelodi Sundowns ekupheleni kwesizini edlule, wajoyina iChippa United ngoJanuwari 2020.Ushaye igoli lakhe lokuqala leqembu ngo-Agasti 28 2020: igoli lokulinganisa elidlule lapho bedlala ngokulingana ngo-1-1 neStellenbosch.

Umsebenzi wamazwe omhlaba 
Wabizelwa eqenjini laseNingizimu Afrika labangaphansi kweminyaka engama-23 ngo-2011. 
Abadlali bebhola baseNingizimu Afrika
Abazalwa nge-1991
Abantu baphilayo

title: Nthabiseng Mosia
text:
UMosia ungusomabhizinisi waseNingizimu Afrika-waseGhana futhi ongumsunguli wenkampani yamandla elanga asuselwa eSierra Leone i-Easy Solar.

Impilo yokuqala nemfundo 
UMosia wazalelwa eGhana,kamuva wathuthela eNingizimu Afrika.Ngesikhathi esemusha wayehlangabezana nokucinywa ngezikhathi ezithile ngenxa yokutholakala kukagesi okungathembekile, okwaqala kwamenza waba nentshisekelo ngamandla.UMosia uthole iBachelor of Business Science in Finance and Economics eNyuvesi yaseKapa, waphothula ngeziqu zokuqala nokwehlukanisa, ngemuva kwalokho wasebenza njengomxhumanisi wabaphathi e-Afrika yonkana.Ngo-2016 wafundela iziqu zeMasters egxile kwi-Clean Energy Finance and Policy eSchool of International and Public Affairs, e- Columbia University, lapho ahlangana khona nabasunguli bakhe be-Easy Solar, Eric Silverman no-Alexandre Tourre.

Umsebenzi 
UMosia nabasunguli bakhe babamba umqondo wokunikeza ugesi onokwethenjelwa futhi ongabizi kakhulu emakhaya angalondolozwa igridi eNtshonalanga Afrika,ngesikhathi sokufunda kwabo iziqu.Ngokubambisana bathole uxhaso olukhulu lwephrojekthi kusuka emincintiswaneni nakuma- hackathons aseUS,njenge-D-Prize ngo-2015 kanye ne-Columbia Venture Competition 2016.Uxhaso lokuqala lwavumela uMosia nozakwabo ukuthi benze ucwaningo ngokutholakala kwamandla kuyo yonke imindeni eyi-1,500 yaseSierra Leone.

I-Easy Solar, edayisa umhlaba wonke njenge-Azimuth, yadalwa ngo-2016 njengesinyathelo sokuhweba sokwandisa ukufinyeleleka kwamadivayisi asebenza ngamandla elanga aphezulu (njengamalambu nezinhlelo zasekhaya) kuyo yonke iSierra Leone enganikeziwe. Le nkampani inikela ngezinhlelo zezimali, njengokuqashisa -ukuba-ngumnikazi, ngemali oyikhokhelwayo ukuze usize amakhaya ampofu ukuthi akwazi ukuzitholela ama-solar panel.  
Abantu baphilayo

title: EVOD
text:
I-eVOD insiza yaseNingizimu Afrika yokufuna ividiyo ephethwe yi-eMedia Investments eyethulwe ngomhlaka 5 Ncwaba 2021.

Umlando

Njenge-Openview Plus 
Sekuyiminyaka eyisikhombisa i- Openview yethulwa njengenkonzo yamahhala, abakwa-e.tv bebehlela ukwelula ukunikezwa kwe-TV yabo yesathelayithi futhi bazokwethula i-Openview Plus ngo-Okthoba 2020 njengensizakalo yokusakaza ividiyo eNingizimu Afrika kanye ne-Openview Connect ezonikeza insizakalo entsha yokuxhuma nge-broadband . 

Ekupheleni kuka-Okthoba 2020, ipulatifomu yehlulekile ukwethula nge-eMedia ingenalwazi maqondana nepulatifomu ngaleso sikhathi kepha okuqukethwe okuvela ku-Openview kamuva kwengezwa kuwebhusayithi yabo.

Njenge-eVOD 
NgoJuni 2021, i-eMedia Investments yakhipha umbiko wabo wonyaka wezimali ophele ngoMashi 31, 2021 lapho bethula khona i-eVOD eyayimiselwe ukukhishwa ngoJulayi 2021 kodwa yabambezeleka. 

Ngemuva kwenyanga kudalulwe imininingwane emayelana nepulatifomu kufaka ne-logo esemthethweni yesikhulumi.  Ipulatifomu yatholakala ngomhlaka 5 Agasti 2021.

Ukuhlela 
Ipulatifomu ithwala okuqukethwe ikakhulukazi kusuka kusethi yeziteshi ze-eMedia Investments nokunye okuqukethwe okusha. Inikela ngezigaba ngale ndlela elandelayo:

 Ama-eOriginals

Ikhaya bonke amadrama wendawo ezinye zazo may ayitholakali ku e.tv ezifana Is'phindiselo futhi Atlantic.

 I-Afrikaans Premium

Ikhaya bonke amadrama Turkish etholakalayo kakade e.tv futhi eExtra eceleni ezinye izinhlelo ezifana Dokter Ali futhi Voelvry .

 Amadrama aseNdiya nawaseKorea

Iqukethe imibukiso eminingi etholakala ku-eExtra efana ne- Ice Adonis ne- Piyaa Albela

 eDramas

Ifaka ukukhethwa kwamadrama aphesheya kanye nezinsipho ze-Kuiertyd.

 eSoaps

Indawo yamadrama endawo angaphambilini anjenge-Broken Vows ne-Isipho.

 I-Microblast TV

Iletha ifomu elifushane laseNingizimu Afrika lokuqukethwe nge-smartphone yakho esukela kumahlaya wokuma,amatravel kanye nama-mini-documentary.

 Ama-movie

Ifaka ithoni lama-movie atholakala kumaeMedia Investments kwezinye iziteshi futhi angikaze abone amafilimu asukela kuzenzo, amahlaya,amafilimu omndeni nawendawo.

title: Ividiyo
text:
Ividiyo iyindlela esebenza ngogesi yokuqopha, ukukopisha, ukudlala, ukusakaza, nokukhombisa imidiya ebonakalayo ehambayo.Ividiyo yaqale yathuthukiselwa izinhlelo zethelevishini ezenziwa ngomshini, ezathathelwa indawo ngokushesha yizinhlelo ze- cathode ray tube (CRT) ezathi kamuva zathathelwa indawo ukuboniswa kwamapaneli ayizicaba ezinhlobo eziningana.

Izinhlelo zevidiyo ziyahlukahluka ekubonisweni kokuboniswa, isilinganiso sobukhulu, isilinganiso sokuqabula, amandla wombala nezinye izimfanelo. Ukuhlukahluka kwe-analog ne-digital kukhona futhi kungenziwa kwimidiya eyahlukahlukene, kufaka phakathi ukusakazwa ngomsakazo, itheyiphu kazibuthe, ama-disc optical, amafayela ekhompyutha nokusakazwa kwenethiwekhi .

Ividiyo ye-Analog isetshenziswa kuzo zombili izicelo zokukhiqiza zabathengi nezobuchwepheshe.

Ividiyo yedijithali 
Digital isiqophi isignali nezakhiwo seyemukeliwe, kuhlanganise serial esibonakalayo digital (SDI), Digital Interface Visual (DVI), High soxhumanoningi oluchazayo (yocezuningi) kanye yokubonisa Interface.

Ukuboniswa kwekhompyutha 
Izindinganiso zokubonisa zekhompyutha zicacisa inhlanganisela yesilinganiselo, usayizi wokubonisa, ukulungiswa kwesibonisi, ukujula kombala, nezinga lokuvuselela.Uhlu lwezinqumo ezivamile luyatholakala.

Ukuqopha 

Ithelevishini yakuqala cishe yayiyindlela yokuphila bukhoma enezinhlelo ezithile ezirekhodwe ukuqoshwa ukuze kusatshalaliswe izinhloso zomlando kusetshenziswa iKinescope.I-analog video tape recorder yethulwa ngokokuhweba ngo-1951.Ngokulandelana okulandelanayo.Onke amafomethi abhalwe ohlwini athengiselwa futhi asetshenziswa abasakazi, abakhiqizi bamavidiyo noma abathengi; noma zazibalulekile ngokomlando (i-VERA).

title: Iminyaka evunyelwa ucansi e-Afrika
text:
Iminyaka yemvume e- Afrika yokwenza ucansi iyehluka ngokwamandla ezwekazi lonke.Umsebenzi othile ohilelekile noma ubulili babahlanganyeli bawo nawo ungathinta le minyaka kanye nokuba semthethweni kwezenzo zocansi. Ngezansi kunengxoxo yemithetho eyahlukahlukene ephathelene nale ndaba. Iminyaka egqanyisiwe isho iminyaka noma ngaphezulu lapho umuntu angazibandakanya ebudlelwaneni bezocansi obunganqandekile nomunye umuntu naye oseminyakeni noma ngaphezulu kwalokho.Ezinye izinto eziguqukayo, ngokwesibonelo ukuhlinzekwa kobungqingili kanye / noma ukuhlinzekwa kwabantu bobulili obufanayo okungekho emthethweni noma okusondele eminyakeni yobudala okungahle kube khona futhi kuyashiwo lapho kufanelekile.

Isifinyezo 
Ngezansi kunohlu lwazo zonke iziphathimandla e-Afrika njengoba kubhalwe ohlwini lwamazwe azimele kanye nezindawo ezincike e-Afrika.

I-Algeria 
Iminyaka yokuvuma e- Algeria ingu- 16 ngokocansi, njengoba kuchaziwe ku-Article 334 yekhodi yokujezisa. 

"I-Heterosexual Sodomy " (ucansi lwendunu kanye / noma ngomlomo nomuntu wobulili obuhlukile) akukho emthethweni, i-Article 388 ye-Penal Code. Kanye nayo yonke imikhuba yezocansi yabantu bobulili obufanayo, i-Article 338, kanye "nokuthukuthelisa isimilo somphakathi", i-Article 333.Isijeziso semisebenzi emibili yokuqala nalabo abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-19 sinzima kakhulu kulowo obambe iqhaza osekhulile.

I-Angola 
Iminyaka yokuvuma e-Angola ingu- 14 kepha ukwenza ucansi nabantu abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-16 akuvunyelwe uma umuntu oneminyaka engaphezu kwengu-18 "esebenzisa ukungabi nalwazi noma isimo sesidingo esithile".

Le mithetho ihlanganiswe ngaphansi kwendatshana 192 no-193 yekhodi yokujezisa — ukuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi kwengane eneminyaka engaphansi kwengu-14, nokuhlukumeza ngokocansi ingane eneminyaka engaphansi kwengu-16. 

Eminye imithombo eku-inthanethi ibhala ngokungeyikho iminyaka yokuvuma njengeyi-12, kepha i-athikili 192 yenza zonke izenzo zocansi zibe necala kubantu abangaphansi kweminyaka eyi-14 (izinhlawulo ziyakhuliswa uma kukhona ukungena noma uma isisulu singaphansi kweminyaka eyi-12).

Ikhodi entsha yokujezisa eqala ukusebenza ngoFebhuwari 2021 ingeza ukuvikelwa kokuthambekela kwezocansi futhi isuse ubugebengu "bemikhuba emibi nemvelo", ebikade isetshenziselwa ukwenza ubugebengu ubulili obufanayo.

IBenin 
Iminyaka yokuvuma eBenin ingu- 16 kwabesifazane, nge-Article 3 yoMthetho Wokuvimbela Nokujezisa Udlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane.

Ubudala bemvume yezenzo zobungqingili ("izenzo ezingcolile noma izenzo eziphikisana nemvelo") zingama-21

EBotswana 
Iminyaka yokuvuma ingu- 18, kusukela kuMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Ikhodi Yephenal 2018,Ubudlelwano bobungqingili sebuvumelekile ngokusemthethweni kusuka ngoJulayi 2019.

IBurkina Faso 
Ubudala bemvume busethwe ngokulinganayo kwabangu-18 kungakhathalekile ubulili.

Isigaba 533-4 sekhodi yokujezisa sithi "ukuhlaselwa okuyihlazo" kubancane okungenani okungu-15 kepha kungaphansi kuka-18.

Isigaba 533-19 sikwenza kube semthethweni ukugqugquzela amanyala noma ukuthuthukisa inkohlakalo yabancane.

IBurundi 
Ngaphansi kwe- Penal Code entsha ka-2009 (ngesiFulentshi), iminyaka yokuvuma eBurundi kwabesilisa nabesifazane (abesilisa nabesifazane) yiminyaka eyi- 18.  Kodwa-ke, ngaphansi kwe- Article 567, izenzo zobungqingili (abesilisa nabesifazane) zithwala inhlawulo efinyelela kuma-franc angu-100 000 aseBurundi kuze kube yiminyaka emithathu ejele.

IGibhithe 
Iminyaka yokuvuma eGibhithe yiminyaka eyi-18, yabesilisa nabesifazane. 

Lokhu kuchazwe endatshaneni 269 yekhodi yokujezisa.

Ukuthengisa ngomzimba akukho emthethweni kanti nomthetho wezocansi usetshenzisiwe ngokumelene nabangqingili besilisa nabesifazane.

I-Equatorial Guinea 
Iminyaka yokuvuma ingu- 18 kungakhathalekile ukuthi uthambekele kuphi kwezocansi kanye / noma ubulili.

I-Eritrea 
Iminyaka yokuvuma e-Eritrea ibonakala ineminyaka engu- 18, njengoba kushiwo ku-Article 305 wekhodi yango-2015, "Intukuthelo yezocansi kubantwana abaphakathi kweminyaka engu-15 no-18 ubudala".Lo mbhalo uthi izenzo zocansi nezingane ezingaphansi kwalesi sikhathi kuyicala elincane elijeziswa izinyanga eziyisithupha kuya kweziyisithupha ejele.

I-Article 311 Imvume Yokuziphatha Ngokobulili (1) ithi lapho ummangalelwa ebekwa icala ngaphansi kwesahluko (isahluko 3: amacala ezocansi, ahlanganisa izindatshana 303–311) aphathelene nesisulu esingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-15, ngeke kube yisivikelo ukuthi isisulu sivumile, ngaphandle uma ummangalelwa naye engaphansi kweminyaka eyi-15 futhi engekho ngaphezu konyaka owodwa kulowo muntu.

I-Article 311 (3) iyaqhubeka ithi imvume ngeke ibe yindlela yokuvikela amacala ngaphansi kwama-athikili 309 (ubungqingili) noma ama-310 (izihlobo).

Izinkokhelo eziphathelene ne-Article 305 azikhulunywa, ngakho-ke akucaci ukuthi imvume ingaba ukuvikela okuvumayo yini ecaleni eliphathelene nezingane ezineminyaka yobudala eyi-15-17.

Eswatini 
Iminyaka yemvume ingu- 18, ibuyekezwe kusukela kuMthetho we-SODV (amacala ezocansi kanye nodlame lwasekhaya) we-2018.

Ingxenye II Amacala Okuziphatha Kocansi Okuvamile

Ngaphansi kwecala lokudlwengula, u-3 (c) uthi isenzo socansi esingekho emthethweni sihlanganisa nalokho okwenziwa "kumuntu ongakwazi ngokomthetho ukwazisa uhlobo lwesenzo"

6 (e) ibala esinye sezimo ezingenza umuntu angakwazi ukusebenza njengo; "umuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18"

E-Ethiopia 
Ubuncane beminyaka yobulili obuvumayo yiminyaka eyi-18, njengoba kucacisiwe ku-Article 626 we-2004 Criminal Code — intukuthelo yezocansi kwabancane abaneminyaka ephakathi kwengu-13 kuya kwengu-18. Ukuya ocansini kuyajeziswa "ngokuboshwa kanzima" iminyaka engu-3-15.

title: Lehlo Ledwaba
text:
ULehlohonolo Benedict " Lehlo " Ledwaba (Julayi 27, 1971-Julayi 2, 2021) wayengumshayisibhakela okhokhelwayo waseNingizimu Afrika owancintisana kusukela ngo-1990 kuya ku-2006,futhi wabamba isicoco se-IBF super bantamweight kusuka ngo-1999 kuya ku2001.

Umsebenzi wobuchwepheshe 
ULedwaba waba ngumpetha ngo-1990 kwathi ngo-1999 wathumba isicoco se-IBF super bantamweight ngokunqoba uJohn Michael Johnson.ULedwaba uvikele leli bhande amahlandla ama-5 ngaphambi kokulahlekelwa nguManny Pacquiao ngeTKO ukuthola uPacquiao umqhudelwano wakhe wesibili womhlaba ezigabeni ezimbili zesisindo.ULedwaba uqhubeke nokulwa, kepha akakaze aphikise isicoco esikhulu selokhu alahlekelwa.Uthathe umhlalaphansi esibhakeleni ngemuva kokwehlulwa kwakhe nguMaxwell Awuku ngomhlaka-24 Novemba 2006.

Ukuqoshwa kwesibhakela kobungcweti

Ukufa 
ULedwaba ushone ngoJulayi 2, 2021 eneminyaka engama-49 ngesifo se-Coronavirus.

title: Lehlohonolo Majoro
text:
ULehlohonolo Majoro (owazalwa 19 Ncwaba 1986 eLadybrand, Free State) umdlali webhola waseNingizimu Afrika odlala njengoba phambili ngoba iPremier Soccer League ohlangothini waMaZulu kanti iqembu izinkomba zobuzwe baseNingizimu Afrika.

Uqale ukubonakala ngokungekho emthethweni kwiVodacom Challenge ngokunqoba ngo 1-0 kwiTottenham Hotspur.Wagxekwa ngokushaya ezokuvikela kubalwa noGareth Bale kodwa wahluleka ukuguqula.Udlale umdlalo wakhe wokuqala kwiChiefs ngo-18 Ncwaba 2011 ngesikhathi benqoba iJomo Cosmos ngo-2-1.Uphinde washaya igoli okokuqala kuphela ngemuva kwemizuzu engu-2 ngemuva kokuphasiswa okunembile okuvela kuBernard Parker.Uqhubeke waba ngumshayimagoli ohamba phambili wamagoli nge-10.

Umsebenzi wamazwe omhlaba 
Uqale ukudlala eNingizimu Afrika ngomhlaka 14 Meyi 2011 eqhathanisa neTanzania kowobungani bamazwe omhlaba.

Izinjongo zomhlaba jikelele 

 Izikolo nemiphumela zibala kuqala inani lamagoli aseNingizimu Afrika.

title: Lehlohonolo Seema
text:
ULehlohonolo Seema (owazalwa 9 Nhlangulana 1980 e Mafeteng ) umdlali wase-Lesotho webhola wasemuva.Ubuye abe yisakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika.Njengamanje ungumphathi weChippa United kwiSouth African Premier Division.

Umsebenzi 
Ukujoyina South African ithimba neBloemfontein Celtic e isizini 1998/99, wathuthelae-Orlando Pirates ngo2006. Wayengukaputeni weBloemfontein Celtic phambilini,wayengukaputeni we-Orlando Pirates futhi esethathe umhlalaphansi eqenjini ngo-1 Ntulikazi 2011.

Umsebenzi wamazwe omhlaba 
Isihlabani seqembu lesizwe laseLesotho, uSeema nguyena kuphela umdlali owathi ngo-2003 wadlala ibhola lekilabhu phesheya.Ngo-2001, washaya igoli lokuwina ngesikhathi sekukhahlelwa iphenathi ngomzuzu ka-87 wokuhlungela i-African Cup of Nations iqhathaniswa neZimbabwe eyayiseBulawayo ukunika iLesotho ukunqoba okudumile.
Abadlali bebhola bakwamanye amazwe eNingizimu Afrika

title: Lehlogonolo Masalesa
text:
Lehlogonolo Masalesa (owazalwa 21 Mashi 1992 e yaseMankweng ) kuwumdlali webhola ngubani okwamanje udlalele neBlack Leopards e-DStv Premiership njengoba mdlali.

Umsebenzi 
UMasalesa uqale umsebenzi wakhe wokudlala kuPlatinum Stars ngemuva kokungena kwi-Africa Sport Youth Development Academy.Kodwa-ke udlale indawo eyodwa kuphela kwiDikwena, nokuholele ekutheni afudukele kuBidvest Wits,obemele amahlandla angama-28 ngaphambi kokusayina isivumelwano seminyaka emithathu ne-Orlando Pirates ngoSepthemba 2012.Lo mdlali owayedlalela iqembu lesizwe lika-Under 20 wahlaba umxhwele kakhulu ngesikhathi enikwa isikhathi sokudlala ngesikhathi iPirates igijimela owamanqamu weCAF Champions League ngo-2013 .

Wanikezwa igama lesidlaliso " Vieira " ngumhlaziyi odumile webhola laseNingizimu Afrika uBaba Mthethwa ngenxa yokufana akufana nalona owayengumdlali webhola lezinyawo waseFrance.

title: Thapelo Matsheka
text:
UThapelo Matsheka ungusopolitiki noMotswana osesebenze njengoNgqongqoshe wezeziMali nokuThuthukiswa koMnotho kusukela ngoNovemba 2019.Wakhethwa njengelungu lePhalamende Likazwelonke Lobatse ngo-Okthoba 2019.Uyilungu leBotswana Democratic Party.UMatsheka ubenguMqondisi Ophethe wakwaFiducia Services.

Umsebenzi 
UMatsheka wayenguMphathi Omkhulu weCitizen Entrepreneurship Development Agency, uhlelo lukahulumeni lwamabhizinisi, kusukela ngo-2003 kuya ku-2010.Ubuye wasebenzela i-AON Botswana ngaphambi kokusula esikhundleni sakhe ukuze akhe iFiducia Services ngo-Agasti 2017.

Okhethweni lukazwelonke lwango -2019, uMatsheka wayeyilungu leBotswana Democratic Party ePhalamende eLobatse .Wakhethwa futhi wangena esikhundleni sikaSadique Kebonang.UMongameli Mokgweetsi Masisi wamqoka njengoNgqongqoshe wezeziMali nokuThuthukiswa koMnotho ngomhla ziyi-6 kuLwezi 2019, futhi waqala ukusebenza ngalo lolo suku.Wethule inkulumo yakhe yokuqala yesabelomali ngoFebhuwari 2020.

title: Johann Sebastian Bach
text:
UJohann Sebastian Bach (Mashi 21, 1685 - Julayi 28, 1750) wayengumqambi waseJalimane wesikhathi samaBaroque. Uthathwa njengomunye wabaqambi abanethonya elikhulu futhi ababalulekile emlandweni wase-Europe, kanti umculo wakhe umele ukuphela kwesikhathi seBaroque. Amadodana amane kaBach aba ngabaculi abadumile futhi. UBach waba nomthelela omkhulu kubaqambi abeza ngemuva kwakhe, ngokwengxenye ngoba wakhuphula amafomu omculo esikhathi sakhe ezingeni eliphakeme lobuchwepheshe nobungcweti. Umculo kaBach waziwa ngobuhle bawo, ubuciko, ubukhazikhazi, ukuqina kwengqondo kanye namandla ezemizwa. Ngenxa yekhwalithi yomculo wakhe, abaqambi abangochwepheshe bavame ukumbiza ngokuthi umqambi omkhulu kunabo bonke emlandweni waseNtshonalanga. Umculo kaBach uyenziwa, ufundwe futhi uthokozelwe umhlaba wonke.

indaba yokuphila 
UBach wazalelwa e-Eisenach ngo-1685. Wafundiswa ukudlala i-violin nguyise, uJohann Ambrosius, owayengumcilongo wasenkantolo osebenzela uMbusi wase-Eisenach. UBach wayengakabi neminyaka eyishumi ngesikhathi kushona uyise, emshiya eyintandane. Wahamba wayohlala ekhaya lomfowabo; umfowabo wayehlala e-Ohrdruf. Ngenxa yezwi lakhe elihle, uBach wathola umsebenzi esigodlweni sezindela saseMichaelis eLüneberg ngo-1700. Izwi lakhe lashintsha ngemuva kwesikhashana, kodwa waqhubeka njengomculi. Ngemuva kokuthatha umsebenzi wesikhashana eWeimar ngo-1703 njengomdlali we-violinist, uBach waba ngumdlali weNeue Kirche e-Arnstadt (1703-1707). Ubudlelwano bakhe nomkhandlu wesonto babunzima njengoba lo mculi osemncane wayevame ukungayinaki imisebenzi yakhe, ancamele ukujwayeza u-ogani. Enye i-akhawunti ichaza ikhefu lezinyanga ezine elinikezwe uBach, lokuya eLubeck lapho ezozijwayeza khona ngomculo kaDietrich Buxtehude. Ubuyele e-Arnstadt kade elindelwe, wathukuthelisa umkhandlu. Wabe esebenza isikhashana eSt.Blasius eMühlhausen njengodokotela, kusukela ngoJuni 1707, futhi washada nomzala wakhe, uMaria Barbara Bach, ekwindla leyo. UBach waqamba iToccata yakhe edumile neFugue kuD minor (BWV 565) nama-cantata akhe okuqala eseMühlhausen. Wabe esethatha umsebenzi kuMbusi waseSachsen-Weimar ngo-1708, esebenza njengomdlali wasenkantolo futhi edlala e-orchestra, ekugcineni waba ngumholi wayo ngo-1714. Wabhala izingoma eziningi zezinhlaka ngalesi sikhathi, kuhlanganise no-Orgel-Büchlein wakhe. UBach washiya iWeimar futhi wathola umsebenzi ngoDisemba 1717 njengoKapellmeister eCöthen. Ngo-1720, umkaBach wafa ngokuzumayo, wamshiya nezingane ezine (abanye abathathu bafa besebancane). Ngemuva kwesikhashana, wahlangana nonkosikazi wakhe wesibili, u-Anna Magdalena Wilcke, owashada naye ngoDisemba 1721. Wayezozala izingane eziyi-13, yize bebeyisihlanu kuphela abasinda ebuntwaneni. IBrandenburg Concertos (BWV 1046-51) eyisithupha, phakathi kweminye imisebenzi eminingi yezinsimbi, isukela eminyakeni yakhe yaseCöthen. UBach waba nguKantor weThomas School eLeipzig ngoMeyi 1723 futhi wawubamba lo msebenzi waze wafa. UBach wagcina engenelisekanga ngalo msebenzi, hhayi kuphela ngenxa yeholo lakhe eliphansi, kepha nangenxa yemisebenzi enzima nemishini emibi. Ngakho-ke, wamukela eminye imisebenzi, ehlanganisa nokuqondisa iCollegium Musicum yedolobha, iqembu labaculi abaqeqeshiwe nabafundisayo ababenikeza amakhonsathi masonto onke, ngo-1729. Wabuye waba ngumqondisi womculo eDresden Court ngo-1736, esebenzela uFrederick Augustus II. Yize wayenemisebenzi embalwa, wanikwa inkululeko yokuqamba lokho ayekufuna. Wagula isifo sikashukela, uBach washona ngoJulayi 28, 1750.

title: Michael Schumacher
text:
UMichael Schumacher (/ ˈʃuːmɑːkər /; isiJalimane: [ˈmɪçaːʔeːl ˈʃuːmaxɐ] (Mayelana nalolu luhlu lomsindo); owazalwa ngomhlaka 3 Januwari 1969) wayengumshayeli waseJalimane wangaphambili owayeqhudelana eFormula One yeJordan, Benetton, Ferrari neMercedes. USchumacher unerekhodi elihlangene lamarekhodi ayisikhombisa e-World Drivers 'Championship kanti, ngesikhathi ethatha umhlalaphansi kulo mdlalo ngo-2012, wayephethe amarekhodi emiklomelo eminingi (91), izikhundla zepali (68) kanye ne-podium finish (155) - esephulwe nguLewis Hamilton — ngenkathi egcina amarekhodi emathanga ashesha kakhulu (77) kanye nemijaho enqotshwe kakhulu ngesizini eyodwa (noSebastian Vettel) (13), phakathi kokunye.

Ngemuva kokuqala umsebenzi wakhe wokugijima ekarting, uSchumacher wakuthokozela ukuphumelela ochungechungeni oluncane lwezihlalo ezincane. Ngemuva kokubonakala okukodwa kweFormula One noJordani kwi-Belgian Grand Prix ka-1991, uSchumacher wasayinwa nguBenetton sonke isizini ka-1991. Uwine iziqu zakhe zokuqala nezesibili zabashayeli ngokulandelana ngo-1994 nango-1995, waqeda kabili ngaphambi kukaDamon Hill owagijima isibili. USchumacher wathuthela kuFerrari ngo-1996, owawina naye izicoco ezinhlanu zilandelana kusukela ngonyaka ka-2000 kuya ku-2004, kuhlanganisa nezicoco zesithupha nezesikhombisa ezazingakaze zibe khona, ephula amarekhodi amaningi. Ngemuva kokuqeda isithathu ngo-2005 nesesibili ngo-2006, uSchumacher uthathe umhlalaphansi kulo mdlalo, yize ngokuhamba kwesikhathi abuye kafushane neMercedes kusuka ngo-2010 kuya ku-2012.

Ngaphezulu komsebenzi wakhe, uSchumacher wayebandakanyeke ezigamekweni eziningi zomjaho eziphikisanayo. Kabili, wabandakanyeka ekushayisaneni emncintiswaneni wokugcina wesizini owanquma isicoco, okokuqala noHill ku-1994 Grand Prix yase-Australia futhi kamuva noJacques Villeneuve ku-1997 European Grand Prix. USchumacher nomfowabo omncane, uRalf, yibo kuphela izelamani abanqobe imijaho kuFormula One nezelamani zokuqala ukuqeda owokuqala nowesibili kulo mjaho ofanayo, okuyinto abayiphinde emijahweni emine eyalandela. USchumacher wahlonishwa ngokucindezela imoto yakhe kuze kube semkhawulweni ngezikhathi eziqhubekayo emijahweni kanye nohlobo lokuqina lokuqina.

Inxusa le-UNESCO, uSchumacher ubambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokusiza abantu futhi unikele ngamashumi ezigidi zamaRandi ezinhlanganweni ezisiza abantulayo. NgoDisemba 2013, uSchumacher walimala kanzima ebuchosheni engozini yokushushuluza eqhweni. Wafakwa ekhomeni elalisetshenziswa kwezokwelapha kwaze kwaba ngoJuni 2014. Washiya esibhedlela eGrenoble ukuze aqhubeke nokulungiswa esibhedlela i-University of Lausanne, ngaphambi kokuba adluliselwe ekhaya lakhe ukuze athole ukwelashwa nokuvuselelwa ngasese ngoSepthemba 2014.

title: Lewis Hamilton
text:
USir Lewis Carl Davidson Hamilton MBE HonFREng (owazalwa ngo-7 Januwari 1985) ungumshayeli wezimoto waseBrithani. Njengamanje uncintisana kwiFormula One yeMercedes, phambilini eshayela uMcLaren kusuka ngo-2007 kuya ku-2012. KuFormula One, uHamilton uzuze irekhodi elihlangene lamarekhodi ayisikhombisa e-World Drivers 'Championship (ahlanganiswe noMichael Schumacher), futhi uphethe amarekhodi okuhamba phambili kakhulu ukuwina (99), izikhundla ze-pole (101), nokuqedwa kwe-podium (173), phakathi kokunye.

Wazalelwa wakhulela eStevenage, eHertfordshire, uHamilton wasayinwa ohlelweni lwabashayeli abasebasha lakwaMcLaren ngo-1998. Lokhu kwaholela kuFormula One drive noMcLaren ngo-2007, okwenza uHamilton waba ngowokuqala, futhi kuze kube manje kuphela, umshayeli omnyama ukugijima kulo mdlalo owuchungechunge. Ngaleyo nkathi, uHamilton wabeka amarekhodi amaningi njengoba eqeda ukugijimela uKimi Räikkönen ngephuzu elilodwa. Isizini elandelayo, wawina isicoco sakhe sobuntombi ngendlela eyisimanga - enza into ebaluleke kakhulu ekhoneni lokugcina lomlenze wokugcina emjahweni wokugcina wesizini - ukuze abe yiFomula One World Champion ngaleso sikhathi emlandweni. Ngemuva kweminyaka emine noMcLaren, uHamilton wasayina neMercedes ngo-2013.

Izinguquko emithethweni ka-2014, egunyaza ukusetshenziswa kwezinjini ze-turbo-hybrid, zafika ekuqaleni kwesikhathi esibe yimpumelelo enkulu kuHamilton, lapho athola khona iziqu eziyisithupha zabashayeli. UHamilton unqobe izicoco ezilandelanayo ngo-2014 nango-2015 ngesikhathi ebangisana kakhulu nozakwabo uNico Rosberg. Ngemuva kokuthatha umhlalaphansi kukaRosberg, uSebastian Vettel kaFerrari waba yimbangi eseduzane kaHamilton ezimpini ezimbili ezinzima zobuqhawe, kwathi uHamilton waguqula kabili ukusilela kwamaphoyinti aphakathi nesizini ukuze afune izicoco ezilandelanayo futhi ngo-2017 nango-2018. , okulingana nokuqoshwa kukaSchumacher kwezihloko eziyisikhombisa zokushayela.

UHamilton udunyiswe ngokuqhubekisela phambili okulandelayo kweFormula One ngokunxusa izethameli ezibanzi ngaphandle komdlalo, ngokwengxenye ngenxa yendlela yakhe yokuphila ephezulu, ubushoshovu bezemvelo nezenhlalo, kanye nokusebenzisa kwakhe umculo nomfashini. Ubuye waba ngummeli ovelele ekusekeleni ubushoshovu bokulwa nokucwasana nokucindezela ukwanda kokwehlukahlukana kumotorsport. UHamilton ubhalwe ohlwini lwenkathi ka-2020 yeTime njengomunye wabantu abayi-100 abanethonya elikhulu emhlabeni jikelele, futhi waqeqeshwa ku-2021 Honours New Year.

title: Max Verstappen
text:
UMax Emilian Verstappen (ukuphinyiselwa kwesiDashi: [ˈmɑks eːˈmilijɑn vɛrˈstɑpə (n)]; owazalwa ngomhlaka 30 Septhemba 1997) ungumshayeli wezimoto zomjaho waseBelgian-Dutch [2] njengamanje encintisana kwiFormula One, ngaphansi kwefulegi laseDashi, neRed Bull Racing. Ku-2015 Grand Prix yase-Australia, lapho eneminyaka engu-17, izinsuku eziyi-166, waba ngumshayeli omncane kunabo bonke ukuncintisana kwiFormula One. Uphethe ezinye "zokuqala" eziningana kuFomula One.

Ngemuva kokuchitha isizini ka-2015 noScuderia Toro Rosso, waqala umkhankaso wakhe we-2016 neqembu lase-Italy ngaphambi kokukhushulelwa eqenjini labazali iRed Bull Racing ngemuva kwezinhlanga ezine njengendawo kaDaniil Kvyat. Lapho eneminyaka engu-18, wawina i-Spanish Grand Prix yango-2016 eqala ukudlala iRed Bull Racing, waba ngumshayeli omncane kunabo bonke futhi waba ngumshayeli wokuqala waseDashi ukuwina iFormula One Grand Prix. [3]

Ngokuhamba kwamasizini amahlanu alandelayo uzuze eminye imijaho eminingi yokuwina, okuhlanganisa neyokuqala yomshayeli ophethwe yiHonda kusukela ngo-2006. Uqede umqhudelwano wango-2019 nowe-2020 endaweni yesithathu. UVerstappen kufanele ahlale eRed Bull kuze kuphele isizini ka-2023 ngemuva kokusayina inkontileka. [4]

Uyindodana yowayengumshayeli weFormula One uJos Verstappen.

title: Charles Leclerc
text:
UCharles Marc Hervé Perceval Leclerc [2] (indlela yokubiza ngesiFulentshi: [ʃaʁl ləklɛʁ]; owazalwa ngomhla ka-16 Okthoba 1997) ungumshayeli womjaho waseMonégasque, njengamanje ogijima eFormula One yeScuderia Ferrari, ngaphansi kwefulegi laseMonégasque. ILeclerc iwine ubuqhawe be-GP3 Series ngo-2016 kanye neFIA Formula 2 Championship ngo-2017.

ULeclerc wenza ukubonakala kwakhe kweFormula One ku-2018 kuSauber, iqembu elihlangene neFerrari, ayekade eyingxenye yeFerrari Driver Academy. Njengoba uSauber eqede nyakenye ngonyaka owedlule, uLeclerc wahola icala lokuthi athuthukise indawo yokuqeda emqhudelwaneni wabakhi aye kwelesishiyagalombili, ngokuba sezingeni eliphakeme labashayeli ababili be-Sauber.

Kusukela ngo-2019 futhi wenza inkontileka kuze kube sekupheleni kwesizini ka-2024, uLeclerc njengamanje ushayela iFerrari. Waba ngumshayeli wesibili omncane ukwedlula wonke ukuthola iziqu zeFormula One e-2019 Bahrain Grand Prix. Isizini ka-2019 ibuye yabona uLeclerc ethatha ukunqoba kwakhe kokuqala kwezomsebenzi eBelgium, kwalandela ukunqoba i-Grand Prix yakhe yokuqala yase-Italy njengomshayeli weFerrari ngesonto elilandelayo. Uwine iPole Trophy ngesizini ka-2019 eba ngumshayeli omncane kunabo bonke futhi waba ngumshayeli wokuqala ongeyona iMercedes ukuyinqoba selokhu kwasungulwa le ndebe ngo-2014.

title: Sibusiso Moyo
text:
USibusiso Busi Moyo (SB Moyo) (1960 – 20 Januwari 2021) wayengusopolitiki waseZimbabwe futhi engumphathi jikelele wezempi.Waziwa ngokumemezela ukuxoshwa kukaRobert Mugabe kuthelevishini kazwelonke ngesikhathi seRussia ngo- 2017.Uqhubeke nokusebenza njengoNgqongqoshe Wezangaphandle Nezokuhwebelana Namazwe Omhlaba kwikhabhinethi ka- Emmerson Mnangagwa kusukela ngoNovemba 2017 kwaze kwaba sekushoneni kwakhe.

Isiqalo sokuphila 
UMoyo wazalelwa esibhedlela saseMnene Mission eMberengwa ngo1960.Wayengowesithathu ezinganeni eziyisishiyagalombili.Ngesikhathi efunda eManama Secondary School, wajoyina umzabalazo wenkululeko ngo-1977.Uthole iMasters kwi-International Relations ne-PhD kwi-International Relations e-University of Zimbabwe, waphinde wathola ne-Masters in Business Administration ayithole e-Zimbabwe Open University

Umsebenzi 
USB Moyo wasebenza njengomphathi omkhulu embuthweni weZimbabwe National Army, ngaphambi kokukhushulelwa esikhundleni sokuba nguLieutenant General mhla ethatha umhlalaphansi ngoDisemba 2017.Wanyuselwa esikhundleni sokuba ngu-brigadier general waba ngu-general general ngowayenguMongameli uRobert Mugabe ngoJanuwari 2016.

title: Hungani Ndlovu
text:
UHungani Ndlovu (owazalwa ngomhlaka 19 UNhlangulana 1994, uBushbuckridge), ungumlingisi nomdansi waseNingizimu Afrika.Ungumlingisi wesiTsonga owaziwa kakhulu ngezindima zakhe kumdlalo kamabonakude iMemoir of an Honest Voice, uSipho neScandal!.

Impilo yomuntu siqu 
Wazalwa ngo-19 Juni 1994, eMpumalanga, eNingizimu Afrika emndenini onezelamani ezintathu. Kodwa-ke, wakhulela eBushbuckridge eNelspruit, eNingizimu Afrika.Abazali bakhe baphuma emphakathini wamaTsonga.

Ushadelwe naye ongumlingisi wakuleli, futhi ongumethuli wezinhlelo kumabonakude uStephanie Sandows.Umshado ubugujwe ngasese ngomhlaka 23 Febhuwari 2019.

Umsebenzi 
Uqale umsebenzi wakhe ngo-2001 eneminyaka eyisikhombisa. Wayekwazi ukudansa, kodwa kamuva waphenduka waba ngumlingisi. Ngenhloso yokuba ngumlingisi, wathuthela e-USA waphothula izifundo zeHipHop Choreography eFlii'Cademy, eLos Angeles. Ubuye athandwe kakhulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngaphansi kwegama, 'Sbujwa dance' lapho efake khona ama-video okudansa. Ngesikhathi efunda eFlii'Cademy, waqeqeshwa ngaphansi komdwebi womdanso owaziwayo, uFliiStylz iminyaka emithathu.  Ubuye wafunda eNew York Film Academy waphasa i-Associated Degree in Acting for Film.

Ngemuva kokubuyela eNingizimu Afrika, waqala ukulingisa. Ukubonakala kwakhe okokuqala kwaba yindima ephambili efilimini, iMemoir yeZwi Elithembekile ngo-2014.Le filimu kamuva yathola indondo yeBest Short Film kuma- Africa Movie Academy Awards ngo-2015.Ngo-2016, wajoyina abalingisi bomdlalo wethelevishini odumile iScandal! futhi wadlala indawo ethi 'Romeo'.Khonamanjalo, ubuye wabonakala efilimini Yingoba Umnyama .  Wabe esedlala indima ephambili kuvidiyo yomculo uBlack Coffee . 

Ungumsunguli wesikhungo sokuqeqesha se-NPO, i-The Ndlovu Foundation esiza intsha ukuthi ifinyelele ezinhlosweni zayo ngokudansa nangemidlalo.Futhi uyiphayona lokusungula isitudiyo sokuthuthukisa ezobuciko, iStrong Attitudes Nurture Success Group (SANS).

Ngo-2016, wabonakala emidlalweni emibili yasesiteji: A Raisin in the Sun and A Night with Sam.Ngo-2018, walingisa efilimini uSipho wabe esethi HEKS ngo-2019. 
Abazalwa nge-1994
Abantu baphilayo

title: Stephanie Sandows
text:
UStephanie Ndlovu (née Sandows) (owazalwa ngomhla ka-29 Mfumfu 1990) ungumethuli wezinhlelo kumabonakude waseNingizimu Afrika futhi ongumlingisi owaziwa ngokubonakala kwakhe emdlalweni iSepha! nakuchungechunge lweMTV Shuga .

Impilo 
USandows wazalwa ngo-1990 futhi wafunda e- University of Johannesburg . Ngenkathi enza izifundo ze-post graduate wayekhanyisa inyanga ngokwakha imibhalo engezansi yeScandal yensipho! . Ucele iqembu lokukhiqiza ukuthi lengeze futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ubonakala kaningi. 

Wayengomunye zezimpi e.tv ka- Craz-e izingane izinhlelo ne nashayela Thulisile oPhongolo . 

USandows ubengumethuli wohlelo lwezenkolo lwezingane, uBonisanani.

AmaSandows adlale u-Ingrid, indodakazi kaWesley Thompson ( uZane Meas ), emdlalweni owuchungechunge waseNingizimu Afrika iScandal!, selokhu kwaphela unyaka ka-2015. 

Ulingiswe ochungechungeni lokuqala lwe-web series iMTV Shuga njengoTsholo . Wabizwa emuva kweminyaka ukuthi avele kokukhethekile kubo ngo-2019.

Impilo yangasese 
USandows waqala ukuthandana noHungani Ndlovu ngo-2016.UNdlovu, oveza umlingiswa kaRomeo kuScandal!, wahlangana naye ngo-2015 njengoba eba ngumlingisi omusha kulolu hlelo.Laba bobabili bashada ngasese ngoFebhuwari 2019.

title: Nomvelo Makhanya
text:
UNomvelo Makhanya (owazalwa ngomhlaka-24 Ephreli 1996), ungumlingisi nomculi waseNingizimu Afrika.Waziwa kakhulu ngokulingisa emdlalweni owuchungechunge wethelevishini Isibaya, iSoul City neScandal!.

Impilo yomuntu siqu 
Wazalwa ngomhlaka-24 Ephreli 1996 eNkandla, KwaZulu-Natal, eNingizimu Afrika.Ngemuva kweminyaka embalwa, wathuthela eGoli nabazali bakhe. 

Ngo-2016, kwatholakala ukuthi unesifo sokudangala nokukhathazeka.Kodwa-ke, ngemuva kwezikhathi zokubonisana eziningana, wakunqoba ukucindezeleka kwengqondo.NgoJanuwari 2019, umshayeli okuthiwa wayephuzile washayisa imoto kaNomvelo eyayipakiwe.NgoFebhuwari 2019, waveza umyalezo wakhe ongokomzwelo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ukuthi uhlukunyeziwe nge-cyber ngenxa yekhanda lakhe.

Umsebenzi 
Ujoyine iNational School of Arts (NSA) eBraamfontein, eGoli ngaphansi kokuholwa ngumama wakhe.Ngemuva kwalokho wadlala kumculo 'weSarafina' futhi wacabanga ukulandela njengomculi okhokhelwayo. Kamuva wajoyina imidlalo eminingi yeshashalazi efana neThe Bald Prima Donn, African Reflections futhi Mhlawumbe Lesi Isikhathi.Ngo-2016, wadlala indawo ka'Lindiwe Ngema ', emdlalweni owuchungechunge we-eTV iScandal!.
Abazalwa nge-1996

title: Ntokozo Hlonyana
text:
UNtokozo Khonziwe Fortunate Hlonyana ungusopolitiki waseNingizimu Afrika osebenza njengelungu lePhalamende Likazwelonke laseNingizimu Afrika kusukela ngomhlaka 23 Januwari 2018.Uyilungu leqembu le- Economic Freedom Fighters .

Impilo 
UHlonyana une-diploma kazwelonke yokuphathwa kwezemidlalo evela eDurban University of Technology kanye nesitifiketi sokubusa esivela e- University of Pretoria.Ujoyine i-EFF ngo-2013.  Ubeyilungu lethimba labaphathi begatsha futhi wakhonza njengomxhumanisi wesifunda esincane.UHlonyana ubebuye abe ngumhleli wethimba leqembu elilawula isifundazwe eGauteng. Ngo-2018, wayengumgqugquzeli weSifunda seChris Hani se-EFF.Ngaphambi kwalokho ubengumxhumanisi wesifunda i-Alfred Nzo. Ngo-2019, wakhethwa eqenjini eliphambili le-EFF njengelungu elengeziwe.

Ngesikhathi sakhe sokuqala njengelungu lePhalamende, ubesebenza kuwo womabili amakomidi ephothifoliyo emfundo ephakeme nokuqeqeshwa kanye nokuthuthukiswa komnotho.  Wakhethwa isikhathi esiphelele okhethweni lukazwelonke lwango-2019.Njengamanje uyilungu lePortfolio Committee on Women, Youth and People with Disabilities.

title: Killer Kau
text:
Sakhile Hlatshwayo (1998 - 9 Ncwaba 2021), eyaziwa efanele njengoba Killer Kau, kwaba-South African rapper, umdansi futhi irekhodi umkhiqizi waziwa kakhulu hit yakhe ingoma "Tholukuthi Hey".

Impilo yokuqala nomsebenzi 
UKiller Kau wazalwa ngo-1998 eSoweto, eNingizimu Afrika.Ukhule ecula esontweni ngaphambi kokuthi ajoyine ikhwaya yesonto iStain PC, ecula ibaritone. Ubuye futhi wajoyina ikhwaya labesilisa i-African Heavenly Soul Singers.

Umsebenzi wakhe wezomculo waqala ngesikhathi esafunda isikole nalapho ebhala umatikuletsheni ngo-2019. Waduma kakhulu ngesikhathi efaka ivideo ecula iculo lakhe elithi "Tholukuthi Hey", eladuma laheha uDJ Ephonik.

Ukufa 
Ngo-9 Ncwaba 2021, uKiller Kau washona engozini yemoto eya egig, eceleni komculi wamapiyano uMpura.
