title: Musician
text:
Umculi ngumuntu oqamba, aqhube, noma enze umculo.Ngokwe- United States i-Employment Service, "umculi" kuyinto jikelele eside lasetshenziswa ukuze kubhekiselwe endaweni umuntu olingisa umculo njengendlela mkhakha.Abaculi zihlanganisa bezingoma ngubani ukuqamba umculo kanye bhala isosha esihlatshelelwayo izingoma, babashayeli ngubani uqondise ukusebenza zomculo, noma abadlali abenza i izilaleli.Umenzi womculo ngumculi ngokuvamile noma umculi ohlinzeka vocals noma instrumentalist odlala a insimbi yomculo.Abaculi bangazenzela bodwa noma njengengxenye yeqembu, ibhendi noma i-orchestra.Abaculi bagxile kwisitayela somculo, kanti abanye abaculi badlala ngezitayela ezahlukahlukene eziya ngamasiko nemvelaphi. Umculi oqopha futhi akhiphe umculo angaziwa njengomculi oqoshiwe.

Izinhlobo

Umqambi 
Umqambi ungumculi odala izingoma zomculo.Isihloko sisetshenziselwa ikakhulukazi labo ababhala umculo we-classic noma umculo wamafilimu.Labo ababhala umculo wezingoma ezidumile bangabizwa njengababhali bezingoma (Labo ababhala kakhulu amagama ezingoma kungabizwa ngabo njengabaculi bezingoma ).

Umqhubi 
Umqhubi uqondisa ukusebenza komculo; ukuqhuba kuchazwe ngokuthi "ubuciko bokuqondisa ukusebenza ngasikhathi sinye kwabadlali abaningana noma abaculi ngokusebenzisa isenzo."Umqhubi umi emsamo ophakanyisiwe futhi uxhumana nabaculi ngokuthinta ngezandla noma ngokubabheka emehlweni.

Umenzi 
Izibonelo zabaculi zifaka, kepha azikhawulelwanga,abaculi bezinsimbi nabahlabeleli abaculela izethameli.Umculi angadlala njengomculi ohamba yedwa noma njengengxenye yomculo (isb. I-orchestra, ikwaya noma iqembu le-pop ).

title: Isigingci
text:
I isiginci yithuluzi eli-fretted insimbi yomculo ukuthi ngokuvamile eziyisithupha amayunithi wezinhlamvu . Kunenkolelo flat ngokumelene umzimba womdlali bese eyadlalwa strumming noma abahluthula izintambo onesandla evelele, kuyilapho ngesikhathi esifanayo ngokucindezela amayunithi wezinhlamvu akhethiwe ngokumelene frets nge iminwe uhlangothi okuhlukile.I-plectrum noma ukukhetha komunwe ngamunye kungasetshenziselwa ukushaya izintambo.Umsindo isiginci kulindeleke noma acoustically, esebenzisa ikamelo resonant phezu ithuluzi, noma iyakhula i-electronic iveni kanye amplifier .

Izinhlobo 

Iziginci zingahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezimbili ezibanzi, ama-acoustic kanye nama-guitar kagesi.Ngaphakathi kwalezi zigaba, kukhona nezinye izigaba ezingaphansi.Isibonelo, isigingci sikagesi singathengwa ngemodeli yezintambo eziyisithupha (imodeli ejwayelekile kakhulu) noma kumamodeli wezintambo eziyisikhombisa noma eziyishumi nambili.

I-Acoustic 

Ama-guitar acoustic akha imikhakha eminingana ephawulekayo ngaphakathi kweqembu lesigingci le-acoustic: izigingci zakudala nezama-flamenco ; ama-guitar-steel-guitar, afaka isigingci esicijile, noma "abantu", isiginci; isiginci sezintambo eziyishumi nambili ; kanye nesigingci se-arched-top. Iqembu lesigingci le-acoustic lifaka neziginci ezingafakwanga kahle ezenzelwe ukudlala kumarejista ahlukahlukene, njenge-acoustic bass guitar, enokushuna okufanayo nokwesigingci se-bass kagesi.

title: Velaphi Ndlangamandla
text:
UVelaphi Ndlangamandla (owazalwa ngo-1966), owaziwa ngo- The Saloon Killer, uyisigebengu saseNingizimu Afrika futhi ungumbulali, obhekene nokubulala abantu abangu-19 phakathi kuka-Ephreli noSepthemba 1998 eMpumalanga .Ugwetshwe iminyaka engu-137 ebhadla ejele ngamacala akhe.

Ngo-Ephreli 4, 1997, ngemuva kokweba isibhamu i-.22 Anschütz kuJacobus Christoffel van Schalkwyk, obizwa ngokuthi "yisaloon", uNdlangamandla waphinde wantshontsha esinye isibhamu, izinhlamvu, imisakazo, ubucwebe, okokugqoka, okheshi nokunye ukudla, ngaphambi kokuqhubeka ukubhebhetheka kobugebengu.Ithimba lamaphoyisa eliholwa nguSuperintendent Izak van Zyl, libophe uNdlangamandla esigodini sasePhoswa ngasePiet Retief ngoSepthemba 10, 1998.Wabekwa icala 19 okuzama ukubulala amacala, 9 okuzama ukubulala, 6 okuphanga, omunye lokuzama ukubamba inkunzi, 5 lokugqekeza, ukushaya ngendlela engalungile, ifa esingekho emthethweni kanye nezinhlamvu, nokukhomba othile ngesibhamu.UNdlangamandla ulahlwe yicala lawo wonke amacala, wagwetshwa iminyaka engu-137 ebhadla ejele.UKhomishana wamaphoyisa esifundazweni, u-Eric Nkabinde, uncome umsebenzi wamaphoyisa, waxwayisa zonke ezinye izigebengu ukuthi ngeke zibaleke isikhathi eside.

title: Gugulethu Zuma-Ncube
text: UGugulethu Zuma-Ncube (owazalwa ngomhlaka 10 Mfufu 1985) ungumkhiqizi waseNingizimu Afrika, ongumlingisi nendodakazi kaMengameli wangaphambilini uJacob Zuma kanye nosopolitiki we- African National Congress (ANC) uNkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, kanye nomalokazana ku-Zimbabwean Movement for Democratic Change Alliance usopolitiki uSolwazi Welshman Ncube. Impilo yomuntu siqu UGugulethu Zuma-Ncube, indodakazi yalowo owayenguMengameli waseNingizimu Afrika uJacob Zuma nosopolitiki owayengunkosikazi we-ANC uDkt Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, ushadelwe yisazi sezibalo uWesley Ncube, oyindodana kasopolitiki waseZimbabwe uSolwazi Welshman Ncube. Babeshade ngosuku lwabo lomshado ngo-20 Disemba 2008 ePitoli, eNingizimu Afrika. Umsebenzi Gugulethu Zuma-Ncube is a TV producer of serial dramas mainly on prime TV through her production company Stained Glass which she co-owns with her sister producer Thuli Zuma; the pair has produced Ifalakhe for pay-per-view channel Mzansi Magic.She’s produced the leading TV serial exploitation drama Uzalo on the leading channel SABC 1;she also produces South Africa’s medical drama Durban Gen on the privately owned channel E TV since October 2020;and she also produces Ehostela on Mzansi Magic. Early life Zuma-Ncube was born in 1985. In 2007, she graduated from AFDA with a Live Performance degree. Sindiswa, a graduation film in which she played a role, was nominated for the Student Academy Awards (Student Oscars) in Hollywood.She met her future husband, Wesley Ncube, while she was studying in Cape Town, and married him at the end of 2008. Career EGugulethu uvele imibukiso eziningana ithelevishini, kuhlanganise kokuphenywa Room, SABC3 ka- Isidingo,futhi e.tv ka- Rhythm City. Okwempilo Ngokusebenzisa Nyenyedzi Productions, okuyinto yena babambisane ungumnikazi odadewabo uNokuthula Nomaqhawe futhi Thuthukile Zuma, yena babambisane ekhiqizwa futhi wenza kuMzansi Magic 's Okwawo Life, 2011 asiwona umdlalo wethelevishini ezine 20-somethings ngubani ukuthola kwemijondolo elisendlini yabo.Ubaba wabo ukhuthaze lolu chungechunge nge- akhawunti yakhe esemthethweni ye-Twitter, lapho athola khona ukugxekwa. Uzalo UZuma-Ncube futhi co-ungumnikazi angcolile Glass Productions nge Kobedi "Pepsi" Pokane, which they co-kukhiqizwa Uzalo ngokuba SABC1 siteshi.Idlale izinsuku ezinhlanu ngesonto, ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu, kanti bekungumbukiso wethelevishini wesibili odume kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, ngemuva kwesiteshi soMzansi Magic, Isibaya telenovella, obekuhloswe ngaso ukuqhudelana naso. Ngo-2015 nango-2016, amaphephandaba ahlukene kazwelonke asola ukuthi uZuma Ncube wazuza ngokungafanele ekuqashweni ngokwezivumelwano ngezivumelwano zika-R167million kwaSABC nakuR8million esivela kuMasipala weTheku u- Uzalo . Lolu chungechunge lwe-TV lwabanjwa mpikiswano ngesikhathi isikhulu se- SABC ngaleso sikhathi uHlaudi Motsoeneng engenelela esinqumweni sokungaluvuseleli lolu chungechunge, kunalokho wathatha isinqumo sokukhokha amanye amasizini amathathu ngemali elinganiselwa ku-R167 million, okuyimali "i-SABC eyayingakhiqiza ngayo izinhlelo ezingaba ngu-20".AbakwaStain Glass Productions babesolwa ngokugxambukela kwezepolitiki ezinhlelweni zokuthengwa kwempahla kwaSABC,okwaphikwa ngabadidiyeli ababambisene nabo, bethi "benza konke ngale ncwadi" futhi abatholi "mpatho ekhethekile". Ezombusazwe Ngo-2011, wazinikela eLuthuli House, ekomkhulu le-ANC, nodadewabo uThuthukile. Abazalwa nge-1985 Abantu baphilayo

title: Rethabile Ramaphakela
text:
URethabile Ramaphakela (owazalwa ngomhlaka 13 Mbasa 1987), ungumenzi wamafilimu waseNingizimu Afrika, umkhiqizi wamafilimu nomlingisi .Waziwa kakhulu njengomqondisi kanye nomdidiyeli wezinhlelo ezithandwayo zethelevishini namafilimu iSeriously Single, Bedford Wives neThe Bang Bang Club.

Impilo yomuntu siqu 
Wazalwa ngomhlaka 13 Ephreli 1987 eNingizimu Afrika.Unabafowabo ababili: uTshepo noKatleho.

Umsebenzi 
Waqala umsebenzi wakhe njengomethuli we-KTV. Ekanye nabafowabo ababili, uRethabile wasungula inkampani ekhiqiza amafilimu 'iBurnt Onion' ngo-2010.Ngo-2014, wenza indima yokweseka efilimini yomhlaba iThe Bang Bang Club . Bese kule nkampani kukhiqizwa umdlalo owubukhoma wethelevishini iMy Perfect Family, osakazwa kuSABC1 ngo-2015. Ngemuva kokukhonjiswa ngempumelelo kwe-sitcom, wakhiqiza amafilimu amafushane afana neGoody Thokoza asuselwa ezimpini zaseThokoza ngawo-1980.Ngemuva kokuphumelela kwe-sitcom, wakhiqiza uchungechunge lwethelevishini iThuli no Thulani, Kota Life Crisis kanye neCheck Coast ngendlu yokukhiqiza. 

Ngo-Agasti 2020, waqondisa ifilimu yamahlaya iSeriously Single nomfowabo uKatleho Ramaphakela.Ikhishwe ngoJulayi 31, 2020 kuNetflix.

title: Umfana oqashisayo
text:
Ubufebe besilisa isenzo noma umkhuba wamadoda ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zocansi ngenhloso yokukhokha.Kuyindlela yokusebenza ngocansi.Yize amaklayenti kungaba yibuphi ubulili, iningi labo ngabesilisa.Uma kuqhathaniswa nabaqwayizi besifazane, abaqwayizi besilisa abakafundwa kangako ngabaphenyi.

Amagama 
Amagama esetshenziselwa besilisa izifebe ngokuvamile zihlukile esetshenziselwa nabesifazane.Amanye amagama ayahluka ngamakhasimende noma ngendlela yebhizinisi.Lapho ukudayisa ngomzimba kungavunyelwe noma Taboo, kuvamile ukuba izifebe zesilisa ukusebenzisa euphemisms okuyinto ukwethula ibhizinisi labo nokunikeza ubungane ukumodeliswa nude noma ukudansa, umzimba ukubhucungwa, noma enye eyamukelekayo Imali i-service ilungiselelo. Ngakho-ke umuntu angabizwa ngokuthi ngumkhaphi wesilisa, i- gigolo (okusho amakhasimende abesifazane), umfana oqashisayo, u- hustler (ovame kakhulu kulabo abacela ezindaweni zomphakathi), imodeli, noma i- masseur.Umuntu alibheki yena njengoba gay noma ngithanda abesilisa nabesifazane, kodwa ocansini namaklayenti besilisa ngemali, ngezinye izikhathi ibizwa ngokuthi gay i-pay, noma ukuhweba.

Amakhasimende wesilisa, ikakhulukazi lawo acosha abaqwayizi emgwaqweni noma ezindaweni zobhawa, kwesinye isikhathi abizwa ngama- johns noma amaqhinga.Labo abasebenza ngokudayisa ngomzimba, ikakhulukazi abaqwayizi basemgwaqweni, kwesinye isikhathi babiza isenzo sobufebe njengokuguqula izinto.

title: EReality
text:
eReality yisiteshi sase eNingizimu Afrika ngokoqobo ithelevishini isiteshi wadala futhi kungeyakho eMedia Investments sika e.tv ngoba OpenView.Isiteshi sisakaza amahora angu-16 ngosuku sikhombisa inhlanganisela yochungechunge lwasekhaya nolwamazwe omhlaba nostalgic ngokoqobo nemibukiso engakaze ivele ku-e.tv. 

I-eReality njengamanje iyisiteshi seqiniso esithandwa kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika.

Umlando 
I-eMedia Investment yenze ucwaningo ngokuthi yiziphi izibukeli ezazikhetha kakhulu ku-e TV naku-Openview.Lesi sinqumo bekungukuthi kunokuqukethwe okuhlanganisiwe okungokoqobo esiteshini esikhulu se-e.tv kufanele kube nesiteshi esisha, okwamanje esisebenza kuphela ku-Openview. 

UMarlon Davids, ongumqondisi ophethe iziteshi zakwa-e.tv, uthi ama-reality shows aqhubeka nokukhula ekuthandeni futhi kuyamjabulisa ukuthi abakwa-e.tv bethule lesi siteshi esizihlanganisayo.

Izinhlelo 
Ukuhlelwa kwe-eReality kufaka izindaba zangempela, izinhlamvu ezithakazelisayo nemizwelo yabantu eluhlaza. Izihloko eziphawuleka kakhulu zifaka phakathi i- MasterChef, Family Feud, The Real Housewives, Little Women franchise, Cheaters, The Planet's Funniest Animals, Forensic Files and Paternity Court.

Kusukela ngoMgqibelo mhlaka-10 Julayi 2021, lesi siteshi sizokwethula uhlelo lwendawo olubizwa nge-eKasi olusakaza izinhlelo ezifana no-Deadbeats, Beef, Will You Be My Ex, Tembisa Show nethi Pay Back The Money.Kusukela ngo-Agasti 2021, okunye okuqukethwe kwatholakala kuphela kwi- eVOD . 
Iziteshi kumabonakude

title: EExtra
text:
I-eExtra (kwesinye isikhathi ibizwa nge-e.tv Extra ) iyisiteshi sethelevishini saseNingizimu Afrika sedijithali.

Umlando 
I-e.tv njengomsakazi yethule i-eKasi +, eToonz +, eMovies + ne-eAfrica + njengeziteshi ezingosisi ezintsha njengesiteshi sayo sokuqala sezinhlelo ze-TV zethelevishini yedijithali yomhlaba (i-DTT).I-e.tv, i-SABC ne-M-Net bahlela kutsi ngamunye wabo akhicite emaqoqo abo etiteshi letengetiwe taseNingizimu Afrika ekugcineni.

Ukuhlela 
I-eExtra isakaza ikakhulukazi ama-telenovelas anenhlanganisela yezinye izinhlelo ezifana nochungechunge lwedrama, iqiniso, ama-sitcom, imibukiso yasenkantolo, indlela yokuphila nama-movie

Ama-movie nochungechunge 
Isiteshi sihlinzeka ngochungechunge namabhayisikobho ikakhulukazi ngezimpelasonto, ngemidlalo eminingi evela emazweni aphesheya.

I-Kuiertyd 
Ngomhla ka-1 Okthoba 2018, i-eExtra yakhipha ibhulokhi yesiBhunu eyaziwa ngokuthi yiKuertyd, ebonakala kakhulu ngezingcingo ezibizwa ngokuthi ama- telenovelas aseTurkey kanye nomyalezo wezindaba wansuku zonke ka-20: 00.

Amadrama namaTelenovelas 
Ngaphezu kwama-telenovelas aseTurkey, lesi siteshi sinama-telenovelas aphesheya avela kuTelemundo, iZee TV neSeoul Broadcasting System, ebizwa ngesiNgisi.
Iziteshi kumabonakude

title: E.tv
text:
e.tv (esivame ukubizwa emoyeni njengoba e) ungowokuqala futhi ngasese kuphela ephethwe free-kuya-emoyeni esiteshini sethelevishini e South Africa . Yisiteshi sethelevishini sesihlanu somhlaba ezweni, elandela iziteshi ezintathu ezisetshenziswa yiSouth African Broadcasting Corporation (okungukuthi i- SABC 1, i- SABC 2 kanye ne- SABC 3 ) kanye ne- M-Net ekhokhelwa ngabanikazi abazimele.Ngo-1997 isiteshi se-etv sathenga amalungelo okusakaza ekusakazeni imidlalo ye-English Premiership League (EPL) kwathi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi bathenga namalungelo okusakaza imidlalo ye-UEFA Champions League.

Ngaphandle-SABC, kuba lesibili kakhulu inethiwekhi wabukela kuleli zwe, ngokuvumelana DStv -sourced idatha.

Lo msakazi waba yinkonzo yezindaba yokuqala nokubukwa kakhulu ezweni lonke lapho yethulwa ngoJuni 2008.I-e.tv isiteshi sokuqala sezindaba esitholakala kuphela ku- DStv .

title: EMovies
text:
I-eMovies iyisiteshi sethelevishini samahhala esisebenza ngama -satellite saseNingizimu Afrika esisebenza amahora angama-24 esakhiwe futhi esiphethwe ngabakwa-e.tv baseMedia Investment besikhulumi se-Openview .

Umlando 
Ngesikhathi kwethulwa, abakwaStarSat bangenele izingxoxo nabakwa-eMedia Investments mayelana nokuthi bangakwazi yini ukufaka iziteshi zabo kungxenyekazi yabo ngaphambi kokuthi izinto zilunge.   

Ngo-2016, i-OpenView yethule isiteshi sesibili sama-movie esibizwa nge-eMovies Extra ukunika ababukeli ithuba lokuzikhethela kuma-movie. Ngemuva konyaka kwengezwa omabili ama-eMovies ne-eMovies Extra ku-DStv eNingizimu Afrika eceleni kwe-eExtra ne-eToonz.

Ngo-2017, izindaba zaveza ukuthi ngokutholakala kwesiteshi ku- DStv ngaphambi kokuba kwenziwe ngokusemthethweni ngoMeyi 17 eceleni kwe-eToonz, eMovies Extra ne-eExtra.Kamuva ngalowo nyaka, abakwa-e.tv banikeze ama-eMovies + ne-eToonz + ukucabanga kabusha; ngethelevishini yedijithali esunguliwe, izithombe "+" zezimpawu nazo zehlisiwe kusuka kulawo manethiwekhi.

Kamuva ngalowo nyaka, abakwa-e.tv banikeze ama-eMovies + ne-eToonz + ukucabanga kabusha; ngethelevishini yedijithali esunguliwe, izithombe "+" zezimpawu nazo zehlisiwe kusuka kulawo manethiwekhi.

eMovies Extra 

I-eMovies Extra iyisiteshi sesibili samahhala samahhala esenziwa yi-eMedia Investments eNingizimu Afrika.

Isiteshi sethulwe ngo-2016 ku-Openview kugujwa usuku lwesi-3 lwengxenyekazi ngaphambi kokuthi sitholakale ku-DStv eceleni kwe-eMovies + (ngaleso sikhathi), eToonz naku-eExtra.

title: ENCA
text:
eNCA, okubhekiselwa kuzo nangokuthi-eNews Channel Africa, kuyinto angu-24 ithelevishini izindaba Umsakazi okungewakho e.tv ogxile zaseNingizimu Afrika futhi Afrika izindaba.Lo msakazi waba ngowokuqala eNingizimu Afrika futhi wabheka kakhulu insizakalo yezindaba yamahora angama-24 ngemuva kokuyethula ngoJuni 2008.Kusukela saqala ukusebenza ngo-2008, lesi siteshi sezindaba besilokhu sisolwa njalo ngokusabalalisa inkulumo-ze ezinhlangothini lwesokudla nezindaba ezingamanga ngumholi we- African National Congress nomholi we-EFF uJulius Malema.

Ukutholakala 
I-eNCA iyatholakala esiteshini seDStv 403.

Ngo-Agasti 2012, lesi siteshi saqala ukuhlola kusethelayithi i-Eutelsat 28A, ekhululekile ukuyonqamula iYurophu.I-eNCA yethulwe ngokusemthethweni esifundeni ngenkathi ingezwa eSky e- UK nase- Ireland ngomhla ka-20 Agasti 2012, yize yavalwa mhla zingama-31 kuMfumfu 2014.

Umlando 
Izimpawu zokuqala zokuzalwa zalesi siteshi kwaba lapho u-e osanda kwakhiwa. ISat TV ifake isicelo selayisense le-pay-TV ngesikhathi sePay TV Regulation ngonyaka ka-2007. Ngasekupheleni kwalowo nyaka, banikezwa ilayisense kanye neMultichoice Africa esivele isebenza, igatsha lezindaba kwaTelkom SA iTelkom Media, isiteshi samaKristu iWalk on Water kanjalo neDigital Media . Noma kunjalo, e. ISat TV ibe ngeyokuqala ukudela yathi imakethe yaseNingizimu Afrika inkulu kuphela ngokwanele ukuthi isebenze kubashayeli ababili. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi bamemezele ukuthi kunalokho bazosebenza njengabahlinzeki besiteshi emsamo osevele usebenza weMultichoice DSTV. Ngo-1 Juni 2008, lesi siteshi saqala ukusakaza emoyeni ngo-19: 00 senza uhlelo olukhethekile lohlelo lwaso olwaziwa kakhulu i-News Night.  Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi isiteshi siqhubekile nokukhulisa inani lemibukiso, abethuli, nefomethi yokusakaza ukuheha nokwandisa ababukeli.

Ngomhlaka 19 Agasti 2012, i-eNews Channel yaphinde yaqanjwa kabusha njenge-eNCA (eNews Channel Africa) ngaphambi kokwethulwa kwayo e-UK, ngoba yayingafuni ukushayisana nemikhiqizo ekhona emhlabeni jikelele njengo- E! Ezokuzijabulisa iThelevishini futhi befuna igama lesizinda elifushane nelilula njengoba bezilungiselela ukungena ku-inthanethi.   Isiteshi sithole nophawu olusha lwe-mosaic olubonisa izwekazi lase-Afrika. 

Ngo-1 Juni 2018, lesi siteshi sagubha iminyaka engu-10 sasungulwa. Isiteshi sigubhe ingqophamlando ngokwethula ama-studio amasha, ukubukeka okusha, nokuhlelwa okusha ngomhlaka 16 Julayi 2018.  Isiteshi sethule nohlu olusha lwangempelasonto ngomhlaka 1 Disemba 2018.

Ngo-29 Julayi 2019, i-eNCA yethule uhlelo olusha sha.

Ku-inthanethi

eNCA.com 
Yethulwe ngoMeyi 2013, i-eCACA.com ukunwetshwa komkhiqizo we-eNCA kuzinkundla ezidijithali ukuvumela abathengi ukuthi bakwazi ukuthola ukusakazwa kwezindaba zokusayinda kunoma iyiphi into. NgoSepthemba, i-ECA.com yadlulisa ingqophamlando yeziphequluli eziyingxenye yesigidi, ngeziphequluli ezingama-538,000 sezizonke kanye neziphequluli zasekhaya ezingama-395,000. 

, the unique browsers for eNCA.com were 2.4 million, 2 million of which were domestic.

Imakethe ehlosiwe 
I-eNCA.com ine-userbase yabasebenzisi besilisa abangama-51.67% nabasebenzisi besifazane abangama-48.33%; Abasebenzisi ikakhulu bakubakaki beminyaka engu-25–29 (14.42%), 60+ (13.93%), no-30-34 (13.86%). Abasebenzisi be-NCA.com ikakhulu bavela eGauteng (44.6%), eNtshonalanga Kapa (22.07), kanye naKwaZulu-Natal (18.87%). Izilimi ezintathu eziphezulu zabasebenzisi be-ECA.com isiNgisi (73.69%), isiBhunu (30.16%), nesiZulu (11.23%).

Lolu hlelo lubandakanya ukufakwa kwezindaba jikelele ngezihloko ezisematheni nangezinhlelo eziyinhloko ze-eNCA: First Take, Live at Lunchtime, and South Africa Tonight . Le mibukiso ibivame ukufuduswa yizindaba ezigoqekayo kufaka phakathi imibiko ebukhoma, izindaba ezihamba phambili, nezindaba zebhizinisi.

Okokuqala Thatha 
UXoli Mngambi uphakamisa amahange Okokuqala Thatha . Uhlelo luqoqa imicimbi yezindaba ezenzeka ebusuku, kubhekwe i-ajenda yezindaba zosuku, kubuye kubuyekezwe ezemidlalo nesimo sezulu sosuku. Isakazwa phakathi nezinsuku 06: 00–07: 00.

Ukusa kwaseNingizimu Afrika 
UXoli Mngambi ujoyinwa nguJane Dutton weThe South African Morning . Lolu hlelo lubonisa ukuwela bukhoma kuzintatheli, izingxoxo zezingxoxo, nemibiko enemininingwane yezemidlalo neyezulu. Kusakazwa ngo-07: 00–08: 00.

Ihora likaJane Dutton 
UJane Dutton ubamba ihora eligcwele lezindaba, ezemidlalo nesimo sezulu esibizwa ngeThe Jane Dutton Hour . Uhlelo luletha zonke izindaba ngenkathi luhlola izihloko ezithokozisayo nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abathandekayo. Isakaza ngo-08: 00–09: 00.

Namuhla 
Namuhla, ihlelwe nguDan Moyane, iletha ababukeli izindaba ezisathuthuka, imibiko ebukhoma evela eNingizimu Afrika nakuMhlaba, izindaba zebhizinisi, nemibiko yezemidlalo neyezulu. Isakazwa ngo-09: 00–11: 00.

IRundown ifakwe ihange nguMichelle Craig iqukethe izindaba ezithuthukisayo zosuku, ukusakazwa bukhoma ngokubikwa okujulile kwezinsimu, izindaba zebhizinisi, nemibiko yezemidlalo neyezulu. Isakazwa ngo-11: 00–13: 00.

Ngo-2014, kwakhishwa idokhumentari eyayikhombisa ukuthi ithimba lisebenza kanjani ukumboza ukudlula emhlabeni kukaNelson Mandela. 

Ama- Olimpiki Asehlobo ngo-2012 abona iqembu lamadoda amabili, intatheli uPeter Stemmet kanye nomthwebuli wezithombe uNeil Raath, ebika impumelelo yaseNingizimu Afrika emidlalweni eyayiseLondon,kubalwa nezingxoxo nezingqwele zompetha bakuleli bama-Olympic uCameron van der Burgh, uChad le Clos, kanye negolide iqembu laseNingizimu Afrika eligwedla izindondo.

Impikiswano 
NgoFebhuwari 2021, intatheli ye-eNCA uLindsay Dentlinger wasolwa ngokuba nobandlululo ngemuva kokuphoqa abaholi bezepolitiki abamnyama be-UDM ne-IFP ukuthi bagqoke izifihla-buso ukuvimbela ukusabalala kwe- COVID-19 kodwa bavumela ozakwabo abamhlophe beDemocratic Alliance kanye ne- Afrikaner Freedom IFront Plus ezoxoxwa nayo ingagqokiwe izifihla-buso.

Iqiniso langempela 
Ngomhlaka 22 Novemba 2015, i-eNCA yashicilela indaba yokuqala yaseNingizimu Afrika yezindaba ezingokoqobo, eyabikwa nguYusuf Omar futhi yakhiqizwa ngokubambisana nenkampani yangempela yaseNingizimu Afrika, i- Deep VR . Le vidiyo engu-360 ° iqale ukuvela ekhasini le-eNCA kuFacebook futhi isithole ukubukwa okuningi kunamanye ama-eNCA.
Iziteshi kumabonakude

title: Africa Magic
text:
I-Africa Magic iqoqo leziteshi zokuzijabulisa zePay TV ezigxile ezinhlelweni zase-Afrika,okuthandwa kakhulu uchungechunge namabhayisikobho aseNigeria I-Africa Magic, eyaqala njengesiteshi esisodwa esinegama elifanayo, iwumkhiqizo wakwaM-Net futhi manje uneziteshi eziyisikhombisa.

Umlando 
I-Africa Magic yethulwa ngoJulayi 2003 njengesiteshi samabhayisikobho nesokuzijabulisa esijwayele ukukhombisa ithalente le-nollywood namasiko ase-Afrika. Ngesikhathi yethulwa ithole ukuthandwa kakhulu phakathi kwababhalisile be-DStv, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika naseNigeria. Ngakho-ke ukwethulwa kwesiteshi esingudade, i-Africa Magic Plus, kwenziwa kwaba nokwenzeka.Lezi ziteshi zadlulela kolunye uhlobo lomkhiqizo futhi eminyakeni eyishumi ezayo, lo mkhiqizo wakhula wafaka ezinye iziteshi eziyisikhombisa ezibandakanya ama-movie, izinhlelo zethelevishini nokuzijabulisa okujwayelekile.I-Africa Magic isakaza emazweni angaphezu kwama-50 ase-Afrika.Lezi ziteshi kubalwa i- Africa Magic Family, Africa Magic Showcase, Africa Magic Yoruba, Africa Magic Igbo, Africa Magic Hausa . I-Africa Magic Epic ne- Africa Magic Urban.I-Africa Magic ibuye ibhekane nemiklomelo yaminyaka yonke ye-Africa Magic Viewers 'Choice Awards (AMVCAs), umgubho omkhulu kunayo yonke wethalente lamafilimu nethelevishini e-Afrika.

title: M-Net
text:
IM-Net (isifinyezo se-Electronic Media Network) isiteshi sethelevishini esikhokhelwayo saseNingizimu Afrika esasungulwa yiNaspers ngo-1986.Isiteshi sisakaza izinhlelo zasekhaya nezamazwe aphesheya, kufaka phakathi ezokuzijabulisa jikelele, uchungechunge lwezingane, ezemidlalo nama-movie. Ngenkathi isignali ye-TV ivame ukubethelwa, uM-Net ukhombise ezinye izinhlelo 'ezikhululekile ukungena emoyeni' endaweni yayo "Yesikhathi Esivulekile" phakathi kuka-5 ntambama no-7 pm, kuze kuvalwe indawo ngomhla ka-1 Ephreli 2007.

title: OpenView HD
text:
I-OpenView (phambilini eyayaziwa nge-OpenView HD) ingumhlinzeki wethelevishini we-Direct Broadcast Satellite eNingizimu Afrika ophethwe yiPlatco Digital (ingxenye ye-eMedia Group efaka isiteshi samahhala somoya i-e.tv kanye no-24- isiteshi sezindaba sehora eNCA).Yethulwe ngomhlaka 15 Okthoba 2013, kepha yahluleka ekuqaleni ukukhulisa isisekelo sayo.

Ku-2020, ipulatifomu itholakala ku-2.4. amakhaya ayisigidi 

Inkampani engudade ye-e.tv, iPlatco Digital, yethule ipulatifomu ye-Openview HD ngomhlaka 16 Okthoba 2013.Isizathu esikhulu ukuthi ukufuduka kwedijithali eNingizimu Afrika bekuhamba kancane: Izinkampani ezinikezwe amathenda zithathe isikhathi eside ukuletha, ukuxhaswa ngezimali kwama-decoded subsidans, kanye nempikiswano phakathi kweziteshi ezinkulu ze-TV zokuthi ama-decoder we-DTT kufanele abe nokufinyelela okunemibandela noma cha.

title: Channel O
text:
Isiteshi O yisiteshi somculo esisekelwe eNingizimu Afrika esiqale ukudlulisa ngo-1997.Umqondo wayo omkhulu ngumculo wase-Afrika e- Afrika nakwamanye amazwe.

Isiteshi O sitholakala nge- DStv, isevisi ekhokhelwa nge-satellite pay kumakhaya akwele-Afrika.Isiteshi sisakaza amavidiyo omculo ahlukahlukene.

Iphinde ibe nomcimbi waminyaka yonke wamaChannel O Music Video Awards, lapho abaculi baklonyeliswa ngeqhaza labo elihle emculweni.

Isiteshi O, kule minyaka edlule, besilahlekelwa isithunzi esikhulu ngenxa yokuvulwa kakhulu kweMTV Base Africa, Trace Urban neTrace Africa.Isiteshi besilokhu sizama izindlela eziningi zokuthola ukuthandwa kufaka phakathi indlela ethandwa kakhulu yokwakha okuphakelayo kwaseNingizimu Afrika kanye ne-Rest of Africa feed (iMTV Base neTrace nabo bakwamukele lokhu)

title: Trace Africa
text:
ITrace Africa iyisiteshi somculo we-afro-pop esizinikele ekusakazeni abaculi bomculo abaphambili e-Afrika.ITrace Africa, okuyisiteshi somculo sokuqala e-Afrika, izinikele ekudlaleni nasekuboniseni umculo wabaculi abahamba phambili base-Afrika kanye nezinhlobo ezibandakanya i-Afro-pop, Coupé Décalé, Kwaito House, Afro-trap, Makossa, N'dombolo ngomsakazo nasemicimbini yekhonsathi ebukhoma.ITrace Africa yingxenye encane yomkhiqizo omkhulu weTrace, inkampani ezinikele ekusakazeni umculo, izindaba namasiko kulo lonke elase-Afrika eliHlakazekile.I-Trace Africa uhlelo lokuqala lomsakazo lwaqala ukukhonjiswa ku-DStv, ngonyaka ka-2016 esikhundleni seTrace Sports Stars kulo lonke izwekazi futhi kusukela ngo-2017 nalo selikhona kuStarSat.

IZimbabwe neTrace Africa 
Njengoba umculo weTrace Africa ukhethwa futhi ucwaningwe kubaculi bakuleli nabakwamanye amazwe kwenye yezindawo ezintathu zeTrace eziseNingizimu Afrika, eCameroon naseNigeria, abaculi bakuleli kulindeleke bazuze kakhulu ekukhuleni kweTrace Africa.Labo abavela eZimbabwe bahlomule ikakhulukazi ezindlekweni zeTrace Africa zokuthola umculo.Abaculi baseZimbabwe bavame ukucindezelwa emthunzini wabantu abadumile baseNigeria nabaseNingizimu Afrika a rtists , kanti iTrace Africa manje isiphenduke inkundla lapho abaculi abaningi bengakhombisa ngamakhono abo futhi bazibeke ebalazweni.Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngemizila emisha yokulandela umkhondo yase-Afrika, abaseZimbabwe nabanye abaculi abavame ukumbozwa manje sebenethuba lokubonakala. Lokhu futhi kukhulisa ubuhlakani nokukhiqiza kubaculi bendawo.

title: SABC 3
text:
I-SABC 3 (eyenziwe isitayela njenge-S3) yinethiwekhi yethelevishini yamahhala yaseNingizimu Afrika ephethwe yiSouth African Broadcasting Corporation (SABC). Iphethe izinhlelo ngesiNgisi kanti, kusukela ngo-Ephreli 2009, isiBhunu, okwakuthi ekuqaleni sasineziqephu zaso kodwa eminyakeni embalwa edlule besiphinda kakhulu i- 7de Laan.

Kusukela ngoJuni 2018, bekusakazwa ngencazelo ephezulu.

Ngo-Ephreli 2021, lesi siteshi saphinde saqanjwa kabusha futhi sabhalwa njenge-S3.

Ukuhlela

Ezemidlalo 
ISABC3 isakaza imidlalo ye-English Premier League kusukela ngasekupheleni kuka-Agasti 2018 kuze kube ngu-Agasti 2019 futhi ibingumsakazi osemthethweni wayo yonke imidlalo engu-38 PL yeChelsea Football Club.Sekuyiminyaka uSABC 3 esakaza imidlalo yekhilikithi njengemidlalo yeT20, ODI, iTest series, World Cups neAfrican Cup of Nations, njll. Lesi siteshi futhi sinamalungelo okusakaza imidlalo yobuciko obubumbene bemidlalo yempi kusuka kuma-Extreme Fighting Championships Kusukela ngoSepthemba 2020, iSABC 3 isakaza iBundesliga njengomsakazi oyedwa waseNingizimu Afrika amasizini amabili

Izindaba Nezindaba Zamanje 
Isiteshi sikhonza izindaba zezikhulumi zesiNgisi, simulcasting ukusakazwa kwezindaba nesiteshi sabo seSABC News .Ibuye ibe nezindaba zamanje nezamadokhumentari amanje nasekhaya. I-SABC 3 iphinde yasakaza iDeutsche Welle yaseGerman ngesiNgisi.Ngo-Ephreli 2021, i-SABC 3 inohlelo olusha lwezindaba ezisematheni olubizwa ngePrime News On 3, manje seluzosakaza phakathi nezinsuku ngeSonto ngo-8 ebusuku nangama-Weekends ngo-6 ntambama.

title: Takalani Sesame
text:
UTakalani Sesame ("be happy Sesame" ngesiVenda ) uhlelo lwaseNingizimu Afrika lohlelo lwethelevishini lwezingane iSesame Street, olwenziwe ngokubambisana yiSesame Workshop kanye nabalingani baseNingizimu Afrika.

Ngokusho kweSesame Workshop, iTakalani Sesame "yindlela ehlukile yaseNingizimu Afrika yokuhumusha imodeli yeSesame, iheha izingane nabazali bazo futhi igqugquzela ukulungela isikole okuyisisekelo, ukufunda nokubhala, ukubala, kanye nempilo nenhlanzeko."ITakalani Sesame nayo igxile ngokukhethekile ekuqwashiseni nge-HIV / AIDS futhi ifuna ukwethula ukuphepha nge-HIV / AIDS ngenkathi ikhuthaza ukubekezelelana nokunciphisa ukucwaswa. Uchungechunge lweTakalani lubuye lubandakanye nohlelo lomsakazo oludumile, uchungechunge lwamahlaya omagazini namaphephabhuku, kanye nomkhankaso kazwelonke okhuthaza abantu abadala ukuthi bakhulume nezingane zabo nge-HIV / AIDS nezinye izindaba ezihlobene nayo.

Umbukiso uhlanganisa zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni zaseNingizimu Afrika eziyi-11: isiBhunu, isiNgisi, isiZulu, isiXhosa, iSwazi, isiNdebele, isiSuthu, isiSuthu saseNyakatho, isiTsonga, isiTswana nesiVenda.

U-Archbishop Desmond Tutu, uKofi Annan, noNane Annan benze ezibukwayo njengezivakashi kulolu hlelo.Isizini 11 yalolu hlelo bekufanele iqale ngomhlaka 1 Juni 2020 esiteshini sethelevishini saseNingizimu Afrika i- SABC 2.Isizini 12 njengamanje idlala phakathi nezinsuku ngo-15: 30 kuSabc2.

title: IVelvet (isiteshi se-TV)
text:
IVelvet kwakuyinethiwekhi yethelevishini yekhebula lasePhilippines ezinze eQuezon City.Yayiphethwe futhi iqhutshwa yiCreative Programs, Inc. (manje eyi-ABS-CBN Cable Channels), okuyinkampani ephethwe ngokuphelele yithimba labezindaba i-ABS-CBN Corporation.Ukugxila okuyinhloko kwenethiwekhi bekuzinhlelo zokuzijabulisa ezigxile kwabesifazane.

Imininingwane Yesiteshi 
Velvet kwadingeka kusengaphambili hlala ku SkyCable isiteshi 25 kusukela ngo-November 2007, kanye Maxxx futhi Amabhola.IVelvet yethulwa ngokusemthethweni ngoJanuwari 1, 2008. IVelvet iphinde yasakaza imibukiso ekhethiwe kuStudio 23 (manje eyiS + A ).

Isiteshi sasuka emoyeni phakathi kwamabili ngoMasingana 1, 2014.UMiss Universe 2013 kwakuwuhlelo lokugcina lweVelvet ngaphambi kokuthi lusayinwe unomphela.

Iningi lezinhlelo zesiteshi kanye nezipesheli zithuthelwe ku-Lifestyle (manje eyiMetro Channel ).

Incazelo 
IVelvet ingumphumela ngemuva kokuphela kwenkontileka yeSolar Entertainment's 2nd Avenue neSkyCable . IVelvet ifana ncamashi netimu nezethameli ezine- ETC ne-yesibilind Avenue ngokujwayelekile ikhanga uhlobo lwababukeli besifazane ngobubanzi obusuka ngaphambi kokuthomba kuya kubakaki abaneminyaka engamashumi amathathu nantathu.I-Velvet ifaka izinhlelo ezisuselwa ezindabeni zokuzijabulisa nakokukhethekile, imibukiso yemidlalo,izenzo zamahlaya wokuma, idrama, uchungechunge lweqiniso nemibukiso yemiklomelo.

title: Ntare School
text:
Isikole iNtare yisikole samabanga aphakeme sabafana abahlala eMbarara, esifundeni iMbarara, eningizimu ntshonalanga ne- Uganda.Yasungulwa e1956 nguthisha waseScotland ogama lakhe linguWilliam Crichton.

Idumela 
INtare School ingesinye sezikole ezihlonishwa kakhulu e-Uganda ngenxa yomlando waso, idumela laso, ukusebenza kahle kwezemfundo, nokubusa kwalo kwezemidlalo. 

INtare School ibuye izishaye isifuba nge-Alumni Soccer League iNtare Lions League  eqhutshwa njalo ngeSonto.

Izifundiswa 
Izihloko ezinikezwa ngeleveli ejwayelekile ("O") zifaka; I-Biology, i-Chemistry, i-Christian Religious Education, i-Agriculture, i-Commerce, i-Computer Studies, i-English Language kanye ne-Literature, i-Music, i-Fine Art, i-French, i-Geography, i-History, i-Mathematics, i-Physics, i-Political Education ne-Kiswahili.

Ezifundweni ezisezingeni eliphakeme ("A") ezifundiswayo zihlukaniswe ngeZobuciko neSayensi.Izifundo zobuciko ezinikezwayo yilezi; Umlando, Ezomnotho, UbuNkulunkulu, IsiFulentshi, Izincwadi ZesiNgisi, IJografi, IsiSwahili, Umculo Nobuciko Obuhle.Izifundo zeSayensi ezinikezwayo yiFizikiki, iChemistry, iMathematics, iBiology, ezoLimo, iMasidi esezingeni eliphansi kanye neGeneral Paper okuyisifundo esiyimpoqo.

title: Ntando Duma
text: UNtando Duma (owazalwa ngo-Agasti 29, 1995) ungumlingisi waseNingizimu Afrika futhi ungumlingisi wakumabonakude. Yena waziwa kakhulu njengoba umethuli ku e.tv ka- intsha izinhlelo block Craz-e, lapho yena ngokuyinhloko ofakwe Craz-e Umhlaba bukhoma.Uyaziwa futhi ngokulingisa uZinzi Dandala emdlalweni owuchungechunge i-e.tv iRhythm City. Ubuye futhi waba semjahweni kulandela ukusakaza bukhoma lapho ahlukumeza khona ngokobuhlanga owesifazane owambuza ngokupaka endaweni yokupaka ekhubazekile. Isiqalo sokuphila UNtando Duma wazalelwa elokishini e- Orange Farm eGoli, eGauteng.Ukhulele elokishini i- Orange Farm etholakala cishe kuma-45 km ukusuka eGoli, lapho akhuliswa khona ngunina nogogo wakhe. Unabafowabo abathathu okubalwa kubo nodadewabo, uThando Duma. Ubaba wakhe washiya umndeni eneminyaka emithathu ubudala futhi washona ngo-2008. Impilo yomuntu siqu Unengane enoDJ obizwa ngeJunior DeRocka oqambe ingane yabo, uSbahle Mzizi. Umsebenzi Ithelevishini Ujoyine i- Rhythm City ye-etv enguZinzi Dandala.NgoJuni 2014 uNtando Duma wethulwa njengomunye wabethuli abasha beCraz-e. Ngo-2020, wajoyina iThe Queen telenova edlala indawo kaMpho Sebata, ngonyaka olandelayo ngoJuni 2021 kwamenyezelwa ukuthi uyashiya kulo mdlalo. Ukumodela Usebenze njengesibonelo futhi ubeyingxenye yomgwaqo wokugijima weviki lezimfashini laseSoweto ngo-2015. Umphakathi Wasungula i-Inspire A Teen SA Foundation. Impikiswano Isikhala Sokupaka Esikhubazekile Ngo-6 Julayi 2021, uNtando Duma wathola ukugconwa ngokupaka endaweni ekhubazekile ebhalwe abakhubazekile, ngemuva kokuyifaka ku-akhawunti yakhe yeTwitter.Abantu abaningi ababuke le vidiyo bathi uDuma wayelindele ukuthi abantu abaMnyama bamvikele ngokubiza abantu abamhlophe "nokuziphatha kwabo okubi" noma "ukuzikhukhumeza". Abantu baphilayo

title: Ntfombi yaseswatini
text:
U-Queen Ntfombi, u-The Queen Mother, u-Ndlovukati wase-Eswatini (owazalwa ngo- Ntfombi Tfwala ngo-1950) uyindlovukazi yamanje no- head of state of Eswatini, okhonza kusukela ngo-1986. Wayephinde Regent ka Eswatini kusuka 1983 kuya ku-1986. Ungumama weNkosi uMswati III.

Impilo yokuqala nomshado 
UNtfombi wazalwa ngo-1950. Washada neNkosi uSobhuza II waseSwazini, owathola indodana naye, uMntwana uMakhosetive Dlamini.

Ngo-1982 inkosi uSobhuza esiqokiwe omunye kwamakhosikazi akhe, ukukhashelwa Queen Dzeliwe, njengoba Indlovukati ukubusa njengenkosi eNgophezukonke ezikanye ikusasa lakhe owalandela.Esikhundleni siqaphela enye yamadodana akhe ngokuthi indlalifa sobala, wabonisa ukuthi bakhe Loqoqo ukuthi wayefuna Prince Makhosetive Dlamini esikhundleni sakhe sobukhosi. NgoJuni 1982 wabuye welula igunya leLoqoqo, walinika amandla okusebenza "njengoMkhandlu Ophakeme Wombuso", okhululekile ukuqoka "Umuntu Ogunyaziwe" ozosebenzisa ilungelo lobukhosi uma i-regent ithathwa njengengakwazi ukwenza kahle.

Ukubusa kweNdlovukazi u-Dzeliwe 
Esikhala sokuphela kwamandla esabangelwa ukufa kukaSobhuza II, u- Indlovukati Dzeliwe waba yiNdlovukazi u-Regent ngesikhathi esincane sendlalifa ekhethiwe, kepha iLoqoqo, eyayiqukethe kakhulu izihlobo eziphezulu zeNkosi uSobhuza, izinduna nabeluleki, yathatha igunya lakhe futhi yaxosha UNdunankulu kaSobhuza, uMntwana uMabandla Dlamini, okusobala ukuthi amalungu kaLoqoqo besaba ukuthi uzobaphuca indima yabo entsha.Uma Prince Makhosetive Dlamini attained iningi yakhe futhi ngokusemthethweni ukubusa, unina Bazobe kulindeleke ukuba eyabizwa ngokuthi Indlovukati entsha.Kodwa-ke, iNdlovukazi u-Dzeliwe yaboshwa ngaphansi kwendlu ngo-1983.Ukulandela izinsuku ezingu-9 ngesikhathi lapho Swaziland lalibuswa Prince Sozisa Dlamini, Ntfombi sikhethwe njengoba indlovukazi ibamba .
Abantu baphilayo
Abazalwa nge-1950s

text:

Iminyaka yokuqala

I-eBella kwakuyisiteshi sethelevishini saseNingizimu Afrika sedijithali esenziwe futhi esasiphethwe yi-e.tv 's eMedia Investment ye- Openview ne- DStv.

Umlando

Ukwethulwa kwalokhu kungenxa yesiteshi esisha sokuqukethwe ku-DStv esibizwa ngeMoja Love, esethulwe ngomhlaka 14 kuFebhuwari 2015.Isiteshi besigxile kubathandi nabathandi bobudlelwano, okuyi-e.tv edale i-eBella ukuba ibe yisiteshi esithandwa ngabesifazane.

I-eBella inqanyulwe ekupheleni kukaMashi 2019 ngenxa yokubukwa okuphansi. Konke okuqukethwe kuhanjiswe kwa- eExtra.Ngenxa yokususwa kweStar Life,i-OVHD imemezele ukuthi maduzane lesi siteshi sizovula kabusha.

title: Umbhali
text:
Umbhali ngumuntu osebenzisa amagama abhaliwe ngezitayela namasu ahlukene ukudlulisa imibono.Ababhali bakhiqiza izinhlobo ezahlukahlukene zobuciko bemibhalo nokubhala kokuqamba njengamanoveli, izindaba ezimfishane, izincwadi, izinkondlo, imidlalo yeshashalazi, imidlalo yesikrini, izingcingo, izingoma nezindatshana kanye neminye imibiko nezindatshana zezindaba ezingaba nentshisekelo emphakathini.Imibhalo yabalobi ishicilelwa kwimidiya ehlukahlukene. Ababhali abanekhono abakwazi ukusebenzisa ulimi ukuveza imibono kahle, bavame ukufaka isandla kakhulu kokuqukethwe kwamasiko emphakathini. 

Igama elithi "umbhali" liphinde lisetshenziswe kwenye indawo kwezobuciko nasemculweni - njengombhali wezingoma noma umbhali wesikrini - kepha njenge "mbhali" ozimele ngokuvamile kubhekiswa ekwakhiweni kolimi olubhalwayo.Abanye ababhali basebenza ngokwesiko lomlomo.

Ababhali bangakhipha okokusebenza ezinhlotsheni eziningi, eziqanjiwe noma ezingezona eziqanjiwe.Abanye ababhali basebenzisa imidiya eminingi - ngokwesibonelo, ihluzo noma umfanekiso - ukuthuthukisa ukuxhumana kwemibono yabo.Esinye isidingo sakamuva senziwe ngabafundi bakahulumeni kanye nohulumeni ngomsebenzi wabalobi bezobuchwepheshe abangaqanjiwe, abanamakhono adala imibhalo eqondakalayo, etolikekayo yohlobo olusebenzayo noma lwesayensi.Abanye ababhali bangasebenzisa izithombe (ukudweba, ukudweba, ihluzo) noma i- multimedia ukukhulisa ukubhala kwabo. Ezimweni ezingavamile, ababhali bokudala bayakwazi ukudlulisa imibono yabo ngomculo nangamagama.

title: Imbongi
text:
Imbongi ngumuntu odala izinkondlo.Izimbongi zingazichaza kanjalo noma zichazwe kanjalo ngabanye abantu. Imbongi ingavele ibe ngumbhali wezinkondlo, noma ingenze ubuciko bayo kuzethameli.

Umsebenzi wembongi empeleni ungowokuxhumana, kungaba ukuveza imibono ngomqondo ongokoqobo, njengokubhala ngomcimbi othile noma indawo ethile, noma ngokomfanekiso. Izimbongi bezikhona kusukela endulo, cishe kuzo zonke izilimi, futhi zikhiqize imisebenzi eyehluka kakhulu emasikweni nasezinkathini ezahlukahlukene.Kuyo yonke impucuko nolimi ngalunye, izimbongi zisebenzise izitayela ezahlukahlukene eziguqukile ngokuqhubeka komlando wokubhala, okuholele emlandweni wezimbongi ezahlukahlukene njengezincwadi abazikhiqizile.

Umlando 
E- Ancient Rome, izimbongi eziqeqeshiwe zazivame ukuxhaswa ngabathengi, abacebile abacebile kubandakanya izikhulu nezikhulu zamasosha.Isibonelo, uGaius Cilnius Maecenas, umngani kaKesari Augustus, wayengumphathi obalulekile wezimbongi zika-Augustan, kufaka phakathi bobabili uHorace noVirgil.Ngenkathi u- Ovid, imbongi esungulwe kahle, waxoshwa eRoma ngu- Awugustu wokuqala.

NgeNkathi Ephakathi Ephakathi, abahlukumezi babeyisigaba esibalulekile sezimbongi futhi bevela ezizindeni ezahlukahlukene.Babehlala futhi behamba ezindaweni eziningi ezahlukahlukene futhi babebhekwa njengabalingisi noma abaculi njengezimbongi.Babevame ukuphathwa, kepha abaningi babehamba kakhulu.

Isikhathi se- Renaissance saqhubeka nokuxhaswa kwezimbongi ngabasebukhosini.Izimbongi eziningi, kodwa, bezineminye imithombo engenayo, okubandakanya amaNtaliyane anjengoDante Aligheri, uGiovanni Boccaccio noPetrarch 's works in a pharmist's guild and William 's Shakespeare's theatre.

Esikhathini se-Romantic kuya phambili, izimbongi eziningi zazingababhali abazimele ababeziphilisa ngomsebenzi wabo, imvamisa belekelelwa yimali evela kweminye imisebenzi noma emndenini.  Lokhu bekubandakanya izimbongi ezinjengoWilliam Wordsworth noRobert Burns.

Izimbongi ezifana noVirgil ku- Aeneid noJohn Milton kwi- Paradise Lost bacele usizo lwe- Muse.

Ezemfundo 
Izimbongi zezikhathi zangaphambili zazivame ukufundwa kahle nabantu abafunde kakhulu kanti ezinye zazizifundise ngezinga elikhulu.Izimbongi ezimbalwa ezifana noJohn Gower noJohn Milton bakwazile ukubhala izinkondlo ngezilimi ezingaphezu kweyodwa.Ezinye izimbongi zasePortugal, njengoFrancisco de Sá de Miranda, azibhalanga ngesiPutukezi kuphela kodwa nangeSpanishi.UJan Kochanowski ubhale ngesiPolish nangesiLatin,  uFrance Prešeren noKarel Hynek Mácha  babhala izinkondlo ezithile ngesiJalimane, yize babeyizimbongi zaseSlovenia naseCzech ngokulandelana. U-Adam Mickiewicz, imbongi enkulu kunazo zonke zolimi lwasePoland, wabhala i-ode yesiLatini yombusi uNapoleon III.Esinye isibonelo uJerzy Pietrkiewicz, imbongi yasePoland. Lapho ethuthela eGreat Britain, wayeka ukubhala izinkondlo ngesiPolish, kodwa waqala ukubhala inoveli ngesiNgisi.Wabuye wahumusha izinkondlo zisuselwa esiNgisini ziye esiNgisini.

Amanyuvesi amaningi ahlinzeka ngama-degree ekubhaleni okudala yize lokhu kuvele kuphela ngekhulu lama-20.Yize lezi zifundo zingadingeki emsebenzini wokuba yimbongi, zingaba wusizo njengokuqeqesha, nokunikeza umfundi iminyaka eminingi yesikhathi egxile ekubhaleni kwabo.

Izimbongi zevesi elingcwele 
Izimbongi ezi-Lyrical ezibhala izinkondlo ezingcwele ("ama- hymnographer ") ziyehluka emfanekisweni ojwayelekile wezimbongi ngezindlela eziningi.Umbhali wezingoma ezifana no- Isaac Watts owabhala izinkondlo ezingama-700 ngesikhathi sakhe sokuphila, kungenzeka ukuthi izingoma zakhe ziculwa yizigidi zabantu njalo ngeSonto ekuseni, kodwa azifakwanga njalo kwizingoma zezinkondlo.Ngoba amaculo abhekwa njengokuthi " ukukhonza " kunokuthi "izinkondlo," igama elithi "ubuciko kenosis" kwesinye isikhathi lisetshenziselwa ukuchaza impumelelo yomculi wehuna "ekuchitheni" umuzwa wokuphumelela njengombongi.Umculi osesihlalweni angahle abambe ngekhanda izitanza ezimbalwa zikaWatts, ngaphandle kokwazi igama lakhe noma ukumcabanga njengembongi.

title: Ntumba Luaba
text:
U-Alphonse Daniel Ntumba Luaba Lumu wayenguNobhala Ophethe Wengqungquthela Yamazwe Ngamazwe Esifundeni SamaLwandle Amakhulu kusukela ngoDisemba 2011 kuze kube ngu-2016.

Phambilini uke waba nguNgqongqoshe Wamalungelo Abantu eDemocratic Republic of the Congo (DR of the Congo). Ngaphambi kwalesi sikhundla, ubenguSolwazi Wezomthetho Womhlaba Wonke eKinshasa.Wayengomunye wabantu, owayemele i-DR yaseCongo eNkantolo Yomhlaba Yezobulungiswa eHague 

NgoMeyi 2003, uNtumba waphoqeleka ukuba aphephele ezikhungweni ezilawulwa yi-UN ngesikhathi kuchitheka igazi elabulala abantu abangaphezu kuka-112.Lesi sigameko besingenye yezehlakalo eziningi ezenzeke eminyakeni edlule lapho ukuphepha kukaNtumba kusongelwa ngokuqhubeka nodlame lwangaphakathi.Onyakeni owawandulele, ngo-2002, Ntumba ethunjiwe ngeviki nge Hema amasosha e Bunia ngaphambi kokukhishwa bengenamiyocu kulesi sigameko.UNtumba Luaba ubephethe izikhundla eziningana kuhulumeni waseDRC njengePhalamende, iphini likangqongqoshe wezobulungiswa, ungqongqoshe wamalungelo abantu, unobhala-jikelele kahulumeni. WayenguMqondisi wohlelo lukazwelonke lwe-DDR waze waqokwa njengommeleli kanye nonobhala omkhulu we-DRPG we-CEPGL (Great Lakes Economic Community).
Abantu baphilayo

title: Faith TV
text:
I-Faith TV kwakuyi- movie yamaKristu, idokhumentari kanye nesiteshi se-biography esasi amadrama, amahlaya, isenzo, nezinhlelo zemfundo kanye namafilimu afakiwe athathwe emitatsheni yolwazi ekhuthazayo.Kwafakwa i- My Family TV.

Ukuhlela

Ukutholakala 
IFaith TV ibonakale ezweni lonke ngensizakalo yeSky Angel IPTV.

 Thuthukisa abantu, imindeni, umphakathi nempucuko ngokukhuthaza izindinganiso zikaNkulunkulu

title: Kabza De Small
text:
UKabelo Petrus Motha owaziwa kakhulu ngegama lakhe isigaba Kabza De Small, kuyinto eNingizimu Afrika DJ futhi urekhode umkhiqizi.Wazalelwa eMpumalanga wakhulela ePitoli . Ubebizwa ngenkosi yohlobo lohlobo lwama-Amapiano.UMotha usebenze kakhulu nomdidiyeli womculo uDJ Maphorisa no Blessing Mahlangu.

Impilo nomsebenzi 
UKabelo Motha wazalelwa eMpumalanga, eNingizimu Afrika, wakhulela ePitoli.UMotha waqala umsebenzi wakhe wokuba nguDJ ngo-2009, wangena ezinhlotsheni: Indlu ene-Afro-fused ne- EDM.Ngo-2016, wenza izikweletu zakhe zokukhiqiza ngokukhipha i-albhamu yakhe yokuqala, i- Avenue Sounds ngaphansi kwelebuli, i-House Afrika Records. NgoNovemba 2018, wathola ukunakwa ngokukhipha izingoma, "Amabele Shaya" nethi "Umshove", ngokulandelana, equkethe izingoma zabavakashi ngozakwabo wama-amapiano, uLeehleza. Ngemuva kwezingoma zombili, uqhubeke nokusebenzisana kwakhe noLeehleza njengoba ekhipha ingoma ethi "Bamba La", ngomhlaka 3 Januwari 2019.

Ngo-4 Ephreli 2020, ngesikhathi se- COVID-19 kuzwelonke sokuvala, wakhipha i-EP esihloko sithi Pretty Girls Love Amapiano 2, edlala ngoTyler ICU, DJ Maphorisa, Xolani, King Deetoy.

Ngo-26 Juni 2020, wakhipha i-albhamu yakhe elandelayo eyedwa, I Am The King Of Amapiano: Sweet & Dust, eveze zombili izinto zaseNingizimu Afrika nezamazwe omhlaba ezifana noBurna Boy, Wizkid, Cassper Nyovest, Dali Wonga, DJ Maphorisa, Samthing Soweto, Sha sha, Mlindo, Bontle Smith. 

Ngo-Okthoba 2020, wabonakala engomeni ka-Oscar Mbo esihloko sithi Genesis ku-albhamu, For The Groovists.

Ngo-9 Ephreli 2021, uKabza wakhipha iRumble in the Jungle, okuyicwecwe lokusebenzisana nomdidiyeli womculo uDJ Maphorisa nomculi weTRESOR . 

Kuma- South African Music Awards ama-27 athola amagama amathathu aqokiwe afaka phakathi; I-albhamu yonyaka, Male Artist of the Year neBest AmaPiano Album, okumenze waba ngumculi oqokwe kakhulu, nge-albhamu yakhe ethi I Am The King Of AmaPiano: Sweet & Dust.

Umthelela nempumelelo 
UMotha uvame ukubizwa nge "King of Amapiano".Uthathwa njengomunye wabaculi bomculo abathengisa kakhulu ama-amapiano, futhi futhi ungomunye wamaphayona alolo hlobo. Ngokuthuthuka kwakhe ngo-2018, wadlala indima enkulu ekwandiseni uhlobo lwama-amapiano.Ngomhla ka-3 kuZibandlela wezi-2019, iSpotify South Africa, yabiza uMotha njengomculi waseNingizimu Afrika osakazwa kakhulu endaweni yesikhulumi yango-2019

title: Sbu Nkosi
text:
US'busiso Romeo Nkosi (owazalwa ngomhlaka 21 Januwari 1996) ungumdlali webhola lombhoxo waseNingizimu Afrika oseqenjini lesizwe laseNingizimu Afrika futhi Oshaka kwiSuper Rugby.Isikhundla sakhe esijwayelekile yi-winger.

Umsebenzi webhola lombhoxo

2012-2014 : Umbhoxo wentsha - iPumas neGolden Lions 
UNkosi wazalelwa futhi wakhulela eBarberton.Ngo-2012, indawo yangakubo Iqembu lePumas limbizele ukuzobamela kumqhudelwano we-Under-16 Grant Grant Khomo Week, lapho uNkosi adlale khona kathathu.Wafunda iBarberton High School waze wafunda uGrade 10 lapho ngemuva kokuthuthela eGoli ukuyofunda eJeppe High School for Boys, lapho athola khona izifundo Iqembu le-Golden Lions 'Under-18 Craven Week ngawo womabili ama-2013 nango-2014.Yena kukora Zama kowamanqamu olungekho emthethweni we 2013 mqhudelwano ePolokwane, kodwa ohlangothini lwakhe kuntsandvo, ukulahlekelwa 29-45 ukuze eSifundazweni Sasentshonalanga.

title: Mpuma Kapa TV
text:
IMpuma Kapa TV (phambilini eyayiyiBay TV) ngumsakazo womphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika esifundazweni sesibili ngobukhulu, e-Eastern Cape. Isiteshi siyatholakala esiteshini se-DStv 260.

Lesi siteshi sifinyelela ePort Elizabeth nezindawo ezisizungezile okubalwa kuzo iBethelsdrop, i-Uitenhage, Ibayi, iDespatch, iHumansdrop, iJeffriesbay, iMotherwell namaphethelo.
Iziteshi kumabonakude
Iziteshi kumabonakude eNingizimu Afrika

Umlando 
Isiteshi sethulwe ngo-Okthoba 1, 2011,sihlinzeka ngokuzijabulisa okuseqophelweni kuzo zonke izinhlaka zabantu abahlala endaweni ezungeze iBay.

Ngo-2012, lesi siteshi satholakala kuDStv kusukela ngoLwezi 13.

Ngo-2014, iMultiChoice yatshala izigidi ezinhlanu ekwakhiweni kwesikhungo sokugcina sokulawula ngaphambi kokulahlekelwa yilayisensi yasemhlabeni. 

Ngo-2020, lesi siteshi sashintsha igama futhi senziwa ngokusemthethweni ngoFebhuwari 2021.Baphinde bethula uchungechunge lwemini,Ekhondweni.  

NgoJuni 2021, lesi siteshi sabambisana neNewzroom Afrika ukukhiqiza okuqukethwe yilesi siteshi sezindaba okuzosiza nasekuthuthukiseni ikhono lezindaba leMpuma Kapa TV.

title: DJ Maphorisa
text:
UThemba Sonnyboy Sekowe, odume ngegama lesiteji sakhe uDJ Maphorisa, ungumdidiyeli wamarekhodi waseNingizimu Afrika, uDJ futhi ungumculi.Njengophrojusa womculo onenhlanganisela yomculo we-house ne-afropop, usebenze futhi uthole amakhredithi wokukhiqiza avela kubaculi abaningana abaziwayo, okubalwa kubo uWizkid, Kwesta, Uhuru, Drake, Black Coffee, Major Lazer, Runtown, C4 Pedro, Kabza De Small no- Era Istrefi.Njengamanje usayinwe kulebuli yakhe yokurekhoda iBlaqBoy Music ngemuva kokuyeka iKalawa Jazmee Records.

Ube yisidlakela ngemuva kokukhiqiza abaculi abambalwa abaculi bezinhlobo eziningi zomculo, njengo-Uhuru ("Y-Tjukuta"), Kwesta (" Ngud ' "), uBusiswa ("Lahla"), uDJ Zinhle ("Igama lami ngingu" ), UProfesa ("uJezebeli") noShekinah (" Ofanelekile ").

Umsebenzi

Ngo-Ephreli 16, 2021, uMaphorisa noTyler ICU studio EP Banyana badedelwa.I-EP ifaka uSir Trill, uDaliwonga noKabza De Small, uMpura, noVisca.I- "Banyana" eyodwa yadlula imifudlana eyizigidi ezingama-4.2 futhi yaqinisekiswa ngeplatinamu ephindwe kabili yimboni yokuqopha yaseNingizimu Afrika.Ngo-2021, uzoqala eMade eLagos Tour ukuze enze isenzo sokuqala noWizkid.Kuma-2021 Music Kwaito and House Music Awards wathola ukuqokwa kweBest DJ.

title: Kalawa Jazmee
text:
IKalawa Jazmee Records ilebula elizimele eliqoshwe eNingizimu Afrika.Leli lebuli linedumela elikhulu njengeqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni uhlobo lomculo weKwaito eNingizimu Afrika.IKalawa Jazmee Records ibilokhu iyilebuli eliqopha umlando elizimele eNingizimu Afrika iminyaka engaphezu kwengama-25 ikhona. Iyaqhubeka nokugqugquzela izitayela zomculo womdanso omusha futhi yaba negalelo ekuvuleni umculo we-kwaito, we-afro-pop nowe-house ngokuhweba ngeDangerous Combination Crew njengeKalawa Jazzmee Records.

Selokhu yasungulwa, iKalawa Jazmee Records isungule futhi yasungula abaculi abangaziwa baba yizenzo ezihamba phambili kumashadi omculo ngokuthengisa okuphula amarekhodi ngokulandelana.Lokhu kubeka leli rekhodi emlandweni wesimanje njengesikhungo samagugu omculo wentsha esingekho esinye. 

Kalawa Jazmee Records kuye kwaba ekhaya ukuze izizukulwane abaculi kwande namaqembu edume efana Trompies, Boomshaka, Mafikizolo, Bop, Bongomuffin uProfessor, Uhuru, Zonke, Dj Zinhle, Black Motion, BigNuz, Busiswa futhi Vigro Deep phakathi kwabanye.

IKalawa Jazmee Records inikeze abaculi abanjengoBlack Coffee noDJ Tira amandla okuqala umsebenzi wabo kwezomculo ngokusungula amalebuli abo okuqopha amaSoulistic Records ne-Afrotainment ngokulandelana ngokunikeza umculo wabo amalayisense ngesikhathi besathuthuka njengamaciko.

IKalawa Jazzmee Records iqalwe ngabaqondisi bayo okungo-Oscar Sibonginkosi “ Oskido ” Mdlongwa, Mandla “Spikiri” Mofokeng, Bruce Tebogo “Dope” Sebitlo, Emmanuel “Mjokes” Matsane, Zynne “Mahoota” Sibika noDon Laka. Ngonyaka ka-2001 u-Oscar Sibonginkosi “Oskido” Mdlongwa, uMandla “Spikiri” Mofokeng, uBruce Tebogo “Dope” Sebitlo, u-Emmanuel “Mjokes” Matsane noZynne “Mahoota” Sibika babumba iDangerous Combination Crew behweba njengeKalawa Jazzmee Records kwathi uDon Laka yena wasungula iBokone Music.

Kuze kube manje, ukuhweba ngeDangerous Combination Crew njengeKalawa Jazmee Records kusalokhu kuyisikhungo sikandunankulu sethalente. Lokhu kuholele kubalandeli abaqotho belebuli ukuthi benze imali ibinzana elithi University Of Kalawa Jazmee.

IKalawa Jazmee Records yakhethwa ukuba nguphathina wokuqopha ochungechungeni lwama- Idols aseNingizimu Afrika ngo-2020

title: Kwesta
text:
USenzo Brikka Vilakazi (owazalwa 11 Ncwaba 1988) eyaziwa efanele njengoba Kwesta, kuwumculi eNingizimu Afrika kanye nomrephi futhi wengoma.Wazalelwa eKatlehong, eGauteng, ilokishi elaziwa nangokuthi 'K1'.Ngo-2003, eneminyaka engu-15, yena nabangane bakhe basungula iqembu le-rap iGhetto Fellaz elabe selishintsha laba yiThe Juvenylz, ngo-2003. Njengamanje usayinelwe inkampani yakhe ezimele yabezindaba eyaziwa ngeRapLyf Records nomsunguli wakhe uKid X. 

Ukhiphe i- albhamu yakhe yokuqala ye-studio iSpecial ReKwest (2010) ne-albhamu yakhe yesibili iDaKAR (2013), ebikleliswe kunombolo 3 kwiTunes South Africa Hip-hop / Rap Chart. 

Ezincwadini zakhe kubalwa ama- South African Music Awards ayisithupha, ama-South African Hip Hop Awards amane, ama-MTV Africa Music Awards ayi-1, kanye nama-1 Metro FM Awards.

title: Mafikizolo
text:
IMafikizolo iqembu labaculi baseNingizimu Afrika elasungulwa ngo-1996,eliqukethe umqambi wezinhlamvu uTheo Kgosinkwe nomculi oholayo uNhlanhla Nciza.Laba bobabili badume kakhulu ngemuva kokukhipha izingoma zabo ezithi “Ndihamba Nawe kuphela”, “Kwela Kwela”, “Sibongile”, “Udakwa Njalo”.Leli qembu likhiphe i-albhamu yalo ebizwa ngeMafikizolo ngo-1997 ne- Music Revolution ngo-1999.

Ngo-2000, leli qembu likhiphe i-albhamu yalo yesithathu iGate Crashers, eyaba yi-albhamu edayiswa kakhulu.

IMafikizolo isizuze indondo ye-14 South African Music Award, 2 MTV Africa Music Awards okubalwa kuyo nezindondo zeBest Duo noma iGroup of the Year. 

I-albhamu yabo yokuqala ngemuva kokuyeka kwabo ukulandela ngo-2013 kwathiwa yiReunited eyabathola bewina izindondo kuma-20 South Africa Music Awards ngobusuku obubodwa phakathi kweminye imiklomelo.Impumelelo yeReunited yayinkulu kakhulu kangangokuba bakhipha i-albhamu eyalandela ngemuva kweminyaka emine ngo-2017 enesihloko esithi 20 ukugubha iminyaka engu-20 basembonini yezomculo.Kule albhamu kukhona i- “Love Potion” kanye no-Yemi Alade osizwe “Ofana Nawe”.

Kuma- 24th South African Music Awards, angama-20 athola amagama amathathu futhi athola iDuo / Group of the Year neBest Engineered album catergory.

title: Busiswa
text: UBusiswa Gqulu (owazalwa ngomhlaka-8 Lwezi 1988), owaziwa ngokuzibiza ngoBusiswa noma uBusi, ungumbhali wezingoma nomlobi wezinkondlo waseNingizimu Afrika.Wazalelwa eMthatha, e-Eastern Cape, eNingizimu Afrika,uthole ukuqashelwa emphakathini ngengoma yakhe engomeni kaDJ Zinhle ethi, “My Name Is”, ngemuva kokutholwa yisikhulu sakwaKalawa Jazmee u- Oskido. Ngemuva kokusebenzisana ngempumelelo noDJ Zinhle, ukhiphe izingoma ezihamba phambili ezihlanganisa; "Ngoku", "Lahla", futhi wabonakala engomeni kaBhizer, "Gobisiqolo".Ngo-8 Disemba 2017, wakhipha i-albhamu yakhe yokuqala, iHighly Flavored, yandulelwa yodwa, "Bazoyenza".Kuwo wonke umsebenzi wakhe, uGqulu uthole izindondo eziningi. Ngo-2014, waqokwa kuMail & Guardian abangama- 200 baseNingizimu Afrika . Abazalwa nge-1988 Abantu baphilayo

title: Phindiwe Sangweni
text:
UPhindiwe Dlamini-Sangweni (owazalwa ngomhlaka 2 kuZibandlela 1963, njengoPrincess Phindiwe Rita Dlamini ) ungummeli waseNingizimu Afrika futhi ungusomabhizinisi wesifazane.Njengamanje uyilungu le- African National Congress futhi unguSihlalo weSifazane wePurple Tree Holdings, okuyinkampani ezimele.Dlamini-Sangweni kuyinto Uthishanhloko Princess we Nhlangwini asebukhosini, Princess we Zulu aseNdlunkulu futhi umzala uMswati III, inkosi yakwa-Swaziland.Unempahla engalinganiselwa ezigidini ezingama-30 zamadola aseMelika ezivela kutshalo-mali ezehlukene kanye nasemasheya aseNew York Stock Exchange naseJohannesburg Stock Exchange.

UDlamini-Sangweni wayengumqondisi wokuqala omnyama nowesifazane wokuqala weNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, lapho asebenza khona kusuka ngo-2002 kuya ku-2005.Ube esesebenza njengomeluleki omkhulu kaSmangaliso Mkhatshwa, ngaphambi kokuba asebenze njengoMeluleki Oyinhloko Wezomthetho Wezifundazwe wase-Eastern Cape kusukela ngonyaka wezi-2013 kuya kowezi-2017.

Isiqalo sokuphila 
UDlamini-Sangweni uzalelwe eXopo . Abazali bakhe babe eNkosi C Dlamini Inkosikati H Dlamini.Lapho eneminyaka emibili umndeni wakhe wathuthela eMzinto, kwathi ngo-1980, waphothula iziqu eSacred Heart College for Girls, eVerulam.

Imfundo nomsebenzi 
Ngo-1993, uDlamini-Sangweni wathola iziqu ze-B.Proc kwezomthetho e- University of Natal.Ngo-2005, waba ngumeluleki omkhulu kaSmangaliso Mkhatshwa, oyiMeya enkulu yasePitoli.

Ngomhlaka 16 Septhemba 2010 uDlamini-Sangweni wethule inkulumo esithangamini esasinesihloko esithi " Ubuholi Bomdabu Emhlabeni Wanamuhla: Izinsiza Zabantu, Amasiko kanye Nabahlakazekile" eRayburn House Office Building eWashington, DC eyayiqhutshwa nguCongressmember Diane Watson, ilungu leNdlu Yezangaphandle IKomiti Yezindaba, esifundeni sayo saseLos Angeles sifaka iLittle Ethiopia.Enikezwe ubukhosi obuvakashile obuvela eCameroon nase-Ethiopia (iNkosana u- Ermias Sahle Selassie ), uchaze ubuholi bamasiko obusetshenziswa ngokubusa nokususa ubukhosi phakathi kwamalungu emiphakathi yezinhlanga ezihlala ezindaweni zamadlozi noma ezihlakazekile e-United Kingdom.

Izingane nomshado 
UDlamini-Sangweni unezingane ezimbili. Ngo-1994, washada noMhlengi Moses Sangweni, baze bahlukanisa ngo-1997.Unendodana, uMakhosini "Omari" Dlamini, owazalwa ngomhlaka 1 Disemba 1991, nendodakazi, uNikita Dlamini, owazalwa ngo-1995.
