title: Tongai Moyo
text:
UTongai Moyo (12 Mashi 1968 - 15 Okthoba 2011) wayengumculi wesimanje waseZimbabwe, obevame ukubizwa ngoDhewa.Wazalelwa futhi wakhulela Kwekwe, Dhewa rose waduma ngo-1990 ngasekupheleni njengoba umculi ohamba ngayedwa kanye ne-band Utakataka Express.Abaculi abaphumelele kakhulu abahlanganisa "uSamanyemba", "Naye", kanye "noMuchina Muhombe" baholele ekudumeni kwakhe kuzwelonke, ezifundeni nakwamanye amazwe; wakhiqiza ama-albhamu ayi-14 emkhakheni weminyaka engaphezu kwamashumi amabili. 

I-albhamu yakhe yesi-14 neyokugcina, iToita Basa, ikhishwe ngomhlaka-25 Novemba 2010 ngelebula yokuqopha iGrama Records.Le albhamu yakhishwa ngesikhathi elashelwa umdlavuza, owawutholakale ngo-2008. Ingoma ethi "Ndinobvuma" ibiqondiswe ikakhulukazi empini yakhe yokulwa nalesi sifo.

Ingemuva 
UTongai Moyo ube ngumklomelo odume ngelikaSungura wodumo, obedume kakhulu ngempilo yakhe yobukhazikhazi. UMoyo waduma kakhulu ekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-1990s ngemuva kokukhipha izingoma ezimnandi ezifana no'Samanyemba 'nethi' Mudzimu weshiri 'neqembu lakhe i-Utakataka Express.

UMoyo wazalwa ngomhlaka-12 Mashi ngo-1968 eKwekwe.Ushone ngomhlaka 15 Okthoba 2011.Ubeshade noMiniehle Mukweli futhi enezingane eziyisithupha okungoNatasha, Nicole, Obert (Tongai Jnr), Tanaka noNyasha noPeter Moyo.

Umsebenzi womculo 
Lo mculi onethalente waqala umsebenzi wakhe ngo-1988 edolobheni lasekhaya eKwekwe.Ukuhlonipha umsebenzi wakhe wobuciko, lo mculi 'uMuchinamuhombe', wadlala emaqenjini amaningi wagcina esejoyine iShirichena Jazz Band njengomculi weseshini, futhi wasiza iqembu ukukhipha ama-albhamu amabili neyodwa.Owayedume kakhulu kwakungu "Ndoita Zvangu Ndega" owakhishwa ngo 1991 uMoyo wayesaziwa ngaleso sikhathi. Uqhubekile wenza iqembu lakhe i-Utakataka Express ngemuva kwalokho wakhipha i-albhamu yakhe yokuqala, i-'Vimbo 'ngo-1996.Le albhamu yathola igama kuMoyo endimeni yomculo, eyayiphethwe ngabalingisi abafana noNicholas Zakaria no-Alick Macheso abacula uhlobo olufanayo.Kusukela lapho, akazange abheke emuva futhi wakhipha ama-albhamu ayi-14 kwisikweletu sakhe.I-albhamu ethi "Naye" yabona uDhewa ehlaba umxhwele ngokuqopha ishadi lakhe "Nemumvura Mese" okwamenza wathola amaZimbabwe Music Awards (ZIMA) amabili. Ngesikhathi eshona, uMoyo wayesanda kukhipha i-albhamu yakhe engu-14 ethi 'Toita Basa'.

Uhambo Lomhlaba Wonke 
UDhewa uhambe ibanga nobubanzi bomhlaba enikeza abalandeli bakhe bomculo umuthi wokwelapha. Wayevakasha e-United Kingdom, e-USA, eBotswana naseNingizimu Afrika kwesinye isikhathi ehamba no-Oliver Mtukudzi no-Alick Macheso.

title: Isidlakathi
text:
Ngokomchazandalo, isidlakathi noma  IMpekumpeku iwutho olunesibalo olidluliselwa emzimbeni noma ohlelweni oluphathekayo, olubonakala kahle ekwenziweni komsebenzi nasesimweni somchadamezo nokukhanya. Isidlakathi singubungako obulondiwe; umthetho wokulonda isidlakathi uthi isimo sempekumpeku singaguqulwa, kodwa asinakudalwa noma sibhujiswe. Umuvo wokulinganisa isidlakathi ngokweInternational System of Units (SI) uyi- joule, (umjulu).

Izimo ezivamile zesidlakathi zihlanganisa isidlakathi somdiki sento enyukuzayo, isidlakathi esingaba khona esigcinwe entweni (ngenxa yokuba kwayo senkundleni), isidlakathi senjombuluka esigcinwe entweni enqumile, isidlakathi sesiqa esiyamaniswa nokusabela ngokwevanga, isidlakathi eziyonzayo esithwalwa imiyonzi yenzubawonga, kanye nesidlakathi esingaphakathi esiqukethwe ngaphakathi kohlelo lwezomchadamezo. Zonke iziphili zijwayele ukuthatha nokukhipha impekumpeku.

Ngenxa yokulingana kwesisindo–sidlakathi, noma iyiphi into enesisindo lapho imile (okubizwa isisindo esiphumule) inaso isilinganiso senani sesidlakathi esinesimo esibizwa isidlakathi esiphumuke, futhi noma isiphi isidlakathi esinye (sanoma iluphi uhlobo) esizuzwa isidlakathi esiphumule sizokhulisa isamba sesisindo njengalapho ikhulisa isamba sesidlakathi sayo.

Impucuzeko yabantu idinga isidlakathi ukuze isebenze, futhi isithola kwizinsizakusebenza zesidlakathi ezifana nesivuthisi sentshicwa, noma esidlakathini esivuselelekayo. Isimo sezulu somhlaba nezinqubo zoxhaxhamvelo ziqhutshwa impekumpeku umzulane esikuwo eziyamukela elangeni.

Imvelo

Izimo

Isidlakathi esiphelele sesimiso singahlukaniswa ngezingcezu futhi sijinjwe ngokuthi isidlakathi esingase, isidlakathi somdiki, noma izingxube zazo zombili ngezindlela ezihlukene. Isidlakathi somdiki sinqunywa umdiki wento - noma umdiki obumbene wezigcoyi zento - bese isidlakathi esingase sikhwentuza amandla wento wokuba nomdiki, futhi imvama buwumsebenzi wokuma kwento ngaphakathi enkundleni noma singagcinwa khona enkundleni ngokwayo.

title: Imigwaqo eNingizimu Afrika
text:
ENingizimu Afrika eminye imigwaqo ibekwa njengemizila enezinombolo yokusiza ekuzulazuleni. Kukhona uhlelo lokubala izinombolo ezweni lonke olunemizila kazwelonke, yesifundazwe neyesifunda, futhi ezindaweni ezahlukene zasemadolobheni kunezinhlelo zemigwaqo yamadolobha amakhulu.

Imigwaqo  

Ohlelweni lukazwelonke lwezinombolo, imizila yehlukaniswe ngezigaba ezintathu: imizila kazwelonke, okuyizindlela ezibaluleke kakhulu ezibandakanya amadolobha amakhulu; imizila yesifundazwe, exhuma amadolobha amancane namakhulu kunethiwekhi yomzila kazwelonke; nemizila yesifunda, exhuma amadolobha amancane kunethiwekhi yomgwaqo.

Izinombolo zemizila zinikezwe la makilasi ngokulandelayo:

 Imizila kazwelonke - N1 kuye N21 
 Imizila yesifundazwe - R21 kuya R99 
 Imizila yesifunda efanayo - R101 kuya R120 (Umzila wesifunda ohambisanayo uzoba namasegmenti emigwaqo phambilini obuyingxenye yomzila kazwelonke ongu-R1xy. I-Nxy eshintshwe yimigwaqo ethuthukisiwe) 
 Imizila yesifunda esifundazweni saseKapa sangaphambili: R300 kuya R499. 
 Imizila yesiFunda eSifundazweni sangaphambilini seTransvaal: R500 kuye R599 
 Imizila yesifunda KwaZulu-Natal: R600 kuye R699 
 Imizila yesifunda eFree State: R700 kuya R799

text:

title: Mandla Mandela
text:
UZwelivelile "Mandla" Mandela, iLungu lePhalamende (owazalwa ngomhlaka 21 Juni 1974) uyinduna yesizwe soMkhandlu Wendabuko waseMvezo futhi ungumzukulu wesithunzi uNelson Mandela.Uphothule eRhodes University ngeziqu zePolitiki ngo-2007.

Ukulandelana ebukhosini 
Uyise, uMakgatho Mandela, ushone ngo-2005, okwamhlahlela indlela yokuba yinhloko yobukhosi. Njengoba lesi sizwe singazange sixoxe ngokukhetha ilungu lomndeni wakwaMandela kuze kube ngu-2007, wakhethwa njengozothatha izintambo.UNelson Mandela wayelahle ilungelo lomholi wabaThembu cishe eminyakeni engama-70 ngaphambi kokulwa nokubusa kwabamhlophe eNingizimu Afrika.Ngenkathi isizwe manje sesibheke kuye ukuthi abuye athole isihloko sakhe, waphakamisa ukuthi umzukulu wakhe athathe le ndima.Lapho Mandela abasebasha baba abakhulu ngo-2007, eneminyaka engu-32 kuphela ubudala futhi iningi imisebenzi yakhe Kwakuthiwa ukubandakanya emikhosini tribal, lokuxazulula izingxabano phakathi amalungu emindeni, futhi ezimele esizweni ezindabeni zezombusazwe.

Umsebenzi kanye nemfundo 
UMandela ubeyilungu lephalamende le- African National Congress kusukela okhethweni lwango-2009.

Ngaphambi kokulandela kwakhe sobukhosi kanye nokukhethwa kwakhe ephalamende, wayefunda eWaterford Kamhlaba, i- United World College eSwaziland (manje eyi-Eswatini), kwaze kwaba ngu-1995.

UKhaya wuhlobo lwezinhlobo ezinhlanu zezihlahla emndenini wama-mahogany iMeliaceae.Ugodo lukaKhaya lubizwa ngokuthi yi- African mahogany, futhi luthathwa njengolungena esikhundleni se-American mahogany ( sohlobo lwe-Swietenia).

Incazelo 
Uhlobo luvela e- Afrika eshisayo naseMadagascar.Zonke izinhlobo zikhula zizungeze u-30-35m ubude, akuvamile ukuba yi-45m, nesiqu esingaphezu kobubanzi obuyi-1m, esivame ukuboshelwa phansi.

Amaqabunga aphinyiwe, anezincwajana ezingama-4-6, ipheshana lokugcina alikho; Ipheshana ngalinye linobude obungu-10-15 cm obuzungezwe ngokungazelelwe phezulu, kepha imvamisa linethiphu le-acuminate.Amaqabunga angaba yi- deciduous noma i- evergreen kuye ngezinhlobo.Izimbali zenziwa ngama- inflorescence akhululekile, imbali ngayinye incane, inamacembe amane aphuzi aphuzi kanye ne-stameni eziyishumi. Izithelo ziyi-globose capsule ezine noma ezinhlanu-valve 5-8 cm ububanzi, oqukethe imbewu enamaphiko eminingi.

Izinhlobo 

 Khaya anthotheca ( syn. K. nyasica )
 Khaya grandifoliola
 Khaya ivorensis
 Khaya madagascariensis
 Khaya senegalensis

Imisebenza 
Ugodo lukaKhaya lubizwa nge- "mahogany yase-Afrika", ngezakhiwo zokhuni ngokuvamile ezibhekwa njengeziseduze kakhulu ne- mahogany yangempela. 

Imbewu ka K. senegalensis inokuqukethwe kukawoyela okungama-52.5%, okuqukethe i-21% palmitic acid, 10% stearic acid, 65% oleic acid, ne-4% "ye-asidi engaziwa" 

I eliqinile le iba nsundu ngokubomvu ukhuni K. anthotheca isetshenziselwa canoes elenjiweko noma makoros futhi njengoba ugodo jikelele, umnyango Uhlaka kanye semfenisha ugodo okuyinto somuhlwa futhi borer ukumelana.

title: Haircut
text:
Isitayela sezinwele, izinwele noma ukugunda izinwele kusho isitayela sezinwele, imvamisa ekhanda lomuntu. Kwesinye isikhathi, lokhu kungasho nokuhlelwa kwezinwele zobuso noma zomzimba.Ukwenziwa kwezinwele kungabhekwa njengesici sokuzilungisa komuntu siqu, imfashini, nezimonyo, yize kusebenza ngokoqobo, amasiko kanye nokuthandwa kakhulu futhi kuthonya ezinye izitayela zezinwele.

Umlando wokuqala nomlando 
Kuzo zonke izikhathi, abantu bagqoke izinwele zabo ngezitayela ezahlukahlukene, ikakhulu ezinqunywa yimfashini yesiko abahlala kulo.Izitayela zezinwele yizimpawu nezimpawu zesigaba senhlalo, ubudala, isimo somshado, ukuhlonza ubuhlanga, izinkolelo zepolitiki, nezimo zengqondo mayelana nobulili.

Abanye abantu bangamboza izinwele zabo ngokuphelele noma ngokwengxenye ngezizathu zamasiko noma ezenkolo.Letibonwako ikhanda isigubungelo babandakanya abesifazane Islam ngubani agqoke hijab, abesifazane abashadile Haredi UbuJuda ngubani agqoke sheitel noma tichel, washada ongumHimba amadoda ubani ukumboza izinwele zabo ngaphandle uma nilila, Tuareg amadoda ubani afake isembozo sobuso, kwabhapathizwa abesilisa nabesifazane eSikhism abagqoka i- dastar.

I-Paleolithic 
I ukukhiqizwa kabusha endala aziwayo izinwele ngiluka amanga emuva eminyakeni engaba ngu-30,000: i- Venus ka Willendorf, manje eyaziwa e Academia njengoba nowesifazane Willendorf, ka insikazi Umfanekiso kusukela Paleolithic, okulinganiselwa ukuthi enziwe phakathi mayelana 28.000 futhi 25,000 BCE.IVenus yaseBrassempouy ibala cishe iminyaka engama-25,000 ubudala futhi ngokungangabazeki ikhombisa ukuhlobisa izinwele.

Ubudala Bethusi 
Esikhathini seBronze,izinsingo zazaziwa futhi zisetshenziswa ngamanye amadoda, kepha hhayi nsuku zonke ngoba inqubo yayingemnandi futhi idinga ukuvuselelwa kwethuluzi elanciphisa ukubekezela kwalo.

Izitayela zezinwele zesimanje

Izici ezichazayo 
Ukucatshangelwa kobuhle besitayela sezinwele kunganqunywa yizici eziningi, njengezimpawu zomuntu osetshenziswayo kanye nokuzenzela isithombe okufunwayo noma ukuthambekela kobuciko komlobi.

Isitayela sezinwele sitholwa ngokuhlela izinwele ngendlela ethile, kwesinye isikhathi kusetshenziswa amakhehla, isomisi esishaywayo, ijeli, noma eminye imikhiqizo.Umkhuba wokutayela izinwele uvame ukubizwa ngokuthi ukucwala izinwele, ikakhulukazi uma kwenziwa njengomsebenzi.

Inqubo 

Ukugqoka izinwele kungafaka ukusikeka, ukuluka, ukufaka imibala, izandiso, izimvume, izinto zokuphumuza unomphela, ukugoba, nanoma yiluphi olunye uhlobo lwesitayela noma lokuthumela imiyalezo.

Ukuzisika 
Ukusika izinwele noma ukusika izinwele kuhloswe ngakho ukudala noma ukugcina ukwakheka okuthile nefomu.Kunezindlela zokunquma izinwele zomuntu kepha imvamisa kubhaliswa omunye umuntu ukwenza le nqubo, ngoba kunzima ukugcina ukulinganisa ngenkathi usika izinwele ngemuva kwekhanda lakho.

Ukusika izinwele kuvame ukwenziwa ngezinwele, isikelo nezinsingo . Ama-Combs nezinwele kuvame ukusetshenziselwa ukwehlukanisa ingxenye ethile yezinwele ebese isikwa.

Ukuxubha nokukama 
Amabhulashi namakhemikhali asetshenziselwa ukuhlela nokuxhuma izinwele, kukhuthazwa yonke imicu ukuba ilele ohlangothini olufanayo futhi isuse imfucumfucu enjenge- lint, dandruff, noma izinwele esezivele zichithekile kuzicucu zazo kodwa ziqhubeke nokubambelela kwezinye izinwele.

Ukomisa 
Izomisi zezinwele zisheshisa inqubo yokomisa izinwele ngokushaya umoya, okuvame ukufudunyezwa, phezu kwesiqu sezinwele esimanzi ukusheshisa izinga lokuhwamuka kwamanzi.

Ukushisa okwedlulele kungakhuphula izinga lokuqhekeka kwe-shaft noma omunye umonakalo ezinweleni.Ama-dryer diffusers angasetshenziswa ukunweba ukusakazeka kokugeleza komoya ngakho-ke kubuthakathaka kepha kumboza indawo enkudlwana yezinwele.

Izomisi zezinwele zingasetshenziswa njengethuluzi lokuqopha izinwele ngezinga elincane kakhulu. Inqubo efanele ibandakanya ukukhomba isomisi ukuze umoya ungashayi ebusweni noma ekhanda, okungadala ukusha.

Amanye amasu ajwayelekile okomisa izinwele afaka ukomisa ithawula nokomisa umoya.

Kwelukwa futhi Updos

Izinwele mfakela 

Ukunakekelwa kwamawigi wezinwele ezingabantu noma ezinye zemvelo kuyefana nokunakekelwa kwekhanda elijwayelekile lezinwele ngokuthi iwigi ingashaywa, ifakwe isitayela, futhi igcinwe ihlanzekile kusetshenziswa imikhiqizo yezinwele.

Ama-wigi wenziwe ngokuvamile enziwa nge-fiber enhle elingisa izinwele zabantu. Le fiber ingenziwa cishe kunoma imuphi umbala kanye nekhanda, futhi imvamisa i-glossier kunezinwele zomuntu.Kodwa-ke, le fiber iyazwela ekushiseni futhi ayikwazi ukwenziwa isitayela ngezinsimbi eziyizicaba noma izinsimbi ezigoqekayo.Kukhona i-fiber entsha yokwenziwa engathatha ukushisa kuze kufike ekushiseni okuthile.

Ama- wigi ezinwele zabantu angashaywa ngesitayela ngokushisa, futhi kufanele abhululwe kuphela lapho somile. Ama-wigi wezinwele zokwenziwa nawomuntu kufanele abhululwe omile ngaphambi kokugeza ukuze kususwe izigaxa.Ukuhlanza i-wig, i-wig kufanele ifakwe kwisitsha esinamanzi ne-shampoo emnene, bese ifakwa emanzini acacile bese inyuka iye phezulu naphansi ukuze isuse amanzi amaningi.Iwigi kufanele emva kwalokho yome umoya ngokwemvelo kwisitayela sayo sezinwele.Ukugcinwa okufanele kungenza iwigi yezinwele zomuntu ihlale iminyaka eminingi.

Imihlobiso esebenzayo neyokuhlobisa 
Kunezinketho eziningi zokuhlobisa nokuhlela izinwele.Izikhonkwane zezinwele, izingwegwe, ama-barrette, amabhande asekhanda, amaribhoni, amabhande enjoloba, ama- scrunchies, kanye nama-combs angasetshenziselwa ukufeza izitayela ezahlukahlukene.Kukhona futhi imihlobiso eminingi yokuhlobisa okuthi, ngenkathi ingahle ibe nezingwegwe zokuyinamathisela ezinweleni, isetshenziselwa ukubukeka kuphela futhi ayisizi ekugcineni izinwele endaweniENdiya ngokwesibonelo, iGajra (imbali yezimbali) kuvamile ukuthi kunezinqwaba zezinwele.

Imiphumela yomphakathi namasiko

Ubulili 
Ezikhathini eziningi emasikweni amaningi, amadoda afake izinwele zawo ngezitayela ezehlukile kwezabesifazane.Isazi sezokuhlalisana kwabantu baseMelika uRose Weitz wake wabhala ukuthi umthetho osabalala kakhulu wezamasiko ngezinwele ukuthi izinwele zabesifazane kumele zehluke kunezinwele zabesilisa.Okuhlukile ngabesilisa nabesifazane abahlala e- Orinoco-Amazon Basin, lapho ngokwesiko bobabili ubulili begqoke izinwele zabo ezisikiwe zaba umumo wesitsha. Emazweni aseNtshonalanga ngawo-1960, bobabili izinsizwa nezintombi babegqoka izinwele zabo ezinde nezemvelo, futhi kusukela lapho sekuyinsakavukela ukuba amadoda akhule izinwele zawo.Esikhathini esiningi emlandweni wesintu lapho abesilisa nabesifazane begqoka izitayela ezifanayo, njengaku-1920s naku-1960s, kudale ukukhathazeka okukhulu kwezenhlalo nokwesekwa.

Isimo sakho somshado 
Ngawo-1800, abesifazane baseMelika baqala ukugqoka izinwele zabo lapho sebekulungele ukushada.Phakathi Fulani abantu entshonalanga Afrika, kwabesilisa nakwabesifazane ukugqoka izinwele zabo ornamented nge encane amber ubuhlalu futhi zemali, kuyilapho abesifazane abashadile ukugqoka amber imihlobiso ezinkulu.Umshado ukhonjiswa phakathi kwabesifazane baseToposa baseSouth Sudan ngokugqoka izinwele ezinkalweni eziningi zezingulube.Engashadile Hopi abesifazane baye ngokwesiko wayegqoka "butterfly" kwekhanda libhekene twist noma whorl izinwele at ohlangothini ubuso ngamunye.Abafelokazi abangamaHindu eNdiya babevame ukugunda amakhanda abo njengengxenye yokulila kwabo, yize lo mkhuba usunyamalele kakhulu manje.

Izinguquko zempilo 
Emasikweni amaningi, kufaka phakathi isiko lamaHindu kanye naphakathi kwabantu baseWayana basezintabeni zaseGuiana, abantu abasha ngokomlando baye bagunda izinwele zabo ukukhombisa iminyaka yobudala.Abesifazane eNdiya ngokomlando bakhombise ukuba ngabantu abadala ngokushintsha kusuka ekugqokeni amagoda amabili baye kokunye.Phakathi kweRendille yasenyakatho-mpumalanga yeKenya kanye nabantu baseTchikrin basehlathini lemvula laseBrazil, abesilisa nabesifazane baphuca amakhanda abo ngemuva kokushona kwelungu lomndeni eliseduze. Lapho owesilisa eshona eGrisi lasendulo, unkosikazi wakhe wayegunda izinwele zakhe futhi wazingcwaba nayenasemindenini yamaHindu, kulindelwe ukuthi umuntu ozilile kakhulu aphuce ikhanda lakhe ezinsukwini ezintathu emva kokushona.

Isigaba senhlalo 
Kuwo wonke umlando, izinwele bezilokhu zikhomba isigaba somphakathi.

Abantu abasezingeni eliphezulu bahlale besebenzisa izitayela zabo zezinwele ukukhombisa ingcebo nesimo.Abesifazane abacebile baseRoma babegqoka izitayela zezinwele eziyinkimbinkimbi ezazidinga imisebenzi yabantu abaningana ukuze bazinakekele, futhi abantu abacebile nabo bavame ukukhetha izitayela zezinwele ezivimbela noma zithwalise umthwalo wabo ukunyakaza, okwenza kube sobala ukuthi abadingi kusebenza.Izitayela zezinwele zabantu abacebile bezijwayele ukuba semikhawulweni yemfashini, kusethwa izitayela zabacebile kancane. Kepha namuhla, abacebile bavame ukubonwa ukuthi bagqoka izinwele zabo ngezitayela zokulondoloza ezazisukela emashumini eminyaka edlule. 

Izitayela zezinwele ezisezingeni eliphakathi nendawo zivame ukwehliselwa phansi kanye nobuchwepheshe.Abantu abasezingeni eliphakathi bafisa ukuthi izinwele zabo zibukeke ziphilile futhi zingokwemvelo, okusho ukuthi banezinsizakusebenza zokuphila impilo enempilo futhi bazinakekele kahle.

Ngokomlando, izinwele zezinwele zabantu besigaba esisebenzayo zivame ukuba lusizo futhi zilula.Abesilisa besigaba esivamile baye baphuce amakhanda abo noma bagqoke izinwele zabo zivaliwe, futhi abesifazane besigaba esisebenzayo baye badonsa izinwele zabo phezulu nasebusweni babo ngezitayela ezilula.Kodwa-ke, namuhla, abantu abasebenza kakhulu bavame ukuba nezitayela zezinwele ezisezingeni eliphakeme nezithanda imfashini kunezinye izigaba zomphakathi.Amadoda amaningi asebenzayo eMexico emadolobheni aseMelika agqoka izinwele zawo ngezitayela ezinjengeMongolian (zigundwe ngaphandle kwengcezu yezinwele entanyeni) noma umsila wegundane (i-crewcut phezulu, i-tuft ku-nape), ne- Afrika- AbaseMelika bavame ukugqoka izinwele zabo emaphethini ayinkimbinkimbi amabhokisi ama-braids nama-cornrows, afakwe nge-barrettes nobuhlalu, futhi kwesinye isikhathi kufaka izingxenye ezigundiwe noma umbala ogqamile.Izazi zezenhlalo zithi lezi zitayela ziyimizamo yokuveza ubuntu nobukhona lapho kubukelwa phansi umphakathi kanye nokungabonakali.

title: Ntando Kebe
text:
UNtando Lucky Kebe (owazalwa ngomhlaka 19 Agasti 1988) ungumdlali wezinyunyana waseNingizimu Afrika, osanda kudlala umbhoxo wasekhaya weCurrie Cup ne IBorder Bulldogs neSuper Rugby enezimpawu ze- Amakhosi aseNingizimu.Isikhundla sakhe esijwayelekile yi-scrum-half.

Umsebenzi

Intsha 
Ubemele iqembu lakhe lendawo IBorder Bulldogs emqhudelwaneni we-Under-19 Provincial Championship ka-2007 nasezingeni lika-Under-21 ngo-2007, 2008 nango-2009.

Izidakamizwa zivinjelwe 
Ngomhlaka 1 Mashi 2016, uKebe wahlinzeka ngesampula yomchamo owawungaphandle komncintiswano, owahlola kahle ukutholakala kwezidakamizwa ezinqatshelwe i- stanozolol, futhi wabekwa icala ngokusemthethweni lokwephula umthetho wokulwa nokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa ngomhlaka 2 Agasti 2017.Walivuma icala, ethi lowo owayesebenza naye uMonde Hadebe wamnika isengezo esasineziqu, futhi wathola ukuvinjelwa iminyaka emibili kusukela ngomhlaka 7 Julayi 2016.UKebe wethule ukuphikisana nalesi sinqumo, lapho isigungu sokwedlulisa isinqumo sanquma ukuthi ukuvalwa kwakhe kufanele kuguqulwe kusuka eminyakeni emibili kuye eminyakeni emine, uKebe evunyelwe ukubuyela embhoxweni ngomhla ka-8 Julayi 2020. 
Abantu baphilayo
Abazalwa nge-1988

title: WWE
text:
IWorld Wrestling Entertainment, Inc., d / b / a WWE, yinkampani yemidiya nezokuzijabulisa edidiyelwe yaseMelika eyaziwa kakhulu nge- wrestling yobungcweti.I-WWE iphinde yahlangana neminye imikhakha, kufaka phakathi ama-movie, ibhola, kanye namanye amabhizinisi ahlukahlukene.

Igama le-WWE libuye lisho ukukhuthazwa kwe-wrestling uqobo, okwasungulwa ngo-1953 njengeCapitol Wrestling Corporation . Kungukuphakanyiswa kwe-wrestling okukhulu kunakho konke emhlabeni, ophethe imicimbi ebukhoma engaphezu kuka-450 ngonyaka, nohlu luhlukaniswe kakhulu lwaba yimikhiqizo emithathu ehamba emhlabeni wonke, futhi luyatholakala emakhaya ayizigidi ezingama-900 emhlabeni wonke ngezilimi ezingama-28.Indlunkulu yomhlaba wonke yale nkampani iseStamford, Connecticut, inamahhovisi eNew York, eLos Angeles, eLondon, eMexico City, eMumbai, eShanghai, eSingapore, eDubai, eMunich naseTokyo.

title: WWE Raw
text:
I-WWE Raw, eyaziwa nangokuthi i- Monday Night Raw noma i- Raw nje, wuhlelo lwethelevishini oluphambili lwaseMelika olwenziwa yi- WWE njengamanje olusakazwa bukhoma njalo ngoMsombuluko ngo-8pm ET e- USA Network e-United States.Umbukiso uqukethe abalingiswa bohlobo lweRaw, lapho abasebenzi beWWE babelwe ukusebenza nokwenza.Umbukiso wavela ngoJanuwari 11, 1993 kanti njengamanje uthathwa njengomunye wemibukiso emibili ehamba phambili, kanye neLwesihlanu Night SmackDown.NgoSepthemba 2000, uRaw wasuka e-USA Network waya ku-TNN,owabuyela ku- Spike TV ngo-Agasti 2003.Ngo-Okthoba 3, 2005, uRaw wabuyela e-USA Network, lapho isekhona nanamuhla.I- WWE Network iyekile ukusebenza e-United States kusukela ngo-Ephreli 5, 2021, ngakho konke okuqukethwe kuyiswa ku- Peacock TV, njengamanje eneziqephu eziningi ze-Raw, ngaphandle kokuqukethwe okwakucatshangelwa noma kwasuswa umnyango wezindinganiso nemikhuba ye-Peacock TV.Iziqephu zakamuva zisatholakala ekubukweni okufunekayo ezinsukwini ezingama-30 ngemuva kosuku lokuqala lomoya.

isithombe saphambili se-WWE Raw..

title: WWE NXT
text:
I-WWE NXT, eyaziwa nangokuthi uLwesibili Night NXT noma i- NXT nje, wuhlelo lwethelevishini lobuchwepheshe . It ikhiqizwa yi-American lochwepheshe wrestling ukukhuthazwa WWE, obonisa abadlali kusukela ukukhuthazwa sika NXT brand division . Umbukiso njengamanje udlala bukhoma ngoLwesibili ngo-8 ebusuku ET ku- USA Network.

I-NXT iqale ukuvela ku-2010 njengombukiso wesizini owethulwe njenge-hybrid phakathi kwemibukiso yemicimbi ebukhoma yeWWE nethelevishini yangempela, lapho ithalente elivela endaweni ethuthukisa iWWE yaseFlorida Championship Wrestling (FCW) labamba iqhaza emncintiswaneni wokuba "inkanyezi yokuphuma" elandelayo yeWWE, ngosizo lwabeluleki abavela kwimikhiqizo yeWWE's Raw and SmackDown. Kwasakazwa izinkathi ezinhlanu zalokhu kushaywa, kwathi uWade Barrett, uKaval, uKaitlyn noJohnny Curtis bamenyezelwa njengabaphumelele.

NgoJuni 2012, iWWE iqede ifomethi yokuncintisana kwesizini futhi yakhetha ukuvuselela lo mbukiso.I-WWE NXT yaba ngumbukiso wethelevishini ohamba phambili womkhiqizo we-NXT, futhi selokhu wathola ukwamukelwa okuhle nokubukwa okuphezulu, ngokuncoma ikhwalithi ephezulu ye-wrestling nezindaba ezihehayo.Abaningi babheka i- NXT njengophakeme kunombukiso we- WWE. 

Uhlobo lokuqala lombukiso lwaqala ukuvela kuSyfy ngoFebhuwari 23, 2010, esikhundleni se- ECW, kepha kwafakwa iSmackDown ngo-Okthoba.Yabe isisakazwa njenge- webcast yehora ngehora kuWWE.com e-United States kuze kube nguJuni 13, 2012, ngaphambi kokuba inwetshwe ibe izimakethe zomhlaba jikelele kwiWWE Network ngo-2014.Ku-2019, i- NXT yanda yaba uhlelo lwamahora amabili bukhoma ku-USA Network.

Umlando

Ukwakheka 
NgoFebhuwari 2, 2010, uSihlalo weWWE uVince McMahon wamemezela ukuthi uhlelo olusha lwamasonto onke luzongena esikhundleni se- ECW ekhanseliwe ngesikhathi sayo eSyfy.UMcMahon uchaze lo mbukiso ngokuthi "ukuvela okulandelayo kweWWE; ukuvela okulandelayo komlando wethelevishini".

Ingqikithi yomculo 
Kusukela ngo-Ephreli 20, 2021, ingoma esemthethweni yetimu ye- NXT ithi "Say Cheese" nguPoppy, eyaqala ukwenziwa kuNXT TakeOver: Stand & Deliver.

Ekuthomeni kwayo kwasekuqaleni, iculo laseMelika i-Bang "Wild and Young" belisetshenziselwe isizini ngayinye ngaphandle kwesithathu.Ngesikhathi sesizini yesithathu, ingoma yokuqala yetimu bekuthi " You Make the Rain Fall " nguKevin Rudolf." Vices futhi Virtues " by Art of Dying elalibuye libe bumper umculo ngesikhathi sokuqala zonyaka ezinhlanu umbukiso.

title: WWE SmackDown
text:
I-WWE SmackDown, eyaziwa nangokuthi i- Friday Night SmackDown noma i- SmackDown, uhlelo lwe-American wrestling lwethelevishini olwenziwa yi- WWE okwamanje olusakazwa bukhoma njalo ngoLwesihlanu ngo-8pm ET kuFox . UFox Deportes ulingisa uhlelo ngokuhlaziya ngolimi lweSpanishi . Umbukiso izici izinhlamvu ukusuka SmackDown brand, lapho WWE abasebenzi abelwa umsebenzi futhi enze.Umbukiso njengamanje uthathwa njengomunye wemibukiso emibili ehamba phambili, kanye noMsombuluko ebusuku Raw.

I- WWE Network iyekile ukusebenza e-United States kusukela ngo-Ephreli 4, 2021, ngakho konke okuqukethwe kusendleleni yokuthuthelwa kwi-Peacock TV, manje enazo zonke iziqephu zeSmackDown.Iziqephu zakamuva zisatholakala ekubukweni okufunekayo ezinsukwini ezingama-30 ngemuva kosuku lokuqala lomoya.

Umsakazo 
Ngaphezu kokukhulunywa kolimi lwaseSpain iFox Deportes elingisa neFox bukhoma e-United States nokusakazwa kwamabutho aseMelika athunyelwe phesheya kwezilwandle ku- AFN Sports 2,IsmackDown nayo iyavela emoyeni nasemhlabeni jikelele.

Amazwe aseMelika

i-Latin America 
Iziteshi zeSmackDown zihlala kwiFox Sports eMexico futhi ziwela iMelika Ephakathi neseNingizimu kusukela ngonyaka wezi-2014.

EMexico, i- MVS yasakaza iSmackDown phakathi kuka-2005 no-2008, ne-Azteca 7 kusukela ngo-2008 kuya ku-2014.

ECanada 
ECanada, SmackDown ngokomlando kuye kwasakazwa by Sportsnet 360 (SN360, ebibizwa The Score), njengengxenye umnikazi inethiwekhi Rogers Abezindaba 's eside ziphathelene WWE.Lolu hlelo luye lwasakazwa ngokomlando kwesinye isikhathi emidlalweni ye-simulcast ne-US eshayelwa umoya futhi kwesinye isikhathi ngayizolo.Ngo-2005, lapho lo mbukiso oqoshiwe usudluliselwa kuLwesihlanu osakazwa e-US, wasala ngoLwesine eCanada isikhathi esithile.Ngesikhathi ibuyela ngoLwesine e-US kusuka ngoJanuwari 2015 kuya kuJulayi 2016, iziqephu eziqoshwe ngaphambilini zeSmackDown zikhonjiswe ngoLwesithathu-ngobusuku obubodwa phambilini - ngenxa yezingxabano ezisakazwa yilesi siteshi iNational Hockey League yesiteshi. 

Uhlelo luye lwasakazwa kusimulcast nokusakazwa kwaseMelika kwazise lushintshele kufomethi ebukhoma ngoJulayi 2016, okokuqala ngoLwesibili bese lubuyela ngoLwesihlanu ngoOkthoba 2019.Naphezu hambisa Fox (okuyinto kabanzi baqhubeka abahlinzeki ithelevishini Canadian), Rogers ayizange abaqokelwe simulcast SmackDown ku ukusakaza yayo inethiwekhi Citytv ukuthi abuyisele ezingaba simsub amalungelo.

EJamaica 
EJamaica, iSmackDown idlala bukhoma ngoLwesihlanu ku-Flow 1, nge-replay ngeSonto.

I-Asia, i-Afrika ne-Oceania 
Izindiza zeSmackDown zihlala e-Australia ngoMgqibelo ekuseni kakhulu / ntambama ngantambama nangeSonto ntambama kuFox8 nangoLwesihlanu ebusuku ku- 9Go! njengoba inguqulo yehora,kanye waziphakamisa bahlala New Zealand ku Sky 5 nangeSonto kusihlwa kwi Prime njengoba inguqulo ihora elilodwa. 

ISmackDown idlala eChina kumanethiwekhi ahlukahlukene wethelevishini.

ISmackDown idlala eFiji eSky Pacific naseSky Fiji.

Iziteshi zeSmackDown zihlala ePakistan naseBangladesh, eNepal, eSri Lanka naseNdiya kuSony Ten naseKenya kwiKenya Broadcasting Corporation.

ISmackDown idlala eMalaysia e-Astro Supersport 4, naseMalta eMelita Sports 1. 

Uchungechunge ludlala ePhilippines ku- One Sports ngeCignal TV. 

Iziteshi zeSmackDown zihlala e- Indonesia kuMola TV. 

Lo mdlalo owuchungechunge uhlala eSingapore kuStarhub's HubSports 2,South Africa kuSuperSport,naseSamoa ku- SBC .

ISmackDown idlala kwa-Israyeli ku- 5LIVE .  Iphinde idlale ku-FM1 (Ngaphambilini i-Iran FM-TV) e- Iran.

Eningizimu Afrika, i SmackDown esake olusakazwa free-kuya-emoyeni abasakazi e.tv.Umbukiso ubuzodlala ngoLwesithathu ebusuku kusihlwa, ngokulibaziseka kwezinsuku eziyi-7, uhlelelwe ihora elilodwa futhi ubungomunye wezinhlelo ezibukwe kakhulu kulesi siteshi.Kodwa-ke, ngo-2017 abakwa-e.tv banqume ukungasivuseleli isivumelwano sabo sokusakaza neWWE.La malungelo aphinde athengiswa kuSuperSport (abasakazi bokuqala bohlelo lweWWE) abasakaza lolu hlelo kulo lonke elase-Sub-Saharan Africa, bukhoma futhi abangasikiwe. 

Ngo-2019 iSuperSport, kanye nenkampani yabazali bayo iMultichoice, basayine isivumelwano sokusakaza lesi siteshi se-WWE esingamahora angama-24 enkundleni yabo iDStv.Uhlelo ludlala ngo-02: 00 bukhoma, kanti lubuye lusakazwe ngesikhathi sokuqala ngo-09: 00, 14:00 no-20: 00. .

IYurophu 
EFrance, iSmackdown idlala ku- AB1 njalo ngoMgqibelo ngo-9 ebusuku. EJalimane iSmackDown idlala kuProSieben MAXX njalo ngoMgqibelo ngo-10 ebusuku.

EHungary, SmackDown waziphakamisa ku Galaxy4 njalo ngoLwesithathu ku-10:15 pm.

E- Italy, iSmackDown idlala ku- DMAX, ngombukiso wamazwe omhlaba wehora elilodwa okhombisa ukukhonjiswa kuCielo ngesiNtaliyane.EPoland, iSmackDown idlala ku- Extreme Sports Channel idonsa izinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kwesikhathi.

EPortugal, iSmackDown idlala kuSportTV 5 njalo ngoLwesithathu ngo-7 ebusuku, nenguqulo yehora elilodwa ikhonjiswa kuSportTV + njalo ngoMgqibelo ngo-11 ekuseni.ERussia,ISmackDown idlala ku- Матч! Боец ngamazwana waseRussia.

ESpain, iSmackDown idlala eMega njalo ngeSonto ngo-1 ntambama.E.- United Kingdom nase- Ireland, iSmackdown idlala bukhoma kwi- BT Sport,  ngenguqulo yehora elilodwa ekhonjiswa eParamount Network njalo ngoLwesihlanu ngo-11 ebusuku.IVirgin Media Two ibuye iveze uhlobo lwehora elilodwa e-Ireland njalo ngeSonto Ekuseni.

Ukusakaza okuku-inthanethi 
NgoMeyi 22, 2009, uHulu noWWE bavumelana ukukhipha iziqephu ezigcwele zeSmackDown ukuze zitholakalele ukubuka usuku olulandelayo ngemuva kokukhonjiswa kwalo kwasekuqaleni.NgoSepthemba 24, 2012, uHulu wasayina isivumelwano seminyaka eminingi neWWE ukusakaza yonke imibukiso yenkampani yeTV kanye nolunye uchungechunge lwewebhu, olubandakanya iSmackDown.Iziqephu ezigcwele zeSmackDown ziyatholakala ukubukwa ngosuku olulandelayo lomoya walo wokuqala.Zonke iziqephu ezedlule zeSmackDown ziyatholakala kunethiwekhi yeWWE, lapho iziqephu zakamuva zitholakalela ukubukwa okufunwayo ezinsukwini ezingama-30 ngemuva kosuku lokuqala lomoya.

title: Khayamiya
text:
Khayamiya ( Egyptian Arabic    ) luhlobo lwendwangu yokuhlobisa i-appliqué yendwangu ngokomlando esetshenziselwa ukuhlobisa amatende ngaphesheya kweMpumalanga Ephakathi.Manje ngokuyinhloko eyenziwe Cairo, Egypt, kanye lokho njengoba UMgwaqo amatende (Shari'a al-Khayamiyya, noma ezaziwa Suq al-Khayamiyya) enkabeni Qasaba ka Radwan Bey, emakethe mlando ezimboziwe eyakhelwe ekhulwini le-17 ikhulu leminyaka.Umgwaqo utholakala ngokushesha eningizimu yeBab Zuweila, futhi utholakala eceleni komlando wezomnotho waseCairo (ingxenye esenyakatho neBab Zuweila yaziwa namuhla ngokuthi umgwaqo u-al-Mu'izz ).

Incazelo 
I-Khayamiya yenziwa kahle futhi inemibala egqamile efakwe ngaphakathi kwamatende, isebenza umsebenzi okabili wokukhosela nokuhlobisa.Zifana nezinsika, futhi zinezingqimba ezintathu ezijwayelekile zama-quilts - "umqolo" osindayo, isizinda "phezulu", nokufakwa okuningiliziwe ngaphezulu kwe- "phezulu".Ngokusebenza, bangaqhathaniswa namakhethini, yize izindima zabo zakamuva sezihlukanisiwe ukubhekela izinjongo zokuvakasha.Lokhu manje sekubandakanya amakhava amakhushini, imfashini, izikhwama, okokulala nezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza.

Umklamo 

Khayamiya sici ngesandla babehlanganisa ukotini appliqué phezu esindayo ukotini emuva.Lo mgogqo wenzelwe ukuvikela nokuqina esimweni sezulu esishisayo, esomile, futhi esinothuli.Ukuthungwa kwesandla kwenziwa ngokushesha ngabenzi bamatende abanekhono ngenkathi behleli belengise imilenze, besebenzisa izinaliti nentambo.Izingcezu ezincane zendwangu zisikwa ngosayizi njengoba kudingeka ngokusebenzisa isikele esikhulu.IKhayamiya imvamisa iqedwa ngumenzi wetende elilodwa kungakhathalekile ukuthi ungakanani ubukhulu bento leyo.Lezi zingasuka kwizembozo eziyisisekelo zomcamelo ziye ezilingweni eziyindida zodonga oluphelele amamitha amaningana ngaphesheya.Amaphrojekthi amakhulu kamuva angathatha izinyanga ezimbalwa ukuqeda.Abenzi bamatende bavikela kakhulu ubuhlakani babo, njengoba imiklamo emisha ephumelelayo ivame ukukopishwa ngomakhelwane babo abancintisanayo.

Ama-design motifs adumile afaka amaphethini we-arabesque wejometri kanye ne-curvilinear asuselwa emihlobisweni yamaSulumane, kanye nezigcawu eziphefumulelwe ubuciko be-Pharaonic, ikakhulukazi i- papyrus ne- lotus motifs.WaseGibhithe izifundo folkloric ezifana Goha, abaculi Nubian, kanye dervishes yelangabi athandwa siKotilandi eziyizikhumbuzo, njengoba ukuboniswa eliqoshiwe zezinhlanzi nezinyoni.Amaphethini we-Calligraphic, asuselwa emibhalweni evela ku- Qur'an, avame ukwenziwa abe yizinto nezilwane.Amapaneli e-Khedival enziwe ngasekupheleni kwekhulu leshumi nesishiyagalolunye nasekuqaleni kwekhulu lamashumi amabili ngokuvamile afaka amabhlogo amakhulu we-appliqué kanye nokuthungwa okubanzi, yize i-khayamiya yezokuvakasha neyesikhathi samanje inezandla ezinhle nezicace bha.

Amagama 
Isipelingi esifanele sise-Arabhu, kepha ukulinganiselwa kwesiNgisi kwaleli gama  ,  ,  ,  ,  ,  , kanye ne-  . Igama lesi-Arabhu  (  ), okusho ukuthi "itende", lixhunyaniswe ne-Persian  (  ), okusho ukuthi "umenzi wamatende". Izincazelo ezihlukile ezidumile esiNgisini zifaka phakathi "umsebenzi wabenzi bamatende baseCairo", "appmaker appliqué" noma umane uthi "appliqué waseGibhithe".UMedhat Adel Emam uxoxe ngemvelaphi yaleli gama njengoba kusebenza kuma-Arabhu aseGibhithe ngokusobala anethonya laseTurkey.Ama- "pavilions" amakhulu ahlotshisiwe ekhayamiya aziwa njenge- .

Umlando khayamiya 
Izinhlobo zomlando wekhayamiya azivamile.Ekuqaleni zazenziwe zabekwa ngaphandle lapho kushisa khona futhi kwashunqa uthuli, futhi zazithathwa njengezishintshwayo - yingakho zingabizi kakhulu ukuqoqwa noma ukulondolozwa. Izibonelo zeKhedival zibanjwa ekuqoqweni kweminyuziyamu eminingana, kufaka phakathi iBritish Museum.Kukhona nezinkomba zekhayamiya kumarekhodi ezithombe nemidwebo yase-European orientalist kusukela ngekhulu leshumi nesishiyagalolunye nangaphambili.Izikhombo zemibhalo ngokusetshenziswa kwazo, kufaka phakathi imifanekiso, zingabonakala emibhalweni yesandla yangenkathi ephakathi.Kunobufakazi bemivubukulo obusikisela ukuthi izindwangu ezifana ne-khayamiya zakhiwe futhi zasetshenziswa eGibhithe kusukela esikhathini sobuFaro. 

Naphezu kwefa labo eliyingqophamlando, umsebenzi wokwenza amatende usengozini manje.Lokhu ikakhulukazi kungenxa yokuncintisana okuvela kwizindwangu ezithunyelwe ngobuningi ezingenisiwe ezinamaphethini afanayo okuhlobisa.Lawa mashidi aphrintiwe manje asetshenziswa kabanzi kulo lonke elaseGibhithe njengezikrini zesikhashana zemicimbi ekhethekile, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi seRamadan, imikhosi, imishado, nemingcwabo, esikhundleni sekhayamiya eyenziwe ngezandla yokuqala. Iningi lekhayamiya elenziwe eminyakeni yamuva lithengiswa kubavakashi abavakashela eGibhithe.Ngawo-2000, imibukiso yokuqala yamazwe omhlaba yekhayamiya yaseGibhithe yabanjelwa e-Australia, e-UK, eFrance nase-USA.Lezi zikhethwe nguJenny Bowker, umenzi we-quiltm wase-Australia kanye nothisha.

Khayamiya kubuciko besimanje 
Umdwebi waseGibhithe uMoataz Nasr ufaka izici eziphefumulelwe nge-khayamiya kwimidwebo yakhe yezindaba exubile yesimanjemanje.Ukufaka kukaSusan Hefuna "Ngiyayithanda iGibhithe!" (okuvezwe kwi-18th Biennale yaseSydney ngo-2012) kusebenza neKhayamiya ngaphakathi komongo wobuciko besimanje bokufaka.Kusuka ngo-2009, umculi waseGibhithe uHani el-Masri wasebenzisana nabakhi bamatende ukukhiqiza ukutolika kobusuku obuyinkulungwane nobunye.Umdwebi wase-Algeria u- Rachid Koraïchi ubuye wasebenzisana namaTentmaker aseCairo ukudala amabhanela amakhulu we-calligraphic, njengochungechunge lwakhe lwe- Invisible Masters.Njengoba uKoraïchi asho ngo-2011:

 "Uma sikhuluma ngesiko lobuciko lamaSulumane, asikhulumi ngobuciko bekhulu le-19 obenzeka estudiyo somculi nasendlini. Lapha sikhuluma ngezinto eziphuma empilweni yansuku zonke. . . Akuwona umhlaba lapho umculi ehlala ngokuhlukana khona. "
 Isiko lengcweti - lisekhona, kepha linyamalale kancane emigwaqweni yase-Koraichi yase-Algeria kanye nasemazweni aseMaghreb - linikeza ukuqonda ukuthi ubuciko bungadonswa kanjani ngqo ezweni losuku nosuku, kepha kukhuliswe ukunikezelwa kobuciko."Uma ubheka izisekelo zobuciko basentshonalanga," kuqhubeka uKoraichi, "kwakususelwa kusiko lonke lobuciko elingena emasontweni; izimbiza ezenziwe ngabenzi bensimbi nemabula.Kufana ncamashi namaSulumane, ngokuthi akhiwa yilabo ababengasebenza ngamatshe nangokuluka. Le yimithombo esingayibona ngokusobala kepha umbuzo esinawo ukuthi ungathatha kanjani lawo masiko anyamalalayo siwenze abekhona futhi esikhathini esiphilayo. "

Imephu eya ku-Street of the Tentmakers 

Lesi sixhumanisi sizokuqondisa ku-Google Map echaza indawo yoMgwaqo Wamatende, maqondana nezimpawu ezaziwayo zabavakashi zeKhan el-Khalili.Umgwaqo iTentmaker's Street awaziwa ngezinkinga ezidayiswa kanzima ezihambisana nezitolo zokuvakasha eKhan el-Khalili.

Izitayela 
Kunezinhlobo ezine eziyinhloko zeKhayamiya: iKhedival, iTouristic, Street, neContemporary.

 IKhedival khayamiya yenziwa phakathi kuka-1867 no-1914. Lawa ngokuvamile ngamapaneli amakhulu asetshenzisiwe ku-indigo, abomvu, futhi amhlophe ngendwangu ye-beige, imvamisa enemivimbo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka mpo kudoti uqobo.
 I- khayamiya yezokuvakasha yenziwa kusukela ngawo-1890s kuze kube namuhla, futhi yathandwa kakhulu ngemuva kokutholwa kwethuna likaTutankhamun ngo-1922. Lokhu kuvame ukuba kuncane, futhi kungukusebenzisa okungokomfanekiso, imvamisa okuqukethe imidwebo evela eGibhithe lasendulo noma ngaleso sikhathi okwakuyizigcawu zesikhathi samanje sempilo yaseGibhithe, ikakhulukazi izigcawu ze-folkloric. Ngokuvamile zazithengwa ngabavakashi bamazwe aphesheya abaya eGibhithe njengezikhumbuzo ezithandwayo zaseGibhithe.
 I-Street khayamiya ifaka phakathi amaphaneli enzelwe ukusetshenziswa ngaphandle eGibhithe, njengama-suradeq pavilions noma okwasemuva kwemicimbi yomphakathi. Lezi yizindwangu ezinkulu "zokwakha". Ngekhulu lama-20 ubukhulu obuphakathi bephaneli kwakungu-Amapaneli amaningi ayeboshelwa ndawonye esakhiweni sokhuni ukuze akhe itende lendwangu.
 I-Contemporary khayamiya ngamaphaneli we-appliqué enzelwe ukusetshenziswa endlini.

I-Contemporary khaymiya ingahlukaniswa ngezinhlobo ezingaphansi ezilandelayo:

 I-Arabesque khayamiya, equkethe amaphethini ahlangene ahlangene. Lolu hlobo lukhonya lolu hlobo lobuciko lwesimanje.
 Khayamiya folkloric, ezifana ezinganekwaneni Goha .
 I-Orientalist khayamiya, njengezigcawu zomgwaqo ezisuselwa emaphepheni kaDavid Roberts, noma okufana kwawo uqobo okukhona eCairo.
 Inyoni khayamiya, evame ukuhlotshaniswa nomuthi wokuphila, Insimu yase-Edene, noma umdwebo wamathuna kaFaro
 Abaculi bedlala izinsimbi zomdabu zaseGibhithe noma zaseNubian nemidanso.
 I-Calligraphy imvamisa isuselwa ku-Qur'an.
 Pharaonic imiklamo esekelwe emibhalweni-papyrus ezisukela enkulungwaneni Book of the Dead nezinye art baseGibhithe lasendulo.
 Kuthunyelwe kufaka izingcezu ezihlukile ezenziwe ngesicelo sabaculi, abaklami, abaphathi, nabashicileli.
 Amapaneli we-Neo-Khedival akhuthazwe ukusetshenziswa komlando kwesikhathi seKhedival (1867-1914). Lokhu kuqale ukuvela ngemuva kuka-2014, kulandela ukushicilelwa kukaKhedival khayamiya kumajenali endwangu.

title: Arzu Toker

U-Arzu Toker (owazalwa ngo-1952) ungumbhali okhuluma isiJalimane, intatheli, intatheli nomhumushi odabuka eTurkey.

I-Biography 
UToker wazalwa ngo-1952 eHalfeti, eTurkey. Wathuthela eJalimane ngo-1974, lapho ahlala khona kusukela lapho.

Ekuqaleni kuka-2007, yena noMina Ahadi babephakathi kwabasunguli beCentral Council of Ex-Muslims, okuyinhlangano yaseJalimane ehlose ukumela abantu abalahle ubuSulumane.Toker uthi Islam kuyinto ngonya, ngokuphambene German soMthethosisekelo futhi kokubili misogynous futhi misandrous : ngokusho kwakhe, abesifazane e-Islam sokuba "simfela yokuzalanisa imishini".Uyaxwayisa ukuthi emadolobheni amaningi Dutch kukhona abesifazane futhi inkulisa izikhungo ezandleni Islamists.Ngokuvumela lokhu kuphulukiswa kwamaSulumane, iNetherlands iyabekezelela kakhulu ngokombono kaToker's.Kuyena, i-Islam imele ingcindezelo, futhi umuntu kufanele avunyelwe ukusho lokho, eqamba u- Ayaan Hirsi Ali njengesibonelo sabo.

title: Arzu Geybullayeva
text:
U-Arzu Geybullayeva ( Azerbaijani   ), owaziwa nangokuthi u- Arzu Geybulla ( Azerbaijani   ), ungumlobi we- Azerbaijani, i-blogger, nentatheli yamaphephandaba amaningana nezindawo zezindaba ezibandakanya i- Al Jazeera, Inqubomgomo Yezangaphandle, i- Global Voices, ne- Agos.Ubuye wasebenza nezinhlangano ezingenzi nzuzo kanye namathangi okucabanga kubandakanya iNational Democratic Institute ne- European Stability Initiative . UGeybullayeva wafakwa ohlwini lwabesifazane abasezingeni eliphezulu le-BBC ngo-2014.Ukhuthaza ukuxazululwa ngokuthula phakathi kwabase- Armenia nabase- Azerbaijan ngempi yeNagorno-Karabakh.Kodwa-ke, eminyakeni yamuva nje, uthole izinsongo ezahlukahlukene ikakhulukazi ezivela e-Azerbaijan ngenxa yokusebenza kwakhe ne-Agos, iphephandaba lase-Armenia.Lezi zinsongo zigxekwe umhlaba wonke yizinhlangano ezahlukahlukene ezilwela amalungelo abantu.UGeybullayeva uhlala ekudingisweni okuzimele eWashington DC .

Impilo nomsebenzi 
Ngenkathi ese-Istanbul e2007, uGeybullayeva waqala ukusebenzela i- European Stability Initiative, isikhungo esingenzi nzuzo kanye nenqubomgomo kanye nethangi lokucabanga laseNingizimu East Europe.NgoSepthemba 2008, waqala ibhulogi yakhe ebizwa ngeFlying Carpets and Broken Pipelines.Kusukela ngo-2009, ube ngumlobi wephephabhuku onikela ekuhlelweni kwe- Osservatorio Balcani e Caucaso, ithangi lokucabanga elizinze e-Italy.

Izinsongo nokusabela 
UGeybullayeva uthole izinsongo eziningi emibuthanweni eyahlukene yezokuxhumana evela e-Azerbaijan ngokubambisana kwakhe nephephandaba lase-Armenia i- Agos.Engxoxweni abenayo neGlobal Voices, waveza ukuthi wabizwa ngokuthi "uyimbuka" nokuthi lokho kubhebhethekisa kwaba yizinsongo zokubulawa kwakhe nomndeni wakhe.Lezi zinsongo zimenze ukuthi ayeke ukuvakashela izwe lakubo i-Azerbaijan ngaleso sikhathi lapho ayezidingise khona eTurkey ngo-2015. 
Abantu baphilayo
Abazalwa nge-1983

title: Necdet Yaşar
text:
INecdet Yaşar ( Turkish pronunciation: [ˈNedʒdet ˈjaʃaɾ] ; 1930 - Okthoba 24, 2017) wayengumdlali we- Turkish lute kanye nothisha.Ilungu elingumsunguli we-Istanbul State Turkish Music Ensemble, wadlala umhlaba wonke njengenxusa lezamasiko eTurkey futhi wafundisa kabili e- University of Washington (USA).Ngo-1991, uhulumeni waseTurkey wamnika isihloko esithi " National Artist ".

Sibutsetelo 
Ngo-1930, uNecdet Yaşar wazalelwa eNizip, idolobha elincane eliseduze neGaziantep, eTurkey.Wathweswa iziqu eSikoleni Sezomnotho, e-Istanbul University. 

Ngenkathi ehlala eNyuvesi yaseWashington, u-Yaşar wanikeza izinkulumo ngohlelo lwe- makam lomculo wakudala wase-Ottoman. 

Ngo-1972, u-Yaşar no-Signell bahambela umhlangano waminyaka yonke we-Society for Ethnomusicology (SEM) lapho u-Yaşar empeleni wethula khona umculo ongaziwa kakhulu waseTurkey Classical kuma-ethnomusicologists ngokukhuluma nokwenza ku-tanbur [Tanburi Necdet Yaşar: Anılar-Dostlar. ENew York: Brainstorm, 2009, k.263. ]

Ngo-1988, u-Yaşar wayeyilungu lokuqala le-Istanbul State Turkish Music Ensemble. Wayiqondisa kwaze kwaba ngu-1995 lapho ethatha khona umhlalaphansi. 

Ngo-1991, uhulumeni waseTurkey wamnika isihloko esithi "National Artist" ( Devlet Sanatçısı ). 

Ezingxenyeni ezincane nezinkulu, kufaka phakathi eyakhe i- "The Necdet Yasar Ensemble", usebenze emhlabeni wonke, eYurophu, eMpumalanga ye-Asia, naseNyakatho Melika, njengomculi wekhonsathi kanye nenxusa lomculo wakudala waseTurkey. 
Abafa nge-2017
Abazalwa nge-1930

title: Elif (igama)
text:
Imvelaphi yegama Elif ivela kuTestamente Elidala, bheka u-Aleph, Alpha no-A, ngezansi ukuthola okuningi. Kuwuphawu oluvula imibhalo eminingi yakudala yenkolo ka-Abraham.

Ngesikhathi sempi yezinguquko eTurkey, eyaqala ngo-1919, u- Atatürk waqala ukubhekisa kubantu besifazane abanesibindi abavikela phambili kwekhaya njengo "Elifs".Ngokushesha ngemuva kwempi, abesifazane banikezwa ilungelo lokuvota yiRiphabhulikhi yaseTurkey encane futhi entsha, ngo-1923, phambili kwezinye izizwe.Leli gama laduma eminyakeni eyalandela ukusungulwa kweTurkey entsha, ekhombisa ubungcweti obabuhlanganisa futhi buhlonipha okwedlule.

U-Elif igama lamantombazane elivamile (ikakhulukazi eTurkey ) kanti u-Aleph igama lamagama abafana abangamaHeberu.

Kuvamise ukuthi kukhonjwe ngephutha kuphawu olulodwa noma incazelo, yize inemvelaphi ehlukahlukene.

Igama Elif livame ukusetshenziswa njengegama lamantombazane.Ngonyaka odlule  ibekwe ku-2,636th ohlwini lwama-US Social Security Administration lwamagama amantombazane athandwa kakhulu.

title: Elif Demirezer
text:
U-Elif Demirezer (owazalwa ngomhlaka 12 Disemba 1992 eBerlin ) okwamanje owaziwa ngegama lakhe lesiteji u- ELIF, ungumculi waseJalimane odabuka eTurkey..

I-Biography 
U-Elif Demirezer wazalwa njengendodakazi yabokufika baseTurkey eBerlin futhi ungowesithathu ezinganeni ezine.Ukhulele esifundeni saseBerlin iMoabit futhi wafunda esikoleni i-OSC KIM.Ngaphezu kokudlala emculweni wesikole nasekwayeni yesikole, u-Elif uthathe izifundo zesigingci esemusha.Kwakungaleso sikhathi lapho abhala khona izingoma zakhe zokuqala.

Umsebenzi

Ukuqala njenge-Popstar 
Lapho ngineminyaka engu-16 ubudala, Demirezer ligcwaliswe kule sizini yesishiyagalombili ProSieben ithalente show Popstars.Wenze ukubonakala ngokuhlanganyela ne-All American Rejects (The Wind Blows) noCassandra Steen (Angikaze Ngazi Ukuthi Ngidinga) futhi waqeda ngokubambisana nozakwabo uNiklas Dennin ukuthola indawo yesibili kowamanqamu.

Umsebenzi weSolo 

Ngemuva kwePopstars, uDemirezer uqinise ubukhona bakhe be-inthanethi kuFacebook nakuYouTube ngokwethula izingoma zakhe, ebezitholakala kakhulu ngolimi lwesiJalimane.Ubuye wasebenza njenge-blogger ye- "I Love Radio" yeWebradio.Ngo-2012, uDemirezer wajoyina umbhali wezingoma zomculi waseJalimane uTim Bendzko ohambweni lwakhe lwangoNovemba lwamaqembu aseJalimane.Kamuva, ngoFebhuwari 2013, uDemirezer waba sesichengeni sokuvula kukaRonan Keating phakathi nohambo lwabo lwaseJalimane.Kamuva ngonyaka, i-Unter meiner Haut yakhe yokuqala (Under My Skin) yakhululwa yi-Universal Music, futhi yafinyelela kunombolo 80 kumashadi angashadile aseJalimane maphakathi no-Ephreli.Ngomhlaka 7 Ephreli 2013 kwaba ngu-Elif Demirezer olandelayo Seeed, Blumio, Glass Bead Game no-Andreas Bourani kubaculi be-Memorial Concert - "I am Jonny for our brother voices" ngo-2012 iBerlin eyabulala uJonny K. e-Admiral Palace yenzeka.Ekuqaleni kuka-Agasti 2013, lowo oyedwa wakhishwa izinsuku ezingama-200 ehlobo.Le vidiyo, ekhombisa u-Elif kanye nezindlovu eziluhlaza esiqhingini saseSri Lanka, ibiqondiswe nguJustin Kruse, obesevele enamavidiyo omculo no-Ivy Quainoo, uMax Herre, uMax Prosa, uLeslie Clio noJoy Dena Lane.Ukuphela kuka-Agasti 2013 kukhishwe i-albhamu yokuqala ethi "Unter meiner Haut".Yakhishwa nguDemirezer uqobo noPhilip Schwär futhi wafinyelela kunombolo 23 kumashadi ama-albhamu aseJalimane. NgoJanuwari 2014 u-Elif uqede ukuvakasha kwakhe kokuqala ngamaqembu aseJalimane.

title: Elif Elmas
text:
U-Elif Elmas ( Macedonian   ; ozalwa 24 Septhemba 1999) umdlali waseMacedonia webhola odlalela Serie A club Napoli kanye North Macedonia eqenjini lesizwe njengoba mdlali.

Umsebenzi weklabhu

Umsebenzi wokuqala 
U-Elmas waqala umsebenzi wakhe e- FK Rabotnički kwelakubo eMacedonia. Ngemuva kwesizini evelele lapho athola khona amagoli ayisi-6 weligi futhi wahola uRabotnički waqeda endaweni yesithathu kwiMacedonia First Football League ngo- 2016-17, wajoyina imidondoshiya yaseTurkey iFenerbahçe ngesivumelwano kwaze kwaba ngu-2022, kanti iFenerbahçe ikhokhele lowo owayengu- € 300,000 ngemisebenzi yakhe.Umdlali wasesiswini ohlasele waqhubeka nokushaya amagoli amane emidlalweni engaphezu kwengu-40 kumaYellow Canaries kuyo yonke imiqhudelwano ngaphambi kokuthuthela e-Italy ngoJulayi 2019.

UNapoli 
U-Elmas ushaye igoli lakhe lokuqala leNapoli ngomhlaka 3 Nhlolanja 2020 ukusiza ikilabhu ukuthi linqobe ngo 4-2 kuSampdoria, nokuvikela iwini yabo yesithathu ilandelana kuyo yonke imincintiswano. 
Abantu baphilayo

title: Elif Shafak
text:
U-Elif Shafak ( Turkish   , pronounced [eˈlif ʃaˈfak] ; ozalwa 25 Okthoba 1971) is a -Turkish -British umlobi nesazi, umlobi, zezemfundo, isikhulumi saseningini, isazi sesayensi yezombangazwe kanye amalungelo abesifazane isishoshovu.Lapho kushicilelwa ngesiNgisi, igama lakhe lihunyushwa ngokuthi 'Elif Shafak'.

Imisebenzi 
UShafak ushicilele izincwadi eziyishumi nesishiyagalombili, okuyinhlanganisela yenganekwane nengamanga.

Okungeyona inganekwane 
Izindatshana ezingezona eziqanjiwe zikaShafak ngesiTurkey ziqoqwe ezincwadini ezintathu:IMed-Cezir (2005), iFirarperest (2010), i-Şemspare (2012) neSanma ki Yalnizsin (2017).

Ngo-2020, uShafak washicilela ukuthi Ungahlala Kanjani Sane ku-Age of Division.

Impilo yomuntu siqu 
UShafak uke wahlala e- Istanbul, nase-United States — eBoston, eMichigan nase- Arizona — ngaphambi kokuthuthela e- UK.UShafak uhlale eLondon kusukela ngo-2013, kodwa ukhuluma "ngokuthwala i-Istanbul emphefumulweni wakhe." 

UShafak ushade nentatheli yaseTurkey u- Eyüp Can Sağlık, owayengumhleli wephephandaba iRadikal, onendodakazi nendodana.  Ngo-2017, uShafak waphuma njengowabesilisa nabesifazane.
Abantu baphilayo
Abazalwa nge-1971

title: SABC Education
text:
I-SABC Education iyisiteshi sethelevishini semfundo saseNingizimu Afrika esiphethwe yiSouth African Broadcasting Corporation (SABC).

Umlando 
Ngo-1991, i-TV2, i-TV3 ne-TV4 zahlanganiswa zaba insiza entsha ebizwa nge-CCV (Contemporary Community Values).Kwethulwa isiteshi sesithathu esasaziwa nge-TSS, noma iTopSport Surplus, iTopSport okuyigama elalisakazwa yiSABC kwezemidlalo, kodwa lokhu kwafakwa iNNTV (National Network TV), okuyisiteshi semfundo, hhayi esokuhweba, ngo-1993.

Isungulwe ngonyaka we-1996, iSABC Education wuphiko lwebhizinisi lwe-SABC olubhekele ukuletha igunya lezemfundo lomsakazi womphakathi.Ngokwesiko leqiniso laseNingizimu Afrika, iSABC Education ihlangabezana nale nselelo ngokuletha okuqukethwe okuphoqayo kwezemfundo kubabukeli abahlukahlukene eNingizimu Afrika kanye nase-Afrika yonkana.Okuqukethwe yi-SABC Education, okuqoqwe kusuka ezindabeni ezahlukahlukene zezemfundo kuneqhaza ekunotheni okwabiwe ngobuntu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukucebisa Izingqondo, Ukucebisa Ukuphila! 

Ngo-2012, i-SABC yamemezela izinhlelo zokuyivula njengesiteshi esizimele kanye nezinye iziteshi eziyi-14 umsakazi womphakathi ahlela ukuzethula kuzinkundla zabo ezazilindelwe isikhathi eside ze-DTT eceleni kwe-SABC 4, i-SABC 5, i-SABC Movies ne-SABC Sport. 

Ngo-2015, iSABC Education yabambisana noTuluntulu ukwethula lo mkhiqizo njengesiteshi esiku-inthanethi kanye neSABC Children. 

Ngo-2018, i-SABC yehlisa izinhlelo zayo ezingasekelwa ngezimali ze-DTT eziteshini eziyi-9 iSABC Sport neMfundo ekhona kuleso sikhundla. Baphinde bavula isikole semfundo ephakeme salo mkhiqizo ukusiza abafundi bakamatikuletsheni ezifundweni zabo nokubahlomisa ngamakhono adingekayo ukuze basebenze ngokuzimela.

Ngo-2020, kwaba nobhadane olwaphoqa izikole ukuba zivale ngakho-ke umsakazi womphakathi wanquma ukukhipha isiteshi ku-DTT naku-YouTube kusuka ngoMeyi 4 kunamapulatifomu amaningi okulindeleke ukuthi asengezwe kungekudala.Ngo-Okthoba walowo nyaka, iSABC yabambisana noTelkom ukusabalalisa lesi siteshi kanye nezinye izakhiwo zeSABC ngensizakalo entsha yokusakaza, iTelkomOne. 

Engxoxweni abe nayo neSABC News neExpresso, i-SABC ibalule ukuthi ixoxisana nezinkundla zokukhokhelwa ze-TV ezifana ne- DStv ne- StarSat ngethemba lokuvula isikhala sesiteshi kusukela lapho akuzange kube khona zibuyekezo.

Ukuhlela 
Okuqukethwe okutholakala esiteshini esingu-24/7 kungenzeka kugcinwe kungobo yomlando noma kutholakala ku-SABC 1-3.

title: EToonz
text:
eToonz kuyinto eNingizimu Afrika satellite digital ithelevishini free-kuya-air isiteshi zezingane wadala futhi kungeyakho eMedia Investments sika e.tv.isiteshi sisakaza isikhathi esingamahora ayi-16 kusuka ngeSonto kuze kube uLwesihlanu, amahora ayi-17 ngoMgqibelo namahora ayi-18 ngama-movie ngesikhathi samaholide ezikole.

Umlando 
I-eToonz iqale njengengxenye yemizuzu engama-30 kuye kwangama-60 kuLittle e block engasasebenzi ebinezinhlelo ezinopopayi ezifana neThe Adventures Of Lerato ne-Alex ne-Curious Minds - ye-South Africa ekhiqizwe okuqukethwe. 

I-e.tv njengomsakazi yethule i-eKasi +, eToonz +, eMovies + ne-eAfrica + njengeziteshi ezingosisi ezintsha njengesiteshi sayo sokuqala sezinhlelo ze-TV zethelevishini yedijithali yomhlaba (i-DTT).I-e.tv, i-SABC kanye ne-M-Net bahlela kutsi ngamunye wabo akhicite emaqoqo abo etiteshi letengetiwe taseNingizimu Afrika ekugcineni.

Njengoba ukungasebenzi kahle kukahulumeni nokulwa kwemboni kuye kwabambezela isikhathi eside inqubo yokushintshwa kwedijithali eyaziwa ngokuthi ukufuduka kwedijithali, i-e.tv yethule iziteshi zayo zokuqala ze-TV ezingama-4 ezengeziwe mahhala ku- OpenView HD, yize iziteshi zizotholakala esidlangalaleni kubo bonke ababukeli uma i-DTT isiqalile.

Ngesikhathi kwethulwa, abakwaStarSat bangenele izingxoxo nabakwa-eMedia Investments mayelana nokuthi bangakwazi yini ukufaka iziteshi zabo kungxenyekazi yabo ngaphambi kokuthi izinto zilunge.

Ukuhlela 
Iningi lokuqukethwe kwesiteshi livela ku- Craz-e block ku-e.tv. Imibukiso ethile engangezwanga esiteshini kwakuyimibhulokhi yangaphambilini yezinhlelo zentsha ebukhoma.

title: Izindaba ze-Etv
text:
Izindaba Ezemidlalo kuyinto Afrika eNingizimu free-kuya-air digital satellite ithelevishini izindaba kanye nezemidlalo isiteshi wadala futhi kungeyakho e.tv ka- eMedia Investments.Pambilini ebizwa nge-OpenNews, iyisiteshi sezindaba sesibili esidalwe yi-eMedia, okuxakayo ukuthi siyimbangi yesiteshi sodadewabo i- eNCA.

Umlando 
I-eMedia yethule i-OpenNews njengempendulo kubabukeli be-Openview abafuna kakhulu isiteshi sezindaba sasendaweni.Yize i-eMedia isivele inayo i- eNCA yamahora angama-24, lesi siteshi senzelwe kuphela i-DStv ne- BBC World News (esemapulatifomu womabili) ayizange yanelise izidingo zababukeli zezindaba zendawo. Isiteshi sethulwe ngo-17: 00 CAT futhi sasetshenziselwa ukusakaza izindaba zendawo kusuka ngo-17: 00 CAT kuya ku-23: 00 CAT ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu. Isikhathi sokusakaza sabe sesigcinwa kamuva futhi manje sikhombisa izindaba zasendaweni kusuka ngo-16: 00 CAT kuze kube ngu-19: 30 CAT namanye amahora asetshenziselwe abalingani bezindaba bamazwe omhlaba njenge- TRT World, i- China Global Television Network, i- France 24 namanye amadokhumentari asendaweni.

Ngo-5 Agasti 2019, lesi siteshi, kanye nezindaba zezindaba ze-e.tv, zaqanjwa kabusha zaba yizindaba ze-e.tv.

Ngasekupheleni kwalowo nyaka, lesi siteshi saqala ukukhombisa Ezemidlalo futhi sasebenzisa uphawu lwe-e.tv Sport ngaphambi kokuba sibe yiNews & Sport. Ngemuva kwalokho isiteshi sabuye satholakala kuVui.

title: Izindaba ze-SABC
text:
I-SABC NEWS iyisiteshi sezindaba saseNingizimu Afrika esisebenza amahora angu-24 esiphethwe yiSouth African Broadcasting Corporation kanjalo negama lomnyango wezindaba walo msakazi.

Umlando 
I-News Service yasungulwa ngoJuni 1950, yathatha indawo yezinhlelo ze-BBC.Yize lokhu bekungenxa yokuthi ukusakazwa kwe-BBC bekuthathwa njengokunikeza umbono waseBrithani ngezindaba zamanje, bekukhona nokukhathazeka ukuthi abakwaSABC bazoba ngohulumeni abaphezulu ngokweqile, noma "Izwi Lethu Lenkosi". Ngo-1968, yayinezintatheli ezingaphezu kuka-100 zesikhathi esigcwele emadolobheni amakhulu nakubabhali basekhaya ezweni lonke, nezindaba zaphesheya kwezilwandle ezazinikezwa yiReuters, AFP, AP ne-UPI. Kwakukhona i-News Film Unit okwathi ngaphambi kwethelevishini ngo-1976 yakhiqiza amafilimu ezinhlangano zezindaba nezinhlangano zethelevishini.

title: SABC Sport
text:
I-SABC Sport iyisiteshi sethelevishini semidlalo saseNingizimu Afrika esingena mahhala futhi esiphethwe yiSouth African Broadcasting Corporation (SABC).

Isiteshi besisebenza isikhashana ku-DTT ngaphambi kokunweba kwamanye amapulatifomu. Ngemuva kokunwetshwa kwaso, lesi siteshi manje sesiyiziteshi eziyi-10 eziphezulu ezibukwe kakhulu ku-Openview edonsa ngaphezu kuka-1.4. ababukeli abayizigidi.

Umlando 
Ngo-1991, i-TV2, i-TV3 ne-TV4 (manje eyi-SABC 1-3) zahlanganiswa zaba insizakalo entsha ebizwa nge-CCV (Contemporary Community Values).Kwethulwa isiteshi sesithathu esasaziwa nge-TSS, noma iTopSport Surplus, iTopSport okuyigama elalisakazwa yiSABC kwezemidlalo, kodwa lokhu kwafakwa iNNTV (National Network TV), okuyisiteshi semfundo, hhayi esokuhweba, ngo-1993.

Ngo-1996, i-SABC Sport yasungula umkhiqizo wezemidlalo ozohlinzeka ngemicimbi egcwele bukhoma, izinto ezivelele eziminyene, imidlalo, nokuwela bukhoma! Iwindi okuwukuphela kwalo lokudla imicimbi yezemidlalo oyithandayo, ngolimi lwakho oluthandayo, ngaphandle kwesithiyo ekungeneni, okwenza kufinyeleleke kubo bonke.

Ngo-2012, iSABC yahlela ukutshala imali engu-R732.7 million eminyakeni emibili ezayo ukusungula iSABC Sport njengesiteshi esihlukile se-TV eNingizimu Afrika ngo-Okthoba 1.Baphinde basayina isivumelwano semali eyizigidi zamarandi neNBA yaseMelika ukukhombisa ukugcwala okuphelele ngeSABC Sport futhi bakhetha imidlalo kuSABC 1 ukuvimbela ukubukwa kokuphazamiseka ngaphambi kokuphuthelwa umnqamulajuqu. 

Ngo-2015, bazilahla izinhlelo zabo zokuqala ze-DTT base behlisela eziteshini ezi-5 enye yazo kungu-SABC Sport.

Ngo-2018, bazilahla izinhlelo zabo ezazingakhokhelwa kusukela ngo-2015 base bekhetha ukuvula ezinye iziteshi ezingu-4 ezazingasekelwa ngezimali okuyiPhalamende leSABC, iSABC History, iSABC Education neSABC Health kanti iSABC Sport isekhona kuphothifoliyo yabo. 

Ngo-Okthoba 2020, uTelkom wethula insiza yokusakaza ividiyo yeTelkomONE kubandakanya neziteshi ze-TV ezihamba phambili ezifana neSABC Education iphakethe layo lamahhala.

NgoMashi 2021, i-eMedia Investments, abanikazi benkonzo yesathelayithi yamahhala, i-Openview, kanye ne-SABC bafinyelele esivumelwaneni sebhizinisi esibona ukuthi i-Openview iyaqhubeka nokusakaza iziteshi ezinencazelo ephezulu i-SABC 1, 2 no-3, kanye nezinye iziteshi zethelevishini ezi-3.eyodwa kube yiSABC Sport evela kumsakazi womphakathi, kanye nayo yonke imisakazo engu-19 ephethwe yi-SABC.ISABC Sport kanye neziteshi zabo zomsakazo zenziwe zatholakala ku-Openview kusuka ngomhlaka 17 Ephreli.

Ukuhlela 
Lesi siteshi sinemidlalo emidala nemisha eminye yayo esivele ikhona ku-SABC 1-3. Izinhlelo eziphawulekayo kulesi siteshi kubalwa iSport Arena, iSport @ 10 neSoccerzone.Okuqukethwe yi-SABC SPORT okuqukethe i-ESPN eNingizimu Afrika njenge-ESPN FC ne-EFL Championship

title: GauTV
text:
IGauTV (iGoli Television) isiteshi somphakathi esiseGoli, eNingizimu Afrika. Iqale ngo-Okthoba 2015 ngemuva kwempi yeminyaka emithathu yokuthola ilayisense.

Umlando 
Ngo-2012, uGauTV wayebhekene nenselelo yezomthetho ne- ICASA ngemuva kokuthi lo msakazi enqatshelwe ilayisense yokusebenza.

IMzansi Community Satellite, ehweba njengeGauTV yafuna ilayisense kwa-ICASA ukuze ihlinzeke ababukeli baseGauteng ngethelevishini ezinze kusathelayithi.Ithi isinqumo sesiphathimandla sokungayiniki ilayisense besingafanele futhi singahambisani nomthetho ofanele. 

Ngo-2014, i-Alex TV (eyaziwa nangokuthi i-LX TV) isiteshi esincintisanayo esinakekela ingxenye esenyakatho yeGoli sethulwa ku-Openview ngo-Ephreli ihlinzeka ngokuzijabulisa okufundisayo nokufundisayo kanye nezindaba zamanje. 

Ngo-2015, ngemuva kokusebenza unyaka i-Alex TV yavalwa ngenyanga efanayo eyethula.Ngo-Okthoba walowo nyaka, iGauTV yagcina ithole isiteshi sayo ngokusakaza kwipulatifomu iMultiChoice ye- DStv kusuka ngo-06: 00 - 18:00 (amahora ayi-12 ngosuku) lapho iningi labantu lingatholakali ngaleso sikhathi. 

NgoMashi 2017, lesi siteshi sandise amahora aso okusakaza asuka emahoreni ayi-12 aya emahoreni angama-24.

title: Kapa TV
text:
ICape Town TV iyisiteshi sethelevishini somphakathi esisakaza eKapa, eNingizimu Afrika.Yasungulwa ngoSepthemba 2008 inelayisense yonyaka owodwa, "yesikhashana" futhi ngemuva kwalokho yazuza enye leyo layisense ngoSepthemba 2009. Iyinhlangano engenzi nzuzo enelayisensi njengomsakazi womphakathi ngokoMthetho Wezokuxhumana Ngezobuchwepheshe waseNingizimu Afrika.
Iziteshi kumabonakude
Iziteshi

Ukudluliswa kwesiginali nokwamukelwa 
I-CTV yisiteshi esingena mahhala esisakazwa ekudlulisweni kwe-analogi . Isiteshi sidlulisa kusuka kusidlulisi esisodwa samandla amancane esisegqumeni laseTygerberg, siya enyakatho yeKapa.Leli sayithi lihlinzeka ngokutholakala okubanzi kakhulu esifundeni samadolobha amakhulu aseKapa, yize sinelayisense kuphela (yi- ICASA ) yokudlulisa amandla kagesi aphansi.Isiteshi sisakazwa kumvamisa 607.25I-MHz (isiteshi 38) kubhendi ye-UHF. 

Ababukeli bangasilanda isiteshi uma besemgqeni wokubona kwentaba yaseTygerberg futhi nezindiza zabo zethelevishini zibheke kule ndawo. Ukushuna okuzenzakalelayo noma okwenziwa ngesandla kwethelevishini kufanele kuthathe isiteshi esiphakathi kwezimpawu zeSABC3 ne-eTV  .

Ukuhlela 

I-CTV inezinhlelo ezahlukahlukene ezibandakanya okuqukethwe okutholakala emithonjeni ehlukahlukene (njengabakhiqizi abazimele, amalungu omphakathi, izindlu zokukhiqiza, izinhlangano, izikhungo zemfundo kanye nama-ejensi kahulumeni) nezinhlelo ezikhiqizwa kungaba 'ngaphakathi endlini' noma ngozakwethu bohlelo usebenzisa izakhiwo zesitudiyo ezise-AFDA, UWC noma i-UCT.

Izinhlelo ikakhulukazi zingezemibhalo, zihlanganisa izihloko ezinjenge-NGO, ezempilo, ezomoya, ezenkolo, amalungelo abantu, intando yeningi, ezemvelo kanye nezindaba zomhlaba.Lesi siteshi sizakhele igama ngokusakaza izinhlelo ezingasoze zakhonjiswa eziteshini zethelevishini ezivamile.Lokhu kufaka phakathi izingqinamba ezinempikiswano efana 'nezinkolelo-mbumbulu zetulo' (isbI-Illuminati, ukuhlaselwa okungu-9-11, njl.

Izinselelo 
I-CTV, njengezinye iziteshi zethelevishini zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika, ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi.Lokhu kufaka hlangana imali, ukutholakala kwamafrikhwensi wokurhatjha nokufuduka kusuka ekusakazweni kwe-analogue kuye kweye-digital.

title: IMYtv
text:
I-MYtv ngokusemthethweni i-ASTV (i-Afrikaanse Satellietelevisie) iyisiteshi sethelevishini i-Afrikaans eNingizimu Afrika esingeyabantu abazimele.

Category:Iziteshi kumabonakude

Umlando 
Lesi siteshi sizinze eGoli eNingizimu Afrika kanti saqala ukwethulwa emsamo weSentech's Vivid ngo-2009 sabe sesisungulwa kuTopTV (manje esaziwa ngeStarSat ) ngo-Okthoba 2010.

I-ASTV iqale ukusakaza ku- OpenViewHD15 Okthoba 2013.Ngo-15 Agasti 2016 i-ASTV yamemezela ukuthi lesi siteshi ngeke sisatholakala ku- OpenViewHD futhi okuphakelayo kwesiteshi kuzonqunywa ngomhlaka 14 Okthoba 2016 futhi basazoqhubeka nokusakaza kwiStarSat.

Kusukela ngomhlaka 1 Mashi 2017 i-ASTV yaziwa ngokuthi yi-MYtv.

Okuqukethwe 
IMytv isakaza amadokhumentari, okufundisayo, ukupheka, indlela yokuphila nokuqukethwe kwamavidiyo omculo wesiBhunu.Inkampani ekhiqiza lesi siteshi iphinde ikhiqize izikhangiso ze-TV zabakhangisi namavidiyo omculo wabaculi.

Udade Iziteshi 
NgoSepthemba 2017, lesi siteshi sethule isiteshi sabo sokuqala esingudade, i-Onse TV.Isiteshi esisha sinokuzithokozisa okusiza umphakathi wamaKhaladi.

title: Vuzu
text:
Vuzu (eliqoshiwe njengoba VUZU) kuyinto eNingizimu Afrika bentsha isiteshi sethelevishini ezivezwa -M-Net nodadewabo pay platform ithelevishini DStv.IVuzu ifana nezinye iziteshi ezithandwayo ze-American TV ezifana neBravo, FX, BET, The CW, NBC, TNT nezinye eziningi.

Sibutsetelo 
Lesi siteshi sikhipha izinhlelo ezintsha nyangazonke futhi sizenze sibe yisiteshi sentsha esezingeni lomhlaba esikhaleni se-African Television and Broadcasting. Isiteshi sisakaza esiteshini se-116 ku- Dstv sixuba izinhlelo zombili zakuleli nezakwamanye amazwe.Isiteshi sisakazwa i-Afrika yonkana kubabhalisi beDStv Family, Compact, Compact Plus & Premium.Lesi siteshi besine-premium esithe xaxa yesiteshi esibizwa nge-Vuzu Amp ukusakaza esiteshini se-DStv 103 kubabhalisele ama-premium kuphela, sikhombisa kakhulu ama-HD Programs athile ngqo ngemuva kokukhonjiswa kwe-US okwaziwa nge- "Express From The US". Lokhu kwafakwa i- One Magic .

Umlando 
Isiteshi sethulwa ngo-1 Agasti 2003 njenge- 'Channel go okubhekiswe kuyo intsha nentsha njengomncintiswano weMTV.Isiteshi besitholakala kusiteshi se-DStv 84. Ithuthele esiteshini se-123 ngomhlaka 1 Meyi 2008.

NgoMashi 2009, kwamenyezelwa ukuthi iChannel go izoba yiVuzu ngomhlaka 1 Julayi 2009 njengengxenye yebinzana lesibili lezinguquko ezenziwa eziteshini zalo zentsha.IVuzu ijwayele ukubhekisa kubantu abaneminyaka eyi-14-23.

Ukwethulwa kwaso kuphinde kwaqondana nokwethulwa kwenethiwekhi yomphakathi i-vuzu.tv ngomzamo wokwenza lesi siteshi sisebenzisane kakhulu kunangaphambili.Uhlelo lokuqala ukusakaza kwaba uhlelo oludumile olwaziwa ngeTouch TV, olwalusakazwa ngo-16: 00 (phambilini bekungu-17: 00).Ababukeli abaningi beGo bakhononda ngokwethulwa kwalesi siteshi njengoba kudale ukuthi izinhlelo eziningi ze-go zithuthele isikhathi, iziteshi noma zinyamalale ngokuphelele.

Ngo-2012, lesi siteshi saphinde senza ushintsho njengoba isiteshi saso sendabuko esingu-123 sashintsha saba ngu-116.Ngo-2014, kwasungulwa isiteshi esihambisana nayo esikhundleni seM-Net Series Showcase eyaphinde yabizwa ngeVuzu Amp.

Mhla ziyi-12 kuZibandlela wezi-2017, kwamenyezelwa ukuthi iVuzu Amp izobe isaziwa kabusha njenge- One Magic kusukela ngomhlaka-29 Januwari 2018, isasakaza okuqukethwe okufanayo, kepha izoba nendlela yasendaweni ethe xaxa.

Ngomhlaka 1 Septhemba 2018, iVuzu yathola uphawu olusha futhi manje seluqondiswe emndenini ngohlu lwayo ikakhulu olunamaqiniso kanye nama-sitcom anama-series ambalwa.

Ngomhlaka 1 Julayi 2019, iVuzu igubhe iminyaka eyi-10 yasungulwa.

title: Mzansi Magic
text:
UMzansi Magic uyisiteshi sedijithali saseNingizimu Afrika nesiteshi esijwayelekile sokuzijabulisa esidalwe ngabakwaMultichoice futhi esiphethwe ngabakwaM -Net abanenzalo yendawo, futhi sisakazwa kuDStv .

Umlando 
Isiteshi esethulwe maphakathi noJulayi 2010 esiteshini se-107 njengesikhulumi se-M-Net sokuthuthukisa ukukhiqizwa kwendawo kanye nokukhangisa ngobumnandi eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuthuthuka kweziteshi, abakwaM-Net bazobambisana nabadidiyeli bakuleli, babambisane nabenzi bamafilimu baseNingizimu Afrika ukudala okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo okukhanga wonke umuntu ngenkathi kunikwa amandla ithalente elisha nelizayo nokuqinisekisa ukuthi amakhono abalulekile adluliselwa embonini.

Isiteshi sethulwe ngebhulokhi yohlelo lwamahora ayisithupha ngochungechunge lwasekhaya lokuxuba nama-movie aphesheya.Beyiphethwe ngumakadebona wefilimu uLebone Maema. Isiteshi saqala ukusakaza nge- HD ngomhla ka-24 Julayi 2015.

Ukuhlela 
UMzansi Magic ugxile kakhulu emikhiqizweni yasekuqaleni yakhona nakumafilimu aqhamuka eNingizimu Afrika, ngokunezelwa okumbalwa kokuqukethwe kwamazwe omhlaba.

Izinsipho, amaDrama namaTelenovelas 
Isiteshi siphethe uchungechunge lwedrama lwangempela nama-telenovelas. Izihloko zihlanganisa iThe Queen, iGomora, Isibaya neThe Republic. Lesi siteshi siphethe nochungechunge lwedrama oluvela eziteshini zodadewabo nakwamanye ama-productions avela ku- Showmax njengeJacob 's Cross, The River, Grassroots neTrackers.

Iqiniso, i-Talk kanye neMagazini 
Lesi siteshi sigxile kakhulu ochungechungeni lwe-reality oludume kakhulu, ikakhulukazi iDate My Family, Our Perfect Wedding, uMnakwethu, Idols South Africa, iLiving The Dream noSomizi noBeing Bonang phakathi kwezinye. Kubandakanya nezinkulumo zezinkulumo zomhlaba jikelele ezifana neThe Talk neThe Doctors.

Ezemidlalo 
Iphethe okunye okuqukethwe okufaniswa neSuperSport.Lokhu kufaka phakathi okuvelele kweWWE Raw neSmackDown, kanye neNedbank Ke Yona Team Search.

Umculo 
Isiteshi sinezici zomculo nezingxoxo nabaculi bendawo.

Ama-movie 
Ekuqaleni, lesi siteshi besiphethe izihloko eziningi zama-movie zomhlaba wonke futhi njengoba isikhathi siqhubeka besisebenza nabakhiqizi abasha abasha kanye nomakadebona embonini.Isiteshi sesifikile ezigabeni lezi zihloko zama-movie ezenzelwe i-TV njenge-'Lokshin Bioskop 'futhi zabonakala zithandwa phakathi kwababhalisile be-DStv.

title: DStv
text:
I-DStv (isifinyezo seDigital Satellite Television ) isevisi ye- satellite esakazwa yi- Sub-Saharan Africa ngqo ephethwe yiMultiChoice.Isevisi eyethulwe ngo-1995 inikeza iziteshi eziningi nezinsiza kubabhalisile.Ababhalisile abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika naseNigeria, neKenya, iGhana, i- Angola, iNamibia, iZimbabwe, iZambia, i- Uganda, iMauritius, iMozambique, iMalawi, iTanzania, iLesotho, i- Ethiopia, iRiphabhlikhi yaseCongo, iDemocratic Republic of Congo, iGabon, I-Eswatini neBotswana nazo ziphakelwa yile nkampani.

Umlando 
Ngo-1986 ithelevishini ekhokhelwayo yafika eNingizimu Afrika ngenkathi kwethulwa i-analogue, isiteshi esisodwa, iM-Net, yethulwa yiNaspers.Cishe iminyaka eyisikhombisa, yonke imisebenzi yakwa-M-Net ibisingathwa yinkampani eyodwa kwaze kwaba ngu-1993 lapho inkampani yesibili engaphansi kwayo, iMultichoice, yadalwa yiNaspers.Ukuthengiswa kwama-decoder, izinsizakalo zababhalisile, ukuphathwa kwama-akhawunti nezinye izindaba eziphathelene namabhizinisi ziphathwe ngabakwaMultichoice. 

Ngo-1995 kwamenyezelwa insiza yesathelayithi yedijithali eNingizimu Afrika ngabakwaMultichoice kwathi ngomhlaka 6 Okthoba 1995 iDStv yasebenza ngokusemthethweni kwababhalisile. Ukukhethwa kwasekuqaleni kweziteshi kubalwa iM-Net, MGM, TNT, Sci-Fi Universal, SuperSport, ESPN, Cartoon Network, BBC World News, CNN International kanye neSky News phakathi kokunye.

Lokhu kwalandelwa ukwethulwa kwezinsizakalo ezintsha ezibandakanya: Isathelayithi i-W4 Eutelsat enezinsizakalo ze-Ku-band emazweni ase-sub-Saharan Africa nase-Indian Ocean Islands ngo-2000, i-Interactive Television ngo-2002, i-Dual View decoder ngo-2003, ne-DStv PVR decoder ne-DStv Ihlanganisiwe ngo-2005.

Ukusakazwa kwencazelo ephezulu kweDStv, okubukwa nge-HD PVR decoder kwethulwe ngo-2008.Nakulo nyaka kwethulwe iXtraView Decoder nesiteshi iM-NET HD.

Ngo-2010, kwethulwe iDVB over IP (Digital Video Broadcast over Internet Protocol) neDStv on Demand services. Idecoder ye-HD PVR 2P yethulwe ngonyaka ofanayo kwathi iM-NET Movies 1 HD yasakazwa okokuqala ngqa.IDStv BoxOffice (i-movie on demand service) neDStv Mobile yethulwe ngo-2011.

Iziteshi nezimbali 
IDStv idlala iziteshi zethelevishini nezomsindo noma imisakazo ezingaphezu kwama-200.Uhlu lweziteshi luyahlukahluka kuzo zonke izifunda ezungeze i-Sub-Saharan Africa.Kunezimbali eziyisithupha, ngasinye sinohlu lwamanani ahlukile, namaphakeji amabili wokungezwa weziteshi zaseNdiya nezasePutukezi.Ama-decoder amaningi ezinsuku zamanje nawo anikela ngokufinyelela kungxenyekazi ye-Multichoice yokusakaza i- Showmax, kanye nezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza ezivela eceleni ngoxhumano lwe-Ethernet broadband.

Imishini yokwamukela 
I-DStv inamabhokisi ayo asethelwe phezulu akhiqizwa yinkampani yasekhaya i-Altech UEC, kanye ne- Arris International . Ukukhethwa kwamabhokisi kufaka ibhokisi elijwayelekile elinekhono le- "XtraView", isiqophi sevidiyo esidala, nebhokisi elisha sha le-PVR elaziwa nge-Explora. Idikhoda eyengeziwe eyaziwa njengeDrifta (inqanyuliwe) ivumela ukuguqulwa kwesiginali ye-DStv DVB-H kwenye idivaysi yedijithali enjenge-laptop, ithebhulethi noma i-smartphone yokubukwa ekhaya.

Uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-DStv 
I-DStv iphinde inikeze ngohlelo lokusebenza leselula leselula lamadivayisi eselula namathebulethi, kanye ne-PC ukulawula ama-DVR nezilawuli zabazali futhi ivumela ukufinyelela kokuqukethwe okurekhodiwe nevidiyo kumasevisi okudingwa.

title: Gomora
text:
Gomora kuyinto eNingizimu Afrika ithelevishini idrama uchungechunge ezivezwa Seriti Amafilimu . Kungumkhiqizo wokuqala wakwaM-Net othunyelwe esiteshini sakwaM-Net senzalo yakhona iMzansi Magic.Umdlalo owuchungechunge ungene esikhaleni sika-Isthembiso, ongavuselelwanga isizini yesine.Lolu chungechunge lukhuluma ngemindeni emibili ngezindlela ezimbili zokuphila ezihlukene nokuthi izimpilo zabo zihlangana kanjani nenhlekelele. Uchungechunge luqoshwa elokishini lase-Alexandra, yingakho igama lolo chungechunge. IGomora idlala ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu ngo-19h30 kuMzansi Magic.

Isiza 
Lolu chungechunge lukhuluma ngemindeni emibili, omunye womuntu ozenzele ingcebo nempumelelo ngezindlela ezingekho emthethweni ezivela ebhange analo, elinye elendoda ehlonishwayo emphakathini elwela ukuziphilisa.Amazwe abo amabili ahlangana emzamweni oduniwe wokudunwa kwemigwaqo obeka imihlaba yabo ekuwohlokeni okuphelele. 

Lolu chungechunge luhlola izingqikithi zezinkinga zezenhlalo nezomnotho, ukungafani phakathi kwamalungu aphansi kanye namazinga aphezulu emiphakathini yaseNingizimu Afrika, lapho umehluko wawo phakathi kwawo uvuselelwa ngenye yezindlela zokuqopha ezintsha.

Abalingisi 
Abalingisi banenqwaba yomakadebona emkhakheni wezokulingisa waseNingizimu Afrika, kanti kunezelwe ezimbalwa ezintsha. 

 Onthatile "Thathi" Molefe-Ndaba ( Katlego Danke )

 Unkosikazi wendebe kaMbongeni nowesithandwa sikaMelusi esikoleni esiphakeme. Ukwazile ukubalekela izimpande zakhe zaselokishini eziphansi, ezithobekile futhi ubephila impilo ephezulu njengosonhlalakahle eSandton. Ubeshade ne-CEO futhi enamasheya amakhulu e-CBS Bank, uMbongeni Ndaba ( Themba Ndaba ), otholwa enecala lokukhwabanisa. Ukushona kwakhe emzamweni oduniwe wokudunwa kubuyisa impilo yakhe yaseKasi. Unina wamngenisa ebhizinisini lokuduna imoto futhi uhlanganyela ingane noMelusi. (Indima eyinhloko. Isikhathi sonyaka 1 - okwamanje)

 UMam'Sonto Molefe ( uConnie Chiume )

 Umama kaThathi no Pretty. Ungumpetha wopopayi elokishini owahlela ukudunwa okugcine kuholele ekufeni komkhwenyana wakhe. Ungumphathi womndeni wakwaMolefe futhi uyahlonishwa ngumphakathi waseGomora. (Indima eyinhloko. Isikhathi sonyaka 1 - okwamanje)

 UGladys Dlamini ( Thembi Seete )

 Usonhlalonhle ohlakaniphile emgwaqweni futhi onzima okholelwa ekufukuleni umphakathi.Ulamula ukungqubuzana phakathi kukababa nendodana ekhaya labo.UGladys uzizwa engavikelekile ngoMelusi futhi Lokho ubuhlobo ngoba uThathi uyisithandwa sikaMelusi esikoleni esiphakeme.(Indima eyinhloko. Isikhathi sonyaka 1 - okwamanje)

 UMelusi Dlamini ( Zolisa Xaluva )

 Ubaba oqinile, oqinile. Phambilini ubenobudlelwano noThathi kanti manje ushade noGladys. Unguthishanhloko esikoleni esiphakeme sendawo.Ulindele ukuthi indodana yakhe ibe ngokweqisa ngokweqile.Ubukwa ngumphakathi njengendoda ehlonishwayo, yize umndeni wakhe uphila kanzima. Uyinzalamizi yomndeni wakwaDlamini.Ungubaba kaNtokozo noLanga. (Indima eyinhloko. Isikhathi sonyaka 1 - okwamanje)

 Ntokozo Dlamini ( Ntobeko Sishi )

 Indodana kaGladys efuna uthando kuyise uMelusi, kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya. Ngakho-ke ujoyina iqembu lezigebengu futhi uyabandakanyeka ekudunweni kwemoto okulungisiwe, obhekene nokudonsa inhlamvu.Isimo nemikhuba yakhe iyashintsha, okubonakala kubazali bakhe. Wayenobudlelwano obungazinzile noBuhle. Ungumfowabo kaLanga ngamzali munye. (Indima eyinhloko. Isikhathi sonyaka 1 - okwamanje)

 I-Langa Ndaba ( Siya Xaba )

 ULanga uyindodana kaThathi noMelusi futhi uyizibulo kulo mndeni. . ULanga yingane enekhanda kakhulu phakathi kwakhe noBuhle. Ungumngani noTeddy noNtokozo. (Indima eyinhloko. Isikhathi sonyaka 1 - 2)

 Sibusiso "Teddy" Zondo ( Sicelo Buthelezi )

 UTeddy uyibhungu elitholwe nguGladys noMelusi ngenxa yokuthi unina (uZodwa) uphuza kakhulu. UTeddy wazalwa ene-fetal alcohol syndrome, emenza abe umfundi ohamba kancane.UTeddy ungumngani noNtokozo noLanga.Njengoba umbukiso uqhubeka, kukhombisa ukuthi ukudlwengulwa kwabesilisa kukhona njengoba uTeddy adlwengulwa ngumngani kaGladys uNks Manzi (uthisha osemncane futhi okhangayo) futhi ubhekana nezinkinga ezinzima zengqondo nezenhlalo ngenkathi ebhekene nakho. (Indima eyinhloko. Isikhathi sonyaka 1 - okwamanje)

Umthelela weCovid-19 ekukhiqizeni 
Ngemuva kwenyanga nje uhlelo ludlalile, uGomora ubengomunye wemidlalo yokuqala ye-TV yakuleli ukukhishwa ekusakazeni ngemuva kwekhefu lokukhiqiza ngenxa yemithetho yokuvala i-COVID-19 eNingizimu Afrika.
