title: KykNET
text:
I-kykNET iyisiteshi sethelevishini saseNingizimu Afrika esikhuluma isiBhunu.Iphethwe ngumqhubi we -TV okhokhelwayo uM-Net, yethulwa ku- satellite ye- DStv ngo-Okthoba 1999.Mhla ziyi-16 kuJulayi 2014 iDStv yamemezela ukuthi i-kykNET izosakazwa ngencazelo ephezulu kusukela ngomhlaka 12 Agasti 2014..

Insizakalo ye-kykNet International iyatholakala online kubabhalisile emazweni akhethiwe eNyakatho Melika, eYurophu nase- Australasia ngeplatifomu yeShowmax. 

Phambilini yayitholakala nase- UK, lapho yethulwa khona kwi- TalkTalk, i- IPTV service, iTalkTalk Plus TV, ngo-Okthoba 2013.Kodwa-ke, yehliswa yiTalkTalk ngoDisemba 2015.

title: Real Time
text:
Isikhathi Sangempela ( Discovery Real Time kuze kube ngu-Agasti 31, 2010) isiteshi sethelevishini sase-Italy esiphethwe yiDiscovery Networks Europe .

Isiteshi sethulwa ngo-Okthoba 1, 2005, iba inethiwekhi yesithupha Yokutholwa ezokwethulwa e-Italy.Ikhombise izinhlelo zokuphila ezibhekise kubabukeli besigaba esiphakeme besifazane abaneminyaka engama-25 kuya kwengama-44.Iqukethe zombili izinhlelo zakwamanye amazwe nezinhlelo zase-Italy ezikhiqizelwa isiteshi.

Ngo-Ephreli 7, 2009, isiteshi samukela ilogo entsha nokubukeka okusha.Lokhu kubukeka kwakwamukelwe phambilini yiDiscovery Real Time France.

Ngemuva kokuba isiteshi sokuzijabulisa esingeyona inganekwane esibukwa kakhulu endaweni yesikhulumi i-Sky Italia, ngoSepthemba 1, 2010, sashintsha igama laso laba yi- "Real Time", futhi satholakala kokubili kwi- digital terrestrial nange-satellite yamahhala, futhi sijoyina ipulatifomu yeTivùsat.

NgoNovemba 1, 2010, inguqulo ye +1 yesiteshi yazalwa futhi kusukela ngoFebhuwari 1, 2012, ibuye isakaze ngencazelo ephezulu.

NgoMashi 13, 2019, ivala ngokuqinisekile inguqulo ye- SD kusathelayithi.

Kusukela ngo-Ephreli 9 Isikhathi Sangempela, kanye nezinye iziteshi zamahhala zeqembu, kuyatholakala futhi ekusakazweni kwe- HD kungxenyekazi yeDplay.

Kusukela ngoMashi 1, 2019, kuTivùsat, izinhlobo ze- "HD" ne- "+1" zithatha indawo yenguqulo ye-SD, ngakho-ke ziyabonakala ku-LCN 31 naku-131 ngokulandelana.

NgoDisemba 1, 2020, iReal Time +1 yavalwa.

Isiteshi sisakaza zombili izinhlelo zakwamanye amazwe kanye nemikhiqizo embalwa yase-Italy yasekuqaleni. Izinhlelo eziningi ezitholwe ekuqaleni zenzelwe i-American TLC noma iBritish Channel 4 .

title: TNT Africa
text:
I-TNT iyisiteshi sethelevishini esikhokhelwayo esigxile kuma-movie. Inethiwekhi isakazwa e- Afrika ngaphansi kwegama le-TNT (phambilini elaliyi- TCM Africa kuze kube ngu-2018), kanye nasemhlabeni wama-Arabhu njengo- TCM MENA ; eyokugcina inesheduli yayo kanye nemibhalo engezansi yokuzikhethela yama-Arabhu.

I-TCM MENA yehlukaniswe nokudla kwase-Afrika ngomhlaka 1 Januwari 2016, futhi itholakala kuphela kwi- BeIN .Okwamanje, i-TNT Africa iyatholakala kubahlinzeki abaningi (i- DStv, iBlack, i- StarTimes neCanal + ).

I-TNT njengamanje iyisiteshi sama-movie esibukwe kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika.

Umlando 
Iwebhusayithi yase-Afrika, i-TCMAfrica.com, yethulwa ngo-2010.

I-TCM Africa ishintshele kwisethulo sesikrini esibanzi esingu-16: 9 ngomhlaka 15 Novemba 2015.

NgoDisemba 27, 2015, i-TCM yayeka ukusakaza ku- OSN yathuthela ku- beIN ezweni lama-Arabhu.Lokhu kube ngumphumela wesivumelwano phakathi kwe-Turner Broadcasting System EMEA ne-beIN esuse zonke iziteshi zangaphambili ze-TV ezikhokhelwayo kokugcina, kufaka phakathi i-TCM, iCartoon Network, neBoomerang. 

Ngo-1 Januwari 2016, i-TCM MEA yahlukaniswa yaba yi-TCM Africa ne-TCM MENA. On 21 September 2018, TCM Afrika rebranded ukuba TNT Afrika ngale nguqulo kokuba isiteshi movie ethwele kancane TCM e line-up yayo ababukeli yesimanje Afrika yonkana ku DStv futhi Black.Ukuvuselelwa kabusha kwavumela i-TCM Africa ukuthi inikeze amafilimu anjengeDoom, iGladiator The Green Mile, iHellboy 2: The Golden Army, The Illusionist, Robin Hood, neTango & Cash okungenani izinsuku ezimbili.Ngo-18 Disemba 2018, i-TNT Africa neCartoon Network Africa yethulwe nge-HD ku-DStv.NgoJanuwari 2021, i-TNT Africa yaphinde yashintshwa igama, futhi yamemezela ngomhlaka 22 Januwari ukuthi lesi siteshi sizoqala ukukhombisa i-AEW Dynamite ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku kusukela ngomhlaka 5 Febhuwari 2021.

title: NDTV
text:
INew Delhi Television Ltd yinkampani yezindaba yaseNdiya egxile ekusakazweni nasekushicilelweni kwezindaba zedijithali.Le nkampani ithathwa njengophawu lwefa olwasungula ukusakazwa kwezindaba okuzimele eNdiya, futhi idunyiswa ngokwethula isiteshi sokuqala sezindaba ezingama-24x7 kanye nesiteshi sokuqala sokuphila ezweni.Ingumnikazi futhi isebenza ngeziteshi zezindaba zokusakaza ze- NDTV India ne- NDTV 24x7 .Lezi ziteshi ezimbili zenkampani zithole ama-32 Ramnath Goenka Excellence kuma-Journalism Awards .

Ngokuphikisana nalokho, ingalo yemidiya yedijithali yenkampani, i-NDTV Convergence ibisingene esigabeni sokukhula komchazi.Phakathi kukaMashi 2011 noMashi 2015, ikhule ngokuphindwe kane ngokwezimali kanye nokuphindwe kayishumi ngokwenzuzo futhi ngenxa yalokho inyuse isabelo sayo semali ehlanganisiwe isiyonke isuka ku-4.6% yaya ku-18%.INDTV Convergence ivumelanise ukuhlanganiswa kwezindaba zenethiwekhi ne-inthanethi yayo kanye nobukhona beselula.Ingalo yemidiya yedijithali yahlonishwa ngokunciphisa ukulahleka kwenkampani ngama-50% phakathi konyaka wezimali u-2013-14 no-2014-15.

title: Ukukhula kwemuthondo
text:
Ubudoda bomuntu buyahluka ngosayizi ezinyathelweni eziningana, kufaka phakathi ubude nobubanzi lapho i-flaccid futhi imile.Ngaphandle kokwehluka kwemvelo kokuthomba komuntu ngokujwayelekile, kunezinto eziholela ekwehlukaneni okuncane kowesilisa othile, njengezinga lokuvuka, isikhathi sosuku, izinga lokushisa ekamelweni, izinga lokukhathazeka, umsebenzi wezemidlalo nobuningi bezenzo zocansi.Uma kuqhathaniswa namanye ama-primates, kufaka phakathi izibonelo ezinkulu njenge-gorilla, ipipi lomuntu likhulu kakhulu, zombili ngamagama aphelele futhi lihlobene nawo wonke umzimba.

Ukudla

title: Isitolo sezocansi
text:
A esitolo ucansi (obizwa nangokuthi omdala esitolo,''' esikisela ucansi noma omdala incwadi esitolo)''' kuwuumthengisi ukuthi udayisa imikhiqizo ezihlobene omdala ukuzijabulisa ngokocansi noma ezivusa inkanuko, ezifana ubulili amathoyizi, Lingerie, izingubo, izithombe zobulili ezingcolile, kanye neminye imikhiqizo ehlobene.

Ngokusobala ugogo wesitolo sesimanje sezocansi kwakuyizitolo eziningi ezahlelwa ngawo-1920 nguLéon Vidal wodumo lweDiana Slip, eParis.Izitolo zakhe zathengisa izincwadi ezivusa inkanuko, izithombe nezingubo zangaphansi.

Umlando

E-Australia 
Izitolo zocansi bezisebenza e- Australia kusukela ngawo-1960, okokuqala ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni eSydney, ikakhulukazi iKings Cross.Ukuthuthukiswa kwezitolo zocansi ezweni kwasizwa ngokubhaliswa ngokusemthethweni kokungeniswa komagazini bezithombe zobulili ezingcolile ngo-1971, ukuvela kwama-vibrator akhiqizwa ngobuningi anikwa amandla ngamabhethri ngawo-1970 nokufika kwamavidiyo alinganiselwe i-X ngawo-1980.Ukuthandwa kwezithombe zobulili ezingcolile ze-Intanethi eminyakeni yama-2000 kuholele ekwehleni kokuthengiswa kwezitolo zocansi, ezinye ukuvalwa kwezitolo nokuhlukahluka kube yizimpahla zabantu abadala ezingahlobene nezocansi. 

Izitolo zocansi e-Australia zilawulwa yimithetho yezwe futhi zingaphansi kokulawulwa kokuhlelwa kwasendaweni. Yize imithetho yehluka phakathi kwezifundazwe, abanamalayisense kumele bathobele imibandela eqinile evame ukuthi indawo ibe okungenani amamitha ayi-200 ukusuka ezikoleni nasemasontweni.AmaWindows kuvame ukuthi adanyiswe futhi kungeniswe kuphela kuma 18s, ngamacala ashushiswa ngamaphoyisa ngaphansi kwesigaba 578E soMthetho Wobugebengu. 

Esifundazweni saseNew South Wales (NSW) izitolo zocansi azikwazi ukuhweba ezingeni lomgwaqo futhi kudingeka ukuthi zihwebe ngenhla noma ngaphansi komhlaba.Ngaphansi komthetho we-NSW, imikhiqizo yezocansi engavimbeli inzalo ingathengiswa kuphela ezitolo ezinikezwe ilayisense evinjelwe yimikhandlu yendawo.Noma kunjalo, ngo-2013 izitolo eziningi zangaphansi ze-NSW zase ziqale ukuthengisa amathoyizi abantu abadala nezincwadi ezitolo ezinkulu ngaphandle kokunikezwa ilayisense.

Eshayina 
Ngo-2013 kwakukhona izitolo zocansi ezingaphezu kuka-2 000 eBeijing.Iningi lemikhiqizo yabo lenziwe eChina.

ECanada 
Isitolo sokuqala socansi eNyakatho Melika sabizwa ngokuthi yiJardin. Kuvulwe ngo-Okthoba 1971 ngu-Ivor Sargent kuCrescent Street enkabeni yedolobha iMontreal, eQuebec.Ingadi ihlanganise imiqondo esetshenziswe uBeate Uhse eJalimane kanye no- Ann Summers e-UK.Ukuvulwa kwesitolo kudonse ulayini omude wabathengi. IPalm Beach Post iphawule yathi: "Njengenkukhu noma impikiswano yamaqanda, akekho onesiqiniseko sokuthi ngubani owafika kuqala-isitolo sezitolo zocansi noma lokho okwakuthiwa inguquko kwezocansi ". 

Ayikho imithetho ethile emelene nokusebenzisa noma ukuthenga amathoyizi ocansi kunoma iyiphi iminyaka ethile, kepha kunemithetho evimbela ukuthengwa kwezithombe zocansi.Yize iminyaka yemvume ingu-16 eCanada, iminyaka engu-18 + iyadingeka ukuthenga noma ukubuka izithombe zocansi.Iningi lezitolo zocansi lithengisa ama-video abantu abadala, okusho ukuthi amathoyizi amaningi ocansi ahlala ezandleni zabantu abadala.

I-Italy 
Isitolo sokuqala socansi e-Italy savulwa ngo-1972 eMilan ngu-Angela Masia nomyeni wakhe u-Ercole Sabbatini.Lesi bekuyisitolo sokuqala "esisemthethweni" sezocansi. Kusukela lapho sekuvulwe izitolo eziningi zocansi, ikakhulukazi eRoma.Ngo-2018 idolobha lasePistoia eTuscany lavimbela ukuvulwa kwezitolo ezintsha zocansi esikhungweni somlando sedolobha.

EJapan 

EJapan, izitolo zocansi ziqukethe omagazini be-hentai, amavidiyo abantu abadala nama-DVD.

Abase-Netherlands 

Izitolo zokuqala zocansi eNetherlands zavulwa ekuqaleni kwawo-1970, osomabhizinisi abanjengoBeate Uhse noLasse Braun.Isitolo sokuqala ngqá samaSulumane esise-inthanethi esibizwa nge- El Asira savulwa eNetherlands ngo-2010. Ibinama-70,000 hits kuwebhusayithi ezinsukwini ezine zokuqala zokusebenza.

ISingapore 
Izitolo zocansi azivamile eSingapore. Zimbalwa ebezivulwe ngo-2005, kepha cishe zingu-1-2 kuphela ezikhona njengamanje.Lezi zitolo zidayisa kakhulu izingubo zangaphansi nezamathoyizi ahlukahlukene ocansi.Izimpahla zabo zingabonakala ngewindi lesitolo.

Iningizimu Afrika 
Ngemuva kokuthi uNelson Mandela esekele umthetho wokulwa nobandlululo owawugunyaza amathoyizi ocansi,"I-Adult World" yasungulwa ngo-1994 njengesitolo sokuqala ngocansi saseNingizimu Afrika.I-Adult World ize nezitolo ezingama-52 eseNingizimu Afrika nezitolo eziyi-15 e-Australia.Imiphakathi eminingi yamaKrestu ikholwa ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwalezi zikhungo zokuphila kwabantu abadala kuzoholela emazingeni aphezulu obugebengu futhi kwazanywa ukuhlela imiboniso yabantu abaningi lapho kuvulwa khona ukuphoqa ukuvalwa kwe-Adult World. 

NgoJulayi 1998, i-Adult World yavula isitolo sabo esikhulu kunazo zonke sokuphila kwabantu abadala eParow, eKapa abayiqamba ngokuthi "i-Adult World Warehouse".Lesi sihlabani esidala samabhayisikobho uChristi Lake ubekhona lapho kuvulwa lesi sitolo, lapho imashi yabantu abangu-500 bebhikishe kwaletha isiminyaminya.Ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ezalandela ababhikishi babephethe izingqwembe ezazimemezela ukuthi "Amadoda angempela awazidingi izithombe zobulili ezingcolile" nokuthi "Vikela abantu bethu ezithombeni ezingcolile ezivinjelwe".Ngesikhathi kuvulwa isitolo, kwatholakala ukuthi ama-70% amakhasimende kwakungabesifazane ababefisa ukufunda kabanzi ngemikhiqizo yokuphila kwabantu abadala. 

Njengoba i-Adult World yanda kakhulu, kwagxilwa ekwakhiweni kwezitolo zabantu abadala e-Australia.

i-United Kingdom 

Cishe zonke izitolo zabantu abadala ezinelayisense e-UK azivunyelwe ukuba nezimpahla zabo emafasiteleni avulekile ezitolo ngaphansi komthetho i- Indecent Displays Act 1981, okusho ukuthi imingcele yezitolo ibanjwa phezulu noma imbozwe izingqwembe.Uphawu lwesexwayiso kumele lukhonjiswe kahle emnyango wesitolo, futhi akukho zincwadi zocansi (ngokwesibonelo, izithombe zocansi noma amathoyizi ocansi) okufanele zibonakale emgwaqweni.Kodwa-ke, izingubo zangaphansi, amakhava angacasuli okokusebenza kwabantu abadala, njll. Angakhonjiswa ngokuya ngezimo zelayisense zikamasipala wendawo.IVideo Recordings Act 1984 yethule ukuhlukaniswa okulinganiswe ngama-R18 kwamavidiyo atholakala kuphela ezitolo zocansi ezinelayisense.Alikho ikhasimende elingaba ngaphansi kweminyaka engu-18 ubudala.

ELondon, amadolobha ambalwa anelayisense yezitolo zocansi.Esifundeni saseSoho ngaphakathi kweDolobha laseWestminster idlanzana lezitolo zocansi lavulwa nguCarl Slack ekuqaleni kwawo-1960, kwathi maphakathi nawo-1970 inani lase likhule laba ngama-59.Abanye babenamakamelo angemuva "ayimfihlo" ethengisa izithombe namanoveli alukhuni, kufaka phakathi izinhlelo ze- Olympia Press.

Ngawo-1980, ukususwa kwamaphoyisa akhohlakele, kanye nokulawulwa kwamalayisense amasha futhi okuqinile yiDolobha laseWestminster, kwaholela ekuqothulweni kwezakhiwo ezingekho emthethweni eSoho.Ekuqaleni kwawo-1990, umkhandlu waseLondon waseHackney wafuna ukuvala iSh! I-Women's Erotic Emporium, ngoba babengenayo ilayisense.Sh! yaletha umkhandlu enkantolo futhi ngenxa yalokho yazuza ilungelo lokuhlala ivulekile, ngoba zazingekho izizathu ezanele zokuvalwa.Ngo-2003, i- Ann Summers chain yezingubo zangaphansi nezitolo zamathoyizi ocansi yawina ilungelo lokukhangisa ngabasizi bezitolo eJob Centres, okwakungavunyelwe ekuqaleni ngaphansi kwemingcele yalokho ukukhangisa okungenziwa umkhakha wezocansi.Ngo-2007, isitolo socansi saseNyakatho Ireland sanqatshelwa ilayisense nguMkhandlu Wedolobha laseBelfast.Isitolo sanxusa futhi sanqoba, kepha lokhu kwagumbuqelwa yiNdlu Yamakhosi. 

Ukunikezwa amalayisense noma ukuvalwa kwezitolo zocansi ezingekho emthethweni, kanye nezinguquko zamasiko njengokukhululeka okukhulu kokuvinjelwa okujwayelekile kanye nokutholakala okulungile kocansi olungeyona eyokuhweba, nokutholakala kwempahla yocansi online, kunciphise isifunda samalambu abomvu eSoho indawo encane.Leli dolobha linezitolo zocansi ezinamalayisense eziyi-15 neziningana ezisele ezingenazo izincwadi.I-Islington neCamden ngayinye inezitolo eziningi zocansi; owokuqala unamabhayisikobho amathathu wezithombe zocansi.

Izitolo zocansi eScotland zilawulwa ngaphansi kweCivic Government (Scotland) Act 1982.

EMelika 

E-United States, uchungechunge lwezinqumo zeNkantolo Ephakeme ngawo-1960 (ngokususelwa ekuchitshiyelweni kokuQala koMthethosisekelo wase-United States ) zazivunyelwe ngokusemthethweni izitolo zocansi, ngenkathi zisavumela izifundazwe neziphathimandla zendawo ukuba zikhawulele ngokuklanywa .Imithetho yokwabiwa kwezindawo imvamisa ibangela ukuthi izitolo zitholakale emaphethelweni edolobha, noma zigaxwe endaweni eyodwa, kwakheke uhlobo lwesifunda selambu elibomvu lezitolo zabantu abadala namabhizinisi. Ngawo-1980, cishe zonke izitolo zocansi zaseMelika zaziqondiswe kumakhasimende cishe angabesilisa ngokuphelele.Amaningi afaka phakathi izingoma zabantu abadala, futhi cishe zonke zazenzelwe ukuthi amakhasimende abo angabonakali emgwaqweni: zazingenawo amafasitela, futhi iminyango ivame ukubandakanya ukujika okwenziwe ngo-L ukuze abantu abasemgwaqweni bangaboni phakathi.Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngasekupheleni kweminyaka yama-1980 kanye nasekuqaleni kwawo-1990, izitolo ezazibuye zibe nezindawo zemidlalo yaseshashalazini noma izindawo zokulala ngezinye izikhathi zazivalwa ngomyalo kahulumeni, zikhomba ukusakazeka kwengculaza njengesisusa. 

Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kunezitolo ezifana ne-Ann Summers yase-UK, ezibheke kulayini womkhiqizo "othambile".Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhona izitolo ezavela ikakhulukazi esikweni elikhuthaza ubulili , njengeSan Francisco 's Good Vibrations neXandria.Isigaba sakamuva sezitolo sijwayele ukuba ngamabhizinisi aqonde kakhulu emphakathini, axhase uchungechunge lwezifundo futhi ahileleke kakhulu ezindabeni ezihlobene nezocansi, njll.

title: IMuffin
text:
I- muffin ingumkhiqizo osayizi ngamunye, obhakwe.Lingase libhekisele izinto ezimbili ezingafani, ingxenye-ephakanyiswe flatbread ukuthi kubhakwa bese sasipheka ngesitofu emganwini oyincence (ngokuvamisile ezingenashukela) kanye ikhekhe -like quickbread (ngokuvamile ezinoshukela) ukuthi amakhemikhali esivutshelweyo bese ephekwe isikhunta.Ngenkathi ama-muffin esinkwa esheshayo evame ukuba mnandi, kunezinhlobonhlobo ezinomsoco ezenziwe ngezithako ezifana nommbila noshizi.Isinkwa esiyisicaba sivela eBrithani noma eYurophu, futhi sivela okungenani ekuqaleni kwekhulu le-18, ngenkathi isinkwa esisheshayo sivela eNyakatho Melika ngekhulu le-19.Kokubili kuvamile emhlabeni wonke namuhla.

I-Etymology 
Umthombo owodwa wekhulu le-19 uphakamisa ukuthi "i-muffin" ingahle ihlobane nesinkwa samaGrikhi "maphula", "ikhekhe elibhakwe eziko noma i-griddle", noma kusuka ku-Old French "mou-pain" ("isinkwa esithambile"), okungenzeka yonakaliswe yaba "i-mouffin".  Igama litholakala okokuqala linyathelisiwe ngo-1703, spelled moofin ;  inemvelaphi engaqinisekile kepha kungenzeka ukuthi ithathwe kuMuffen waseGerman ophansi, ubuningi beMuffe okusho ikhekhe elincane, noma mhlawumbe ngokuxhumeka okuthile ku-Old French moufflet okusho ukuthamba, njengoba kushiwo ngesinkwa. Inkulumo ethi "muffin-man", okusho ukuthi umthengisi wasemgwaqeni wasemgwaqeni, kufakazwa enkondlweni ka-1754, efaka ulayini othi: "Hark! The shrill Muffin-Man his Carol plies. . "

Ama-muffin esinkwa esheshayo 

Ama-muffin wesinkwa esisheshayo (kwesinye isikhathi achazwa eBrithani ngokuthi "ama-muffin aseMelika"  ) abhakwa, ngosayizi ngamunye, ukudla okwenziwe ngekhekhe ngokuthungwa "okumanzi, okusalukiwe". Ama-muffin ayatholakala kuzo zombili izinhlobo ezinomsoco, njengama-muffin ombila kanye noshizi, noma izinhlobo ezinoshukela ezifana ne-blueberry, chocolate chip, lemon noma ubhanana flavour. Ama-muffin anoshukela aqala kusuka kumafinithi angenamnandi kuya emikhiqizweni "ecebe kakhulu kunamaqebelengwane amaningi emafutheni nashukela."  Ziyafana namakhekhe ngosayizi nezindlela zokupheka, umehluko omkhulu ukuthi amakhekhe ajwayele ukuba uphudingi omnandi usebenzisa i-cake batter futhi okuvame ukufakwa i-sugar icing (i-American frosting). Ama-muffin angaba nezinto eziqinile ezixubene ne-batter, njengamajikijolo, ama-chocolate chips noma amantongomane. Muffin Fresh wabhaka zidayiswa ngo amabhikawozi, izitolo Ungalokothi futhi abanye ukudla okusheshayo zokudlela kanye yekhofi . Ama-muffin abhakwa efektri athengiswa ezitolo zokudla nasezitolo ezisezingeni eliphakeme futhi ayasetshenzwa nakwezinye izindawo zokuphekela nezindawo zokudlela .

Umlando 
Ukusetshenziswa kwaleli gama ukuchaza ukuthi empeleni amakhekhe noma amabhanisi akuzange kusetshenziswe ngokujwayelekile eBrithani kuze kube ngamashumi eminyaka adlule ekhulu lama-20 ngemuva kokusabalala kwezitolo zekhofi ezifana ne- Starbucks.Ukupheka kwama-muffin esinkwa esheshayo kuvamile ezincwadini zokupheka zaseMelika zekhulu le-19.Ukupheka kwama-muffin asuselwa kwimvubelo, kwesinye isikhathi okwakuthiwa "ama-muffin ajwayelekile" noma "ama-muffin kakolweni" ezincwadini zokupheka zaseMelika zekhulu le-19, kungatholakala ezincwadini zokupheka ezindala kakhulu. Encwadini kaFannie Farmer 's Boston Cooking-School Cook Book, unikeze izindlela zokupheka zombili izinhlobo zama-muffin, zombili lezo ezisebenzisa imvubelo ukukhulisa inhlama nalezo ezisebenzisa indlela esheshayo yesinkwa, zisebenzisa izindandatho ze -muffin ukubumba ama-muffin esiNgisi. Umlimi uveze ukuthi phezulu "kwesitofu", njengoba kwenziwa ngemvubelo inhlama, bekuyindlela ewusizo lapho ukubhaka kuhhavini kungasebenzi.Kuyo yonke le minyaka, usayizi nokuqukethwe kwekhalori kwama-muffin kushintshile: i- "3-inch muffins ugogo owenziwe wayenama-calories ayi-120 kuye kwangama-160 kuphela.Kodwa lanamuhla giant yokubhaka Muffin aqukethe kusukela kilojoule 340 kuya 630 ngamunye. "

Ukwakha 
Ama-muffin ama-Quickbread enziwa ngofulawa, ahlungwe ndawonye ne- bicarbonate of soda njenge-ejenti yokukhulisa.Kulokhu kufakwa ibhotela noma ukunciphisa, amaqanda nanoma yikuphi ukunambitheka (izithelo, njengama-blueberries, ushokoledi noma ubhanana; noma ama-savouries, afana noshizi).

Ama-muffin we-Bran asebenzisa ufulawa omncane futhi asebenzise i-bran esikhundleni salokho, kanye nokusebenzisa ama-molasses noshukela onsundu. Ukuxubana kuguqulwa kube ithreyi le-muffin elifakwa ephaketheni, noma libe isikhunta sephepha ngalinye, bese kubhakwa kuhhavini.Ubisi luvame ukungezwa, ngoba lunomthelela ekubukeni okukhangayo kokunsundu. Umphumela uphakanyisiwe, izinkwa ezisheshayo ngazinye. I-muffin ingahle ifakwe okokufaka, njengoshukela wesinamoni, i-streusel,  amantongomane, noma ama-chip chocolate.

Ama-muffin ezentengiselwano angahle abe "nesitashi esishintshiwe", isiraphu yommbila (noma isiraphu yommbila ephezulu-fructose ), i-xanthan gum, noma i-guar gum yokwandisa okuqukethwe komswakama nokwandisa impilo yeshalofu (futhi, lezi zinsini zingenza okuqinile okwengeziwe, njengama-chocolate chips, usabalalise ngokulinganayo ku-batter).

I-poppyseed muffin 

Ama-muffin we-poppyseed (noma ama- poppy seed muffin ) aqukethe imbewu ye-poppy. Imbewu yePoppy yayivele ithandwa ezingxenyeni eziningi zomhlaba ngokunambitheka kwayo nokuthungwa kwayo — kanye nezimpawu ze- narcotic zesitshalo se-opium poppy ezivunwa kuso. Ezikhathini zanamuhla, ukukhula kwezimbewu ze-poppy ibhizinisi elinzima kubalimi baseMelika, ngenxa yengozi yokukhiqizwa kwe-heroin. Amanye amazwe anezinkinga ezimbalwa ngokuvumela ukukhula kwama-poppies wezinhlamvu zodwa, ezinamazinga aphansi kakhulu (kepha asekhona namanje) ama- opium alkaloids, njenge- morphine . Njengoba amanye amazwe eqala ukulingisa i-muffin yaseMelika, ukusetshenziswa kwembewu ye-poppy ukunambitheka kwayo nako kwasabalala. Yize imbewu ye-poppy ingenakusetshenziswa njenge- narcotic ngenxa yamazinga aphansi kakhulu ama-opium alkaloids,  anakho okwanele ukuthi izivivinyo zezidakamizwa zivame ukukhohliswa futhi zinikeze izinzuzo ezingamanga ngemuva kokuthi umuntu ongenazo ezinye izidakamizwa adle ama-muffin ambalwa nje e-poppyseed.  Ngenxa yalokhu, wonke amaqebelengwane e-poppyseed abeka umuntu owadlayo ngaphambi kokuhlolwa engozini enkulu yokubhekwa ngokungafanele njengomsebenzisi wezidakamizwa.

Ukudla okunomsoco 
Umthombo Wezakhamzimba waseHarvard University uthi yize ama-muffin amaningi wezithelo engabonakala ngathi "... ukuba yisidlo sasekuseni esingcono kunabomakhelwane bawo bama-donut" endaweni yakho yekhofi yangakini, nefulawa yabo evame ukucolisiswa, i-sodium ephezulu, noshukela omningi ongeziwe ... nosayizi wesabelo esikhulu, bakude kakhulu nokukhethwa kokudla okulungile ukuqala usuku lwakho. "  Abathengi bacabanga ukuthi ama-muffin ezentengiselwano angukukhetha okunempilo kunamadonathi; kodwa-ke, ngokusho kukaDietician obhalisiwe uKaren Collins, imvubelo noma ama-donuts aphakanyisiwe anama-khalori asukela ku-170 kuya ku-270 lilinye (ama-donuts wekhekhe anama-calories angama-290 kuye kwangama-360), kuyilapho ama-muffin amakhulu ebhikawozi enama-calories angama-340 kuya ku-630 lilinye kanye no-11 kuya ku-27 amagremu amafutha .  "Ama-muffin amaningi anamafutha amaningi akhohlisayo", anamafutha afinyelela ku-40%, abathengi abaningi abangawazi. 

Uhlobo lwe-muffin lungaba nomthelela omkhulu kokuqukethwe kwalo okunamafutha noshukela; iberry muffin eyodwa enkulu esheshayo yokudla okusheshayo inama-khalori angama-300, kanti i-chocolate chunk muffin efanayo yokudlela inama-calories ayi-620.  Umthombo weHarvard's Nutrition uncoma ama-muffin amancane, okusanhlamvu okuphelele anokushukela okuncishisiwe, uwoyela wesitshalo oketshezi esikhundleni sokunciphisa noma ibhotela, futhi wengeza ukudla okunempilo okufana namantongomane (noma ufulawa wamantongomane) noma ubhontshisi (noma ufulawa kabhontshisi) noma izithelo ezintsha noma imifino .

Ama-Muffin aphezulu 
Ingaphezulu le-muffin liyingxenye ekhanyayo ephezulu ye-muffin, esungule "uqweqwe olunsundu oluboshwe kancane emaphethelweni". Bebegxile esiqeshini se- Seinfeld sitcom sango- 1997 , i- "The Muffin Tops " (isiqephu sama-21 sesizini 8), lapho umlingisi u-Elaine, odla iziqongo kuphela lapho uthenga i-muffin, abona ukuthi ibhikawozi elidayisa iziqongo nje kungaba uphumelele. Lapho ibhizinisi seliqalile, kufanele abone ukuthi enzeni ngamabhodlela e-muffin, okufakazela ukuthi kunzima.

Izinsiza ze-Bakeware nezokubhaka 

Amathini ka-Muffin namaphini we- muffin ngokuvamile angama-bakeware ensimbi anezimpawu eziyindilinga ezimise okomgqomo lapho kuthelwa khona i-muffin batter.Amathini noma amapani kaMuffin angagcotshwa ngebhotela noma ngesifutho sokupheka, ukwehlisa inkinga yokunamathela epanini.Ngenye indlela, kusetshenziswa izinkomishi ze-muffin noma amacala.Izinkomishi noma izimo ngokuvamile amashidi esiyindilinga iphepha, ucwecwe, noma i-silicone ne imiphetho i-scallop ecindezelwe, enikeza Muffin esiyindilinga inkomishi ukuma.Asetshenziswa ekubhakeni kwama-muffin ukugcwala amabhodlela wamathini wamathini, ukwenza lula ukususwa kalula kwe-muffin eqediwe ethinini.Inzuzo kubapheki ukususa kalula nokuhlanza, ifomu eliqonde ngokwengeziwe, nama-muffin we-moister; noma kunjalo, ukuzisebenzisa kuzovimbela uqweqwe ekwakhiweni.

Izinhlobo ezahlukahlukene zamacala we-muffin ziyatholakala. Osayizi abahluke kancane babhekwa "njengokujwayelekile" emazweni ahlukene.Amacala amancane ajwayelekile abe ngu-ububanzi phansi kanye ubude. Amacala osayizi ojwayelekile aqala kusuka ku-ububanzi phansi futhi.Amanye amacala osayizi we-jumbo angabamba ngaphezu kokuphindwe kabili ubukhulu bamacala ajwayelekile. Ababhaki bezinkwa base-Australia nabaseSweden bajwayele amabhokisi amaphepha amade anobubanzi obukhulu ngaphezulu kunababhaki baseMelika nabaseBrithani.

Igalari

Ama-muffin we-Flatbread 
Ama-muffin ayisinkwa esisicaba (aziwa e-United States nakwezinye izindawo ngokuthi " ama-muffin esiNgisi ", noma amane athi 'ama-muffin' eBrithani, noma "ama-muffin ebhikawozi"  ) ayisinkwa esisicaba esimise okwe-disk, ngokuvamile esingenamvubelo semvubelo; ngokuvamile cishe ngo-  nxazonke no-  ubude. Inemvelaphi yesiNgisi noma yaseYurophu. Esikhundleni sokubhaka ngokuphelele kuhhavini, ziyaphekwa futhi ku-griddle ngaphezulu kwesitofu bese ziphenywa zisuka ngapha nangapha, okuholela ekubunjweni kwazo okujwayelekile okuyisicaba kunokuba kube yisiyingi esiyindilinga esibonwa kumaroli abhakwe noma kumafinini ohlobo lwekhekhe.  "Kwesinye isikhathi kufakwa ufulawa."  Lawa ma-muffin athandwa emazweni e-Commonwealth nase-United States. Ama-muffin e-Flatbread avame ukunikezwa i-toasted ngebhulakufesi. Zingaphakwa ngebhotela noma imajarini, zifakwe okokufaka okwehla esiphundu, okufana nojamu noma uju, noma okuthosiwe okunambitheka (isb. Isoseji eyindilinga, iqanda eliphekiwe, ushizi noma ubhekeni). Muffin Flatbread zivame kudliwa njengoba ibhulakufesi ukudla (isib njengoba luyinto esemqoka e Amaqanda Benedict futhi iningi zayo ezihlukahlukene), ephelezelwa ikhofi noma itiye .

Umlando 

Ama-muffin esiNgisi aqale akhulunywa ezincwadini ekuqaleni kwekhulu le-18,  yize umkhiqizo ngokungangabazeki mdala kunalokho.Ku- Oxford Companion to Food, u-Alan Davidson uthi "[lapha] bekulokhu kukhona ukudideka phakathi kwama-muffin, ama- crumpet, nama-pikelets, kokubili ekuphekeni nasegameni." Ukuthandwa okwandayo kwama-muffin ayisinkwa esicwecwe ngekhulu le-19, kufakazelwa ukuba khona kwamadoda "... e-muffin [a] dabula imigwaqo yedolobha ngesikhathi sokudla, eshaya izinsimbi zawo" ukuzidayisa. Ukukhala kwensimbi kwamadoda e-muffin kwande kakhulu kangangokuba ngawo-1840, iPhalamende laseBrithani laphasisa umthetho owenqabela ukukhala kwensimbi ngamadoda e-muffin, kepha awuzange uthathwe ngabathengisi. 

"Ama-mush muffin (abizwa ngokuthi ama-slipperdowns eNew England) abeyi-muffin yamaKoloni [aseMelika] enziwe nge- hominy ku-griddle elengisiwe."  Ama-theses nezinye izinhlobo zama-muffin ayizicaba ayaziwa kubahlali baseMelika, kepha benqaba ukuthandwa ngokufika kwe-muffin esheshayo yesinkwa. I-muffin yaseNgilandi yaphinde yangeniswa emakethe yaseMelika ngo-1880 ngokuthi "ama-muffin amaNgisi" ngumbhaki wamaNgisi waseMelika uSamuel Beth Thomas (inkampani yakhe yezimpahla ezibhakiwe uThomas isekhona kuze kube namuhla). UThomas ubize lo mkhiqizo ngokuthi "ama-crumpets e-toaster", futhi wayewahlose "njengenye indlela ebukekayo yokugcoba 'okufanele isetshenziswe emahhotela amahle.  I-muffin yesiNgisi ichazwe njengefomu ehlukile yesigaxa, noma "umzala", umahluko kube yindawo yemigodi; kukhonkrithi, izimbobo ziyahamba ziye phezulu, kanti nge-muffin yesiNgisi, izimbobo zingaphakathi.  Ngo-1910, uFred Wolferman waseKansas City, eMissouri waqala ukwenza ama-muffin ama-denser angamaNgisi endaweni yakhe yokudla komndeni, esebenzisa amathini angenalutho njenge-molds.

I-Bakeware 
Amasongo kaMuffin ayizinsimbi zokupheka ezisetshenziselwa ukubhaka kuhhavini noma ukupheka imfucumfucu yesinkwa esiyisicaba. Yizinto ezinjengendilinga ezenziwe ngensimbi ezacile. Amasongo angamayintshi ukuphakama.

I- Muffineer ekuqaleni yayiyi-shuaker shaker, ibukeka njengesela elikhulu likasawoti ngenhla yokuhlobisa enamakha, yokusabalalisa ushukela oluyimpuphu kuma-muffin namanye amakhekhe amnandi. Kamuva, ngekhulu le-19, leli gama lasetshenziswa futhi ukuchaza isitsha se-muffin sesiliva, noma esesiliva, esinovalo oluyindilinga negumbi elingezansi lamanzi ashisayo, elalisetshenziselwa ukugcina amakhekhe athosiwe aseNgilandi efudumele ngaphambi kokuphaka.

Ngokwesiko elidumile 
" The Muffin Man " kuyinto bendabuko nursery nemvumelwano, ingoma zezingane noma umdlalo wezingane we ngesiNgisi imvelaphi kusuka 1820.

Isethenjwa esaziwayo sama-muffin esiNgisi sikumdlalo ka- Oscar Wilde wango- 1895 othi The Importance of Earnest .

Njengezimpawu 

 I-muffin yommbila yi-muffin yombuso esemthethweni yaseMassachusetts . 
 I- muffin eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka yi-muffin yombuso esemthethweni yaseMinnesota . 
 I-muffin ye-apula iyimfene kahulumeni esemthethweni yaseNew York .

title: Nduka Obaigbena
text:
UNduka Obaigbena, uMbusi wase- Owa Kingdom ungusihlalo & Umhleli-omkhulu we- THISDAY Media Group, i- ARISE News Channel  kanye nomagazini wesitayela nesiko lase-Afrika i- ARISE Magazine.

Ingemuva 
Wazalelwa e-Ibadan, eSouth West, eNigeria ngoJulayi 14, 1959 emndenini wasebukhosini wase-Owa Kingdom, eDelta State .

Ezemfundo 
U-Obaigbena wafunda e- Edo College, eBenin City, nase- University of Benin.Ufunde e-Graduate School of Business e- University of Witwatersrand, eGoli nase-Advanced Management Program e- University of Cape Town

Umsebenzi 
Wasungula iphephandaba laseNigeria iTheday ngo-1995.Ngo-2000 u-Obaigbena wasungula imiklomelo yaminyaka yonke ye-Thisday Awards  ehlonipha labo abafaka isandla emphakathini waseNigeria emkhakheni wezepolitiki, ebhizinisini lomhlaba jikelele, kwabesifazane abahlonishwayo, nakubantu abahamba phambili emkhakheni wezemfundo waseNigeria.

Ngo-2013 wethula isiteshi sezindaba se-TV samazwe omhlaba esigxile e-Afrika, i- Arise News,   esayina isivumelwano neGlobecast sokudluliswa kwesathelayithi ku- Astra 2G ukusakazwa emsamo we-UK Sky  nakuHot Bird for ukusatshalaliswa kwentambo,  enezisekelo eLondon, eNew York City, eGoli naseLagos .  

Ngo-2021, u-Obaigbena akavumelekile ukusebenza njengomqondisi wenkampani e-UK iminyaka eyisikhombisa; Ijaji uRaquel Agnello, ekhipha isinqumo esivuna icala elethwe ngumamukeli osemthethweni, uthole ukuthi ukuziphatha kwakhe njengomqondisi kuphela we-Arise TV bekungafanele nokuthi inkampani ibilokhu iqhubeka nokuhweba yize "kunokungaqiniseki okuphelele" mayelana nokuxhaswa kwayo.

Ezombusazwe 
U-Obaigbena wayeyilungu le-senate ngo-1991.Wakhethwa waba yilungu leNgqungquthela Yomthethosisekelo ngonyaka we-1994.

Amabhodi wamazwe kanye namaKomidi 
U-Obaigbena uhlala eba khona futhi abe ngumongameli wezikhathi zeForamu Yezomnotho Yomhlaba futhi usebenze njengelungu leKomidi Eliphakamisayo Labaholi Bomhlaba Wonke Bentsha beForamu Yezomnotho Yomhlaba.Ungusihlalo weNewspaper Proprietors 'Association of Nigeria  (NPAN) kanjalo noSihlalo weNigerian Press Organisation - ehlanganisa iNPAN, iNational Union of Journalists kanye neNigerian Guild of Editors lapho engomunye wabo.

ThisDay 
U-Obaigbena waqala ukushicilelwa kwephephandaba i-Theday Nigerian ngo-1995.Ku-2000 usungule ama-Theday Awards minyaka yonke ahlonipha labo abafaka isandla emphakathini waseNigeria emkhakheni wezepolitiki, amabhizinisi omhlaba wonke, Abesifazane abahlonishwayo, kanye nabantu abahamba phambili emkhakheni wezemfundo waseNigeria.

Vuka Izindaba 
Ku-2013 wethule isiteshi sezindaba se-TV samazwe omhlaba esigxile e-Afrika, i-Arise News, esayina inkontileka neGlobecast yokudluliselwa kwesathelayithi ku-Astra 2G yokusakazwa emsamo we-UK Sky, naseHot Bird ngokusatshalaliswa kwentambo, nezisekelo eziseLondon, eNew IYork City, iGoli, neLagos.

ARISE Magazine kanye ne-ARISE Fashion Week 
Uphinde wasungula i-ARISE Magazine.Le ncwadi yethulwa kwi-THISDAY Music & Fashion Festival eLondon eRoyal Albert Hall ngo-Okthoba 14, 2008 futhi yanika amandla i-ARISE (AFRICA) FASHION Week eqala eGoli naseKapa, eNingizimu Afrika, yabuye yathola ikhaya eLagos INigeria - ngemuva kwemibukiso nama-African Fashion Collectives eRoyal Albert Hall, eLondon; Kennedy Centre, eWashington DC; Isikhungo saseLincoln, eNew York. I-ARISE Fashion Week iphinde yaveza iminyaka embalwa eThe New York naseParis Fashion Weeks.

Izindlela Zamasiko 
U-Obaigbena uqale i-THISDAY Music and Fashion Festivals ngo-2006.Lo mcimbi ubufaka izinto eziningi zomculo ezifana noBeyonce, Jay Z, Rihanna, John Legend, Lionel Richie, Dianna Ross, Alicia Keys, Mary J Blige, Snoop Dogg, 50 Cent, Busta Rhyme, Black Eyed Peas, Missy Elliott, Usher, Naomi UCampbell, u-Alec Wek, uLiya Kedebe, u- Oluchi, njll.Uphinde wasungula umqondo wemiklomelo ye-THISDAY.

Impikiswano 
Ngaphambi kokwenyuka kwe- Arise News, abanye abasebenzi kanye nabaphakeli bakhala ngokuhluleka kuka-Obaigbena ukuhlangabezana nesikhathi esinqunyiwe sokukhokha.U-Obaigbena wayekhokhe zonke izikweletu kubasebenzi.Cishe eminyakeni emithathu ngemuva kokwethulwa kwe-Arise News, u-Obaigbena wabandakanyeka ophenyweni olwalwenziwa yiKhomishini Yezobugebengu Nezomnotho eNigeria , (i-EFCC), eyayiphenya ngokusetshenziswa kwesikhwama samaRandi ayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingama- $ 2.1. Inkambo yophenyo elandelayo yathinta ukusebenza kuka-Obaigbena. Cishe ngalesi sikhathi, abasebenzi bakhala futhi bathatha izinyathelo zomsebenzi ngenxa yokubambezeleka kokukhokha.

title: Ogbonnaya Onu
text:
U-Ogbonnaya Onu (owazalwa ngoDisemba 1, 1951) ungusopolitiki waseNigeria, umbhali nonjiniyela.Wayengumbusi wokuqala womphakathi wase- Abia State kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe ngokushesha, iFederal Republic yaseNigeria.

Umsebenzi

Umsebenzi wokufundisa 
Ngemuva kokuphothula iziqu zakhe e-University of Lagos, u-Ogbonnaya Onu waba uthisha eStinary Augustine's Seminary, e-Ezzamgbo, e-Ebonyi State.Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe zobudokotela e- University of California, eBerkeley, uDkt Onu waba ngumfundisi eMnyangweni Wezobunjiniyela Bamakhemikhali e- University of Port Harcourt, futhi kamuva waba yiNhloko yoMnyango eyiphayona.Ubuye wasebenza njenge-Acting Dean ye-Faculty of Engineering waphinde wakhethwa njengelungu loMkhandlu Olawulayo Wenyuvesi.

Izimpikiswano 
UDkt Onu uthe iNigeria izoqala ukukhiqiza amapensela endawo ngonyaka ka-2018 athe uzohlinzeka ngemisebenzi engama-400,000.Kusukela ngo-2019, ukukhiqizwa kwamapensela okushiwo akukaze kuqale.Ngo-1999, ngaphambi kokhetho lukaMongameli kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwe- All People's Party ne- Alliance for Democracy, uDkt Onu wayebandakanyeka engxabanweni eyayihlanganisa zombili i-APP / AD ethatha u- Olu Falae njengomuntu ophethe ifulegi likamongameli ngokuhlanganyela.

title: Necdet Kent
text:
Impilo yokuqala kanye nemfundo 
UNecdet Kent wazalwa ngo-1911 e- Istanbul eMbusweni wase-Ottoman futhi wathola imfundo yakhe yesibili eGalatasaray Lycee, njengoba kwenza nabanye ozakwabo emnyangweni wezangaphandle.Waya e- United States ezifundweni zakhe zaseyunivesithi, wathola iziqu zomthetho womphakathi eNyuvesi yaseNew York.Wayengumdlali webhola lezinyawo kafushane kuHull Fc.

Umsebenzi 
Ebuyela eTurkey, uKent wangena eMnyangweni Wezangaphandle ngo-1937.Uqale wathunyelwa njenge- vice consul e- Athene, eGrisi.Ngo-1941, waqokelwa esikhundleni sokuba yisekela likamengameli eMarseilles, eFrance, okuyisikhundla asiphethe kwaze kwaba ngo-1944.Ababaleki abaningi bahlangana eningizimu yeFrance ngesikhathi sempi, kanti iMarseilles yayiyitheku elikhulu lokuqalisa.

Ngemuva kweMpi Yesibili Yomhlaba, uKent waqhubeka nomsebenzi wakhe kwinkonzo yezangaphandle yaseTurkey. Usebenze njenge- Consul General e-Turkish Consulate General eNew York City . Wayebuye futhi ngezikhathi ezahlukene abe yinxusa laseTurkey eThailand, eNdiya, eSweden,  nasePoland .  

UNecdet Kent washada futhi waba nezingane.Indodana eyodwa, uMuhtar Kent, wayengusihlalo kanye ne-CEO yeNkampani yeCoca-Cola kusukela ngoJulayi 2008 kuze kube nguMeyi 2017.

Izimangalo Zokuhlengwa Kwesizwe 
Esithasiselweni sencwadi kaStanford J. Shaw iTurkey and the Holocaust (1993), izimangalo zikaKent zokuhlenga amaJuda ngesikhathi sokuQothulwa Kwesizwe zashicilelwa okokuqala. 

UKent uthe, ngesinye isikhathi ngo-1943, umsizi wenxusa laseTurkey watshela uKent ukuthi amaJalimane ayesanda kulayisha amaJuda angama-80 aseTurkey ahlala eMarseilles ezimotweni zezinkomo ukuthutha ngokushesha ukuze abulawe eJalimane.UKent kamuva uyakhumbula, "Kuze kube namuhla, ngikhumbula umbhalo owawusenqoleni: 'Le nqola ingahle ilayishwe izinkomo ezingama-20 kanye no-500 kilograms wotshani'." UKent waya kumkhuzi wamaGestapo esiteshini, futhi wafuna ukuthi amaJuda adedelwe, ngoba ayeyizakhamizi zaseTurkey kanti iTurkey yayingathathi hlangothi.Lesi sikhulu senqabile ukwenza lokho, sathi laba bantu babengelutho ngaphandle kwamaJuda. 

Ngokwe-akhawunti yakhe, uKent nomsizi wakhe bangena ngokushesha esitimeleni; isikhulu saseJalimane samcela ukuba ehle, kodwa uKent wenqaba.Esiteshini esilandelayo, izikhulu zaseJalimane zagibela zaxolisa kuKent ngokungamvumeli ahambe eMarseilles; babenemoto elinde ngaphandle ukuthi bambuyisele ehhovisi lakhe.UKent uchaze ukuthi iphutha wukuthi izakhamizi ezingama-80 zaseTurkey zazilayishwe esitimeleni."Njengommeleli kahulumeni owayenqaba impatho enjalo ngenxa yezinkolelo zenkolo, angizange ngicabange ukubashiya lapho," esho.Emangazwe ukuma kwakhe okungayekethisi, amaJalimane ekugcineni adedela wonke umuntu wehla esitimeleni. 

UKent uphinde wathi wafinyelela emphakathini wamaJuda, enikeza omazisi baseTurkey inqwaba yamaJuda aseTurkey ahlala eningizimu yeFrance, noma labo ababebalekele lapho futhi ababengenawo amapasipoti avumelekile aseTurkey. UKent uphinde wathi waya ekomkhulu lamaGestapo eyobhikisha ngokuhlwithwa kwabo abesilisa emgwaqweni eMarseilles ukuthola ukuthi bangamaJuda noma cha ( ngokusoka ); UKent ukhuze umkhuzi wamaphoyisa waseGerman futhi wamazisa ukuthi ukusoka akubonisi ukuthi ungumJuda, ngoba namaSulumane asokile.

Ukuqinisekiswa kwezimangalo 
Isazi-mlando uMarc David Baer uphawula ukungahambisani okuningi endabeni kaKent, ephetha ngokuthi "kwenziwa".Isazi-mlando uCorry Guttstadt uhlola izimangalo ezenziwe, uphetha ngokuthi "isenzo sobuqhawe sikaKent asinasisekelo ngokuphelele". Ugxeke imizamo yokusebenzisa "ukutakula amaJuda njengethuluzi lokukhangisa". 

UKent akabonwa njengoLungile Phakathi Kwezizwe.

Ifa nodumo 
Ngo-2001, uKent, uNamık Kemal Yolga noSelahattin Ülkümen, nabo ababengabameli baseTurkey abake basebenza eYurophu futhi basindisa amaJuda phakathi neMpi Yezwe II, bahlonishwa ngeMedical Service Medal yaseTurkey.

title: Necdet Özel
text:
Jikelele Necdet Özel (owazalwa ngo-1950) is a Army Turkish jikelele, owakhonza njengelungu 28 uMphathi Jikelele Abasebenzi  we -Turkish Armed Forces.Ubuye futhi wakhonza njengomphathi weTurkey Land Forces . UGeneral Necdet Özel ungowesibili kuphela kulesi sikhundla ukungabi nesipiliyoni seNATO.

Impilo yokuqala kanye nemfundo 
U-elzel wazalwa ngo-1950 e- Ankara . Uthole iziqu e-Turkish Military Academy ngo-1969 nase-Infantry School ngo-1970. Ngo-1975 wafunda eLondon School of Economics ezifundweni zokuphothula iziqu kwiDiplomacy Yomhlaba Wonke.

Umsebenzi wezempi 
U-elzel wakhonza njengomholi weqembu kanye nomkhuzi wenkampani emaqenjini ahlukahlukene eTurkey Land Forces Command (TLFC) kwaze kwaba ngo-1978.Ngemuva kokuthweswa iziqu kwakhe e-Army War College e1980 njengesisebenzi, usebenze njenge-Operations Plan Officer eTurkey Peace Forces HQ eCyprus, Chief Branch futhi waba nguNobhala Jikelele e-General Secretariat of Turkish Land Forces, Chief of Staff at i-Turkish Military Academy, nanjengoMkhuzi we-17th Infantry Regiment.

Ngemuva kokukhushulelwa kuBrigadier General ngo-1995, wasebenza njengoMkhuzi we-172nd Armored Brigade nanjengoMqondisi Wezokusebenza Kwangaphakathi Kwezokuphepha, i-TLFC.

Ngemuva kokukhushulelwa esikhundleni sakhe kuMajor General ngo-1999, wathatha isikhundla sokuba yi- 39th Mechanised Infantry Division kanye ne-Army War College.

Umyalo ophakeme 
Ngo-2003, wakhushulelwa esikhundleni sokuba nguLieutenant General futhi wasebenza njengoMkhuzi we-7th Corps waphinde waba yiPhini likaMkhuzi Wokuqeqesha Nokufundisa, iTLFC.

NjengoGeneral, wasebenza njengoMkhuzi we-Aegean Army phakathi kuka-2007–2008, njengoMkhuzi we- 2 Army phakathi kuka-2008-2010, nanjengoMkhuzi weGendarmerie phakathi kuka-2010-2011.Ngemuva kokusebenza njengoMkhuzi we-TLFC nanjengoMlawuli Obambile Wezempi ZaseTurkey phakathi kuka-29 Julayi no-4 Agasti 2011, wathatha isikhundla sokuba ngumkhuzi weTurkey Armed Forces (TAF) ngomhlaka 4 Agasti 2011. Phakathi kuka-4 Agasti 2011 no-18 Agasti 2015, wasebenza njengeNduna yama-28 yabasebenzi baseTurkey General Staff, elandelwa nguHulusi Akar .

Impilo yomuntu siqu 
U-Ezel ushade noKamuran Özel.Banengane eyodwa.

title: Necdet Karababa
text:
Necdet Karababa  usopolitiki kanye obengumholi we -Democratic Left Party.

Wakhethwa njengomholi weDemocratic Left Party emhlanganweni wayo omkhulu owawubanjwe ngoMashi 7, 1988 kulandela ukwesula kwakhe nokushiya ipolitiki kaBülent Ecevit esikhathini esedlule.Washiya kulesi sikhundla ngoDisemba 28, 1988 ngemuva kokungezwani okuqhubekayo nomlingani ka-Ecevit uRahşan.UNecdet Karababa akazange asingenele lesi sikhundla engqungqutheleni yeqembu eyalandela ngoJanuwari 15, 1989, walandelwa nguBülent Ecevit, owabuyela kwezombusazwe futhi ngemuva kokufunwa ngamandla ngamalungu eqembu. 

UKarababa ushade no-Atifet Karababa kanti lo mbhangqwana unezingane ezintathu.

title: Necdet Turhan
text:
UNecdet Turhan (owazalwa ngo-1957) ungumgibeli wezintaba ongaboni kahle waseTurkey nomsubathi kazwelonke wokugijima ibanga elide.Ngo-2017 uqedele iphrojekthi ebifuna ukuthi kusetshenziswe ama-marathoni amahlanu kumazwekazi amahlanu ahlukene, futhi akhuphuke izingqungquthela ezinhlanu emazwenikazi ahlukene amahlanu.

Isiqalo sokuphila 
UNecdet Turhan wazalelwa eBalıkesir, eTurkey, ngo-1957.Wafundiswa eBursa ngenxa yesabelo sikayise sobungcweti.Ulahlekelwe ukubona ngenxa yesifo se-corneal esaqala lapho eneminyaka engu-23.Ngemuva kokuqeda isikole samabanga aphezulu, wafunda isayensi yezepolitiki nokuphathwa komphakathi eMiddle East Technical University e- Ankara.Uphothule ngama-honours ngo-1994.

Umsebenzi 
UTurhan uqale izintaba ngokujoyina i- "Mountain Climbing and Winter Sports Club" eyunivesithi yakhe.Uqale wabhekana nokuphikiswa ngamalungu ekilabhu ngenxa yokungaboni kwakhe, kodwa ngemuva kwalokho wavunyelwa ukuba abambe iqhaza emisebenzini yokuqwala.Ufinyelele eziqongweni zeBey Dağları, iMt. Erciyes, nezinye iziqongo eTurkey.Waba nentshisekelo yokugijima ibanga elide ngemuva kokuhlangana nabadlali abanekhono abazivocavoca eBursa Atatürk Stadium.Ngo-2000, wabamba iqhaza kwi- Istanbul Marathon, egijima ku- 15 I-km (9.3 mi) isigaba.

Impilo yomuntu siqu 
Njengamanje, uTurhan uhlala eBursa. 
Abazalwa nge-1957
Abantu baphilayo

title: Necdet Calp
text:
UNecdet Calp (Septhemba 7, 1922 - Septhemba 13, 1998) wayeyisisebenzi sikahulumeni saseTurkey futhi engusopolitiki.

Isiqalo sokuphila 
Wazalelwa eKaramürsel ilçe esifundazweni saseKocaeli, eTurkey ngo-7 Septhemba 1922.Uthole iziqu e- Faculty of Political Science yase- Ankara University e-1944.Ubuye wafunda eLondon School of Economics.Usebenze njengombusi wesifunda, umhloli eMnyangweni Wezangaphakathi kanye nomphathi wesifundazwe waseSiirt nase- mzmir.Ubuye wasebenza njengomsizi omkhulu ku- İsmet İnönü, owayengundunankulu waseTurkey ngaleso sikhathi.Ngesikhathi sokubusa kwezempi phakathi kuka-1980 no-1983, wayengunobhala ongaphansi kukandunankulu uBülent Ulusu.

Ingqungquthela 
Okhethweni lwasekhaya olwalungo-21 Mashi 1984, lapho i- SODEP nayo yayincintisana khona, i-HP yathola u-8.8%, okwakusho ukulahleka cishe kwama-75% amavoti ayo ezinyangeni ezingaphansi kwezinhlanu.Ngemuva kokufunda le miphumela, uCalp wesula esikhundleni, kodwa kungekudala waphinde wakhethwa njengosihlalo.Kodwa-ke, ngesikhathi sokukhethwa kabusha, iqembu eliphikisayo eqenjini lathola amandla.Engqungqutheleni yeqembu ebibanjwe ngomhlaka-29 Juni 1985, walahlekelwa ngusihlalo ku- Aydın Güven Gürkan.

Iminyaka yamuva 
Ngemuva kuka-1985, akazange abambe iqhaza kwezepolitiki, futhi okhethweni luka-1987, akazange angenele isikhundla sephalamende.Ngo-13 Septhemba 1998, washona e-Ankara ngenxa yesifo senhliziyo.
Abafa nge-1998

title: Arzu Rana Deuba
text:
(26 Januwari 1962) [1] uyilungu leNepali Congress Party yaseNepal kusukela ngo-1996.Uyilungu lomhlangano weNepali Congress Party neCentral Leadership Voting Committee kusukela ngonyaka ka-2000.Ubeyilungu le-Constituent Assembly kanye nePhalamende laseNepal iminyaka eyishumi (2008-2017).Ulandele izindaba ezinjengamalungelo abesifazane, ikakhulukazi amalungelo okuzala, amalungelo okuba yisakhamuzi alinganayo, amalungelo empahla alinganayo, udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane, nokumelwa kwabesifazane ngokulingana nangokulingana kwezombusazwe kuwo wonke amazinga ngenkathi ebhala umthethosisekelo waseNepal .Ungunkosikazi kaNdunankulu waseNepal uMnu uSher Bahadur Deuba ".

Ezemfundo 
UDeuba uthweswe iziqu eSt Bedes College, eHyachal Pradesh University . Uthole iziqu ze-master yakhe ePunjab University.Uthole ne-Ph.D.Yakhe. kwi-Psychology yenhlangano ngo-1990 evela ePunjab University India.

imisebenzi yomphakathi

I-Deuba isungule inqwaba yezindaba zabesifazane nezingane ezihlobene nezinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni (ama-NGO) e-Nepal, ezihlanganisa- Saathi (1992) osebenzela ukuqeda udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane; Isikhungo Sokuthuthukiswa Kwabesifazane Basemakhaya Nobunye (1995) esisebenza ezindaweni ezinezinkomba eziphansi zokuthuthukiswa kwabantu; I-Safe Motherhood Network Federation (1996) esebenza endaweni yezempilo yokuzala kanye namalungelo; kanye ne-Samanata – Institute for Social & Gender Equality (1997) okuyinhlangano esekwe ocwaningweni

U-Deuba wakhethwa njengekhansela lesifunda le-World Conservation Union (IUCN) ngesikhathi sengqungquthela yomhlaba yesine eyayibanjelwe e-Barcelona, ​​e-Spain ngo-Okthoba 2008. U-Deuba uyikhandidethi lokuqala ukukhethwa e-Nepal emgudwini omkhulu wokuthatha izinqumo we-IUCN. Usebenze amahlandla amabili njengekhansela lesifunda elikhethiwe le-South & East Asia le-IUCN (2008 - 2016). Njengamanje ukhonza ebhodini le-IPAS, e-USA (u-2014 uyaqhubeka) kanye ne-Mahatma Gandhi Institute for Education for Peace and Sustainable Development, okuyisikhungo se-UNESCO Type I esizinze eNew Delhi, e-India (eqhubekayo ngo-2014). Futhi uhlotshaniswa ne-White Ribbon Alliance yomama ophephile. UDeuba wayengumbukeli engxoxweni ngokufa komama okungavinjelwa kanye nokugula kanye namalungelo abantu kumhlangano wama-34 woMkhandlu Wamalungelo Abantu (Geneva 2017).

title: Itshe,Iphepha isikelo
text:
Rock iphepha isiyence (kwaziwa futhi nangamanye orderings izinto ezintathu, nge "idwala" ngezinye izikhathi ngokuthi "itshe" noma njengoba Rochambeau, roshambo, noma ro-mbumbulu-bo) kuwuumdlalo uvame ukudlalwa phakathi kwabantu ababili, lapho umdlali ngamunye ngasikhathi sinye akha umumo owodwa kwezintathu ngesandla eseluliwe.Lezi zimo "yidwala" (isibhakela esivaliwe), "iphepha" (isandla esiyisicaba), kanye "nezikele" (isibhakela esinomunwe wokukhomba nomunwe ophakathi, okwakha i-V)."Isikele" siyefana nophawu oluneminwe emibili u-V (futhi lukhombisa "ukunqoba" noma "ukuthula") ngaphandle kokuthi kukhonjwe ngokuvundlile esikhundleni sokubanjwa ume mpo emoyeni.

Umdlalo ngasikhathi sinye, zero-sum, unemiphumela emibili kuphela engenzeka: ukudonsa, noma ukuwina komdlali oyedwa nokulahlekelwa komunye.Umdlali othatha isinqumo sokudlala i-rock uzoshaya omunye umdlali okhethe isikele ("isikelo samatshe" noma kwesinye isikhathi "ashunqise isikele"  ), kepha uzolahlekelwa yilowo oseke wadlala iphepha ("paper covers rock"); umdlalo wephepha uzolahlekelwa umdlalo wesikele ("isikele usika iphepha").Uma bobabili abadlali bekhetha ukwakheka okufanayo, umdlalo uboshiwe futhi uvame ukuphindwa ngokushesha ukuze wephule uthayi.Uhlobo lomdlalo lwavela eChina futhi lwasakazeka ngokuxhumana okwandayo ne-East Asia, ngenkathi kuthuthukiswa okwehlukile ngokuhlukahluka kwezimpawu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

Izikele zamaphepha edwala zivame ukusetshenziswa njengendlela yokukhetha efanele phakathi kwabantu ababili, kufana nokufaka uhlamvu lwemali, ukudweba imicu, noma ukuphonsa amadayisi ukuze kuxazululwe impikiswano noma kuthathwe isinqumo seqembu esingachemile.Ngokungafani nezindlela zokukhetha ezingahleliwe ngempela, noma kunjalo, izikele zamaphepha edwala zingadlalwa ngezinga elithile lekhono ngokubona nokuxhaphaza ukungaziphathi okungahleliwe kubaphikisi.

Akunakwenzeka ukuthola inzuzo ngaphezu komphikisi ongahleliwe ngempela.Kodwa-ke, ngokuxhaphaza ubuthakathaka bengqondo babaphikisi abangahleliwe, kungenzeka ukuthi uthole inzuzo enkulu. Ngempela, abadlali babantu bavame ukungabi okungahleliwe. Ngenxa yalokhu, kube nemincintiswano yohlelo lwama-algorithms adlala isikele.

Ukudlala kwezimfene 
EJapan, abacwaningi bafundise izimfene ukukhomba izandla eziwinile ngokwemithetho yesikele sephepha.

Ama-analog design design 
Emidlalweni eminingi, kujwayelekile ukuthi iqembu lezinketho ezingaba khona lihlanganyele ngesitayela se-rock paper scissors, lapho ukukhethwa ngakunye kunamandla ngokuqhathanisa nokukhetha okuthile, kepha kubuthakathaka komunye.Omakhenikha abanjalo bangenza umdlalo uzilinganise ngandlela thile, uvimbele i-gameplay ukuthi inganqotshwa isu elilodwa elibusayo nohlobo olulodwa lweyunithi. 

Imidlalo eminingi yamavidiyo esekwe ngamakhadi eJapan isebenzisa uhlelo lwesikere se-rock paper njengohlelo lwayo lokulwa, ngokunqoba komzuliswano ngamunye ukwazi ukwenza ukuhlasela kwabo okuqokiwe.Ku- Alex Kidd kwi-Miracle World, umdlali kufanele awine imidlalo yesikele yamaphepha we-rock ngokumelene nomphathi ngamunye ukuze aqhubeke.Abanye basebenzisa okwehluka okulula kwesikele sephepha njenge-subgames.

Isibankwa esivamile esigaxwe ohlangothini ( Uta stansburiana ) sikhombisa iphethini lesikele lephepha le-rock kumasu alo wokukhwelana.Ezinhlotsheni zayo ezintathu zombala womphimbo wabesilisa, "i-orange ishaya okwesibhakabhaka, eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ishaya okuphuzi, nephuzi ishaya ngokusawolintshi" ngokuncintisana kwabesifazane, okufana nemithetho yesikele-iphepha-sikelo.

Imiqhudelwano 

Imiqhudelwano ehlukahlukene yokuncintisana yesikele yamaphepha ihlelwe ngamaqembu ahlukene.

Inhlangano ye-World Rock Paper Scissors 
Iqale ngo-2015 i-WRPSA isingathe i-Professional Rock Paper Scissors Tournaments emhlabeni wonke.

Imiqhudelwano yase-UK 
Imicimbi eminingi ye-RPS ihlelwe e-United Kingdom yiWacky Nation .Umqhudelwano wokuqala wase-UK waba ngomhlaka 13 Julayi 2007, wabe usubanjwa minyaka yonke.Umcimbi ka-2019 unqotshwe ngu-Ellie Mac oqhubeke wayolanda umklomelo wemali engu- £ 20,000 kodwa akakwazanga ukuphinda kabili umholo wakhe ngo-2020 ngenxa yokuqubuka kwe-coronavirus.

Imiqhudelwano ye-USARPS 
I-USA Rock Paper Scissors League ixhaswe nguBud Light.U-Leo Bryan Pacis wayengukhomishani wokuqala we-USARPS.UCody Louis Brown wakhethwa njengokhomishani wesibili we-USARPS ngo-2014.

IGuinness Book of World Records 
Umqhudelwano omkhulu kunayo yonke weRock Paper Scissors ungu-2,950 futhi utholwe ngu- Oomba, Inc.(USA) eGen Con 2014 e- Indianapolis, e-Indiana, e-United States, ngomhlaka 17 Agasti 2014.

Ukuhluka 

Abadlali bakhiqize ukuhlukahluka okuningi kwamasiko nobuntu kulo mdlalo, kusukela ekudlaleni umdlalo ofanayo ngezinto ezahlukahlukene, ukunweba babe yizikhali nemithetho eminingi, nokunikeza igama labo kulo mdlalo ngolimi lwabo lwesizwe.

Izikhali ezahlukene 
Ohlotsheni lwalo mdlalo waseMalaysia, "isikelo" sithathelwa indawo "yinyoni," emelwe ngamathiphu omunwe weminwe emihlanu ehlanganiswe ukwenza uqhwaku.Isundu elivulekile limele "amanzi".Inyoni ishaya amanzi (ngokuwaphuza); itshe lishaya inyoni (ngokuyishaya); netshe lihluleka ukunisela (ngoba liyacwila kulo).

title: Clitoris
text:
I clitoris ( /k l ɪ t ər ɪ s / (  / ) noma /k l ɪ t ɔːr ɪ s / (  / ) ) isitho sobulili sowesifazane esikhona ezincelisayo, izintshe kanye nenani elilinganiselwe lezinye izilwane . Kubantu, ingxenye ebonakalayo - izingilazi - isemphambanweni ongaphambili we- labia minora (izindebe zangaphakathi), ngaphezu kokuvulwa kwe- urethra .Ngokungafani nepipi, i- homologue yesilisa (elingana) ne-clitoris, imvamisa ayinayo ingxenye ye-distal (noma ukuvulwa) kwe-urethra ngakho-ke ayisetshenziselwa ukuchama.I-clitoris nayo ngokuvamile ayinakho umsebenzi wokuzala.Yize zimbalwa izilwane ezichamela i-clitoris noma ziyisebenzise ngokuzala, impisi enamabala, enesigaxa esikhulu ngokukhethekile, iyachama, isizalele futhi izale ngomzimba.Ezinye izilwane ezincelisayo, ezinjengama- lemurs nezinkawu zesicabucabu, nazo zine-clitoris enkulu. 

Kwezilwane ezincelisayo, ukwahlukaniswa ngokocansi kunqunywa isidoda esithwala i- X noma i- Y (chromosome) yowesilisa.  I-chromosome ka-Y iqukethe isakhi sokunquma sobulili (i-SRY) esifaka into yokubhalwa kweprotheni i-TDF (testis determining factor) futhi ibangele ukwenziwa kwe- testosterone ne- anti-Müllerian hormone yokukhula kombungu ibe owesilisa.Lo mehluko uqala cishe emasontweni ayisishiyagalombili noma ayisishiyagalolunye ngemuva kokukhulelwa.Eminye imithombo ithi iyaqhubeka kuze kube yisonto leshumi nambili,  kuyilapho eminye ithi kubonakala ngokusobala ngesonto leshumi nantathu nokuthi izitho zocansi zikhule ngokuphelele ngeviki leshumi nesithupha.

title: Ukudlwengulwa kwabesilisa
text:
Inani lezisulu zokudlwengulwa noma ezinye izehlakalo zodlame locansi ngabesilisa.Ngokomlando, ukudlwengulwa kwakucatshangwa ukuthi kuyicala elenziwa kuphela kubantu besifazane.Le nkolelo isabanjiwe kwezinye izingxenye zomhlaba, kepha ukudlwengulwa kwabesilisa manje sekuyicala lobugebengu futhi sekuxoxiswane kakhulu kunakuqala. 

Kudlwengulwa kwabesilisa namanje Taboo, futhi isetshenziswe ngomqondo ongathandeki phakathi kwabobulili futhi zobungqingili amadoda.Abahlinzeki bomphakathi nabahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo bavame ukusabela ngendlela ehlukile kubantu abahlukunyezwayo besilisa ngokuya ngesimo sabo sobulili kanye nobulili babenzi babo. Kungaba nzima kulabo abahlukunyezwayo besilisa ukubika ukuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi ababhekana nakho, ikakhulukazi emphakathini onomkhuba oqinile wobudoda.Bangesaba ukuthi abantu bazokungabaza ukuthanda kwabo ezocansi futhi bababize ngobungqingili, ikakhulukazi uma bedlwengulwe owesilisa, noma ukuthi bangabonwa njengabangewona abesilisa ngenxa yokuthi bayisisulu.

Isikhathi esiningi, izisulu zesilisa zizama ukufihla ziphike ukuhlukunyezwa kwazo, ngokufana nezisulu zabesifazane, ngaphandle kwalapho zilimele kakhulu emzimbeni.Ekugcineni, izisulu zabesilisa zingase zingacaci kahle ekuchazeni ukulimala kwabo lapho befuna usizo lwezempilo noma lwezengqondo.

Ucwaningo nezibalo

Jikelele 

Ucwaningo mayelana nokudlwengulwa kwabantu besilisa lwalusanda kuqala ukuvela ngo-1980, lugxile kakhulu ezinganeni zesilisa.Izifundo zokuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi ezikhungweni zokuhlunyeleliswa kwezimilo ezigxile ikakhulukazi emiphumeleni yalolu hlobo lokudlwengula zazitholakala ekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-1980, kodwa akukho okwakutholakala eminyakeni eyedlule.Iningi lezincwadi eziphathelene nokudlwengulwa nokuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi ligxile kakhulu kubantu abahlukunyeziwe.

Izinganekwane eziphathelene nezisulu zabesilisa zokudlwengulwa

Abesilisa ababisengozini 
Ngokuzihlanganisa ngokobulili besilisa, kucatshangwa ukuthi abesilisa, noma besilisa abasebasha, abakwazi ukuba yizisulu zokudlwengulwa, noma nokuthi basengozini. Kweminye imiphakathi, kuthathwa njengokuyihlazo nokungabi yindoda uma kukhala umntwana wesilisa, ngoba inkolelo-mbono yabesilisa iveza abesilisa bekwazi ukuzivikela, okungenzeka kungabi njalo. Abafana abancane bangaba buthakathaka futhi babe sengozini yezelelesi, ezivame ukuba namandla. Abenzi bokubi bangasebenzisa noma yini abanayo ukuhlukumeza ingane, kufaka phakathi imali noma okunye ukufumbathiswa. Owesilisa osekhulile naye angaba namandla okuzilwela, noma esabe ukukwenza lokho ngenxa yokuthi kungenzeka aboshwe ngokushaya kanye / noma ngebhethri ngenxa yezindinganiso eziphindwe kabili zomphakathi maqondana nokusetshenziswa kwamandla ekuzivikeleni phakathi kobulili, kwezinye izimo abenzi bobubi besifazane (le ndlela ephindwe kabili iyafana nokukhathazeka kokuzivikela kwabesilisa ekuhlukunyezweni ngokocansi ngabesifazane).

Abesilisa bahlala befuna ucansi 
Inkolelo ejwayelekile yomphakathi ukuthi owesilisa kufanele avuswe uma ethola ukwakheka noma enesitho, ngakho-ke lokho kusho ukuthi uzimisele futhi ujabulela noma yimuphi umsebenzi wobulili. Roy J. Levin noWilly Van Berlo babhale ku-athikili ku- Journal of Clinical Forensic Medicine ukuthi ukukhuthazwa okuncane kwezitho zangasese noma ukucindezeleka kungadala ukuphazamiseka "yize kungekho ukukhuthazwa kocansi okuthile okukhona".Ukwakhiwa akusho ukuthi amadoda ayavuma ukuya ocansini. Abesilisa bangathola ama-erections noma ezimeni zocansi ezihlukumezayo noma ezibuhlungu, futhi lokhu akubonisi ukuvuma. 

Ngokufana nempendulo ye-erectile yabesifazane, impendulo yomuntu okusho ukuthi indoda ayidingi ukuvuswa ukuze ipipi layo liqine; ukukhuthazwa kwemishini konke okudingekayo.Ukuvuka nokuvuselela izinto ezihlukile.Ukukhuthazeka kuyimpendulo ebonakalayo ekuvuseleleni.Amadoda angakhuthazwa ngokomzimba ngaphandle kokuzizwa evukile futhi ngaleyo ndlela abangele ukwakhiwa.Abesilisa bangesaba futhi besatshiswe ukwakhiwa, ikakhulukazi uma umuntu emdala noma eyisiphathimandla.

Ukuya ocansini 
UHenry Leak, usihlalo wenhlangano iSurvivors, uthe ukudlwengulwa kwabesilisa, njengabesifazane, kuhlobene kakhulu namandla kunokuya ocansini, futhi akwenzeki kuphela ngaphakathi komphakathi wobungqingili.  Ukuya ocansini kuyinkinga eyinkimbinkimbi, futhi iningi labenzi bobubi besilisa abafuna abafana ababona ongqingili.

Ngesikhathi sokulwa kuhlonyiwe 
 
Ukudlwengulwa kwabesilisa ngesikhathi sempi kubikwe ukuthi kudlangile kwezinye izingxenye zomhlaba, njengeDemocratic Republic of Congo, esanda kuba nezimpi zombango .  

E-Afrika yonkana, amadoda adlwengulwayo avamise ukubhekana nokucwaswa emphakathini nokugconwa ngokuthi “abuthaka” nokwehluleka ukuvimbela ukudlwengulwa.Bangasolwa nangobungqingili (okuyinto engekho emthethweni emazweni amaningi esifunda).Isibonelo, lapho ababaleki besilisa abavela eCongo befuna ukwelashwa e-Uganda, bashushiswa ngobungqingili, kubika i-The Economist ngo-2012. 

Enyakatho ye-Uganda, eminyakeni edlule kube nokuhlaselwa okuqhubekayo ngamaqembu amavukelambuso emelene namabutho kahulumeni.Phakathi nalezi zingxabano, amadoda avamile ahlaselwe kaningi, athunjwa, adlwengulwa futhi aphoqeleka ukuba alwele amaqembu amavukelambuso.Izisulu zokudlwengulwa zivame ukubhekana nokuhlukumezeka okukhulu ngokomzimba, ngokomzwelo nangokwengqondo ngenxa yesipiliyoni sabo.

Imiphumela

Imiphumela yomzimba 
Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi kubanga ukuhlukumezeka okukhulu ngokomzwelo futhi kaningi ngokomzimba . Kubantu abahlukunyezwa ngokocansi abangaphezu kuka-18, 31.5% wabesifazane kanye nabesilisa abangu-16.1% bathe balimale ngaphandle kwezitho zangasese kulokhu kuhlaselwa. 

Izisulu zesilisa zathola ukulimala okuthe xaxa futhi zazisengozini enkulu yokwesatshiswa ngesikhali ngumenzi wobubi.Izimpawu nokulimala okuqapheleka kakhulu ikhanda elibuhlungu, izilonda, isicanucanu, i-colitis, imihuzuko yomphimbo, amehlo amnyama namathambo aphukile.Ucwaningo olwenziwe ngabakwaStermac nozakwabo (2004) luphawule ukuthi ama-45% ezisulu zabesilisa abaya esikhungweni sokuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi esibhedlela banezinhlobo ezithile zokulimala ngokomzimba (25% ukulimala kwezicubu ezithambile , ukuqaqeka okungu-20%).

Imiphumela yesikhathi eside 
Uma kuqhathaniswa nabesilisa abangakaze bahlukunyezwe ngokocansi, amadoda ahlukunyezwa ngokocansi ngaphambi kweminyaka yobudala eyi-18 asengozini enkulu yokuba nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo, kufaka phakathi izimpawu zesifo sokucindezeleka kwangemva kwenhlekelele nokudangala; ukuphuza ngokweqile nokusebenzisa kabi izidakamizwa; imicabango yokuzibulala nemizamo yokuzibulala; izinkinga ebuhlotsheni obuseduze; nokungaphumeleli kahle esikoleni nasemsebenzini. 

Ngenxa yokulindelwa ubulili, ukuba yisisulu sengane yesilisa yokuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi kungaholela ku: 

 Ingcindezi yokufakazela ubudoda bakhe ngokomzimba nangokobulili (ukuqina nokuzibandakanya ekuziphatheni okuyingozi noma okunodlame; ukuba nabalingani abaningi besifazane ocansini).
 Ukudideka ngobulili nobunikazi bobulili.
 Umuzwa wokuba yindoda enganele.
 Umuzwa wamandla alahlekile, ukulawula nokuzethemba ebudodeni bakhe.
 Izinkinga ngokusondelana nokusondelana.
 Izinkinga zocansi. 
 Ukwesaba ukuba 'ngongqingili' noma 'isitabane'.
 Ukuthandana nabantu bobulili obufanayo .

Ukwelapha 
Izisulu zokuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi zidinga ukwelashwa okukhulu ngokomzwelo nangokwengqondo ngemuva kokudlwengulwa, kodwa abasindile besilisa akunakwenzeka ukuthi bawakhulume amacala abo.U-Elizabeth Donovan, udokotela wezifo zengqondo, uthe; "Abesilisa banomthwalo owengeziwe wokubhekana nomphakathi ongakholelwa ukuthi ukudlwengulwa kungenzeka kubo ... nakancane."

title: Intsha (umagazini)
text:
Teen kwaba teen kanye yokuphila kumagazini i-American ngoba eminyakeni eyishumi nambili kanye ekuqaleni eyeve eshumini nambili amantombazane, abaneminyaka engu-10 kuya ku-15.Okuqukethwe yi- Teen kufaka izeluleko, izindaba zokuzijabulisa, imibuzo, imfashini, ubuhle, abantu abayizibonelo zosaziwayo, kanye "nezindaba zamantombazane angempela".Lo magazini ushicilelwe phakathi kuka-1954 no-2009.

Okuqukethwe 
Lo magazini ubunezigaba eziyisishiyagalolunye: New Stuff, Tech Girl, Celeb Stuff, Celebs, Look, Fashion, Get Real, Absolutely You, and More.INew Stuff ibiyisigaba esikhuluma nganoma yini esanda kukhishwa ekhangayo ekufundeni kwayo, njengobuchwepheshe, izesekeli, izingubo, nezimonyo.Isigaba seTech Girl besikhuluma kakhulu ngobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi ubuchwepheshe "obuhambisana nemfashini" nezibuyekezo zemidlalo.

UCeleb Stuff ubandakanya ukubuyekezwa kwama-movie, imibukiso yethelevishini, izincwadi, nomculo, izingcaphuno zosaziwayo abasebasha, amathiphu osaziwayo nezimonyo, nemibuzo yesitayela sosaziwayo, kanti uCelebs wayeyingxenye efaka amaqiniso osaziwayo, izingcaphuno, ama-eseyi, nokubikezela, njengamaphosta ambalwa ezinkanyezi ezisencane kanye nemibuzo.

Isigaba se-Look sithinta izindatshana zobuhle, njengalezo eziphathelene nezinwele nokwakheka.Imfashini bekuyisigaba sezingubo esikhuluma ngama-knits, ijini, izingubo zomzimba womuntu ngamunye, ubuciko kanye nemibuzo.

I-Get Real ibinemibhalo ebhalwe yintsha yangempela.Lezi zihloko bezibandakanya "Izindaba Eziyiqiniso Ezivela Kwentsha Yangempela", lapho intsha ithumela khona izindatshana zayo, "Buza uSophi", ikholomu yezeluleko zemibuzo yezothando, nemibuzo.Impela Unezeluleko nemibuzo ngempilo yakho yangasese, ama-crushes, nomzimba wakho.Okunye, ekugcineni kwalo magazini, kufaka phakathi ukubikezela inhlanhla, indaba eqanjiwe, izinkanyezi, amahlaya, ne- "Why Me?", Iqoqo lezindaba ezihlazo ezivela kokuhlangenwe nakho kwangempela kwabafundi.

Umculo 
Lo magazini ukhiphe iTeen Mag Music 2000 Volume 1, okuyiCD CD yomculo.

Ukuvalwa 
Ngemuva kokuvalwa kweCosmogirl yayo ngo-Okthoba, i-Hearst Magazines yanquma ngoDisemba 2008  ukuqeda ukushicilelwa kukamagazini iTeen.Udaba lwasebusika luka-2009 lwalungolokugcina.Umkhulumeli uthe "Sizoqhubeka nokushicilela udaba lwaminyaka yonke lweTeen Prom, kodwa sizogxila emizamweni yethu yokushicilela intsha kulona mkhiqizo weSeventeen."Isikhulumi sibuye sabona ukuthi i- teenmag.com izongena ku-Hearst Teen Network yamasayithi ngenyanga ezayo.
