title: Saint Jarlath
text:
I-Saint Jarlath ,  owaziwa nangokuthi u- Iarlaithe mac Loga ( ngekhulu le-6), wayengumpristi wase-Ireland futhi eyisazi esivela eConnacht, ekhunjulwa njengomsunguli weSikole sezindela saseTuam kanye ne- Archdiocese yaseTuam,usanta ongumxhasi.Ayikho impilo yangenkathi ephakathi kaJarlath esekhona, kepha imithombo yempilo yakhe nenkolo yakhe ifaka izinhlu zozalo, ukufel 'ukholo, i-Irish Lives yaseSt Brendan yaseClonfert, kanye ne-biography ehlanganiswe nguJohn Colgan ngekhulu le-17.

Ingemuva 
Izinhlu zozalo lwase-Ireland ziqopha ubukhona bosanta ababili okuthiwa uJarlath: Jarlath indodana kaLugh (Iarlaithe m. Loga ), umsunguli weTuam, noJarlath indodana kaTrian (Iarlaithe m. Trena ), umbhishobhi wase-Armagh. 

Jarlath ka Tuam kuthiwa ingeyamakhosi Conmhaícne, abusa khona ingxenye enkulu ukuthi ungaba wendawo ye Tuam.  Omunye usanta kuthiwa wayengowaseDál Fiatach empumalanga ye- Ulster . Uhlonzwa njengoMbhishobhi wesithathu wase-Armagh, kungemuva kwendlalifa kaPatrick uBenignus kanye no- Annals wase-Ulster no- Innisfallen baqopha ukufa kwakhe ngonyaka ka-481.  

Ukuphila ezimbili Irish of St Brendan, cishe ngekhulu le-12, Jarlath ibizwa ngokuthi indodana ka-Lug, indodana ka tren, indodana ka Fiacc, indodana ka Mochta, Nokuphila Okokuqala kule Ncwadi laseLismore uyaqhubeka lozalo ngokubiza Mochta indodana kaBresal, kaSiracht, kaFiacha the Fair.  Bobabili Izimpilo bamelele Imchada ngoba Mochta futhi ngesisekelo salokhu, Séamus Mac Mathúna uveza ukuthi ziya emuva ungqo okuyinto conflates lozalo Iarlaithe mac Loga naleso namesake wakhe e Armagh. 

UDónall Mac Giolla Easpaig uphakamisa ukuthi abangcwele bangabhekisa kumuntu ofanayo:[...] bobabili banikezwa njengombhishobhi wesithathu wase- Armagh [...] ubufakazi bendawo obusendaweni yaseTuam bungavame ukuqinisa lo mbono [...] ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi kwakukhona uPatrician onamandla futhi, ngenxa yalokho, ithonya elinamandla le-Armagh endaweni yaseTuam kusukela esikhathini sokuqala kobuKristu [...] iqiniso lokuthi u-Iarlaithe wayengumbhishobhi onjengoBenignus waseKilbennan noFelartus waseDonaghpatrick, kuzophinde kubonise ukuthi uTuam [...] wayezobe esandulele uBrendan Clonfert cishe ikhulu leminyaka.

Izimpilo zase-St Brendan zase-Ireland 
UJarlath ubonakala kafushane njengomuntu ovelele ezinsukwini zasendulo zase-Ireland Lives of St Brendan waseClonfert. UBrendan kuthiwa uvakashele eConnacht eyofunda ngaphansi kweJarlath yodumo.Ngelinye ilanga, lapho uJarlath esemdala, uBrendan weluleka umeluleki wakhe ukuba ashiye isikole futhi ahambe ngenqola esanda kwakhiwa kuze kuphuluke imiphongolo yayo emibili yangemuva, ngoba kuzoba khona indawo yokuvuswa kwakhe (esséirge) naleyo yabaningi emva kwakhe.Ngenxa yokuthi uJarlath wavuma ubuNkulunkulu nokuhlakanipha okuphezulu komfundi wakhe, wathi "ngithathe ngikusebenzele kuze kube phakade naphakade", wasamukela ngenjabulo iseluleko sakhe.Uhambo lwakhe aluzange lumuse kude kakhulu, njengoba imiphongolo yaphuka eTuaim da Ghualann ("Indunduma yamahlombe amabili"), okungukuthi, eTuam.  

UJarlath ushone, "egcwele izinsuku", ngomhlaka-26 Disemba, cishe ngo-540, eneminyaka engaba ngu-90 ubudala. 

Ngokubamba iqhaza lokuhola kuSt Brendan esisekelweni seTuam, amaLives asikisela ukuthi ukubonwa kweTuam kwakuhlanganiswe kepha kwaba ngaphansi kwaleyo yase- Annaghdown . 

UTuam wazuza isikhundla sombuso omkhulu weConnacht kuphela ngo-1152 eSynod of Kells-Mellifont, kanti u- Annaghdown waba yisihlalo esizimele sedayosisi eSinodi yaseDublin ngo-1192.Ngalokhu, okuqinisekisiwe ku- Lives kufundwe njengezimo ezibonisa ngekhulu le-12.

Isisekelo seTuam 
UJohn Colgan udwebe imemori yosanta ku- Acta Sanctorum Hiberniae yakhe (1645).UJarlath kuthiwa wafunda ngaphansi kukaSt Benignus eKilbennen, umfundi waseSt Patrick.

Ngemva kwalokho, yena wasungula esigodlweni sakhe sokuqala ngesikhathi Cluainfois ( Cloonfush ), eduze Tuam, kuyilapho esihlalweni zakhe eziyinhloko kwaba khona ngesikhathi Tuam.Isikole sakhe sezindela kuthiwa sidonse izazi ezivela kuzo zonke izingxenye ze- Ireland, kubalwa abafundi abanjengoSt Brendan wase- Ardfert noSanta Colman waseCloyne.Ngokubaluleka kwegama lendawo iTuam, isikhundla sikaDonall Mac Giolla Easpaig :"waba ngowokuqala kwigama lendawo uTuaim Dá Ualann / Ghualann wabhekisa endaweni yokungcwaba yobuqaba efana naleyo eyabekwa isigaba sesibili seCluain Fearta (bheka uClonfert ).Uma kunjalo uTuam unikeza esinye isibonelo sesonto lokuqala elakhiwa noma ngasendaweni engaphambi kobuKristu engcwele. " Ngaphandle kokuduma kwakhe, uJarlath washiya iCloonfush wayofunda ngaphansi kukaSanta Enda wase-Aran cishe eminyakeni engama-495.Ngawo-520s, wathatha umhlalaphansi waya eTuam.Ukhethe uTuam ngoba isondo lenqola yakhe laphuka lapho.UJarlath ufakiwe ohlelweni lwesibili lwabangcwele base-Ireland, okusho ukuthi kumele ngabe waphila ngaphambi konyaka ka-540. 

Inkondlo enikezwe uCuimmín waseCoindeire, nayo ekhonjwe ku-Ó Cléirigh's Martyrology of Donegal, ithi uJarlath wayaziwa ngokupha nangokuzinikela emthandazweni (" izinkulumo ezingamakhulu amathathu njalo ebusuku, namakhulu amathathu okuxubana nsuku zonke").  KuMartyrology of Donegal, ubizwa ngokuthi wayebikezele amagama alabo abazomlandela, kufaka phakathi lawo ababhishobhi abathathu 'abaqamba amanga' kanye noMáel oyedwa. Ngokufanayo, wakhe hagiography ku "Omkhulu Synaxaristes leSonto Lobu-Orthodox" amarekhodi ngenxa yakhe enkulu ukuzila nokuzinikela emthandazweni wanikezwa niprofethe .

Usuku lomkhosi 
Usuku lomkhosi kaSanta Jarlath ngumhla ziyi-6 kuNhlangulana, okuwusuku okuhunyushelwa ngalo izinsalela zakhe esontweni elakhiwe ngokukhethekile ngokuhlonishwa kwakhe eduze kweCathedral yaseTuam.Isidumbu sayo abangu limbozwe a ingcwele esiliva, okuvela kulo ibandla langekhulu le-13 wathola igama Teampul na scrín, okusho "isonto shrine", a vicarage esiphakade united kuya prebend ka Kilmainemore e 1415.  Encwadini eyengezwe kuFélire Óengusso nakwamanye ama-martyrologies, usuku lomkhosi kaJarlath lwaqoshwa ngomhlaka 25 noma 26 kuDisemba.

UJarlath ngekhulu lama-21 
Umgubho wokuqala wase-St Jarlath owawuseTuam, owawuhlelwe yiqembu lomphakathi i-Energize Tuam, wahlelwa ngoMgqibelo mhlaka-7 Juni 2008.Lokhu kufaka phakathi umncintiswano / umbukiso ovela eTuam Cathedral emigwaqweni yedolobha, umncintiswano wobuciko wesikole wokuqwashisa ngefa elingcwele namasiko endawo, kanye nokuzijabulisa emigwaqweni. 

Isondo elaphukile laseSt Jarlath liwuphawu lomlando weTuam, futhi lifakiwe enhlanganweni yezinhlangano eziningi zendawo, kubandakanya noMkhandlu Wedolobha laseTuam.

USt Jarlath Road, umgwaqo ohlala eCabra eDublin 7 ubizwa ngegama lakhe. 

A lesifunda e Oakland, California e-United States nowodwa Yarragon, Australia ezibizwa ngegama lakhe.

title: Ukukhuliswa kwomthondo
text:
Ukukhuliswa komthondo, noma ukuqiniswa kowesilisa, yinoma iyiphi inqubo ehlose ukukhulisa usayizi wepipi lomuntu.Ezinye izindlela sinqophe ekungezeleleni obuphelele Imininingwane, abanye girth shaft, futhi okwamanje abanye glans ngosayizi.Amasu zihlanganisa ukuhlinzwa, izakhamzimba, yokugcoba, nezimagqabhagqabha, nazo izindlela ngokomzimba efana ukudonsa, jelqing, futhi traction.

Izindlela zokukhulisa i-penis zingasebenza; kodwa-ke, izindlela ezinjalo zinezingcuphe zezinkinga futhi azikhonjiswa ngokwezokwelapha ngaphandle kwezimo ezibandakanya i-micropenis.Izindlela ezingezona ezokuhlasela zithole ucwaningo oluncane lwesayensi, futhi iningi alinabo ubufakazi besayensi bokusebenza. Kodwa-ke, ubufakazi obulinganiselwe besayensi busekela ukunwetshwa okuthile ngokudonsa isikhathi eside.Eminye imikhiqizo yowaka bodokotela ingathuthukisa ukwakhiwa kwepenisi, iphazanyiswe abathengi ngokukhuliswa kwepipi.

Izindlela zokuhlinza 

Kunezindlela zokwelapha zokwandisa umthondo eziningi, iningi lazo elinobungozi bezinkinga ezinkulu.Izinqubo zabadokotela abahlinzayo abangenazo izincwadi zingaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu. 

Izindlela zokukhulisa i-penis zihlanganisa ukufaka i-penile augmentation kanye ne- suspensory ligament release . Ukwandiswa kwePenile kubandakanya ukufaka amaseli anonile endondeni noma ekuhlanganiseni amangqamuzana anamafutha ethangeni.Ukujova amangqamuzana anonile endondeni kungadala ukuvuvukala nokukhubazeka; kwezinye izimo, ukususwa kwenduku kungadingeka.Ukuxhunyelelwa kwamaseli anonile epeni kungasebenza; kodwa-ke, ukwanda kosayizi kunganyamalala ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.Ukukhishwa kwe-ligament okusolisayo kukhulisa ubude benduku ye-flaccid, kepha akubukhulisi ubude benduku eqondile futhi kungadala izinkinga ngomsebenzi wezocansi. 

I- American Urological Association (AUA) kanye ne-Urology Care Foundation "babheka umjovo ongena ngamakhemikhali okhulisa i-penile girth njengenqubo engakhonjisiwe ukuthi iphephile noma iyasebenza.I-AUA futhi ibheka ukuhlukaniswa kwesigaxa somthondo esisolisayo sokwandisa ubude be-penile kubantu abadala njengenqubo engakhonjisiwe ukuthi iphephile noma iyasebenza."Zombili lezi zitatimende zashicilelwa okokuqala ngoJanuwari 1994 futhi zaqinisekiswa kabusha kusukela lapho. Izinkinga ezivela ezinkambisweni zokukhulisa i-penis zifaka phakathi isibazi esingaholela, ekugcineni, ekunciphiseni kwepenisi noma ukungasebenzi kahle kwe-erectile .  

Ezinye izindlela zokwelashwa zifaka umjovo wama-dermal fillers, i- gel abicah, noma i- PMMA . Ama-Dermal fillers nawo awavunyelwe yi-US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) ukuthi asetshenziswe endodeni. 

Ngenxa yengozi enkulu nokungaqiniseki, ochwepheshe bezokwelapha ngokuvamile bayangabaza ukukhuliswa kwe-penile futhi bayakugwema ukukuzama. Ucwaningo lwango-2019 ekubuyekezweni kwemithi yezocansi luthole ukuthi izindlela zokuhlinza zokwandiswa kwepenisi ngokuvamile azisebenzi futhi zingalimaza impilo yomzimba nengqondo.Ababhali bathole ukuthi lezi zindlela zokwelapha zisekelwa ubufakazi obuncane, obusezingeni eliphansi. . . Imijovo nokuhlinzwa kufanele kuhlale kuyindlela yokugcina, kubhekwe njengokungekho emthethweni ngaphandle kwezilingo zomtholampilo '".Ngokwalolu cwaningo, "" imiphumela yokwelashwa isiyonke ibingemihle, enamanani aphansi okweneliseka kanye nobungozi obukhulu bezinkinga ezinkulu, kubandakanya ukukhubazeka kwe-penile, ukunciphisa, kanye nokungasebenzi kahle kwe-erectile ". 

Odokotela bezokwelapha bayayelapha i-micropenis ngezinqubo zokuhlinzwa.Ezimweni ezinjalo, ukuhlinzwa kungathuthukisa ukusebenza komchamo noma kocansi.

Izithasiselo 
Amaphilisi okwandisa umthondo, amachashazi nezigcobo athengiswa ku-inthanethi.Imikhiqizo enjalo ngokuvamile ibhekwa njengengasebenzi.

Izindlela zomzimba 
Amasu omzimba afaka amadivayisi wokunweba, izisindo ezilengayo, nengcindezi ye-vacuum.Kukhona nokugqagqana okuphawulekayo phakathi kwamasu ahlose ukukhulisa ipipi namasu ahloselwe ukufeza ezinye izinhloso, ezihlobene nokuguqula ubuthakathaka, ukwandisa isikhathi sokuqina, noma ukukhulisa uvuthondaba lwezocansi.

Ukumpompa 
Imvamisa ibizwa ngokuthi "yipompo yepenisi", idrayivu yokwakhiwa kwe-vacuum, noma i-VED, idala ingcindezi engemihle eyandayo bese idonsela igazi ethangeni.  Ama-VED avunyelwe ngokwelashwa, aphatha ukungasebenzi kahle kwe-erectile, anciphisa ingcindezi enkulu, kanti amaphampu athengwa kakhulu ngabathengi abafuna ukukhuliswa kwepipi angafinyelela kwingcindezi eyingozi, alimaze izicubu zepipi. Ukugcina i-tumescence ngemuva kokuphula uphawu lwedivayisi olungangeni moya, umuntu kufanele aqinise isisekelo sepipi, kepha ukuminyaniswa okugqoke imizuzu engama-30 kungalimaza unomphela futhi kubangele ukungasebenzi kahle kwe-erectile. Yize i-vacuum therapy ingaphatha ukungasebenzi kahle kwe-erectile ngokwanele ukuvimbela ukuwohloka kwepenisi nokuncipha,  izivivinyo zomtholampilo azikutholanga kusebenza ekwandisweni kwepipi.

UkuJelqa 
Igama elihunyushiwe elithi "jelqing" yifomu elonakele elisuselwa ku- Persian jalq zadan ( جلق زدن ), jalq okusho ukuthi "ukushaya indlwabu" kulandelwa isenzo esisizayo esithi zadan esisho "ukushaya, ukushaya noma ukushaya".Yenziwe engxenyeni yomthondo yesisu esezingeni eliphakathi nendawo, i-jelqing ukukhohlisa okwenziwa ngesandla ngokukhama ngasikhathi sinye nokuphulula ishafula kusuka kusisekelo kuye ku- corona .Ebizwa nangokuthi "ukusenga", le ndlela inemvelaphi yasendulo yama-Arabhu.  Yize kunemibiko eminingi yempumelelo, ubufakazi bezokwelapha abukho. Izintatheli ziyichithile le ndlela ngokuthi ayinakuphikiswa,  noma ingenakwenzeka, yize kungeke kulimaze kakhulu ipipi.Noma kunjalo, uma kwenziwa ngokweqile noma ngokhahlo, i-jelqing kungenzeka ibangele ukuqhekeka, ukusikeka, ukuwohloka kobuntu, kanye nokususa ukungabi nathemba.

Ukudonsa 

Ukudonswa ngamandla kuyindlela engeyona eyokuhlinza umthondo ngokusebenzisa imishini edonsa ubukhazikhazi benduku isikhathi eside.Kusukela ngo-2013, iningi locwaningo oluphenya ukusetshenziswa kwe-penile traction ligxile ekwelapheni ukugobeka nokuncipha kwepipi ngenxa yesifo sikaPeyronie, yize ezinye izincwadi zikhona ngemiphumela emadodeni ane-penises emfushane. 

Ubufakazi besayensi busekela ukunwebeka okuthile ngokudonsa isikhathi eside. Kodwa-ke, kukhona nezifundo zobudokotela ezikhomba ukuthi imiphumela yokwelula inganakwa.

Izizathu zokufuna ukukhuliswa kwepipi 
Amanye amadoda afuna ukukhuliswa kwepenisi anezitho zobulili ezijwayelekile, futhi abaningi bangathola i- penile dysmorphophobia ngokubukela phansi usayizi wabo wepenisi ngenkathi beqhakambisa usayizi wepenisi omaphakathi. Amanye amadoda angafuna ipenisi enkulu ukukhulisa izimpilo zabo zocansi, noma ngabe ipipi labo limaphakathi noma lingaphezulu kwesilinganiso vele.Abantu bangahle bathande ukukhulisa usayizi wabo wepenisi uma benesibungu sezitho ezinkulu zobudoda.Ipipi elikhudlwana lingadlala naku- BDSM naku- S & M, ngendoda evelele ngenhloso yokuba nepipi elikhulu lokuzwisa umlingani walo ubuhlungu ngesikhathi sokuya ocansini.

Umphakathi namasiko 
Ngo-2013 eVietnam, amadoda amaningi aseVietnam azama ukukhulisa imithondo yawo ngokujova i-liquid silicone kuwo.Babelaliswe esibhedlela ngenxa yezinkinga ezifana nokutheleleka, i- necrosis, izicubu, ukuvuvukala, ukukhubazeka nokungasebenzi kahle kwezocansi.

title: Inkolo nezidakamizwa
text:
Izinkolo eziningi ziveze imibono yazo ngokwamukelekayo ukudliwa njengendlela yokudakwa kwezinhloso zokomoya, zokuzijabulisa noma zokwelapha.Izinto ezisebenza ngengqondo nazo zingadlala indima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni inkolo nemibono yezenkolo kanye nasemicikilishweni.

I-Neolithic 
Encwadini ethi Inside the Neolithic Mind, ababhali, abavubukuli uDavid Lewis-Williams noDavid Pearce bathi izidakamizwa ze-hallucinogenic zakha isisekelo senkolo ye-neolithic nobuciko be-rock.Imikhuba nezithombe ezifanayo zitholakala kubantu bomdabu "benkathi yamatshe" yangaleso sikhathi eNingizimu Melika besebenzisa yaje.

IGrisi yasendulo 
Ezinye izazi ziphakamise ukuthi izinkolo zasendulo zamaGrikhi zasebenzisa ama- entheogen, afana neKykeon enkabeni yezimfihlakalo ze -Eleusinian, ukwenza umbono noma isimo sokuphupha.Ucwaningo olwenziwe nguJohn R. Hale, uJelle Zeilinga de Boer, uJeffrey P. Chanton kanye noHenry A. Spiller lukhombisa ukuthi iziphrofetho zeDelphic Oracle zashiwo ngabaPristikazi ngaphansi kwethonya lomhoshana wegesi okhishwe emhlabathini.Okutholakele kwabo kushicilelwe ku Ukubuza i-Delphic Oracle: Ukubuka konke / i-Tale edakisayo .

IMesoamerica yasendulo 

Imininingwane yemivubukulo, ye-ethnohistorical, ne-ethnographic ikhombisa ukuthi amasiko aseMesoamerican asebenzise izinto ze- psychedelic kumasiko okwelapha nawenkolo.Ama- Aztec asendulo ayesebenzisa izitshalo nezilwane ezahlukahlukene ze-entheogenic emphakathini wabo, kufaka phakathi i- ololiuqui ( Rivea corymbosa ), teonanácatl ( Psilocybe spp. ), Kanye ne peyotl ( Lophophora williamsii ). Izinjongo zokusetshenziswa kwama- entheogenics ngamaMaya ukuphulukiswa ngokomoya, ukuzuza ukuhlakanipha, kanye nemikhosi yenkolo.Imiphumela yezitshalo ze-psychedelic ngesikhathi semicikilisho yenkolo kukholakala ukuthi ibe nomthelela ekwakhiweni nasekudalweni kwezithombe, nezithombe ezingcwele.

UbuHindu 
UbuHindu bunomlando wokusetshenziswa kwe-psychedelic kubuyela emuva enkathini yamaVedic.Imibhalo emidala kunayo yonke yamaHinduism Rigveda (1500 BCE), ikhuluma ngokusetshenziswa kwesiko kwe-psychedelic yaphezulu eyaziwa ngokuthi yi- soma.Kunemibono eminingi mayelana neresiphi yeSoma. Abaphenyi abangewona amaNdiya baphakamise abazongenela ukhetho okubalwa kubo u- Amanita muscaria, Psilocybe cubensis, Peganum harmala kanye ne- Ephedra sinica.Ngokwezifundo zakamuva ze-philological and archaeological, futhi ngaphezu kwalokho, imiyalo yokulungiselela eqondile iqinisekisa kuRig Vedic Hymns ( inkathi yeVedic ) iSoma yasendulo kungenzeka ukuthi yayiqukethe iPoppy, Phaedra / Ephedra (isitshalo) neCannabis .  

Ku- Vedas, kusetshenziswa igama elifanayo elithi soma ekuphuzeni, esitshalweni, nakunkulunkulu waso. Ukuphuza isoma kuveza ukungafi ( Amrita, Rigveda 8.48.3).I-Indra ne- Agni bavezwa njenge-soma eqothulayo ngobuningi. Ezinganekwaneni ze-vedic, u-Indra waphuza kakhulu isoma ngenkathi elwa nedimoni lenyoka iVritra Ukusetshenziswa kwesoma ngabantu kufakazelwa kahle enkambisweni yamaVeda.

UbuBuddha 
KubuBuddha i-Right View ( samyag-dṛṣṭi / sammā-diṭṭhi ) nayo ingahunyushwa ngokuthi "umbono ofanele", "umbono ofanele" noma "ukuqonda okulungile", iyindlela efanele yokubuka impilo, imvelo, nomhlaba njengoba kunjalo zingezethu ngempela. Ukuqonda ukuthi iqiniso lethu lisebenza kanjani.Kusebenza njengesizathu lapho othile eqala ukuprakthiza indlela.Ichaza izizathu zobukhona bethu njengomuntu, ukuhlupheka, ukugula, ukuguga, ukufa, ukubakhona kokuhaha, inzondo, nokukhohlisa.Ukubuka kwesokudla kunikeza ukuqondiswa nokusebenza kwezinye izinto eziyisikhombisa zendlela. Kuqala ngemiqondo nolwazi lokuphakanyiswa, kepha ngokwenza umkhuba wokuhlunga okulungile, kancane kancane kudluliselwa ekuhlakanipheni, okungaqeda izibopho zengqondo.Ukuqonda kombono ofanele kuzogqugquzela umuntu ukuthi aphile impilo enhle ngokuhambisana nombono ofanele.Emigqeni kaPāli neyamaShayina, kuchazwa kanjena:

Indlela yokuziphilisa efanele 
Indlela yokuziphilisa efanele ( samyag-ājīva / sammā-ājīva ).Lokhu kusho ukuthi odokotela akufanele bahlanganyele kwezentengiselwano noma emisebenzini, eqondile noma engaqondile, eholela ekulimaleni kwezinye izidalwa eziphilayo.

Izinhlobo ezinhlanu zamabhizinisi okungafanele zenziwe: 

 Ibhizinisi ngezikhali: ukuhweba ngazo zonke izinhlobo zezikhali nezinsimbi zokubulala.
 Ibhizinisi kubantu: ukuhweba ngezigqila, ukuthengisa ngomzimba, noma ukuthenga nokuthengisa kwezingane noma kwabantu abadala.
 Ibhizinisi enyameni: "inyama" isho izidumbu zezidalwa ngemuva kokubulawa kwazo. Lokhu kufaka ukuzalanisa izilwane zokuhlatshwa.
 Ibhizinisi ezidakweni: ukukhiqiza noma ukuthengisa iziphuzo ezidakayo noma izidakamizwa eziluthayo .
 Ukuhweba ngobuthi: ukukhiqiza noma ukuhweba nganoma yiluphi uhlobo lobuthi noma umkhiqizo onobuthi owenzelwe ukubulala.

Umyalo wesihlanu 
Ngokomthetho wesihlanu wePancasila, amaBuddha enzelwe ukuthi angagwemi kunoma yiluphi inani "lweziphuzo ezivutshiwe noma ezifakiwe" ezingavimbela ukucabanga noma zibangele ukunganakwa. Ku- Pali Tipitaka umyalo ukhathazeke ngokusobala ngophuzo oludakayo :"Ngibophezela emthethweni wokuqeqesha ukuthi ngingaziphuzi iziphuzo ezinomvubelo ezibangela ukunganakwa."Surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇī sikkhāpadaṃ samādiyāmi.Kodwa-ke, i- caffeine netiye kuvunyelwe, kuze kukhuthazwe izindela zamasiko amaningi, njengoba kukholakala ukuthi zikhuthaza ukuphaphama.

Ngokuvamile, iningi lamaBuddha kanye namahlelo amaBuddhist ayasola futhi ngokomlando akwamukelanga ukusetshenziswa kwanoma iziphi izidakwa ngumuntu othathe imiyalo emihlanu.Iningi lamaBuddha likubheka ukusetshenziswa nokuxhashazwa kwezidakwa njengesithiyo ekukhuleni kwengqondo ekhanyiselwe.Kodwa-ke, kunokwehluka okumbalwa komlando nezimfundiso.

Vajrayana 
 
Izikole eziningi zanamuhla zamaBuddhist zikukhuthaze kakhulu ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa zengqondo zanoma yiluphi uhlobo; kodwa-ke, kungenzeka zingavinjelwa kuzo zonke izimo kuwo wonke amasiko.Amanye amahlelo obuBuddhism be-tantric noma i-esoteric ikakhulukazi abonisa lokhu kokugcina, imvamisa esebenzisa izindlela ezinekhono :

Utshwala 
Isibonelo, njengengxenye yesiko le- ganachakra tsok (kanye neHoma, abhisheka futhi kwesinye isikhathi idrubchen ) amanye amaBuddhist aseTibet neBönpos aziwa ngokudla utshwala obuncane bezinhlamvu (obubizwa ngokuthi i- amrit noma i- amrita ) njengomnikelo.Uma ilungu lingumlutha wotshwala, noma ngenxa yesinye isizathu lingafisi ukubamba iqhaza ekuphuzeni umnikelo wotshwala, khona-ke lingacwilisa umunwe otshwaleni bese libu-flick kathathu njengengxenye yomcimbi .

Amrita futhi mhlawumbe iyafana, noma okungenani ngomqondo othile a esuselwe nekutfutfuka kwelizinga lekucabanga wamaHindu lasendulo soma.(Lesi sakamuva izazi-mlando esivame ukulingana no- Amanita muscaria noma esinye isikhunta se- Amanita psychoactive. UCrowley (1996) uthi:"Ngokungangabazeki, ukufana okuphawulekayo phakathi" Kwenganekwane kaChakdor "nenganekwane yamaHindu yemvelaphi yesoma kubonisa ukuthi amrita amaBuddha nesoma lamaHindu ngesinye isikhathi kwaqondwa ukuthi ayefana.Ngaphezu kwalokho, impahla eyinhloko ye-amrita, kuze kube namuhla, ibonwa ngamaBuddha njengohlobo lokudakwa, kepha ngokomfanekiso lokhu kuchazwa kungachazwa.Kungani enye ubhiya (i- chhang yaseTibetan, "ubhiya webhali") ingasetshenziswa ngama-yogino njengengxenye engokomfanekiso ye-amrita [Ardussi]? Ngakolunye uhlangothi, enye kungani le bDud.rTsi eside ingasetshenziswa njengendlela emagama lafanako esankondlo emelela ubhiya ?Ngakolunye uhlangothi, e- Tibetan naseSherpa lore kunendaba ngomonki owathola owesifazane owamtshela ukuthi kufanele:

 a. hlaba imbuzi yakhe,
 b. ulale naye, noma
 c. phuza inkomishi kabhiya .
 d. Konke okungenhla.

Umonki wacabanga ngaphakathi kwakhe, " awu, impela uma ngiyoyibulala imbuzi ngizobe ngidala ukuhlupheka okukhulu ngoba umuntu ophilayo uzofa.Uma ngilala nowesifazane lapho-ke ngiyobe ngiphule esinye isifungo esikhulu sendela futhi ngokuqinisekile ngizolahleka ezindleleni zomhlaba. Okokugcina, uma ngiphuza ubhiya mhlawumbe akukho monakalo omkhulu ozovela futhi ngizodakwa isikhashana, futhi okubaluleke kakhulu ngizozilimaza mina kuphela. "(Ngokomongo wendaba lesi sibonelo sibaluleke kakhulu kuye ngoba izindela eMahayana naseVajrayana zizama ukuletha ukukhanyiselwa kwazo zonke izidalwa ezinemizwa njengengxenye yenhloso yazo. )

Ngakho indela yaphuza inkomishi kabhiya yabe isidakwa kakhulu.Ekudakweni kwakhe wahlaba imbuzi walala nowesifazane, wephula zonke izifungo ezintathu futhi, okungenani emehlweni akhe, wenza okubi okukhulu emhlabeni.Isifundo sale ndaba senzelwe ukuthi, okungenani ngokwamasiko lapho ichaza khona, utshwala budala ukuthi umuntu aphule zonke izithembiso zakhe, ngomqondo wokuthi umuntu angathi yimbangela yazo zonke ezinye izenzo eziyingozi. 

I Vajrayana uthisha Drupon Thinley Ningpo Rinpoche akushilo ukuthi njengengxenye iziyalezo ezinhlanu lapho layperson ukulungisa abaphephela, ukuthi nakuba kufanele uyeke intoxicants ukuthatha, bangase baphuze ngokwanele ngakho njengoba musa badakwe.Bhikkus futhi Bhikkunis (izindela nezindela, ngokulandelana), ngakolunye uhlangothi, asebethathe izifungo eziyishumi njengengxenye abaphephela beba sezizonke, awukwazi imbibe yisiphi isamba Utshwala lezinye izidakamizwa ke, ngaphandle imithi kuthathwe njengoba imithi.

UTenzin Gyatso, owe-14 weDalai Lama waseTibet, waziwa njenge-teetotaler futhi ongabhemi.

Ama-hallucinogens 
Kunobufakazi obuthile bokuthi ephathelene nokusetshenziswa deliriant Datura imbewu (eyaziwa ngokuthi candabija) e Dharmic Rituals elihlobene ne eziningi tantras - okuyi Vajramahabhairava, Samputa, Mahakala, Guhyasamaja, Tara futhi Krsnayamari tantras - kanye insangu nezinye entheogens e esizweni esincane Vajrayana sanghasURonald M Davidson uthi eNdiya Vajrayana, iDatura kwaba:“Uqashwe njengendunduma noma njengenkuni emcimbini womlilo futhi ungangena kalula esikhunjeni noma emaphashini. Imbewu yale narcotic enamandla, ebizwa ngokuthi "imbewu yothando" (i-candabija), yizinto ezinamandla kakhulu futhi iqukethe i-alkaloids hyoscine, i-hyoscyamine, ne-atropine ngamafomu asinda ekushiseni noma ekubiliseni. Ngisho nangemithamo elinganiselayo, i-datura ingenza umuntu acishe anganyakazi abe nemibono emibi efana ne-belladonna. ”

title: Tapiwa Mufudza
text:
UTapiwa Mufudza (owazalwa ngomhlaka 20 Septhemba 1990) ungumdlali wekhilikithi waseZimbabwe.

Mufudza bekulokhu off-wesipina kusukela Wayesethatha umdlalo Mbizi Primary School Highfield, Harare.Wayedlala ngokuba Takashinga Cricket Club eHarare ngaphambi kokuba ukubuthwa Mountaineers.

Udlale imidlalo yakhe yokuqala yeMountaineers ngo-2011-12, futhi wazimisa eceleni ngo-2012-13, ngesikhathi ethatha amawikhethi ayi-13 ngokwesilinganiso esingu-14.92 ukuhola ama-bowling asezingeni lokuqala.Emdlalweni weLogan Cup neSouthern Rocks ushaye ama-39 eshaya kunombolo 10, wabe esethatha amabili ngo-46 no-5 ngo-27 ekunqobeni ama-run ayi-116.Kowamanqamu womqhudelwano we-T20 waseZimbabwe neMashonaland Eagles uvule iblingling wathatha u-4 kwaba ngu-14.Abadlali bezintaba bawine lo mdlalo futhi yena wawina nendondo yomdlalo womdlalo. 

Udlale iCookham Dean kuThames Valley Cricket League ngo-2014, ethatha amawikhethi angama-80 ngesilinganiso esingu-14.86 nokwenza ama-run angu-499 kuma-27.72. 

Ku-Logan Cup ngoDisemba 2014 uthathe ama-7 kwabangu-31 kwi-innings yesibili bedlala neMid West Rhinos, kufaka phakathi amawikhethi okuqala ayisithupha ukuwa, ukuqinisekisa ukunqoba kwe-Mountaineers.NgoJanuwari 2015 wadlala imidlalo emibili yama-over amabili kwiZimbabwe A bedlala neCanada, ethatha amawikhethi amabili ngama-run angama-56 kuma-over angu-20.Ngasekupheleni kwenyanga leyo, evula i-bowling emdlalweni we- List A neMashonaland Eagles, uthathe u-4 kwabangu-28. 

NgoDisemba 2020, wakhethwa ukuthi ayodlalela i-Eagles ku- 2020-21 Logan Cup .Ngo-Ephreli 2021, uMufudza waqokwa eqenjini laseZimbabwe emdlalweni wabo weTwenty20 International (T20I) nePakistan.

title: Tapiwa Marobela
text:
Tapiwa Marobela (owazalwa ngo-Ephreli 1987 30) kuyinto wangaphambili Botswana zesifazane ithenisi umdlali

Ukudlala i- Botswana e Fed Cup, Marobela unomlando W / L 8-16.

title: Isidlidli
text:
Isidlidli (noma inxuluma) yindawo yokuhlala yabantu. Izidlidli ngokuvamile zinkulu kunemizana futhi zincane kunezidlavela, nakuba inqubo yokuhlukanisa phakathi kwalezindawo ihluka kakhulu  ezingxenyeni ezahlukile zomhlaba.

Umsuka nokusetshenziswa 
Ngolimi lwesiZulu, indawo okuhlala kuyo abantu abaningi, neyakhe imizi eminingi ibizwa ngokuthi "isidlidli" noma 'inxuluma. Lawa amagama wakudala wesizulu achaza indawo enkulu okuhlala umphakathi omkhulu wabantu. 

Nakuba namuhla kusetshenziswa igama eliwumfakela elithi "idolobha" elinemvelaphi negama lesiJalimane elithi  , igama lesiDashi elithi  , kanye ne- Old Norse .Igama lokuqala lamaProto-Germanic, * tūnan, kucatshangwa ukuthi liboleka kusenesikhathi kuProto -Celtic * dūnom (cf.  esidala sase-Ireland , I- Welsh  ). 

Umqondo wokuqala wegama kuzo zombili iziJalimane nesiCeltic wawungowenqaba noma indawo ebiyelwe.Izinkomba ze- "town" ngezilimi eziningi zesimanje zaseJalimane zisho uthango noma uthango.NgesiNgisi nangesiDashi, incazelo yaleli gama yathatha umqondo wesikhala lalezi zicingo ezivalekile, futhi lapho kufanele kugijime khona ithrekhi.ENgilandi, idolobha lalingahambisani umphakathi omncane ukuthi ababengenamandla okukuthola noma ubekade angavunyelwe Yakha izindonga noma ezinye izinqaba ezinkulu, wakha udonga, amaqembu noma stockade esikhundleni.  ENetherlands, lesi sikhala kwakuyinsimu, ikakhulukazi leyo yabacebile, eyayinocingo oluphakeme noma udonga olubazungezile (njengensimu yesigodlo saseHet Loo e- Apeldoorn, okwakuyisibonelo se ingadi kaWilliam III noMary II eHampton Court ).Ku-Old Norse  lisho indawo (enotshani) phakathi kwezindawo zokulima, futhi leli gama lisasetshenziswa linencazelo efanayo ngesiNorway sanamuhla.

I-Old English tūn yaba yisijobelelo esivamile segama lendawo eNgilandi naseningizimu-mpumalanga yeScotland ngesikhathi sokuhlala kwama-Anglo-Saxon. Ku- Old English naku-Early and Middle Scots, amagama athi ton, ibizo, njll.Angabhekisa ezinhlotsheni ezahlukahlukene zezindawo eziqhamuka ezindaweni zezolimo kanye nasekubambeni, ngokwengxenye ethatha umqondo weNorse (njengakwiScots word  ) ekugcineni kwesikali, komasipala abaqinisiwe.Ezinye izijobelelo ezijwayelekile ze-Anglo-Saxon zifaka i- ham 'home', i- stede 'stead', ne- burh 'burury, borough, burgh'.

Kwezinye izimo, igama elithi "isidlidli" lishintshaniswa negama elithi "inxuluma" noma "isigodi" (ikakhulukazi isigodi esikhulu okwakhiwe kuso). Kwesinye isikhathi, igama elithi "inxuluma" lisebenza njengegama elithi "ilokishi". Ngokuvamile, izidlidli zanamuhla ziyahluko kumalokishi (amanxuluma) noma   emizaneni eyakhiwe esigodini, noma imizana ngesisekelo uhlamvu yabo zomnotho, ukuthi iningi labantu edolobheni sika azothanda okuzuza baziphilise kusukela yokukhiqiza umkhakha, commerce, futhi izinkonzo zomphakathi kunokuba wemboni eyinhloko izimboni njengezolimo noma imisebenzi ehlobene.

Usayizi wesibalo sendawo akuyona into enokwethenjelwa yohlamvu lwasemadolobheni.Ezindaweni eziningi zomhlaba, isb. ENdiya okungenani kuze kube yizikhathi zakamuva nje, idolobhana elikhulu lingaqukatha abantu abaphindwe kaningana kunedolobha elincane.E- United Kingdom, kunamadolobha omlando amancane kakhulu kunamadolobha amakhulu.

Umkhuba wanamuhla wokukhula okukhulu kwamadolobha, ukuthuthukiswa kwamasayithi ngamasayimane, kanye nokufudukela kwabahlali emadolobheni kuye kwayenza yanzima incazelo yamadolobha, kudala imiphakathi yasemadolobheni ngezici zayo zezomnotho nezamasiko kepha ingenazo ezinye izici zezindawo ezisemadolobheni.

Ezinye izindlela zokuhlala okungezona ezasemaphandleni, njengezindawo zezimayini zesikhashana, kungabonakala zingezona ezasemakhaya, kepha okungenani kunesicelo esingabazekayo sokubizwa ngedolobha.

Amatemu wezibalo 

Amazwe ayi-193 abambe iqhaza emzameni ofanayo wokuvumelana ngencazelo efanayo yezibalo zale mikhakha emithathu: amadolobha, amadolobha nezindawo zasemakhaya.

Uhlelo lweminyaka yamadolobha 
Isazi sokuma komhlaba sase-Australia uThomas Griffith Taylor uphakamise ukuhlukaniswa kwamadolobha ngokuya ngeminyaka yawo nendlela yokusebenzisa umhlaba.Uhlonze izinhlobo ezinhlanu zedolobha: 

 Amadolobha ezingane, engenawo umkhawulo ocacile
 Amadolobha amancane, athuthukise indawo yezitolo
 Amadolobha asakhula, lapho izimboni seziqale ukuvela khona
 Amadolobha okuqala avuthiwe, anendawo ehlukile yezindlu ezisezingeni eliphakeme
 Amadolobha avuthiwe, anezimboni ezichaziwe, ezentengiso nezinhlobo ezahlukahlukene zendawo yokuhlala

Ngezwe

Afghanistan 
E- Afghanistan, amadolobha namadolobha aziwa ngokuthi shār ( Dari : شهر, Pashto : ښار).Njengoba izwe lingumphakathi wasemaphandleni ngokomlando onemizana embalwa emikhulu, ngamadolobha amakhulu engakaze abe nezakhamizi ezingaphezu kwamakhulu ayizinkulungwane ezimbalwa ngaphambi kweminyaka yama-2000, isiko lezilimi alibandlululi amadolobha namadolobha.

I-Albania 
E- Albania "qytezë" kusho idolobha, elifana kakhulu negama ledolobha ( "qytet" ). Noma kungekho ukusetshenziswa okusemthethweni kwaleli gama kunoma yikuphi ukukhokhelwa.Ngesi-Albania i- "qytezë" isho ukuthi "idolobha elincane" noma "idolobha elisha", kanti ezikhathini zasendulo "indawo yokuhlala encane ngaphakathi kwezindonga zenqaba".

E-Australia 
E- Australia, izikhungo eziningi zasemakhaya nezesifunda zabantu zingabizwa ngamadolobha; amadolobha amaningi amancane anabantu abangaphansi kwama-200. Okuncane kakhulu kungachazwa njengamalokishi.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezinye izinhlangano zohulumeni basekhaya zibizwa ngokusemthethweni njengamadolobha aseQueensland, eSouth Australia, eNtshonalanga Australia naseNorthern Territory, futhi phambilini (kwaze kwaba ngawo-1990) eVictoria .

I-Austria 
Uhlelo lwezomthetho lwase-Austrian alwehlukanisi phakathi kwamadolobhana, amadolobha namadolobha. Izwe lihlukaniswe laba ngomasipala abangama-2098 ( German   ) wezinga elilinganayo ngokuyisisekelo.Omasipala abakhulu baqokwa njengamadolobha ezimakethe ( German   ) noma amadolobha ( iStädte ), kepha lokhu kwehlukaniswa kungokomfanekiso futhi akuniki izibopho ezengeziwe zomthetho.Kunemiphakathi emincane emincane ebizwa ngamadolobha ngoba yayijwayele ukuba yizikhungo zabantu besikhathi esedlule.Idolobha laseRattenberg ngokwesibonelo linabantu ababalelwa ku-400.Idolobha laseHardegg linezakhamizi ezingaba ngu-1200, yize idolobha eliyingqophamlando - iHardegg efanele ngaphandle kwalezi ebezikade ziyizindawo ezizungezile - likhaya lemiphefumulo engama-80 kuphela.

IBulgaria 

Abantu baseBulgaria, ngokujwayelekile, abahlukanisi phakathi 'kwedolobha' nelithi 'idolobha'.Kodwa-ke, ngolimi lwansuku zonke nakwabezindaba amagama athi "amadolobha amakhulu" kanye "namadolobhana amancane" ayasetshenziswa."Amadolobha amakhulu" imvamisa abhekise eSofia, Plovdiv, Varna naseBurgas, anabantu abangaphezu kwama-200,000.URuse noStara Zagora bavame ukufakwa futhi ngenxa yokuba khona kwengqalasizinda ethuthuke kakhulu kanye nenani labantu ngaphezulu komngcele we-100,000.Kunzima ukubiza onhlokodolobha besifundazwe abasele ngokuthi "amadolobha amakhulu" njengoba, ngokuvamile, engathuthukile kangako futhi enabantu abanciphayo, amanye anabantu abambalwa njengokufika kwabangu-30,000.

I-Chile 
EChile, amadolobha (iSpanishi: pueblos ) achazwa yiNational Statistics Institute (INE) njengenhlangano yasemadolobheni enabantu abavela ku-2001 kuya ku-5000 noma indawo enabantu abavela ku-1001 kuya ku-2000 nomsebenzi osungulwe kwezomnotho.

i-Hong Kong

India 

Ukubalwa kwabantu eNdiya ngo-2011 kuchaza amadolobha ezinhlobo ezimbili: idolobha elisemthethweni kanye nedolobha lokubala abantu.Edolobheni emithetho kuchazwa njenganoma zonke izindawo nge umasipala, inkampani, Cantonment ibhodi noma aziswe ekomidini edolobheni endaweni.Amadolobha wokubalwa kwabantu achazwa njengezindawo ezanelisa le mibandela elandelayo:

 Inani eliphansi labantu abangu-5 000
 Okungenani ama-75% wabantu besilisa abasebenza benza izinto ezingezona ezolimo
 Ubuningi babantu okungenani ama-400 / km 2 . (1,000 ngesikwele semayela).

Onke amadolobha asemthethweni, amadolobha okubalwa kwabantu kanye nokukhula okuphuma ngaphandle kubhekwa njengezindawo zokuhlala ezisemadolobheni, uma kuqhathaniswa nezindawo zasemakhaya.

I-Iran 
Emibhalweni yangaleso sikhathi yasePheresiya, akukho mehluko owenziwe phakathi "kwedolobha" nelithi "idolobha"; womabili ahumusha ngokuthi "Shahr" (شهر).Emibhalweni emidala yasePheresiya (kuze kube yingxenye yokuqala yekhulu lama-20), igama lesi-Arabhu elithi "Qasabeh" (قصبه) lalisetshenziselwa idolobha.Kodwa-ke, eminyakeni engu-50 edlule, leli gama selingasasebenzi.

title: Jali
text:
A Jali noma jaali, (Jali, okusho "inetha") leli gama ngoba itshe perforated noma latticed isikrini, ngokuvamile iphathini Ornamental icanjwe ngokusebenzisa calligraphy, i-geometry noma amaphethini zemvelo.Leli fomu lokuhlobisa ngokwakha livamile ekwakhiweni kwe- Indo-Islamic futhi ikakhulukazi ekwakhiweni kwamaSulumane. 

Ngokusho kuka-Yatin Pandya, i- jali ivumela ukukhanya nomoya ngenkathi inciphisa ilanga nemvula.Futhi lapho umoya udlula kulokhu kuvuleka, isivinini sawo sandisa ukwanda okukhulu.   Izimbobo zivame ukuba cishe ngobubanzi obufanayo noma zibe ncane kunokushuba kwetshe, ngaleyo ndlela zinikeze amandla ezakhiwo.Kuye kwaphawulwa ukuthi ezindaweni ezinomswakama efana Kerala futhi Konkan zinemigodi ezinkudlwana jikelele opacity ngaphansana eqhathaniswa ezifundeni ezomile sezulu Gujarat futhi Rajasthan. 

Ngokusetshenziswa kabanzi kwengilazi ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-19, kanye nokuxinana kwezindawo zokuhlala eNdiya yanamuhla, i- jalis yehla kakhulu ezindabeni zobumfihlo nezokuphepha.

Umlando 
Umsebenzi oyisisekelo wamatshe ayizinxande waseJali ubonakala ngesikhathi samaGupta amathempeli amaNachna wamaHindu kanye namathempeli aseGupta Pattadakal.Emsebenzini waseChina owenziwe ngokhuni owakhiwe ngesikhathi sobukhosi bakwaHan, leli siko liqhubekile nokwakhiwa kwamanje kwamaShayina. Imibhalo yesiSanskrit ekwakhiweni kwezakhiwo uSilpa (650 AD), uSamarangana-Sutradhara weNkosi uBhoja (1018-1054 AD), uKāśyapā-Śilpā (1300) no-pilpā-Ratnam wekhulu leshumi nesithupha leminyaka bakhuluma noma baxoxa ngejalis. 

Umsebenzi wokuqala we- jali onobujamo bejiyometri obuningi wakhiwa ngokuqoshwa etsheni, ngamaphethini wejometri, \ kuqala kuvela ku- Alai Darwaza ka-1305 eDelhi ngaphandle kweQutub Minar, kwathi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi abakwaMughal basebenzisa imiklamo eqoshwe kahle yezitshalo, njengase UTaj Mahal.Babuye kaningi bangeze i- pietra dura inlay kokuzungezile, besebenzisa amatshe emabula namatshe ayigugu.  

Enqabeni yaseGwalior, eduze kwesango lase-Urwahi, kunombhalo oqoshiwe olayini abangu-17 obhalwe ngo-Samvat 1553, obalula amagama abanye babakhandi nemisebenzi yabo.Omunye wabo nguKhedu, owayeyisazi se- "Gwaliyai jhilmili" okungukuthi i-jali screen esenziwe ngesitayela seGwalior. Ithuna likaMughal lesikhathi sikaMuhammad Ghaus elakhiwa ngo-1565 AD eGwalior liphawuleka ngama-jalis alo amatshe.  Izindlu eziningi zeGwalior zekhulu le-19 leminyaka zazisebenzisa ama-jalis amatshe.AmaJalis asetshenziswa kakhulu eGwalior's Usha Kiran Palace Hotel, okwakuyindlu yezivakashi yaseScindia.

Amaqoqo eMyuziyamu 
Amanye ama-jali aseminyuziyamu emikhulu e-USA nase-Europe.Lokhu kufaka phakathi i-Indianapolis Museum of Art  neMetropolitan Museum of Art  neVictoria ne-Albert Museum.

title: Inkunzi
text:
Inkunzi kuyinkomo abephule (ie, hhayi wawungabavumeli ) omdala wesilisa kwezinhlobo Bos taurus.Imisipha futhi inolaka kakhulu kunabesifazane bezinhlobo ezifanayo, izinkomo, izinkunzi sekuyisikhathi eside kuwuphawu olubalulekile emasikweni amaningi, futhi zibambe iqhaza elibalulekile ekufuyeni inyama yenkomo, ekufuyeni ubisi, nakweminye imisebenzi ehlukahlukene yamasiko, kufaka phakathi ukulwa nenkunzi ukugibela .

Izici 

Izinkunzi zinemisipha kakhulu kunezinkomo, ezinamathambo amakhulu, izinyawo ezinkudlwana, intamo enemisipha kakhulu, nekhanda elikhulu elinamathambo elinemihosha evikelayo phezu kwamehlo.Lezi zici zisiza izinkunzi ekulweleni ukubusa phezu komhlambi, zinikeze ophumelele ukufinyelela okuphezulu ezinkomeni ezizalisayo. Uboya ngokuvamile bufushane emzimbeni, kodwa intamo nekhanda kuvame ukuba ne- "mane" yezinwele ezisontayo, ezinoboya.Izinkunzi ngokuvamile zicishe zilingane nezinkomo noma zide kancane, kodwa ngenxa yesisindo esengeziwe samathambo, zivame ukuba nesisindo esikhulu kakhulu.Isikhathi esiningi, inkunzi iba ne-hump emahlombe. 

Ezinkomeni ezinezimpondo, izimpondo zezinkunzi zivame ukuba zincane futhi zibe mfushane ngaphezudlwana kunezo zezinkomo,  futhi ezinhlotsheni eziningi, zigobela ngaphandle ku-arc eyisicaba kunokuya phezulu ngesimo sehabhu. Akusilona iqiniso, njengoba kukholelwa kanjalo ngokuvamile, ke izinkunzi babe izimpondo kanye izinkomo musa: khona izimpondo incike zohlobo, noma izinhlobo zinezimpondo ekutheni izimpondo ziye disbudded.(Kuyiqiniso, nokho, ukuthi ezinhlotsheni eziningi zezimvu kuphela abesilisa abanezimpondo. ).Izinkomo ukuthi ngokwemvelo akudingeki izimpondo zibizwa ngokuthi ababuzwa, noma muleys. 

Izinkomo zesilisa ezisikiwe ziyafana ngokomzimba nezinsikazi ezakheke futhi zakhiwe ngophondo, yize zivunyelwe ukuthi zikhule, zingaba zinde kakhulu kunezinkunzi noma izinkomo, ezinamahlombe nezintamo ezinemisipha.

Uhlelo lokuzala 

Izinkunzi ziyavunda zizungeze izinyanga eziyisikhombisa ubudala.Ukuzala kwabo kuhlobene kakhulu nosayizi wamasende abo, kanti isivivinyo esisodwa esilula sokuzala ukuzungeza ubude besikhungu; inkunzi encane kungenzeka ivunde uma lokhu sekufike  ; leyo yenkunzi esekhule ngokuphelele ingaba ngaphezu  .Izinkunzi zinomthondo we-fibroelastic. Njengoba kunikezwe inani elincane lezicubu ze-erectile, ukukhulisa okuncane kwenzeka ngemuva kokwakhiwa.I-penis iqine kakhulu lapho ingami, futhi iba nzima nakakhulu ngesikhathi sokumiswa.Protrusion alithintwa enkulu ngokubhula ukwakhiwa, kodwa eziningi ngokufaka ukuphumula we imisipha retractor umthondo futhi eqondisa we flexure sigmoid.Izinkunzi ziyathinteka ngezikhathi ezithile ngesimo esaziwa nge- "corkscrew penis".Umthondo wenkunzi evuthiwe ucishe ube yi-3-4 cm ububanzi,no-80-100 cm ubude. Umthondo wenkunzi yenkomo unomumo oyindilinga nophakeme.

Imibono eyiphutha 
Umbono oyiphutha ovamile ophindaphindwa kabanzi emifanekisweni yokuziphatha kwezinkunzi ukuthi umbala obomvu uthukuthelisa izinkunzi, uzihlohle ukuthi zikhokhise.Eqinisweni, njengezilwane eziningi ezincelisayo, izinkomo zinombala obomvu noluhlaza okotshani.Ekulweni nenkunzi, ukuhamba kwekapa le-matador, hhayi umbala, kubangela ukusabela kule nkunzi.

Ukuphathwa

Ukukhiqizwa kwenkomo 
Ngaphandle kwezinkunzi ezimbalwa ezidingekayo ukuzalanisa, iningi lezinkomo zesilisa liyathenwa bese lihlatshelwa inyama ngaphambi kweminyaka emithathu, ngaphandle kwalapho zidingeka khona (njengezithenjiwe) njengezinkabi zomsebenzi wokuthwala.Iningi lalezi zilwane zenyama yenkomo lithengelwe njengezinkonyane ukunciphisa isimilo esinolaka nokuvikela ukukhwelana okungafuneki,  yize ezinye zikhuliswa njengenkomo yenkomo engacoliswanga. Inkunzi ivamise ukulungela ukuhlatshwa inyanga eyodwa noma ezimbili ngokushesha ukwedlula eyeduna noma eyensikazi ethenjiwe, futhi ikhiqiza imisipha ethe xaxa ngokwengeziwe. 

Uzimele amaphuzu ayindlela ewusizo yokuchaza ubukhulu bamathambo ezinkunzi nezinye izinkomo.Izikolo zohlaka zingasetshenziswa njengesizo ukubikezela osayizi bezinkomo abavuthiwe kanye nosizo ekukhetheni izinkunzi zenkomo.Zibalwa kusukela ekuphakameni kwe-hip nobudala. Kumakhathalogi wokuthengisa, lesi silinganiso sibikwa njalo ngokungeziwe kusisindo nenye idatha yokusebenza efana nenani lokulinganisa elilinganisiwe.

Isimo nokubamba 

Izinkunzi ezindala zingaba nesisindo esiphakathi kuka-Iningi liyakwazi ukuziphatha nolaka futhi lidinga ukuphatha ngokucophelela ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabantu nezinye izilwane.Lezo zinhlobo zobisi zingase zithambekele kakhulu ekuhlaselweni, kuyilapho izinhlobo zenyama yenkomo zinolaka kancane, kepha izinhlobo zenkomo ezinjengeSpanish Fighting Bull nezilwane ezihlobene nazo zaziwa ngokuthambekela okunolaka, okukhuthazwa ngokuqhubekayo ngokuzala okukhethiwe .

Kulinganiselwa ukuthi u-42% wabo bonke abantu ababulawa imfuyo eCanada bangumphumela wokuhlaselwa kwezinkunzi, kanti kusinda izisulu ezingaphansi koyedwa kwabangu-20 ekuhlaselweni yinkunz.Izinkunzi ezifuywayo zobisi ziyingozi ikakhulukazi futhi zingalindelekile; izingozi zokuphathwa kwezinkunzi ziyimbangela ebalulekile yokulimala nokufa kwabalimi bezinkomo zobisi kwezinye izingxenye ze-United States. Isidingo sokufaka inkunzi ngaphandle nangaphandle kwesibaya sayo ukumboza izinkomo kuveza ophethe engcupheni enkulu yempilo nezitho zomzimba. Ukunyathelwa, ukuminyaniswa odongeni, noma ukuqhutshwa yinkunzi kwakuyimbangela eyodwa yokufa kwabantu embonini yobisi ngaphambi kuka-1940. Ngokuphathelene nezingozi ezinjalo, omunye umagazini odumile wezolimo usikisele wathi, "Bamba inkunzi ngenduku futhi ungathathi amashansi.Inkunzi emnene, hhayi enonya, imvamisa iyabulala noma ilimaze umgcini wayo ".

Ukuphatha 

Ezindaweni eziningi, ukufaka amasongo emakhaleni ezinkunzi ukusiza ukuzilawula kungokwesiko.Iringi ivamise ukwenziwa ngethusi, bese ifakwa emgodini omncane osikwe engxenyeni yekhala. Isetshenziswa ngokunamathisela intambo yomthofu ngqo kuyo noma igijime kuyo kusuka kukhololo wekhanda, noma ezinkomeni ezinzima kakhulu, isigxobo senkunzi (noma abasebenzi bezinkunzi) singasetshenziswa.Lesi yisigxobo esiqinile cishe  ubude nesiqeshana ngakolunye uhlangothi; lokhu kunamathela eringini futhi kuvumela inkunzi ukuthi iholelwe futhi ibanjelwe kude nomphathi wayo.

Inkunzi enobudlova ingagcinwa ivalelwe esibayeni sezinkunzi, indawo yokukhosela eyakhiwe ngokuqinile kanye nepeni, imvamisa kunelungiselelo lokuvumela inkunzi ukuthi iphiwe ngaphandle kokungena esibayeni.Uma inkunzi enobudlova ivunyelwe ukuba idle ngaphandle, kungahle kudingeke ezinye izinyathelo zokuvikela ukuze ingalimazi abantu.Enye indlela isifihla-buso senkunzi, esivala amehlo enkunzi ngokuphelele, noma sivimbele umbono wakhe uwele phansi ngokushesha phambi kwakhe, ngakho-ke akakwazi ukubona umuntu angaba yisisulu sakhe.Enye indlela ukunamathisela ubude beketanga eringini lasekhaleni lenkunzi, ukuze kuthi uma idada ikhanda layo ishaja, inyathele iketango bese ikhuliswa ifushane.Ngenye indlela, inkunzi ingase ibhobokiswe, noma iboshwe ngamaketanga ngendandatho yayo noma ngekhola entweni eqinile enjengendandatho ebekelwe phansi.

Emadlelweni amakhulu, ikakhulukazi lapho kugcinwa khona inkunzi nezinye izinkomo, izilwane zingamane zondliwe ngeveni noma ngogandaganda, imoto uqobo enikela ukuvikelwa kwabantu abathintekayo.Ngokuvamile, izinkunzi ezigcinwa nezinkomo zivame ukungabi nolaka kakhulu kunalezo ezigcinwa zodwa.Ezimweni zomhlambi, izinkomo ezinamathole amancane zivame ukuba yingozi kubantu.Esikhathini esingaphandle, izinkunzi eziningi zingagcinwa ndawonye "emhlambini we-bachelor".

Ukukhulelwa okungekhona okwangempela 

Amapulazi amaningi wezinkomo neziteshi ziqhuba izinkunzi nezinkomo, futhi amapulazi amaningi obisi noma enkomo ngokwesiko ayenezinkunzi okungenani eyodwa, uma kungenjalo, ngenhloso yokugcinwa kwemfuyo.  Kodwa-ke, izinkinga ezihambisana nokuphatha inkunzi (ikakhulukazi lapho izinkomo kufanele zisuswe khona ukuze zisebenze) yenze ukuthi abalimi abaningi bezinkomo bazinqande ekusetshenzisweni kwezinkomo (AI). Isidoda siyasuswa ezinkomeni bese sigcinwa emigqonyeni ye- liquid nitrogen, lapho sigcinwa khona size sithengiswe, ngaleso sikhathi singaba nenzuzo enkulu; empeleni, abafuyi abaningi bagcina izinkunzi ngokukhethekile ngale njongo.I-AI ibuye isetshenziselwe ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yomhlambi, noma ukwethula ukuphuma kwamagazi.Abanye abafuyi bakhetha ukusebenzisa i-AI ukuze bavunyelwe ukuba bazalele izinkunzi ezahlukahlukene ngenkathi ethile noma ukuzala imfuyo yabo engcono kakhulu kunkunzi esezingeni eliphakeme kunaleyo abakwazi ukuyithenga ngokuqondile.I-AI nayo ingasetshenziswa ngokuhlanganyela nokudluliswa kombungu ukuvumela abakhiqizi bezinkomo ukwengeza ukuzalanisa okusha emihlambini yabo.

Ubudlelwano nabantu 

Ngaphandle kwemisebenzi yazo yokuzala, izinkunzi ziyasetshenziswa nakwezemidlalo ethile, kufaka phakathi ukulwa kwezinkunzi nokugibela izinkunzi . Zifakwe futhi emikhosini nasemicimbini yesintu efana nokugijima kwezinkunzi futhi zabonakala emidlalweni yasendulo efana nokuxhuma kwezinkunzi.Nakuba ezivamile esingaphansi kwabesilisa zazithenwa, izinkunzi ezisetshenziswa njengeziwusizo okusalungiswa izinkabi kwezinye izindawo.Umdlalo owake wathandwa kakhulu wokubamba izinkunzi, lapho inkunzi ihlaselwa yizinja ezifuywa ngokukhethekile futhi eziqeqeshiwe (ezaziwa ngokuthi ama- bulldogs ), wavinjelwa eNgilandi yi- Cruelty to Animals Act 1835.

Njengezinye izilwane, ezinye izinkunzi ziye zabhekwa njengezilwane ezifuywayo . Umculi uCharo, ngokwesibonelo, ubenenkunzi yezinkomo egama linguManolo.

Ukubaluleka emasikweni esintu 
Izinkunzi ezingcwele zibambe indawo ebalulekile emasikweni esintu kusukela ngaphambi kokuqala komlando oqoshiwe.Zibonakala emidwebweni yemidwebo elinganiselwa eminyakeni eyi-17,000 ubudala.I-Bull of the Heavens yezinganekwane idlala indima ku- Epic yasendulo yaseSumerian kaGilgamesh, eyaqala emuva ngo-2150 BC.Ukubaluleka kwenkunzi kubonakala ekubonakaleni kwayo kumzodiac njengeTaurus, kanye nokuvela kwayo okuningi ezinganekwaneni, lapho kuvame ukuhlotshaniswa nokuzala. Bheka futhi neKorban.KubuHindu, inkunzi egama layo linguNandi, evamise ukuboniswa ihleli phansi, ikhonzwa njengemoto kankulunkulu uShiva futhi ikhonjiswe ezithombeni eziningi zalowo nkulunkulu.

Ngokomfanekiso, inkunzi ivela ngokujwayelekile ku- heraldry.Bulls selivela amacala futhi crests ku izingalo imikhaya eminingana British.Yezinkunzi ezinamaphiko avele njengoba abasekeli e izingalo okukhulekela Inkampani ye Obhusha . Ezikhathini zanamuhla, inkunzi isetshenziswa njenge- mascot ngamaqembu ezemidlalo amateur nochwepheshe.

Izinkunzi nazo zibaluleke ngokukhethekile emasikweni aseSpain, lapho ukugijima komkhosi wezinkunzi kwenzeka njalo ngonyaka ehlobo.Phakathi nalo mkhosi, iqembu labagijimi abangabantu elibizwa ngokuthi "mozos" lizama ukudlula iqembu lezinkunzi ezigijima ngemuva kwazo, ngenkathi izixuku ezinkulu zibuka wonke umjaho.

title: Ukudlwengula
text:
Ukudlwengula uhlobo ngokocansi ngokuvamile okuhilela nobuhlobo bobulili noma ezinye izinhlobo sokungena ngokocansi eyenziwa ngokumelene umuntu ngaphandle ukuthi lomuntu kwemvume.Lesi senzo singenziwa ngamandla, ukuphoqelelwa, ukusetshenziswa kabi kwegunya, noma ngokumelene nomuntu ongakwazi ukunikeza imvume evumelekile, njengalowo ongazi lutho, okhubazekile, okhubazeke ngokwengqondo, noma ongaphansi kweminyaka esemthethweni yokuvuma.Igama elithi ukudlwengula kwesinye isikhathi lisetshenziswa ngokungafani negama elithi ukuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi. 

Izinga lokubika, ukushushisa kanye nokutholakala enecala lokudlwengula liyehluka phakathi kweziphathimandla. Kumazwe omhlaba, izehlakalo zokudlwengulwa ezirekhodwe ngamaphoyisa ngonyaka ka-2008 zazibalelwa kubantu abayi-100 000, zisuka ku-0,2 e- Azerbaijan zaya ku-92.9 eBotswana zaya ku-6.3 eLithuania njengomuntu ophakathi nendawo .  Emhlabeni jikelele, udlame lwezocansi, kubandakanya nokudlwengula, lwenziwa ikakhulukazi ngabesilisa kwabesifazane.  Ukudlwengula abangabazi ngokuvamile bungavami kuka ukudlwengula abantu isisulu uyazi, futhi wesilisa-on-besilisa kanye nabesifazane-on-zesifazane ejele okudlwengula kuvamile futhi kungenzeka amafomu okungenani kubika okudlwengula.   

Ukudlwengulwa okubanzi futhi okuhlelekile (isb. Ukudlwengulwa kwempi ) nokugqilazwa ngokocansi kungenzeka ngesikhathi sezimpi zomhlaba.Le mikhuba ngamacala abhekene nobuntu kanye namacala empi.Ukudlwengulwa kuphinde kubhekwe njengengxenye yecala lokuqothulwa kohlanga lapho kwenziwa ngenhloso yokucekela phansi, lonke noma ingxenye yalo, uhlanga oluthile.

Abantu abadlwenguliwe bangahlukumezeka bese beba nengcindezi yangemva kokuhlukumezeka .Ukulimala kanzima kungaholela kanye nengozi yokukhulelwa kanye nezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi.Umuntu angabhekana nodlame noma izinsongo ezivela kumdlwenguli, kanti kwesinye isikhathi, angabhekana nomndeni nezihlobo zakhe.

title: MrBeast
text:
UJimmy Donaldson (owazalwa ngoMeyi 7, 1998), owaziwa kangcono kwi-intanethi njengoMnuBeast, uyi-American YouTuber, usomabhizinisi kanye nomuntu osiza abantu.Unikezwe udumo ngokuphayona uhlobo lwamavidiyo e- YouTube agxile kuma-stunts abizayo.Ungumsunguli kaMrBeast Burger futhi ungomunye wabasunguli beTeam Trees, oqoqa imali yeArbor Day Foundation, eqoqe imali engaphezulu kwezigidi ezingama- $ 23.Uphethwe yinkampani yokuphathwa kwamakhono esekwe eDallas iNight Media. 
 

Kusukela ngoSepthemba 14, 2021, isiteshi esiyinhloko se-YouTube sikaDonaldson "MrBeast" sinababhalisile abayizigidi ezingama-69.2 kanye nokubukwa okuphelele okungu-12.5 billion.Yisiteshi se -11 esibhaliswe kakhulu ku-YouTube, kanye nesiteshi sesibili esibhaliswe kakhulu nge-YouTuber, futhi esabhaliswa kakhulu nge-YouTuber evela e- United States.Ngaphandle kwesiteshi sakhe esikhulu, uDonaldson unezinye iziteshi eziyisikhombisa ze-YouTube, kufaka phakathi i-MrBeast Shorts neMrBeast Gaming, lena efinyelela ngaphezu kwababhalisi abayizigidi eziyi-10 esikhathini esingaphansi konyaka.Eziteshini zakhe eziyisishiyagalombili, uDonaldson unababhalisile abayizigidi eziyi-121, kanye nokubukwa okuhlanganisiwe okuyizigidi eziyizinkulungwane eziyi-17.3 kuzo zonke lezi ziteshi eziyisishiyagalombili.

Ngo-2019, uDonaldson uwine i-Breakout Creator ngama- Streamy AwardsKuma- 12th Annual Shorty Awards ngo-2020, wawina i-YouTuber of the Year.Ube engumlobi njalo omunye phezulu 10 YouTubers ezilinganiselwa ikhokhwe ka 2020, ngokuhambisana namanye ubuntu ezifana Markiplier, Umhlaba Ryan sika futhi Blippi .

Umsebenzi we-YouTube

Umsebenzi wokuqala (2012-2017) 
UDonaldson ulayishe ividiyo yakhe yokuqala ngqa ye-YouTube ngoFebhuwari 2012, eneminyaka engu-13 ubudala, ngaphansi kwesibambo esithi "MrBeast6000"; okuqukethwe kwakhe kwasekuqaleni kwakusukela ku- Let Plays (kugxilwe kakhulu kwi- Minecraft ne- Call of Duty ),amavidiyo alinganisa ingcebo yamanye ama-YouTubers,amavidiyo anikezela ngamathiphu kubadali be-YouTube abazayo, namazwana ngomdlalo we-YouTube.Ngalesi sikhathi sokuqala kwesiteshi sakhe, uDonaldson ngokwakhe uvele okumbalwa kumavidiyo akhe. 

Kusukela ngoJulayi 2013, isibalo sababhalisile besiteshi sakhe, esasibizwa nge- "That-dude", sasicishe sibe ngu-240. 

Ngo-2015 nango-2016, uDonaldson waqala ukuzitholela udumo emsamo ngenxa yochungechunge lwamavidiyo wakhe “amabi kakhulu,” aqoqa futhi ahlekisa ngezethulo ze-YouTuber azithola kusayithi.Maphakathi no-2016, uDonaldson wayenababhalisile ababalelwa ku-30,000.Ekwindla ngo-2016, uDonaldson waphuma e- East Carolina University ngaphandle kokutshela (okwathiwa nguDonaldson kwenzeka ngemuva kwamasonto amabili kuphela elapho) ukuze aqhubeke nomsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele njenge-YouTuber.Ngenxa yalokho, umama wakhe wamkhipha ekhaya.

Rise to udumo (2017-present) 
NgoJanuwari 2017, uDonaldson washicilela ividiyo ecishe ithathe usuku lonke ebala abayi-100,000. I-stunt imthathe amahora angama-40, ezinye izingxenye zahamba ngokushesha "ukuyigcina ngaphansi kwamahora angama-24".Ividiyo okwalandela onesihloko esithi "Ukubala ukuze 200,000 (Road Mil)" silayishwe ngenyanga ezayo, nakuba, ngokusho Donaldson, nakho, kwadingeka ukuba washesha ngoba egcwele amahora amahlanu nanhlanu ka nokubala kudlulwe umkhawulo wokulayisha-YouTube.UDonaldson uphinde wazuza ukuthandwa ngalesi sikhathi ngama-stunts, njengokuzama ukuphula ingilazi kusetshenziswa ama- megaphones ayikhulu, ukubuka upende womile ihora lonke,ukuzama ukuhlala ngaphansi kwamanzi amahora angama-24 (agcine ehluleka ngenxa yezinkinga zezempilo), kanye umzamo ongaphumelelanga wokujikeleza i- fidget spinner yosuku.Ngo-2018 uDonaldson wayesekhiphe u- $ 1 million ngezigqoko zakhe ezingajwayelekile, okwamenza waba yisihloko esithi “Umusa omkhulu kunabo bonke wakwa-YouTube”. 

Ngesikhathi sePewDiePie vs T-Series ngo-2018, umncintiswano wokuba isiteshi esibhaliswe kakhulu ku-YouTube, uDonaldson wathenga amabhodi amakhulu, izikhangiso eziningi nezikhangiso zomsakazo ukusiza iPewDiePie ukuthi ithole ababhalisile abaningi kune- T-Series ;  eSuper Bowl LIII, uthengele yena neqembu lakhe izihlalo eziningi ezinamahembe abhalwe ukuthi, "Sub 2 PewDiePie".UDonaldson usho ukuthi usebenzisa isiteshi esikhulu ngokulahlekelwa. 

Ngo-Mashi 2019, uDonaldson wahlela futhi waqopha umncintiswano wempi wangempela we-royale eLos Angeles ngomklomelo wama- $ 200,000 (imidlalo emibili yadlalwa, okwenza inzuzo yemidlalo engu- $ 100,000 ngomdlalo ngamunye) ngokubambisana ne- Apex Legends.Umcimbi nedamu lomklomelo uxhaswe ngumshicileli we- Apex Legends Electronic Arts.

UDonaldson wasolwa ngokusebenzisa imali-mbumbulu kuvidiyo kaNovemba 2019.Ubuye wachaza ukuthi usebenzise imali mbumbulu ukunciphisa izingcuphe zokuphepha nezokuphepha ezingabangelwa ukuqhuma kwabantu ababanga ukuthola imali yamahhala, futhi wathi washintshanisa izikweletu zomgunyathi wenza isheke langempela lawo wonke umuntu ngemuva kwalokho. 

Ngo-Ephreli 2020, uDonaldson wenza umqhudelwano wamadwala, iphepha, isikele owawunabagqugquzeli abangama-32 nomklomelo omkhulu wama- $ 250,000, ngaleso sikhathi owaba ngumcimbi obukhoma obukwa kakhulu we-YouTube ngezibukeli ezihambisanayo ezingama-662,000.Umcimbi ugcine unqotshwe nguNadeshot.

Ngo-Okthoba 2020, uDonaldson wasungula omunye umqhudelwano wabagqugquzeli oqukethe izimbangi ezingama-24 ngomklomelo omkhulu wama- $ 300,000.Umqhudelwano wagcina unqotshwe ngumndeni wakwa-D'Amelio, owadala ingxabano ngenxa yezinsolo zokuthi babekopela. 

NgoJanuwari 1, 2021, uDonaldson wakhipha ividiyo ethi " Youtube [   Buyisela emuva u-2020, Siyabonga uNkulunkulu Kuphelile ".Phambilini umemezele ngoNovemba 2020 ukuthi uzobe enza uRewind ngemuva kwezinsuku i-YouTube imemezele ukuthi abazukuyenza.Ku-video kaDonaldson, uyachaza ukuthi ubelokhu ekholelwa ukuthi i-YouTubers "kufanele ikhulume kakhulu ku-Rewind", futhi ngalokhu engqondweni, wanquma ukubiza "amakhulu ama-YouTubers".Ekupheleni kwevidiyo, uDonaldson unxenxa uPewDiePie, ecaphuna yena noRewind wakhe ka-2018 njengogqugquzelo lukaDonaldson's Rewind (womabili amaRewinds aqukethe abahleli iFlyingKitty, iDolan Dark, neGrandayy, nengoma kaPhathi Emuva Kwezindlu). 

NgoFebhuwari 2021, uDonaldson wavela njengesihambeli kuhlelo lokusebenza lweClubhouse olwenza lwadilika. 

NgoMashi 2021, uDonaldson wasayina isivumelwano noJellysmack esivumela inkampani ukuthi ilawule kuphela ukusatshalaliswa kokuqukethwe kwevidiyo yakhe kuSnapchat nakuFacebook.

Okuqukethwe nesitayela 
Amavidiyo kaDonaldson ngokuvamile afaka izigaxa ezibamba ukunaka.Uvame ukwenza amavidiyo lapho anikela khona ngemali enkulu kubantu ngabanye, iningi lalawa mavidiyo axhaswa yizinkampani ezahlukahlukene.Futhi kwesinye isikhathi ubamba imincintiswano emidlalweni, efana neMinecraft, yemiklomelo emikhulu yemali ebandakanya ukunikela ngendlu kwenye yamavidiyo wakhe wokudlala. 

Ividiyo ejwayelekile ifaka uDonaldson enikeza izizumbulu zemali,njengokunikeza izinto ezingabiza u- $ 100,000 ezindaweni zokuhlala ezingenamakhaya ngoDisemba 2018,enikela ngama- $ 32,000 kuhlelo lweVeterans Army Wounded Warrior Programme, $ 70,000 kuSt. Isibhedlela Sezingane Sokucwaninga, kanye ne- $ 10,000 endaweni yokukhosela izilwane eLos Angeles.Amavidiyo akhe abizayo e-YouTube axhaswa kakhulu futhi axhaswe ngamadili amakhulu emikhiqizo avela njengezikhangiso zevidiyo kumavidiyo akhe.Ngo-2021, uDonaldson wathi usebenzisa isiteshi sakhe esikhulu ngokulahleka. 

UMrBeast unikezwe udumo ngokwethula isitayela esisha samavidiyo abiza kakhulu ku-YouTube, lapho abadali besusa khona izinselelo eziningiliziwe kanye nezipho ezinkulu ezixhasiwe. 

Njengoba isiteshi sakhe sesikhulile uDonaldson ukwazile ukuqasha abangani bakhe abane abasebuntwaneni - uChris, Chandler, Garrett noJake - ukuba basebenzele yena nesiteshi, okuholele ekutheni bakhonjiswe njalo kumavidiyo akhe.

Imisebenzi yebhizinisi 
UMrBeast ubizwe ngendlela yokuqala yabadali-osomabhizinisi bakusasa.

UMnuBeast Burger 
UWill Hyde, ongumdidiyeli wesiteshi seMrBeast, umemezele ku-athikili kaNovemba 2020 neThe Wake Weekly ukuthi uDonaldson uzokwethula indawo yokudlela ebonakalayo ebizwa nge-MrBeast Burger ngoDisemba 2020.U-Hyde uthe iqembu lakhe lisebenzisane nama-Virtual Dining Concepts ngesikhathi kuthuthukiswa umqondo wokudlela.UMnuBeast Burger uzothengisa amalungelo e-franchise okuhlinzeka ama-burger ezindaweni zokudlela ezise-US futhi amakhasimende azokwazi uku-oda ama-burger ngezinsizakalo zokulethwa online.

Ukutshalwa kwezimali nokubambisana 
UDonaldson ungumtshali-zimali we-tech startup Backbone okhiqiza i-Backbone One, isilawuli esenza ama-smartphones avele afane kakhulu nabalawuli beNintendo switchch, kanye ne-Backbone app, ukudala okuqukethwe kanye nohlelo lokusebenza lwamathuluzi omphakathi kubasebenzisi bayo

NgoMashi 2021, uDonaldson wabambisana nenethiwekhi yezezimali yeClassic Juice ukwethula amaJuice Funds, isikhwama sokutshala imali esingu- $ 2 million esinikeza abadali imali efinyelela ku- $ 250,000 ukushintshanisa ukulingana eziteshini zabo ze-YouTube. 

Ngo-Ephreli 2021, uDonaldson waba ngumtshalizimali wesikhathi eside nomlingani wenkampani yezobuchwepheshe bezezimali i-Current.Ngenyanga efanayo, uDonaldson wathola ukuhlaselwa ngemuva kokuthi abalandeli belahlekelwe yimali eningi ohlelweni lwe- cryptocurrency uDonaldson ayelufake futhi wakhuthaza.

Ububele

Izihlahla Zethimba 

Ngo-Okthoba 25, 2019, uDonaldson nowayengunjiniyela we- NASA kanye no-YouTuber uMark Rober bahlele umcimbi wokubambisana wokuphonswa kwemali ku-YouTube obizwa nge- #TeamTrees. Inhloso yale phrojekthi bekuwukuqongelela u- $ 20 million we- Arbor Day Foundation ngoJanuwari 1, 2020 bese utshala izihlahla "kungakadluli uDisemba 2022".Yonke iminikelo iya kwi-Arbor Day Foundation ethembisa ukutshala umuthi owodwa ngedola ngalinye.Abakwa-YouTubers abaziwayo abanjengoRhett & Link, Marshmello, iJustine, Marques Brownlee, The Slow Mo Guys, Ninja, Simone Giertz, Jacksepticeye, noSmarter Every Day baletha lo mbono. Izihlahla zaqala ukutshalwa ngo-Okthoba 2019 emapaki kazwelonke ase-United States.NgoDisemba 19 walowo nyaka, umgomo wama- $ 20,000,000 weqiwa,futhi kusukela ngoMeyi 27, 2020, iphrojekthi yafinyelela ngaphezu kwezigidi ezingama-22 zamaRandi.Le phrojekthi ithole neminikelo emikhulu evela kubaphathi bezinkampani uJack Dorsey, uSusan Wojcicki, u-Elon Musk,noTobias Lütke.Izinkampani ezifana Ukutholwa, Verizon futhi Izitshalo vs. AmaZombi nawo afake ukusiza.

Isipho sokuphana 
NgoSepthemba 17, 2020, kwakhiwa isiteshi se-YouTube iBeast Philanthropy.NgoMashi 26, 2021, lesi siteshi safaka ividiyo yaso yokuqala esihloko sithi "I Opened My Own Charity!"  lapho uDonaldson amemezele khona abantulayo, ibhange lokudla kanye noDarren kusuka kumavidiyo angaphambilini njengoMqondisi Omkhulu.

Impilo yomuntu siqu 
UDonaldson wazalwa ngoMeyi 7, 1998 esifundazweni saseKansas.UDonaldson wakhuliswa ikakhulukazi kanye nomfowabo uCJ eGreenville, eNorth Carolina.UDonaldson uthweswe iziqu eGreenville Christian Academy, okuyisikole samabanga aphansi esizimele kule ndawo, e2016.Ufunde kafushane e- East Carolina University ngaphambi kokuyeka isikolem

UDonaldson uphethwe yisifo sikaCrohn, isifo sokuvuvukala kwamathumbu .Kokuthunyelwe ku-2019 ku-Instagram, kwavezwa ukuthi uDonaldson wayethandana nemodeli ye-Instagram nomgqugquzeli wezokuxhumana uMaddy Spidell. 

Izinhlolovo zemibono zikhombisile ukuthi uDonaldson ungomunye wama-YouTubers athandwa kakhulu endaweni yesikhulumi ngenhlolovo ye-2021 yeSurveyMonkey ekhombisa ukuthi ama-70% wabaphenduli banombono omuhle ngaye, uma kuqhathaniswa nabangu-12% ababenombono ongathandeki.

title: Isikhutha
text:
I scrotum noma scrotal sac kuyinto yokwakheka besilisa isakhiwo zokuzala sise kumila umthondo ukuthi siqukethe okwesikhashana sac-dual-chambered zesikhumba bushelelezi kwemisipha. Itholakala ezilwaneni eziningi ezincelisayo zesilisa ezisemhlabeni.I-scrotum iqukethe i- spermatic fascia yangaphandle, ama- testes, i- epididymis, ne ductus deferens.Kungukuhlukaniswa kwe- perineum futhi kuthwala izicubu ezithile zesisu emgodini wayo kufaka phakathi umthambo wamasende, umthambo wamasende, ne-pampiniform plexus.I- perineal raphe iyisigaxa esincane, esime mpo, esikhuphuke kancane sesikhumba esingaphansi lapho okutholakala khona i- scrotal septum.Kubonakala njengolayini omncane we-longitudinal ogijima ngaphambili uye emuva phezu kwesikhafu sonke.Kubantu nakwezinye izilwane ezincelisayo i-scrotum imbozwa izinwele zasesidlangalaleni ngesikhathi sokuthomba .I-scrotum imvamisa iqine ngesikhathi sokumiswa kwe-penile nalapho ivezwa emazingeni okushisa abandayo.I-testis eyodwa ngokuvamile iphansi kunenye ukugwema ukucindezelwa uma kwenzeka kuba nomthelela. 

I-scrotum i-biologically homologous kuya kuma- labia majora kwabesifazane.Yize sikhona ezilwaneni eziningi ezincelisayo, i-scrotum sangaphandle asikho ezilwaneni ezincelisayo zasolwandle ezihlanjululwe, njengemikhomo nezimpawu,kanye nakwezinye izizukulwane zezilwane ezincelisayo zomhlaba, njengama- afrotherians, ama- xenarthrans, nemindeni eminingi yamalulwane, amagundane, kanye nezinambuzane.

Isikhumba nezindlala 
Isikhumba esisesikhotheni sesikhumba sinombala ophakeme kakhulu uma siqhathaniswa nawo wonke umzimba. I-septum ulwelwesi lwezicubu ezihlanganayo oluhlukanisa i-scrotum zibe izimbotshana ezimbili.

Uhlelo lweLymphatic 
I-scrotum lymph idonsela ekuqaleni kuma-lymph node angenhla, lokhu kudlulela kuma-lymph node ajulile.Ama-lymph node ajulile angenela ku-iliac ejwayelekile ekugcineni ekhipha i-lymph ku-cisterna chyli.

I-Asymmetry 
I-testis eyodwa ngokuvamile iphansi kunenye, okukholelwa ukuthi isebenza ukugwema ukucindezelwa uma kwenzeka kuba nomthelela; kubantu, ama-testis angakwesokunxele ngokuvamile aphansi kunesokudla.Umbono ohlukile ngothi i-testis descent asymmetry yavela ukuze kupholise amasende ngempumelelo.

title: Ukuphuka kwepenile
text:
Ukuphuka kwepenile ukuqhekeka kweyodwa noma zombili ze- tunica albuginea, izembozo ezinemicu emboza i- corpora cavernosa yepipi.Kubangelwa amandla asheshayo aqonde endondeni emile, imvamisa ngesikhathi sokuya ocansini, noma ukushaya indlwabu ngolaka.Kwesinye isikhathi kufaka nokuqhekeka okuyingxenye noma okuphelele kwe- urethra noma ukulimala kwezinzwa, imithambo nemithambo yegazi . 
Izifo zomthondo

Izimpawu nezimpawu 
Umsindo wokuqhuma noma wokuqhekeka, ubuhlungu obukhulu, ukuvuvukala, ukulahlekelwa ngokushesha kokwakhiwa okuholela ekuqothukeni, kanye ne- hematoma yesikhumba yamasayizi ahlukahlukene kuvame ukuhlotshaniswa nomcimbi wezocansi.

Izimbangela 

Ukuphuka kwepenile yisimo somtholampilo esingajwayelekile. Ubulili besitho sangasese sowesilisa nokushaya indlwabu okunolaka kuyizimbangela ezivame kakhulu.Ucwaningo lwango-2014 lwamarekhodi ezingozi kanye nezimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela ezintathu eCampinas, eBrazil, lukhombisile ukuthi owesifazane osezikhundleni eziphezulu udale ingozi enkulu kakhulu ngokuthi isikhundla sezithunywa zevangeli sibe esiphephe kakhulu.Ucwaningo lubhekise ekutheni uma umlingani owamukelayo ephezulu, bavame ukulawula ukunyakaza futhi abakwazi ukuphazamisa ukunyakaza lapho ipipi lithola ukungena okungalungile.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, lapho umlingani ongena ngaphakathi elawula ukunyakaza, banamathuba angcono okuyeka ukuphendula ubuhlungu bokungalungiswa kahle, banciphise ukulimala. 

Umkhuba we- taqaandan (obuye abe ngu- taghaandan ) nawo ubeka abesilisa engcupheni yokuphuka i-penile.Taqaandan, elivela Kurdish elisho "ukwetha chofoza" kuhilela eguqa phezulu ingxenye umthondo uqonde ngenkathi ebambe ingxenye engezansi kushaft esikhundleni, kuze ukuchofoza wezwa futhi wazizwa.UTaqaandan kuthiwa akanabuhlungu futhi useqhathaniswe nokuqhekeka imimese yomuntu, kepha umkhuba we-taqaandan uholele ekwandeni kokuqhekeka kwezintambo zepenile entshonalanga ye- Iran .Taqaandan kungase kwenziwe ukufeza detumescence .

Ukuxilongwa

Ukucwaninga izifundo 
Ukuhlukumezeka kwe-penile kungavela ekulimaleni okungaqondile noma okungena ngaphakathi, lokhu okugcina kungaphenywa kakhulu ngezindlela zokucabanga, cishe ngaso sonke isikhathi kudinga ukuhlolwa ngokushesha kokuhlinzwa.Emthondweni omile, ukuhlukumezeka kubangelwa ukunwebeka nokuncipha kwe-tunica albuginea, engahle idilizwe ngokwengxenye eyodwa noma zombili ze-corpora cavernosa, okudala ukuphuka kwepenile. Ku-10-15% we-penile traumas, kungaba nesilonda esihambisana ne-urethral. Lapho kugcinwa igazi enyameni ye-urethral, ukuhlolwa okuthuthukisiwe kokuqhathanisa kwe-urethra kuyadingeka.Ezimweni lapho ukutholakala kwe-ultrasound kungahambelani, ukusetshenziswa kwemifanekiso yamagnetic resonance kungenza kube lula ukuxilongwa futhi kunconywe ababhali abahlukahlukene.

Ukwelashwa 
Ukuphuka kwepenile kuyisimo esiphuthumayo sezokwelapha, futhi ukulungiswa kokuhlinzwa okuphuthumayo yindlela yokwelashwa ejwayelekile.Ukubambezeleka ekufuneni ukwelashwa kukhuphula izinga lokuxakaniseka.Izindlela ezingezona ezokuhlinzwa zibangela amazinga okuxakaniseka ayi-10-50% afaka ukungasebenzi kahle kwe-erectile, i- penile curvature yaphakade, ukulimala kwe- urethra nobuhlungu ngesikhathi sokuya ocansini, ngenkathi iziguli ezelashwa ngokuhlinzwa zithola isilinganiso se-11% sokuxakaniseka.

Izinkinga zomthetho 
E- United States, icala likaDoe v. UMoe, iMisa lama-63. Uhlelo lokusebenza. Ct. I-516, 827 NE2d 240 (2005), isikweletu esivivinyiwe sokulimala kwepenile okwenziwe ngesikhathi sokuya ocansini.Inkantolo yenqabile ukuthola umsebenzi phakathi kwabantu abadala ababili abavumelana ngemibono.Ummangali kuleli cala, owesilisa owahlushwa isitho sangasese sowesilisa, wakhononda ngokuthi ummangalelwa, owayeyintombi yakhe, wamlimaza ngesikhathi ephezu kwakhe ngesikhathi benza ucansi.Inkantolo yamvuna, yanquma ukuthi ukuziphatha kwakhe kwakungeyona into engafanele ngokomthetho noma budedengu.

title: Ukubhoboza izitho zangasese
text:
Ukubhoboza izitho zangasese kuyindlela yokubhoboza umzimba okubandakanya ukubhoboza ingxenye ethile yezitho zangasese, ngaleyo ndlela kwakheke indawo efanelekile yokugqoka izinhlobo ezahlukene zobucwebe.Noma kunjalo, leli gama lingasetshenziswa futhi i- pars pro toto ukukhombisa konke ukubhoboza umzimba endaweni ye- anus, perineum, izitho zangasese kanye ne- mons pubis, kufaka phakathi ukubhoboza okufana ne- anal, i-guiche, ne- pubic engabandakanyi ukuphuka kwesitho sangasese .

Ukubhoboza izitho zangasese kungenziwa kwabesilisa noma kwabesifazane, ngezinhlobo ezahlukahlukene zokubhoboza ezitholakalayo.Isisusa esikhulu sabo bobabili ubulili ukuhlobisa nokuzenzela; ngaphezu kwalokho, okunye ukubhoboza kuthuthukisa injabulo yezocansi ngokwandisa ukuvuselela.Ukubhoboza izitho zangasese kungatholakala emiphakathini eminingi yezizwe, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu naseMpumalanga ye-Asia, lapho bekuyingxenye yomkhuba wendabuko kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo. Amarekhodi okuqala wokubhoboza izitho zangasese atholakala kwi- Kama Sutra eyabhalwa eminyakeni engaphezu kwengu-2000 eyedlule.

Izisusa 
Njengokubhoboza umzimba kukhulu, ukubhoboza izitho zangasese kuvame ukwenziwa ngezizathu zobuhle nanjengesibonakaliso sesitayela sakho.Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezinye (kepha hhayi zonke) izinhlobo zokubhoboza izitho zangasese zandisa ukuzwela futhi zinikeze ukukhuthazeka okwengeziwe ngesikhathi sokuya ocansini noma ukugqugquzela.Ngokusho kombiko wochwepheshe we- Association of Professional Piercers ka-Elayne Angel, oyiphayona lokubhoboza umzimba, owayeyilungu le-Gauntlet futhi owasungula ukubhoboza izitho zangasese okufana ne- fourchette ne- lorum, izisusa nezintandokazi zomuntu zihluke kakhulu:

Ubumnandi obuthuthukisiwe nokuzwa 
Ngokwengeziwe, ukubhoboza izitho zangasese kungakhuphula injabulo yezocansi ngesikhathi sokushaya indlwabu, ukudlala kwangaphambili nokuya ocansini.Ngenkathi ukubhoboza izitho zangasese zabesifazane kukwenza lokhu kuphela kwabesifazane abazigqokile, ukubhoboza izitho zangasese zabesilisa kungakhuthaza ukukhuthazeka kwabo bobabili umuntu ogqoke ubucwebe nozakwabo ngokuvuselela zombili izingqimba zomuntu ozigqokile nodonga lwesitho sangasese sowesifazane noma ingquza yomlingani ongene ngaphakathi.Ngenxa yomzimba wobufazi, abesifazane babonakala bethola injabulo ethe xaxa ngokocansi kubo bobabili, ngokwabo nangokubhoboza izitho zobulili zomlingani wakhe.

Okomlingani ocansini 
Lo mphumela ubikwa ikakhulukazi ngokubhoboza okudlula kumthondo we-glans: ukubhoboza kwe-ampallang ne-apadravya.Abesifazane baseDayak eSarawak, eBorneo bathanda amadoda ane-ampallang, bethi ukuya ocansini ngaphandle kuzoba buthuntu:

UPaolo Mantegazza uthe, women Abesifazane baseDayak banelungelo lokugcizelela i-ampallang futhi uma indoda ingavumi bangafuna ukwehlukana. Bathi ukwangana ngaphandle kwalomcabango kuyilayisi elisobala; ngayo ilayisi ngosawoti."Kwenye i-akhawunti yisazi semvelaphi yabantu uTom Harrisson, owachitha isikhathi esiningi sempilo yakhe eBorneo futhi waxoxisana nabomdabu mayelana ne-ampallang yendabuko; uthe, "umsebenzi wale divayisi, phezulu, ukwengeza ubumnandi bezocansi besifazane ngokuvuselela nokwelula izindonga zangaphakathi zesitho sangasese sowesifazane.Kulokhu, ngokwami ukubona, kuphumelele ngokunqumela. "

Izingozi zezempilo ezingaba khona 
Uma kuqhathaniswa nokunye ukubhoboza, inhlanzeko engafanele ngesikhathi senqubo yokubhoboza inobungozi bokudlulisa izifo ezithwalwa yigazi futhi ngesikhathi sokuphulukiswa kungaholela ekuthelelekeni.

Abanye odokotela bakholelwa ukuthi ukubhoboza izitho zobulili kwabesilisa kwandisa ingozi yokudluliswa kwe-STD ngokwenza izivimbelo zocansi eziphephile (amakhondomu) zingasebenzi kahle.   Iningi lababhobozi bochwepheshe nabathandi bobuciko bomzimba bakholelwa ukuthi lezi zingozi zichazwe ngokweqile noma azikho.Ocwaningweni olwenziwe kabili, u-5% –18% wamadoda abhoboza izitho zangasese abike “izinkinga ezingasetshenziswanga zokusebenzisa amakhondomu” yize kungacaci ukuthi mangaki kulawa madoda abesebenzisa amakhondomu njalo. Abukho ubufakazi obuqanda ikhanda bokuthi abaphatha ukubhoboza izitho zangasese banamathuba amaningi okuthi bathole izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi.

Ukunakekelwa ngemuva 
Isikhathi sokupholisa ngokuphelele ukubhoboza izitho zangasese sehluka kakhulu, kuya ngesiza sokubhoboza nezimpawu zomuntu ngamunye: singaqala kusukela esontweni kuye ezinyangeni eziyisithupha.Kuze kube selulame ngokuphelele, kufanele kwenziwe amalungiselelo ngokulwa nezimbangela zokutheleleka, njengokuhlanzwa okufanele nsuku zonke.Abantu abanokubhoboza okusha kufanele bagweme ukuya ocansini ezinsukwini ezimbalwa zokuqala futhi futhi lapho-ke kufanele basebenzise imigoqo yokuvikela ngokomzimba njengamakhondomu kuze kube yilapho ukubhoboza selulame ngokuphelele.

Ukucatshangelwa kwezomthetho 
Imithetho kwamanye amazwe iyahlukahluka.Emazweni amaningi ase-Europe, izingane kudingeka ukuthi zilethe ifomu lokuvuma elisayiniwe noma lizophelezelwa ngugadi osemthethweni.Ngisho nasemazweni angenayo imithetho elawula ukubhoboza izitho zobulili ezinganeni, abaningi abagwazayo bayayeka ukukwenza (ngoba ukukhula komzimba akuqediwe kwabancane).E- United States, akuvunyelwe ukubhoboza izitho zangasese zabantu abangaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18.

Izinhlobo zokubhoboza izitho zangasese

Ukubhoboza izitho zangasese zowesilisa 
Izindawo ezingabhoboza ezithweni zobulili zesilisa zifaka i-glans, isikhumba somgudu wepenisi, i- scrotum noma i- perineum.

Umthondo weglans 
Ukubhoboza ngokusebenzisa glans wenduku zihlanganisa ampallang, oludlula nendawo, kanye apadravya, ludlulele thwi ngokusebenzisa glans.Ukubhoboza iPrince Albert kutholakala ohlangothini lomgogodla (ngaphansi) kwepipi ngokushesha ngemuva kwe-glans, kanti ukubuyela emuva kwePrince Albert kudlula ngasesinqeni (phezulu) sohlangothi.I- dydoe ihlaba ngasemgqeni we-coronal we-glans.Ngaphandle kwe-dydoe, konke lokhu kubhoboza ngokwesiko kudlula kwi-urethra.Lokhu kukhethwa ngoba isikhathi sokuphulukisa kanye nezifo zokutheleleka kuncishiswa ukuhamba komchamo oyinyumba. 

Lokhu kubhoboza kunikeza ukukhuthazeka okwandayo ngesikhathi sokuya kowesilisa (ophethe ukubhoboza) kanye nakumlingani.Ukubhoboza ekhanda, noma i-glans, kungukubhoboza izitho zobulili ngobufakazi bomlando obhalwe kahle kakhulu.

Isikhumba somgudu wepenisi nesikhutha 
Ukubhoboza isikhumba kudlula esikhunjeni se-penile ohlangothini lwe-dorsal, ventral noma le-lateral.Kuyadingeka ukuthi owesilisa angasoki.Ukubhoboza i-frenum kudlula nge-penile frenum, ibhuloho elincane lesikhumba elixhumanisa i-glans nesikhumba se-shaft.Le ngxenye yokwakheka komzimba kaningi ayitholakali emadodeni asokile. Ukubhoboza i-hafada kutholakala esikhunjeni se-scrotum.Njengenguqulo ephakathi nendawo phakathi kwe-frenulum ne-hafada, ukubhoboza i-lorum ( lo w fren um ) kuhlala lapho kuhlangana khona ipipi nesirobhothi. Isitebhisi sikaJacob siyisitebhisi esisuka kwi-frenum kuya esikhwameni.Ukubhoboza i-guiche ukubhoboza umzimba ku-perineum.Lokhu kubhoboza kudlala indima encane ekungezeni ukugqugquzela nokuningi kufeza kuphela injongo yokuhlobisa.

Ukubhoboza izitho zangasese zabesifazane 
Kubantu besifazane futhi, izingxenye ezahlukahlukene zokwakheka zingakulungela ukubhoboza. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ama- mons pubis, i- clitoral hood, i-labia (yangaphakathi nengaphandle) kanye ne-vestibule ye-vulval (okuyindawo ezungeze ukuvuleka kwesitho sangasese sowesifazane).

Clitoris futhi hood clitoral 
Amagqabha e-clitoris uqobo angahlatshwa.Njengoba le ngxenye yokwakheka incane kakhulu ezimweni eziningi, lokhu kubhoboza akuvamile.Ngokuphambene nalokho, ukubhoboza i-clitoral hood yikubhoboza okuvame kakhulu kwezitho zobulili kubantu abanemizimba yabesifazane.Ingasetshenziswa ngokuvundlile nangokuqondile. Ukubhoboza hood okujulile kungukwehluka kokubhoboza i-clitoral hood okudlula kujule nge hood clitoral. Ukubhoboza u-Isabella kudlula mpo ngomgogodla futhi kunzima kakhulu ukubhoboza.

I-Labia ne-vestibule ye-vulval 
Ukubhoboza i-Labia kungasetshenziswa kuma- labia majora noma kwi- labia minora.Ukubhoboza i-Triangle kutholakala ekugcineni kwe-labia minora, lapho kuguquka khona phakathi kwe-labia ne-clitoral hood.Igijima ngokuvundlile, ngokwengxenye ingaphansi kwesigaxa se-clitoral.Ngomphetho we-dorsal we-vestibule ye-vulval kudlula ukubhoboza kwe-Fourchette.Uhlobo olungajwayelekile kakhulu lwe-Fourchette ukubhoboza i-Suitcase, okungathathwa njenge-Fourchette ejulile (ingena ku-perineum).Okunye futhi ukuthi akujwayelekile ukubhoboza kweNkosazana u-Albertina, inguqulo yabesifazane yokubhoboza kweNkosana u-Albert, edlula odongeni lwe-ventral (ngezansi) lwe-urethra.

Izinsimbi zomphakathi 
Ukubhoboza uChristina ukubhoboza indawo, okusengxenyeni engenhla yamamons pubis lapho kuhlangana khona amalebula angaphandle.Kuyafana nokubhoboza kweNefertiti, okungabonakala njengokuhlangana phakathi kokubhoboza i-clitoral hood ukubhoboza nokubhoboza kukaChristina.

Ukubhoboza izitho zangasese ze-unisex
