title: Tendai Biti
text:
UTendai Laxton Biti (owazalwa ziyisi-6 kuNcwaba 1966) usopolitiki waseZimbabwe owasebenza njengoNgqongqoshe Wezezimali waseZimbabwe kusukela ngo-2009 kuya ku-2013.Ulilunga ledale lephalamende eHarare East Constituency njalo usengumsekeli kamongameli weMovement for Democratic Change.Uke waba nguNobhala Jikelele weMovement for Democratic Change kanye namaqembu ezepolitiki alandela iMovement for Democratic Change – uTsvangirai (MDC-T) kanye nelungu lePhalamende laseHarare East waze waxoshwa eqenjini waphinde wakhishwa ephalamende phakathi. 2014, ngaphambi kokuwina isihlalo futhi ngo-2018.

Isiqalo sokuphila 
UBiti wazalelwa eDzivarasekwa, eHarare, yena umdala emndenini wabantwana abayisithupha.Kusukela ngo-1980 kuya ku-1985 wafunda eGoromonzi High School, lapho aqokwa khona njengesekela lomfana ngo-1985. Wabhalisa eUniversity of Zimbabwe Law School esanda kufunda ngomnyaka ka1986.Ngo 1988 lo 1989, uBiti wayengunobhala jikelele weUniversity of Zimbabwe Student Representative Council, uTerry Mhungu engumongameli weSRC, owakhokhela ukutshengisela kwabafundi bekhalala ukuhlukuluzwa kukahulumende ezifundweni.Ngemva kokuqeda isikole, wajoyina inkampani yoMthetho i-Honey and Blackenberg, lapho aba khona umlingani omncane kunabo bonke eneminyaka engu-26. UBiti washonelwa nguyise esanda kweva eminyakeni engu-30.

Umsebenzi wezombangazwe 
Ngo-1999 wasiza ekutholeni iMDC. Wakhethwa ukuba lilunga ledale lephalamende endaweni yeHarare East ngomnyaka ka2000.EPhalamende Lesihlanu uke wasebenza njengelungu leKomidi lePhalamende lezoMhlaba, ezoLimo, ukuThuthukiswa kwamanzi, iMithombo yaseMakhaya kanye nokuhlaliswa kabusha kanye nelezokuvikela kanye nezasekhaya.NgoMashi 2005 wasigcina lesi sifunda.Usebenza kuPortfolio Committee on Budget, Finance and Economic Development kanti njengamanje unguNobhala Jikelele weMDC.Emsebenzini wakhe wezomthetho uBiti useke waphatha amacala ezisebenzi kanye lamalungelo oluntu emele inhlanganiso ezinkulu zezisebenzi ezifana lePost and Telecommunications Trade Union.

Wabotshwa ngomnyaka ka 2007 labanye abanengi okugoqela umkhokheli weMDC uMnu Morgan Tsvangirai ngemva komkhuleko owenzelwe elokitshini leHarare eHighfield.

Mhla ziyi-16 kuNhlangulana wezi-2007, uBiti noWelshman Ncube bahlangana noNgqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa uPatrick Chinamasa kanye noNgqongqoshe wezabaSebenzi uNicholas Goche, ePitoli, eNingizimu Afrika.UMongameli Thabo Mbeki weSouth Africa, okhethwe yinhlanganiso yeSouthern African Development Community, nguye okhokhela izingxoxo zokuthi kuqedwe izijeziso ezibekwe inkokheli zeZANU-PF leziphathamandla zikahulumende eZimbabwe.

ukhetho lwango-2008 
UBiti waphinda wakhethwa ukuthi abe sedale lephalamende eHarare East ngokhetho lukaMarch 2008 .Ngokwemiphumela esemthethweni, uthole amavoti angu-8,377 eqhathaniswa nezi-2,587 ku- ZANU-PF.Esikhathini esilandela ukhetho, wahlala ngaphandle kweZimbabwe (ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika), kanye noTsvangirai, phakathi kwesimo sangemva kokhetho esabonakala ngodlame olubi olubhekiswe kubalandeli beMDC.

Ukuboshwa 
UBiti wabuyela eZimbabwe mhla zili-12 kuNhlangulana 2008 waboshwa ngokushesha esikhumulweni sezindiza eHarare.Engakasuki eGoli uBiti uthe usezwile ukuthi uzabotshwa, kodwa uthi icala lakhe linye elokulwela intando kazulu wathi kumele abuye ukuze aphatheke kubandla leMDC. Ngemva kokubotshwa kukaBiti, isikhulumeli samapholisa uMnu Wayne Bvudzijena uthe uzabetheswa icala lokuvukela umbuso kugwalo lweMDC olumayelana lokuguqula uhulumende. Ugwalo lolu, obelubizwa ngokuthi, “The Transition Strategy” okuthiwa lwalotshwa nguBiti mhlaka 25 March,  lugoqela amacebo okuqilibezela ukhetho kucele leMDC.  UBvudzijena uthe uBiti uzophinde abekwe icala lokukhuluma izitatimende ezingamanga "ezihlukumeza umbuso" ngenxa yokumemezela kwakhe imiphumela yokhetho ngaphambi kokuthi ikhishwe yiKhomishana yoKhetho.  Umeli weMelika uMnumzana James McGee utshengise ukukhathazeka okukhulu emele uhulumende weMelika esithi ugwalo olukhulunywayo luyinkulumo engaphikiswanga ngenhlelo lezinjongo zeMDC; ngokusho kukaMcGee, enye inguqulo, eyedlulele kakhulu yombhalo yayikhona, kodwa yenziwa. Igqwetha likaBiti laye lathi indaba ekhulunywayo yimgunyathi. 

Mhla zili-13 kuNhlangulana amagqwetha kaBiti athi kabavunyelwanga ukuhlangana laye, base befaka isicelo esiphuthumayo emthethwandaba weHigh Court ngelanga elifanayo.Ibandla leMDC lithi likhathazeke kakhulu ngenhlalakahle kaBiti laze lathumela ithimba enkambeni zamapholisa eHarare likhangelele ukuthola ukuthi ubotshwe ngaphi. Uvele enkantolo ngomhlaka-14 Juni. 

Umuzi kaBiti wapeqululwa ngamapholisa mhlaka 16 June, lanxa amapholisa engazange akhiphe lutho endlini.  Ummeli wakhe, uLewis Uriri, uthe uBiti uphenywe imibuzo amahora angama-24 agcwele ngemuva kokuboshwa kwakhe; Uriri uphinde wathi uzadinga idale leHigh Court ukuthi uBiti akhulule uBiti esithi ubotshwe okwedlula amahola angamatshumi amane lasitshiyagalolunye engalacala. 

UBiti uphinde wavela emthethwandaba mhlaka 18 June; nokho-ke lokhu kulalelwa kwahlehliselwa ngakusasa ngoba amandla ehlulekile, okusho ukuthi ukulalelwa kwakungaqoshwa. Ubekwe icala ngoJuni 19.  Ubhekane namacala amane: "ukuvukela umbuso, ukukhuluma amanga ahlukumeza umbuso, ukuthuka uMongameli Mugabe kanye nokudala ukungezwani phakathi kwamasosha". .  Abatshutshisi baphikisene ngokuphiwa kukaBiti ibheyili bebona ukuthi amacala abekwe wona mabi kakhulu okokuthi angagwetshwa.Abamangalelwa bafake isicelo sokuthi amacala ahoxiswe, kodwa ngomhlaka-20 Juni imantshi uMishrod Guvamombe wasichitha lesi sicelo, wathi ukholelwa ukuthi kukhona "okuzwakalayo ukusola ukuthi ummangalelwa wenze leli cala".UBiti uzophinde avele enkantolo ngomhlaka-7 Ntulikazi, uGuvamombe wayalela ukuthi ahlale esitokisini kuze kube yileso sikhathi. 

Mhla zingama-26 kuNhlangulana, uBiti wanikwa ibheyili yetrillion yamadola eZimbabwe ; kwadingeka nokuthi anikele ngamatayitela omuzi wakhe futhi ayobika emaphoyiseni masonto onke. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi amagqwetha kaBiti afake isicelo sokuthi abuyiselwe ipasi lakhe ukuze aphatheke kunkulumo phakathi kwamabandla akweleSouth Africa, okwabangela ukuthi ipasi lakhe libuyiselwe kuye mhlaka 9 Ntulikazi, okwamenza ukuthi ahambe.Ukhokhele iqula leMDC-Tsvangirai kunkulumo lezi, eziqale ePretoria mhlaka 10 Ntulikazi, lanxa ngokusho kukaTsvangirai inhloso yalokhu bekuwukubeka imibandela yeMDC-Tsvangirai yokuphatheka kungxoxo, hatshi ukuphatheka kuzo.  

Uriri ucele ukususwa kukaBiti esitokisini ngoba bekumele kubekwe usuku lokuqulwa kwecala kanjalo nophenyo lwamapholisa seluphelile.Mhlaka 27 Ncwabakazi 2008, uChioniso Mutongi, umantshi eHarare, wasichitha lesi sicelo, wathi uBiti akakahlali esitokisini isikhathi eside ngokwanele ukuba asuswe esikhundleni. 

Ngo-2018 kulandela ukhetho lwaseZimbabwe olwalunezingxabano, waboshwa wanqatshelwa ukukhoseliswa eZambia.

Ukuqokwa kuHulumeni Wobumbano Lwesizwe 
Mhlaka 10 Nhlolanja 2009, umkhokheli weMDC uMnu Morgan Tsvangirai wamemezela ukuqokwa kukaBiti njengoNgqogqoshe Wezezimali kuHulumeni Wobumbano Lwesizwe .Lanxa engelambali eyaziwayo kwezemali lezomnotho, ingcwethi ezicubungulayo zithi uTsavingarai wayengelayo enye indlela nxa kukhangelwa isikhundla sikaBiti kuMDC.Phezu kwalokho, uyaziwa ngokuxoxisana kanzima futhi angaba ngumuntu ongcono kakhulu ukubhekana nomsebenzi womphakathi olawulwa yiZanu-PF.Wafungiswa kanye nabanye oNgqongqoshe mhla ziyi-13 kuNhlolanja wezi-2009 eHarare.

UkuBuyela emsebenzini wezomthetho 
Mhlaka 20 Lwezi 2013, uBiti wamemezela ukuthi uzavula inkampani entsha yabameli.Le femu yayizosebenza ngokukhethekile emthethweni wezezimali wamazwe ngamazwe kanye nezindaba zomthethosisekelo wasekhaya.

UkuBuyela kwezombusazwe 
UBiti waxabana loTsvangirai ngomnyaka ka2014, okwabangela ukuthi uTsvangirai amemezele ukuxotshwa kukaBiti ngoMpalakazi 2014.Ngomnyaka ka2015 uBiti wahlangana lamanye amalunga eMDC-T ayehlubuke kubandla leMDC-Renewal, waba ngunobhala jikelele walo.NgoMpandula 2015, iMDC-Renewal yasungulwa njengebandla elizimele, iPeople's Democratic Party, uBiti wakhethwa njengomongameli webandla elisha.

Ngo-2020, uBiti wagxeka ithimba lamalungu amathathu aseNingizimu Afrika elathunyelwa ukuyophenya ngokuhlukunyezwa kwamalungelo abantu lapho bebuyela ezweni labo bengakhulumanga namaqembu aphikisayo. 

NgoFebhuwari 2019 walahlwa yicala lokwephula umthetho we-Electoral Act ngokumemezela ngokungemthetho imiphumela okwakuthiwa yokhetho lukamongameli lwango-2018 eZimbabwe. Wahlawuliswa u-$200.

NgoFebhuwari 2022, uTendai Biti, wavalelwa ngamahora ambalwa ekhankasela ukhetho eHarare, isikhulumeli sebandla lakhe.

Izithenjwa 

Abantu baphilayo
Abazalwa nge-1966

title: Tendai Mtawarira
text:
UTendai Mtawarira (owazalwa ngo-1 Agasti 1985) ungumdlali webhola lombhoxo okhokhelwayo waseZimbabwe odlalela i- Old Glory DC kuMajor League Rugby futhi phambilini edlalela iqembu lesizwe laseNingizimu Afrika kanye neqembu lesizwe.Oshaka kuSuper Rugby .Wazalelwa eZimbabwe futhi wafaneleka eNingizimu Afrika ngezizathu zokuhlala, ngaphambi kokuba athole ubuzwe baseNingizimu Afrika.UMtawarira, i- prop, waziwa ngesiteketiso esithi Isilo .

UMtawarira udlale okokuqala eNingizimu Afrika bebhekene neWales mhla zili-14 kuNhlangulana wezi-2008.Njengoba esedlale imidlalo engu-117, ungumdlali odlale imidlalo eminingi kunabo bonke emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika futhi ungowesithathu kumaBhokobhoko adlale amasizini amaningi ngemuva kukaVictor Matfield noBryan Habana.

Njengoba esedlale imidlalo engu-117, uMtawarira ungumdlali we-17 odlale imidlalo eminingi kunabo bonke abake badlala futhi esendaweni yesi-5 kunabo bonke abake badlala.Uphinde abe ngumnqobi weNdebe Yomhlaba Yebhola lombhoxo ka-2019.

Unenkampani yonogada eNingizimu Afrika kanye neCBO eyaziwa ngeThe Beast Foundation

Isiqalo sokuphila 
UMtawarira wazalwa mhlaka 1 August 1985 eHarare, eZimbabwe.Wafunda eChurchill School eHarare okweminyaka emihlanu waphiwa umfundaze ogcweleyo ePeterhouse Boys’ School, isikolo esizimele eMashonaland East .Eseneminyaka engu-15, eseChurchill, wabonwa ngumqeqeshi waseZimbabwe uJoey Muwadzuri owammema ukuthi ajoyine iqembu lika-Under 19 kuNational Schools Festival.Kamuva ngalowo nyaka uMuwadzuri wamema ukuthi abe yingxenye yeThimba le-Cats and Dogs Rugby Academy eyanqoba umqhudelwano weNational Seniors 7.Udlale noDan Hondo, Pete Benade, Tonderai "Kawaza" Chavhanga, nabanye.

Ukudlala umsebenzi 
Ngemuva kwesizini eqinile ye- Super 14 ka- 2008 namaSharks kwabonakala ukuthi unamandla amakhulu futhi isivinini sakhe sizoba nenzuzo ngemithetho emisha ( ELV 's).

Wabe eseqokwa eqenjini lamaBhokobhoko futhi waqala ukudlala ebhekene neWales mhla ziyi-14 kuNhlangulana wezi-2008.Ekuqaleni ithole isikhathi esilinganiselwe segeyimu.Kamuva waba nethuba lokuba isiqiwu ngesikhathi sovivinyo ngokumelene namaWallabies ePerth.Lapho esefikile, umthelela wakhe wawubalulekile; waqhubeka waba yingxenye yabaqalayo bazo zonke izivivinyo ezalandela ze-Tri-nations.

Okugqamile empilweni kaMtawarira kuze kube manje kwenzeka kuvivinyo lokuqala lwe- British & Irish Lions tour ngo-2009.Eqhulula uPhil Vickery, uMtawarira unqobe isitha sakhe esinamava, okuholele ekutheni uVickery akhishwe ngemuva kwemizuzu engu-45, kanye nomklomelo wokuba ngumdlali ovelele kuMtawarira.Kodwa-ke, wavumela izinhlawulo eziningana esivivinyweni sesibili lapho edlala ngokumelene ne- Welsh prop Adam Jones.Ngokunjalo, kusivivinyo sesithathu, uMtawarira ubengasebenzanga ku-scrum, uVickery obuyile noJohn Hayes abamnqobile ngaphambili.

Mhla zili-16 kuNhlangulana 2018, uMtawarira udlale umdlalo wakhe wokuvivinya ikhulu le-England.Wabekwa ebhentshini lapho iNingizimu Afrika ihlulwa yi-Australia mhla ziyisi-8 kuMandulo wezi-2018, futhi walimala entanyeni bedlala ne-New Zealand mhla ziyisi-6 kuMfumfu wezi-2018, okusho ukuthi waphuthelwa uhambo lwamaBhokobhoko oluya e-Europe ngo-2018.

UMtawarira uqokwe eqenjini laseNingizimu Afrika elizodlala kwiNdebe yoMhlaba yeRugby ka-2019.INingizimu Afrika iqhubekile nokuwunqoba lo mqhudelwano, ihlula i- England kowamanqamu.Ukubhuquza kukaMtawarira kowamanqamu kuchazwe njengokucekela phansi, iNingizimu Afrika yanqoba izigwebo eziningi ze-scrum. 

Kanye nemidlalo yakhe ye-Test engu-117, uMtawarira usedlale imidlalo engadlalwanga kumaBhokobhoko edlala namaBarbarians ngo-2010 no-2016, kanye ne- World XVs ngo-2014 no-2015.Useke wadlala kabili kumaBarbarians.

UMtawarira nguyena ophethe irekhodi lokudlala imidlalo eminingi yeSuper Rugby kumdlali waseNingizimu Afrika osedlale imidlalo engu-160.

Irekhodi lokufanisa lokuhlola

Izama lokuhlola

Ingxabano yobuzwe 
Nakuba uMtawarira wayefaneleka ngokugcwele ukudlalela iNingizimu Afrika ngaphansi kwemithetho ye-IRB, ubuzwe bakhe baseZimbabwe bebuqinile ngo-2009 nango-2010.INingizimu Afrika inomgomo wokuvumela kuphela abantu bakuleli ukuba bamele izwe, nakuba kuye kwaba nokuguquguquka okuthile; ISouth African Rugby Union (SARU) yamgunyaza ngokusemthethweni ukuthi adlale namaBoks ezivivinyweni zikaNovemba 2009, ngemuva kokuthola imvume kungqongqoshe wezemidlalo kuleli uMakhenkesi Stofile.

Muva nje, ubuzwe bakhe bekuyinkinga encane yezombangazwe ezweni.NgoJanuwari 2010, uButana Komphela, oyilungu le- ANC ePhalamende likazwelonke nosihlalo wekomidi lezemidlalo, wasabisa esidlangalaleni ngokubeka i-SARU icala ngokufaka uMtawarira "ngokungekho emthethweni" futhi adingiselwe eZimbabwe.Ngemva nje kokusatshiswa, uMtawarira utshele iSunday Independent ,

Ngokuhamba komnyaka, uhulumende weSouth Africa waphinda waqinisa umthetho wakhe wokuthi yizizalwane zakwele South Africa kuphela ezizavunyelwa ukumela ilizwe kumncintiswano wamazwe omhlaba, okwenza uMtawarira angatholakali ukuthi akhethwe kumaBhokobhoko kumaTest kaNhlangulana ; ngaleso sikhathi isicelo sakhe sokuba yisakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika sase siboshiwe.Ngomhla zingama-25 kuNhlangulana wezi-2010, i-SARU yamemezela ukuthi uNgqongqoshe Wezasekhaya uNkosazana Dlamini-Zuma usesamukele isicelo sikaMtawarira sokuba yisakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika.Umphumela osheshayo kwaba ukumenza afanelekele ukukhethwa ku- Tri Nations ka -2010.

Amanothi

Abazalwa nge-1985

title: Tatenda Maturure
text:
Tatenda uPawulu Maturure (owazalwa 14 Agasti 1988) umdlali webhola waseZimbabwe

Umsebenzi weqembu 
UMaturure uchithe ingxenye enkulu yomsebenzi wakhe ne- Harare City Hornets yaseZimbabwe.Uke wadlalela iRaiders ne-JBC.

Ngo-2018, wajoyina i-Soweto Panthers ye- Basketball National League eNingizimu Afrika futhi waqokwa njengomdlali obaluleke kakhulu weligi (MVP) ngemuva kokunqoba umqhudelwano. 

Ngo-2021, uMaturure waqokwa njenge-MVP yeshumi leminyaka yi-Basketball Union of Zimbabwe (ZUB). 

UMaturure udlalela iqembu lesizwe laseZimbabwe.Ubengomunye wabashayimagoli abahamba phambili beqembu ku-AfroBasket 2015.

title: Chipo Chung
text:
Articles with hCards
UChipo Tariro Chung (owazalwa 17 Agasti 1977) ungumlingisi kanye nesishoshovu saseZimbabwe ozinze eLondon.

Impilo yokuqala kanye nemfundo 
UChung wazalwa njengombaleki eDar es Salaam, eTanzania.UngowaseZimbabwe odabuka eMberengwa kanti ungowaseChina.Igama lakhe elithi Chipo lisho "isipho" ngolimi lwesiShona .Wachitha iminyaka yokuqala engu akhe amabili evile eminyakeni emakamu ababaleki eMozambique nezinkulungwane zabantu abasha ukubalekela impi e then- Rhodesia.

UChung wakhulela eHarare lapho afunda khona eDominican Convent High School futhi wathuthukisa ukulingisa kwakhe enkampanini yemidlalo yeshashalazi exubile i- Over the Edge.Lapho eneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili, wathuthela e-United States lapho unina uFay Chung ayesebenzela iNhlangano Yezizwe.UFay Chung isazi sezemfundo futhi owake waba ngungqongqoshe wezemfundo eZimbabwe Ubaba wakhe nguRugare Gumbo waseMberengwa esifundeni saseZimbabwe owake waba yilungu leqembu elibusayo eZimbabwe.

Umsebenzi 
UChung waqala wafundela ukuqondisa eYale University, wabe eseqeqeshwa njengomdlali eRoyal Academy of Dramatic Art (RADA) eLondon futhi waphothula ngo-2003. 

Ukuvela kwakhe kubalwa i- Talking to Terrorists ( Royal Court Theatre ), The Overwhelming (Royal National Theatre) kanye ne- Fallujah (lapho ayedlala khona i- Condoleezza Rice ), kanye nemidlalo yakudala efana nethi Phedre, adlala kuyo noHelen Mirren ( Royal National Theatre. ), kanye ne- Epidavros.

Ubonakale kabili kuDokotela Who,esiqeshini esisodwa edlala umsizi we-Master Chantho,kanti kwesinye, umlingisi obizwa ngokuthi uMbhuli.Ikhredithi yakhe yokuqala yefilimu kwaba njengezwi lika- Icarus II kuDanny Boyle 's Sunshine, kanye nokuvela ku- In the Loop and Proof .Okunye ukuvela ithelevishini zihlanganisa idrama Isitha Sokugcina futhi njengoba intatheli kuleli Sherlock uchungechunge lwesibili isiqephu " The Hounds ka Baskerville ".

Ngo-2011 waba nendima ephindaphindayo njengo-Vivian, inceku eyisisebenzi enkantolo yeNkosi u-Uther owabe esebenza njengesikhonzi nesithunywa sikaMorgan, udadewabo kaKing Arthur, ochungechungeni lwedrama yothando lwasendulo i-Camelot .Uvele ochungechungeni lwe-TV lwaseBrithani lwango-2015 iFortitude njengoTrish Stoddart.

Ngo-2015 wawina indima kaMary Magdalene ochungechungeni lwe-TV, AD IBhayibheli Liyaqhubeka.Lolu hlelo lwanconywa ngokulingisa amazwe ngamazwe kanye nezinhlanga ezahlukene futhi lwavulelwa ababukeli abayizigidi ezingu-11 ngo-April 2015.

Ngo-2017, uChung wathatha indima yeNdlovukazi uDido ekukhiqizweni kweRoyal Shakespeare Company kaDido, iNdlovukazi yaseCarthage ngumbhali wemidlalo uChristopher Marlowe.Ubuye wadlala i-Agent Whitman e- Absentia futhi kusukela ngo-2017 kuya ku-2019 i-Master ochungechungeni lwe-TV Into the Badlands.

Ubushoshovu 
U-Chung wasungulwa kanye nomsunguli u-Nick Reding inhlangano esiza abantulayo i-SAFE-Kenya ethuthukisa itiyetha yoshintsho lwezenhlalo eKenya, egxile emfundweni ye-HIV kanye nokuqeda i- clitoridectomy, futhi okwamanje useBhodini layo Labaphathiswa.Usebenza eduze lenhlanganiso yePeace Direct esekela i-Envision Zimbabwe, inhlanganiso yabesifazana esebenzela ukwakha ukuvumelana kanye lokuthula eZimbabwe.Uphinde futhi ahlale eMkhandlwini we-RADA kanye neKomidi Lamazwe Ngamazwe LaseBrithani Equity Lenkululeko Yabaculi (ICAF).

NgoZibandlela wezi-2019, kanye nezinye izibalo zamasiko ezingama-42, uChung wasayina incwadi egunyaza iLabour Party ngaphansi kobuholi bukaJeremy Corbyn okhethweni lukazwelonke lwango-2019 .Le ncwadi yathi "I-manifesto yokhetho lwabasebenzi ngaphansi kobuholi bukaJeremy Corbyn inikeza uhlelo loguquko olubeka phambili izidingo zabantu neplanethi kunenzuzo yangasese kanye nezithakazelo zabambalwa." 
Abantu baphilayo
Abazalwa nge-1977

title: Focalistic
text:
ULethabo Sebetso (owazalwa zinga-26 kuNhlaba 1996) owaziwa ngelika-Focalistic, ungumrepha waseNingizimu Afrika.USebetso wayengumdlali webhola lezinyawo ngaphambi kokuphishekela umsebenzi womculo we-rapper, uSebetso wakhipha i-albhamu yokuqala ethi Sgubhu Ses Excellent (2020).

Umsebenzi 
Ngo-2016, wawina umncintiswano we- Artist on Rise .Iculo lakhe elithi "Fak'mali" liphume okokuqala kumashadi omculo we- YFM Hip Hop.Ekuqaleni kuka-2020, wasungula ilebula yakhe yokuqopha i-18 Area Holdings ngokubambisana ne-Vth Seasons.Ngo-Ephreli 10, 2020, i-Extended Play Quarantined yakhe yakhululwa.Ngo-Ephreli 2020, kwakhululwa ingoma yakhe ethi "Ke Star " ehambisana noVirgo Deep.I-"Ke Star" yathola isitifiketi segolide ngokuthengiswa kwamakhophi angu-25 000.NgoFebhuwari 2021, i-remix yakhe ethi "Ke Star", ehlanganisa u- Davido no-Virgo Deep yakhululwa emhlabeni jikelele.Eyodwa yathola impumelelo enkulu emhlabeni wonke futhi yabekwa kunombolo-16 eshadini le- Billboard Top Triller Global e-US Ngo-2021 All Africa Music Awards yathola amagama ayisikhombisa eqoqweni le-Best male artiste, Artiste of the Year, ukusebenzisana okuhamba phambili kwase-Afrika, I-Best Artiste Umdanso wase-Afrika, Best Artiste in African Electro, Break out artiste of the year, Song of the Year. 

Ekuqaleni kukaSepthemba 2021, wabhekisa amabombo ku-AmaFest Tour e- UK, ukuze athuthukise uhlobo lwe- Amapiano.NgoSepthemba 27, isitudiyo sakhe Esinwetshiwe sokudlala, uMongameli u-Ya Straata, sakhululwa ngengoma yayo ehamba phambili, "16 Days No Sleep", ehambisana no- Kabza De Small, DJ Maphorisa kanye no-Mellow & Sleazy.I-Focalistic ithole ukuqokwa kwe- Best African Act kuma- MTV Europe Music Awards ngo-2021.
Abazalwa nge-1996
Abantu baphilayo

title: Ziqu zinthathu
text:
Imfundiso yobuKristu kaZiqu -zintathu ( Latin       , Kusukela Latin   "kathathu")  ichaza uNkulunkulu njengonkulunkulu oyedwa okhona kubantu abathathu abalinganayo, abaphakade, abaphila ndawonye :  uNkulunkulu uYise, uNkulunkulu iNdodana ( uJesu Kristu ) noNkulunkulu uMoya oNgcwele — abantu abathathu abahlukene bahlanganyela ingqikithi eyodwa.Kulo mongo, abantu abathathu bachaza who uNkulunkulu ungubani, kuyilapho ingqikithi eyodwa ichaza what uNkulunkulu ayikho.Le mfundiso ibizwa ngokuthi imfundiso kaZiqu-zintathu futhi abalandeli bayo babizwa ngokuthi abakholelwa kuZiqu-zintathu, kuyilapho abaphikisana nayo bebizwa ngokuthi abakholelwa kuZiqu-zintathu noma abangakholelwa kuZiqu-zintathu.Tikhundla Nontrinitarian zihlanganisa Unitarianism, Binitarianism futhi Modalism .

Nakuba imfundiso ethuthukisiwe kaZiqu-zintathu ingacacile ezincwadini ezakha iTestamente Elisha, iTestamente Elisha linokuqonda okunxantathu ngoNkulunkulu [6] futhi liqukethe inqwaba yezindlela zikaZiqu-zintathu.Imfundiso kaZiqu-zintathu yaqala ukusungulwa phakathi kwamaKristu okuqala kanye nobaba beBandla njengoba amaKristu okuqala ayezama ukuqonda ubuhlobo phakathi kukaJesu noNkulunkulu emibhalweni yawo yemibhalo kanye namasiko angaphambili.

UNkulunkulu eTestamenteni Elisha 
Nakuba imfundiso ethuthukisiwe kaZiqu-zintathu ingacacile ezincwadini ezakha iTestamente Elisha, iTestamente Elisha liqukethe inani lezindlela zikaZiqu-zintathu, kuhlanganise noMathewu 28:19, 2 Korinte 13:13, 1 Korinte 12:4-5, Efesu. 4:4-6, 1 Petru 1:2 kanye nesAmbulo 1:4-5. [7] [9] Yokuzindla amaKristu okuqala ngemiBhalo enjengeyoku-the Commission Omkhulu : "Ngakho-ke futhi ukwakheka Hamba abafundi kuzo zonke izizwe, abhabhadisa nabo igama likaYise, neleNdodana nelikaMoya Oyingcwele" futhi uPawulu umPhostoli Isibusiso sikaJesu Kristu: "Umusa weNkosi uJesu Kristu nothando lukaNkulunkulu kanye nenhlanganyelo kaMoya oNgcwele mayibe nani nonke", ehola izazi zezenkolo emlandweni wonke ekuzameni ukuveza ubuhlobo phakathi kukaYise, iNdodana, noMoya oNgcwele.Ekugcineni, izinkomba ahlukahlukene kuNkulunkulu, uJesu, futhi uMoya ezitholakala eTestamenteni Elisha baletha ndawonye ukwakha imfundiso kaZiqu-zintathu nanye ubuNkulunkulu ngokudla kubantu abathathu nokukodwa izidakamizwa.Imfundiso kaZiqu-zintathu yasetshenziselwa ukuphikisa imibono ehlukile yokuthi laba abathathu bahlobene kanjani nokuvikela isonto emacaleni okukhulekela onkulunkulu ababili noma abathathu. 

I <em>Comma Johanneum, izazi eziningi ezivumayo ukuthi iyicwecwe lombhalo [11] futhi ayiyona ingxenye yombhalo wokuqala [lower-alpha 1] ifundeka kanje: “Ngoba bathathu eZulwini abafakazayo—uBaba, uLizwi noMoya oNgcwele. futhi laba abathathu bamunye.

title: Ukubhala kabusha
text:
Kumathematika, isayensi yekhompiyutha, kanye nokunengqondo, ukubhala kabusha kuhlanganisa izindlela eziningi (okungenzeka zinganqumeli ) zokushintsha amagama angezansi efomula namanye amagama.Izinto okugxilwe kuzo zalesi sihloko zihlanganisa amasistimu okubhala kabusha (owaziwa nangokuthi amasistimu okubhala kabusha, bhala kabusha izinjini,   noma amasistimu okunciphisa ).Ngokwesimo sawo esiyisisekelo, aqukethe iqoqo lezinto, kanye nobudlelwano bokuthi zingaguqulwa kanjani lezo zinto.

Ukubhala kabusha kungase kunganqumi .Umthetho owodwa wokubhala kabusha igama ungasetshenziswa ngezindlela eziningi ezahlukene kulelo gama, noma kungasebenza umthetho ongaphezu kowodwa.Amasistimu okubhala kabusha awanikezi i- algorithm yokushintsha ithemu elilodwa ukuya kwelinye, kodwa isethi yemithetho engase isetshenziswe.Nokho, uma kuhlanganiswe ne-algorithm efanelekile, amasistimu okubhala kabusha angabhekwa njengezinhlelo zekhompyutha , futhi izaga ezimbalwa ze-  nezilimi zokuhlela ezimemezelayo zisekelwe ekubhalweni kabusha kwethemu.

Isibonelo samacala

Okunengqondo 
Ngo logic, inqubo yokuthola ifomu evamile conjunctive (CNF) yefomula ezingase zithathwe njengoba uhlelo ubhalwe kabusha.Imithetho yesibonelo sesistimu enjalo ingaba:

lapho inombolo (  ) kubonisa ukuthi isisho esihambisana nesandla sobunxele somthetho singabhalwa kabusha sibe sisohlangothini lwesandla sokudla, futhi izimpawu ngayinye isho umusho ongaphansi.Esimisweni esinjalo, umthetho ngamunye ukhethwa ukuze uhlangothi lwesobunxele lulingane nohlangothi lwesokudla, futhi ngenxa yalokho lapho uhlangothi lwesobunxele lufana ne-subexpression, ukubhala kabusha kwaleyo nkulumo engaphansi ukusuka kwesobunxele kuya kwesokudla igcina ukuvumelana okunengqondo kanye nenani layo yonke inkulumo. .

I-Arithmetic 
Amasistimu okubhala kabusha ethemu angasetshenziswa ukubala ukusebenza kwezibalo ezinombolweni zemvelo .Ukuze wenze lokhu, inombolo ngayinye enjalo kufanele ifakwe ikhodi njengetemu .Umbhalo wekhodi olula yilowo osetshenziswa ku- axiom ye -Peano, esekelwe ku-0 (zero) ongashintshi kanye nomsebenzi womlandeli u- S . isibonelo, izinombolo 0, 1, 2, kanye no-3 zimelelwe imigomo 0, S(0), S(S(0)), kanye S(S(S(0))), ngokulandelana.Uhlelo olulandelayo lokubhala kabusha lungasetshenziswa ukubala isamba nomkhiqizo wezinombolo zemvelo ezinikeziwe.

lapho isinyathelo sokugcina sihlanganisa isibonelo sangaphambilini sokubala.

Isayensi yezilimi 
Ezifundweni zolimi, imithetho yesakhiwo samagama, ebizwa nangokuthi imithetho yokubhala kabusha, isetshenziswa kwezinye izinhlelo zohlelo lolimi olukhiqizayo,njengendlela yokukhiqiza imisho elungile ngokohlelo lolimi.Umthetho onjalo ngokuvamile uthatha uhlobo A → X, lapho u-A eyilebula yesigaba sokwenziwa , njengebinzana lebizo noma umusho, futhi u-X uwukulandelana kwalawo malebula noma amamofimu, okuveza iqiniso lokuthi u-A angathathelwa indawo ngu-X ekukhiqizeni isakhiwo somusho.Isibonelo, umthetho othi S → NP VP usho ukuthi umusho ungaqukatha ibinzana eliyibizo elilandelwa umusho wesenzo ; eminye imithetho izocacisa ukuthi ibinzana lebizo nebinzana lesenzo lingaqukatha ini, njalo njalo.

Amasistimu okubhala kabusha angabonakali 
Kulezi zibonelo ezingenhla, kusobala ukuthi singacabanga ngokubhala kabusha amasistimu ngendlela engabonakali.Kudingeka sicacise isethi yezinto kanye nemithetho engasetshenziswa ukuze siziguqule.Isilungiselelo esivame kakhulu (esingavamile) salo mbono sibizwa ngokuthi isistimu yokunciphisa  noma isistimu yokubhala kabusha engabonakali (isifinyezo se- ARS ). I-ARS imane iyisethi engu- A yezinto, kanye nokuhlobana okumbambambili → ku- A okubizwa ngokuthi ubuhlobo bokunciphisa, bhala kabusha ubuhlobo  noma nje ukunciphisa . 

Imibono eminingi kanye nokuphawula kungachazwa kulungiselelo elivamile le-ARS.  ukuvalwa kwe- reflexive transitive kwe  .  ukuvalwa kwe-symmetric ye  .  ukuvalwa kwe- reflexive transitive symmetric of  . Igama elithi inkinga le-ARS liyanquma, kunikezwe u- x kanye no- y, ukuthi ngabe  . Into engu- x ku- A ibizwa ngokuthi i- reducible uma kukhona omunye u- y ku- A onjalo  ; kungenjalo ibizwa ngokuthi i- irreducible noma ifomu elivamile . Into ethi y ibizwa ngokuthi "uhlobo olujwayelekile luka- x " uma , futhi y akanakuncishiswa. Uma uhlobo olujwayelekile luka- x luhlukile, lokhu kuvame ukuchazwa ngokuthi  . Uma yonke into inefomu okungenani elilodwa elivamile, i-ARS ibizwa ngokuthi normalizing .  noma u- x kanye no- y kuthiwa angahlanganiswa uma kukhona okuthi z nempahla leyo  . Kuthiwa i-ARS inempahla ye- Church–Rosser uma  kusho  . I-ARS ihlangana uma kukho konke u- w, x, kanye no- y kokuthi A,  kusho  . I-ARS ihlangana endaweni uma futhi kuphela uma kubo bonke u- w, x, kanye no- y kokuthi A,  kusho  . Kuvele ARS kuthiwa oqeda noma noetherian uma kukhona akukho ketanga elingapheli  . I-confluent ne-ARS eqedayo ibizwa ngokuthi i- convergent noma i- canonical .

Theorems Ezibalulekile Ezingafundwa izinhlelo abstract ubhalwe kabusha kukhona ukuthi ARS kuyinto confluent IFF it has impahla Church-Rosser, lemma Newman sika okuyinto sithi ARS ukuqeda kuyinto confluent kuphela uma kuba endaweni confluent, nokuthi inkinga izwi i ARS kuyinto undecidable ngenjwayelo.

title: Hamba, Nja. Hamba!
text:
Hamba, Nja. Hamba! () iwuchungechunge lwethelevishini olusakazwayo lwezingane olusakazwa ngekhompyutha olusekelwe encwadini yezingane yango-1961 enegama elifanayo ka-P. D. Eastman, eyathuthukiswa i-Netflix ngu-Adam Peltzman.

Ididiyelwe ngokuhlanganyela yi-DreamWorks Animation Television kanye neWildBrain Studios, uchungechunge lwaboniswa kuqala ngoJanuwari 26, 2021. Isizini yesibili yakhululwa ngoDisemba 7, 2021.

Umlando 
Izindaba ziphathelene no-Tag Barker, inja enobungani eneminyaka eyisithupha ubudala ethanda ukuhamba, hamba, hamba. Ukhuluma ngokushesha, ushayela ngokushesha, futhi ufuna ukwenza abangane abasha ngokushesha okukhulu. Uyi-tinkerer othanda ukulungisa isithuthuthu sakhe nokuqamba ama-contraption amasha. U-Tag uhlala edolobheni lase-Pawston nomndeni wakhe -- uMa, uPaw, uGogo, umkhulu, kanye nezingane zakubo. Umngani wakhe omkhulu u-Scooch Pooch uhlala kwamakhelwane, kanye nokuzidela kwe-duo kulo lonke elase-Pawston ngesithuthuthu sika-Tag nenqola eseceleni. Abalingisi abahlanganisiwe bahlanganisa abalingisi abaningi abahle abaletha ubuwula ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kukhona u-Lady Lydia ohlale ekhombisa isigqoko esisha, i-Manhole Dog ehlala emigodini futhi ivela ukuze ikhulume ngendlela yasePawston, kanye neqembu le-capella i-AmaBarkapella elilandisa yonke into ngengoma. I-Tag ne-Scooch izama ukuxazulula izinkinga, njengokubhekana nesiminyaminya ukuze ufike ephathini yenja noma ukusiza inja entsha yomphathi wemeyili ilethe imeyili. Endleleni, u-Tag ufunda ukuthi ngezinye izikhathi kungcono ukuhamba kancane futhi ubekezele.

Izinhlamvu 

 Tag Barker (kukhulunywe nguMichela Luci) inja ewolintshi efana ne-Beagador. Ungumngane omkhulu kaScooch, uyindodakazi kaPaw no-Ma futhi ungudadewabo kaCheddar Biscuit, Spike, Gilber kanye no-Yip Barker. I-Tag ukuphela kwenja evela kuzo zonke iziqephu namasegimenti, futhi inamandla kakhulu futhi ivulekile. Unekhono ekwenzeni izinto eziqanjiwe.
 Scooch Pooch (kukhulunywe nguCallum Shoniker) inja encane eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka efana ne-Terrier. UScooch ungumakhelwane omusha edolobheni lase-Pawston (njengoba esuke epulazini), futhi unamahloni futhi uzinzile uma eqhathaniswa no-Tag. Ungumngane omkhulu ka-Tag.
 Ma Barker (kukhulunywe nguKatie Griffin) inja ye-lavender efana ne-Beagador. Ungomunye wabashayeli bezindiza bePawston blimp, futhi ungumama kaTag, Cheddar Biscuit, Gilber, Spike noYip Barker.
 Paw Barker (kukhulunywe nguMartin Roach) inja ensundu efana ne-Beagador. Ungumnikazi futhi uphethe isitolo se-Ding Dong Doorbell, futhi unguyise ka-Tag, Cheddar Biscuit, Gilber, Spike kanye no-Yip Barker.
 Cheddar Biscuit (kukhulunywe nguTajja Isen) inja enamachashazi amhlophe efana ne-Beagador. Ungusomahlaya futhi uthanda ukuculela abantu, futhi ungudadewabo kaTag, Gilber, Spike kanye no-Yip Barker. Umeseka kakhulu u-Tag kodwa uvame ukuncintisana naye. UGilber uvame ukwenza naye ezenzweni zakhe.
 Spike Barker (kukhulunywe nguLyon Smith) inja ebomvu efana ne-Beagador. USpike ushiye i-Race Cadet ukuze ajoyine ama-Space Cadets, futhi ungumfowabo ka-Tag, Cheddar Biscuit, Gilber kanye no-Yip Barker. Uthanda ezemidlalo kakhulu.
 Gilber Barker (kukhulunywe nguLyon Smith (Melika) / James Cartmell (Umbuso Ohlangeneyo)) inja ephuzi efana ne-Beagador, futhi ingumqambi we-Barkers, kanye ne-isiphithiphithi sika-Tag. Ungumfowabo ka-Tag, Cheddar Biscuit, Spike kanye no-Yip Barker. Uvamise ukusebenza eduze kwe-Cheddar Biscuit noma nini lapho enza noma eqhudelana ne-Tag.
 Grandma Marge Barker (kukhulunywe nguJudy Marshank) inja ensomi efana ne-Beagador. Ungumatriashi womndeni wakwaBarker, futhi ungugogo kaTag, Cheddar Biscuit, Gilber, Spike kanye no-Yip Barker. Bobabili uMarge noMort banesitolo sokulungisa ePawston.
 Grandpaw Mort Barker (kukhulunywe nguPatrick McKenna) inja e-beige efana ne-Beagle ewela ne-Basset hound. Unesitolo sokukhanda noMarge, futhi ungumkhulu ka-Tag, Cheddar Biscuit, Gilber, Spike kanye no-Yip Barker.
 Yip Barker umdlwane onsomi onsomi onebhola lethenisi emlonyeni.
 Sgt Pooch (kukhulunywe nguLinda Ballantyne) inja ye-teal efana ne-Terrier engumama ka-Scooch kanye nephoyisa e-Pawston.
 Lady Lydia (kukhulunywe nguLinda Ballantyne) i-Poodle enombala oyirose odume e-Pawston ngokuba nezigqoko eziningi kunanoma iyiphi inja edolobheni.
 Gerald (kukhulunywe nguPatrick McKenna) inja ye-teal efana nesiphambano phakathi kwe-Terrier ne-Great Dane. UGerald ungomunye wabasanda kufika uPawston, futhi usebenza edolobheni ehambisa imeyili.
 IMeya uSniffington (kukhulunywe nguLinda Ballantyne) inja ensomi efana nesiphambano phakathi kwe-Beagador kanye ne-pug eyimeya yasePawston.
 Muttfield (kukhulunywe nguPatrick McKenna) inja ensomi efana nesiphambano phakathi kwe-Beagador ne-Bulldog. Uyisangoma esidumile ePawston.
 Manhole Dog (kukhulunywe nguPatrick McKenna) inja e-beige efana ne-Beagle yawela ne-Basset hound kanye ne-French Bulldog. Njengoba igama lakhe liphakamisa, i-Manhole Dog ivame ukubonakala iphuma emigodini yonke indawo e-Pawston, futhi ifake isembozo somgodi ekhanda layo. Uphinde abe ngu-Master Wag ngasese, umpetha kwezobuciko owaziwa ngokuthi "Tail-kwondo".
 Sam Whippet (kukhulunywe nguJoshua Graham) inja eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka efana ne-Greyhound. U-Whippet ungusaziwayo wase-Pawston, unemivimbo embalwa engahluliwe emjahweni. Umaka umenza isithixo.
 Fetcher (kukhulunywe nguDeven Mack) inja ye-teal efana nesiphambano phakathi kwe-Beagle, i-Poodle, ne-Labrador retriever. U-Fetcher uvalelwe e-Ball Island kusukela esewumdlwane ngemuva kokujaha ibhola lakhe alikhonzile.
 Frank (kukhulunywe nguDavid Berni) inja enezibuko ephuzi efana nesiphambano phakathi kwe-Beagle ne-Dachshund kanye nenye yezimbangi zika-Tag. U-Frank uhlale eceba ngezinhloso zobugovu, futhi uwubuchopho be-duo phakathi kwakhe nobhontshisi.
 Ubhontshisi (kukhulunywe nguAnand Rajaram) inja enkulu eluhlaza efana ne-Old English Sheepdog ekepisini lendiza yomshayeli wendiza kanye nenye yezimbangi/inkululeko ka-Tag. Ubhontshisi uyisilima kodwa unenhliziyo enhle, futhi uvame ukusebenza njengesicucu ezinhlelweni zikaFrank.
 Kelly Korgi (kukhulunywe nguStacey Kay) inja enombala wepentshisi efana nesiphambano phakathi kwe-corgi ne-shiba inu. UKorgi ungumculi owaziwayo kanye nesihlabani somculo we-pop phakathi kwezakhamizi zase-Pawston, futhi umculo wakhe wamukelwa ngenjabulo enkulu.
 Leo Howlstead (kukhulunywe nguJohn Stocker) inja endala empunga efana nesiphambano phakathi kweGreat Dane, i-husky, ne-German Shepherd. U-Leo uhlala e-Senior Center futhi wayejwayele ukuba yi-row cadet, futhi ngokungafani neningi labadala asebenza nabo ukhuthele kakhulu.
 AmaBarkapella, izinja ezintathu ezicula ngokuvumelana esikhundleni sokukhuluma. Ama-mohawk amathathu afaka othayi, amakholomu ehembe nama-cuffs esudi.
 Tenor (kukhulunywe nguPaul Buckley) owesilisa omude osawolintshi we AmaBarkapella.
 Bass (kukhulunywe nguReno Selmser) iduna elifushane elinsomi lama-AmaBarkapella.
 Alto (kukhulunywe nguZoe D'Andrea) insikazi e-cyan enosayizi omaphakathi we-AmaBarkapella.
 Coach Chewman (kukhulunywe nguPhill Williams) inja ebomvu engumqeqeshi omkhulu.
 Gabe Roof (kukhulunywe nguPhill Williams) inja ephuzi.
 Early Ed (kukhulunywe nguEarly Ed) inja eluhlaza engumlandeli weGet Sox ehlale ifika kuqala enkundleni.
 Catch Morely (kukhulunywe nguJulie Lemieux) inja eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ongukapteni weqembu nomdlali ovelele izikhathi ezimbili.
 Donny Slippers (kukhulunywe nguJamie Watson) inja ebomvu
 Flip Chasely (kukhulunywe nguAnand Rajaram) inja ensundu ephethe irekhodi leqembu lokulanda okuningi emdlalweni.
 Waggs Martinez (kukhulunywe nguLinda Ballantyne) inja ensomi eshayela indiza.
 Uweta (kukhulunywe nguJudy Marshank) inja eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka esebenza eBig Bowl Diner e-Pawston.
 Beefsteak (kukhulunywe nguTajja Isen) i-chihuahua ebomvana ongumqeqeshi wokuzivocavoca e-Ruff and Tumble Gym.
 Sandra Paws (kukhulunywe nguDeann DeGruijter) inja enkulu, eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka eneqhwa ephefumulelwe uSanta Claus.
 Inja Enkulu inja enkulu emhlophe nempunga. Ungumngane omkhulu weNja Encane.
 Inja Encane (kukhulunywe nguHattie Kragten) inja encane ensomi. Ungumngani omkhulu weNja Enkulu.
 Onlooker Dog (kukhulunywe nguAnand Rajaram) inja ephuzi.
 Taylee (kukhulunywe nguManvi Thapar) umdlwane oluhlaza.
 Bowser (kukhulunywe nguAnand Rajaram) inja eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ephequlula esitolo sensimbi yokuncencethwa emnyango.
 Franny umdlwane onsundu.
 Umama kaFranny (kukhulunywe nguTajja Isen) inja ye-teal.
 Ubaba kaFranny (kukhulunywe nguJoshua Graham) inja eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka.
 Upelepele (kukhulunywe nguAnand Rajaram) inja ebomvu.

 Waggles inja ebomvana.
 Bowowzo noWowbowzo izinja ezimbili ezinsomi
 Boingos inja ye-teal.
 Soppy inja eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka.

Ukukhiqiza 
Lolu chungechunge lwamenyezelwa okokuqala ngo-2019 njengengxenye yemidlalo eyisikhombisa ye-Netflix Original Preschool eqondiswe kwabaneminyaka engu-2-6 ubudala. Ekuqaleni yayizokhishwa ngasekupheleni kuka-2020, kodwa yahlehliswa kuze kube uJanuwari ngonyaka olandelayo. Isizini yokuqala ineziqephu eziyisishiyagalolunye, ngasinye siyimizuzu engama-24 ubude. Zonke iziqephu zinezindaba ezi-2 zemizuzu eyi-11-12, nakuba iziqephu 6, 9 kanye ne-18 zingabahlanganyeli abangu-2 kanti isiqephu se-10 siyisiqephu sobude obugcwele.

Khulula 
Hamba, Nja. Hamba! ikhonjwe okokuqala ngqa ngoJanuwari 26, 2021, emhlabeni jikelele ku-Netflix. I-trailer yakhululwa ngoJanuwari 6, kanye nenqwaba yeziqeshana zamahlaya ezikhishwe ngokushicilelwa okuhlukile.

Ukwamukela

Ukwamukela okubalulekile 
U-Ashley Moulton we-Common Sense Media uthole uchungechunge lwethelevishini izinkanyezi ezingu-4/5 wathi "Hamba, Nja. Hamba! izokitaza amathambo ahlekisayo ezingane zasenkulisa kanye nabantu abadala ngokufanayo". Isayithi lesinema yesi-Fulansi i-AlloCiné inikeze uchungechunge lwethelevishini isilinganiso sezinkanyezi ezingu-3.0/5 ngokusekelwe kumanothi angu-3.

text:

Uyilungu leqembu lamantombazane laseNingizimu Korea i- T-ara .Ngaphandle kwemisebenzi yeqembu lakhe, uHyomin useke walingisa emidlalweni yethelevishini eyahlukene efana nethi My Girlfriend is a Nine-Tailed Fox (2010), Gye Baek (2011), The Thousandth Man (2012), nasemafilimini ehlukene afana noGisaeng Ryung ( 2011) kanye noJinx !!! (2013). Uqale ukucula njengomculi yedwa nge-EP yakhe yokuqala, Make Up, ngoJuni 30, 2014.

Umsebenzi

1989-2011: Impilo yakuqala kanye nesiqalo somsebenzi 
UHyomin wazalelwa ePark Sun-young ngoMeyi 30, 1989, eBusan, eSouth Korea, futhi uwukuphela kwengane emndenini wakhe.Ngo-1997, indlela ka-Hyomin yokuduma yaqala ekuqaleni lapho ewina umncintiswano wokumodela we-MiMi Princess eneminyaka engu-8.  Ubeyi- internet ulzzang edumile futhi emodela ngisho nasezinxanxatheleni zezitolo ze-inthanethi ngaphambi kokuthi akhulume okokuqala no- T-ara.Wayengumfundi oqeqeshwayo ngaphansi kwe- JYP Entertainment futhi wayebhekwa njengomuntu ozongena esikhundleni sikaHyuna, owayeyilungu le- Wonder Girls ngo-2001.Ngaphambi kokusakazwa yi- Core Contents Media, waqala ukubonakala kumavidiyo omculo, afana neka-SS501 ethi "Vula", eka-SG Wannabe ethi "Smooth Break-Up" neka-FT Island ethi "Heaven".

Omunye umsebenzi

Umklamo wemfashini 
Ngesikhathi sokuphromotha kuka-T-ara " Roly-Poly " ngoJuni 2011, u-Hyomin waklama imvunulo yakhe yasesiteji, eyayibukisa ngephethini ye-retro nezikhindi ezifushane ezazidumile ngaleso sikhathi. 

U-Hyomin wethule iqoqo lezingubo ezikhethekile, ngokubambisana nosaziwayo wesitayela u-Kim Sung-il, ku- G-Market ngoJuni 4, 2012.U-Hyomin uqhamuke nesamba semikhiqizo engu-150 yokuqoqwa, futhi ubebambe iqhaza elikhulu ekuhleleni, ekuklameni, nasekulungiseleleni ukwethulwa komkhiqizo wesitolo. 

Ngo-2016, u-Hyomin uphinde waba ubuso bomkhiqizo omusha we-makeup weBrave Brothers, "Brave i" futhi wathwebula ifilimu yokuthengisa.

Idizayini yezimonyo 
Ngo-2019, u-Hyomin usebenzisane ne-VT Cosmetics kanye ne-KODI ukwethula uhlobo olusha lwezimonyo olubizwa ngokuthi "MINITT" ngoFebhuwari 25, 2019 U-Hyomin ubambe iqhaza ngokuqondile ekuhleleni, ekuklameni nasekuthuthukisweni.

Igama lomkhiqizo elithi "MINITT" liyinhlanganisela yegama elithi "MIN" lika-Hyomin nelithi "MINUTE", okusho ukuthi "wela ezintelezini ze-MINITT okwamanje". Isiqubulo somkhiqizo sithi "Dweba umbala wakho, Dweba i-MINITT yakho".

title: Igugu lenani elikhulu(ubumomoni)
text:
IPhere Lenani Elikhulu liyingxenye yezincwadi ezijwayelekile ezisemthethweni zeBandla likaJesu Kristu Labangcwele Bezinsuku Zokugcina (LDS Church) kanye namanye amahlelo abaNgcwele Bezinsuku Zokugcina.

Isigaba sokuqala seNcwadi Yesethulo kushicilelo lwe-LDS lweGugu Lenani eliKhulu lithi: “IGugu Lenani Elikhulu liyikhethelo lempahla ethinta izici eziningi ezibalulekile zokholo kanye nemfundiso yeBandla likaJesu Kristu Lezinsuku Zokugcina.Abangcwele.Lezi zinto zakhiqizwa uJoseph Smith futhi zanyatheliswa ezincwadini zeBandla zosuku lwakhe.”

Igama lencwadi lithathwe eMfanekisweni weGugu owashiwo nguJesu kuMathewu 13.

Ikhophi yeGugu Lenani Elikhulu lomthwebuli wezithombe we-NASA unkosikazi ka-M. Edward Thomas u-Ruth C. Thomas wahamba waya eNyangeni futhi wabuyela emuva ngo-1972 nosonkanyezi u- John Young begibele i- Apollo 16 .

Okuqukethwe 
IPhere Lenani Elikhulu liqukethe izigaba ezinhlanu:

Incwadi kaMose 
Incwadi kaMose iqala “ngeMibono kaMose,” isethulo sendaba yendalo kanye nokuwa komuntu (uMose isahluko 1), futhi iqhubeka nemininingwane ehambisana nenguqulo kaSmith (JST) yezahluko eziyisithupha zokuqala zencwadi kaMose. Incwadi kaGenesise ( UMose izahluko 2–5, 8 ), yaphazanyiswa izahluko ezimbili “zezingcaphuno zesiphrofetho sika-Enoke” ( uMose izahluko 6–7 ).izingxenye zeNcwadi kaMose ekuqaleni zashicilelwa ngokwehlukana yiBandla le-LDS ngo-1851, kodwa kamuva zahlanganiswa futhi zanyatheliswa njengeNcwadi kaMose ePhareleni Lenani eliKhulu. Izinto ezifanayo zinyatheliswa uMphakathi KaKrestu njengezingxenye zeMfundiso neziVumelwano kanye ne- Inspired Version yeBhayibheli .

Incwadi ka-Abrahama 

Incwadi ka-Abrahama ingumsebenzi wango-1835 owakhiqizwa uJoseph Smith  athi wawusekelwe kuma- papyrus aseGibhithe athengwa embukisweni womama ohambahambayo. Ngokusho kukaSmith, le ncwadi "yayingukuhunyushwa kwamanye amarekhodi asendulo ... okuhloswe ukuthi kube imibhalo ka- Abrahama, ngenkathi eseGibhithe, ebizwa ngokuthi iNcwadi ka-Abrahama, eyabhalwa ngesandla sakhe siqu, phezu kwe- papyrus ".Umbhalo owakhishwa uSmith uchaza indaba yokuphila kuka-Abrahama esemncane, kuhlanganise nombono wendawo yonke .

Incwadi ka-Abrahama yenziwa yaba ngcwele ngo-1880 yiBandla le-LDS njengengxenye yeGugu Lenani Elikhulu.  Ngakho-ke, kwakha isisekelo semfundiso yeSonto le-LDS kanye namahlelo amaMormon ayisisekelo se- Latter Day Saint movement .Awubhekwa njengombhalo wenkolo nguMphakathi kaKristu . Amanye amahlelo eNkathini Yezinsuku Zokugcina anemibono eyahlukene mayelana neNcwadi ka-Abrahama, amanye ayenqaba futhi amanye amukela umbhalo njengombhalo ophefumlelwe. Le ncwadi iqukethe izimfundiso eziningana ezihlukile kumaMormonism, njengomqondo wokuthi uNkulunkulu uhlela izinto zaphakade, ezikhona ngaphambili ukuze adale indawo yonke esikhundleni sokuyidala ex nihilo .

Incwadi ka-Abrahama papyri kwakucatshangwa ukuthi ilahleka eMlilo Omkhulu WaseChicago ngo-1871 Nokho, ngo-1966, izingcezu ezimbalwa zama- papyri zatholakala endaweni yokugcina umlando yeMetropolitan Museum of Art eNew York, nasezindaweni ezigcina umlando zeSonto le-LDS. Manje sebebizwa ngokuthi yiJoseph Smith Papyri . Ngemva kokuhlolwa ochwepheshe bamaMormon kanye nabangewona amaMormon Egyptologists, lezi zingcezu zatholakala ukuthi azifani neze nencazelo kaSmith, futhi zahlonzwa njengemibhalo evamile yaseGibhithe yomngcwabo, eyaqala cishe ngekhulu lokuqala BC. Ngenxa yalokho, iNcwadi ka-Abrahama ibe ngumthombo wezingxabano ezibalulekile, ngokugxekwa kwezazi zase-Egypt kanye nabaxolisi bamaMormon bevikela ubuqiniso bayo.

Joseph Smith–Matthew 
UJoseph Smith–Matthew (efushaniswe ngokuthi JS–M) uyingcaphuno evela “ ekuhumusheni kabusha ” kukaJoseph Smith kwezingxenye zeVangeli likaMathewu.Yashicilelwa okokuqala ngo-1831 eKirtland, e-Ohio, ku- broadsheet elingabhalwanga isikhathi ngokuthi "Ingcaphuno Evela Kunguqulo Entsha YeBhayibheli".

UJoseph Smith–Matthew uhlanganisa ukuhumusha kabusha kukaSmith kukaMathewu 23:39 kanye nawo wonke uMathewu isahluko 24.Umbhalo Iphathelene kaJesu esiprofetho salo Ukubhujiswa okuzayo eJerusalema futhi izinhlekelele ezifanayo ezokwenza sibandulele yakhe kwesibili.UJoseph Smith–Matthew uqukethe izinguquko ezibalulekile kanye nezengezo embhalweni wokuqala weBhayibheli.

Joseph Smith–Umlando 

UJoseph Smith–Umlando (efushaniswe ngokuthi JS–H) uyingcaphuno erekhodini le-autobiographical yezinye zezehlakalo zakuqala empilweni kaJoseph Smith. Njengemibhalo eminingi kaSmith, yayibizelwa umbhali.

Izehlakalo ezichazwe kuJoseph Smith–Umlando zihlanganisa uMbono WokuQala kanye nokuhanjelwa yingelosi uMoroni  Ngendlela yakhona yamanje, ukulandisa kugcina ngokuthi uSmith ahumushe Incwadi kaMormoni, ngaphambi nje kokusungulwa kweSmith's Church of Christ, nakuba uchungechunge lwangempela lweTimes and Seasons lusekelwe ekuqhubekiseni indaba kuze kube maphakathi nawo-1830s.

Izihloko Zokholo 
I-Articles of Faith iyisivumokholo esakhiwe nguJoseph Smith njengengxenye yencwadi ye-1842 eyathunyelwa ku- "Long" uJohn Wentworth, umhleli we- Chicago Democrat, futhi yaqala ukushicilelwa ephephandabeni le-Latter Day Saint i- Times and Seasons .Kuwuhlu olufushane lwezimfundiso eziyisisekelo eziyishumi nantathu zamaMormonism .Iningi lamahlelo abaNgcwele beSuku Lokugcina libheka lezi zihloko njengesitatimende esinegunya semfundiso yenkolo eyisisekelo. Kwamanye amahlelo, aziwa ngokuhlanganyela ngokuthi "I-Epitome of Faith and Doctrine".

Izinguquko 
Okuqukethwe kwasekuqaleni kweGugu Lenani Elikhulu kwakuhluke kakhulu, kuphinda kukhiqizwe izinto ezitholakala kuMfundiso neziVumelwano kanye nenkondlo enesihloko esithi "Oh Say What Is Truth?" (manje etholakala ku- LDS Church hymnal ).Ngo-1878, kwafakwa okuthile eNcwadini kaMose . IPhere Lenani Elikhulu lagcotshwa yiBandla le-LDS ngo-1880.Ngo-1902, izinto ezaphinde zakhiqizwa kuMfundiso neziVumelwano zasuswa. Eminye imibhalo emibili, Umbono Wombuso Wasezulwini kanye Nombono Wokuhlengwa Kwabafileyo,  yengezwa eGungwini Lenani Elikhulu ngo-1976 futhi yayiswa enguqulweni yeBandla le-LDS ye-Doctrine and Covenants (izigaba 137 kanye ne-138) 1979.

1851 inguqulo 
IPhere Lenani Elikhulu lahlanganiswa okokuqala nguFranklin D. Richards eLiverpool, eNgilandi.Ezinye izinto ziyimpinda yombhalo owawuvele utholakala kuMfundiso neziVumelwano. Yayiqukethe okufakiwe okulandelayo (ukubekwa kombhalo ezincwadini zanamuhla zeBandla le-LDS kuphawulwe kubakaki):

title: Basiswar Sen
text:
U-Basiswar "Boshi" Sen (1887 - 31 Agasti 1971) wayengusosayensi wezolimo waseNdiya.Wayeyingqalabutho yenhlangano yeGreen Revolution eyashintsha isimo sokudla saseNdiya ngokutshala inala yokusanhlamvu, ngaleyo ndlela yehlisa amathuba okuba nanoma iyiphi indlala ezweni. Umkakhe kwakunguGertrude Emerson Sen, umbhali waseMelika kanye nochwepheshe wase-Asia. Wasungula i- Vivekananda Laboratory esifundeni sase-Almora e-Himalayas. Wayengumngane wabantu abaningi abaphawulekayo, njengoNdunankulu waseNdiya uJawaharlal Nehru, imbongi uRabindranath Tagore, uJulian Huxley, kanye noDH Lawrence.USen uphinde wahlotshaniswa ne- Ramakrishna Order kanye nenhlangano kaRamakrishna Vivekananda, kanye no- Jagadish Chandra Bose, usosayensi waseNdiya, kanye noDade Nivedita, umbhali, isikhulumi, umlweli wenkululeko kanye nomfundi oqondile kaSwami Vivekananda .  Uhulumeni waseNdiya wamklomelisa ngendondo yesithathu ephakeme kakhulu yezakhamuzi zasePadma Bhushan ngo-1957.

Isiqalo sokuphila 
USen wazalelwa endaweni yaseBishnupur eBengal ngo-1887. Igama likayise kwakunguRameswar Sen, owayengumfundi wokuqala e-Calcutta University wase- Bankura esifundeni sase-Bengal. Igama likanina kwakunguPrasannamoyi Devi.Umfowabo omdala kaSens u-Sureswar Sen wayezinikele ngokushiseka kuMama Ongcwele uSri Sarada Devi .Ngenxa yokushona okungazelelwe kukaRameshwar, umndeni wakwaSen wawusenkingeni yezimali. USen (noma uBoshi njengoba aziwa kanjalo ekuphileni kwakhe kwakamuva), waqeda imfundo yakhe yesikole ngokuhlala nodade eRanchi. Uphumelele ukuhlolwa kwe-BSc e- St. Xavier's College eCalcutta. Wethulwa ku- Ramakrishna Order ngumngane wakhe u-Bibhuti Bhushon Ghosh. USen wayehlotshaniswa kakhulu no- Swami Sadananda, obuye abizwe ngoGupta Maharaj, umfundi wezindela oqondile we- Swami Vivekananda.U-Boshi uphinde wathatha izithombe ezimbalwa zikaMama Ongcwele u- Sri Sarada Devi .

Ngalesi sikhathi waphinde wahlangana noDade Nivedita owamethula ku-Acharya Jagadish Chandra Bose, usosayensi odumile waseNdiya, isazi sezinto eziphilayo kanye nesazi sezitshalo. UBoshi usebenze noSir Jagadish Chandra Bose iminyaka eminingana e- Bose Institute waze wamphelezela eLondon. Ngo-1923, waya e-United States ecelwe usosayensi waseMelika, uGlen Overton. Ngemva kokubuyela e-India, u-Boshi wayefuna ukwenza ucwaningo oluzimele, futhi wahlukana noDkt. JC Bose futhi wasungula ilabhorethri yakhe ekhishini elincane e-Bosepara Lane, e-Baghbazar, lapho ayehlala khona. Ilabhorethri yaqanjwa ngoSwami Vivekananda . U-Boshi wahlangana no- Romain Rolland ngo-1928 futhi waba nengxoxo ngempilo kaRamakrishna noVivekananda naye. Wahlangana no- Albert Einstein ngo-1930 eBerlin futhi waba nezingxoxo ngeSayensi Nezenkolo.  

Ngo-1924 uDade Christine noma uChristine Greenstidel ongumfundi waseMelika oqondile kaSwami Vivekananda wehlele eNdiya futhi wathatha indawo yakhe yokuhlala noBoshi. UBoshi wathuthela e-Almora lapho amisa khona ilabhorethri yakhe eKundan House, wayiqasha ngemali kaJosephine MacLeod, futhi uDade Christine wahlala naye lapho iminyaka emibili. Ngo-1928 uBoshi waphelezela uDade Christine eNew York ukuze amsize alulame ekuguleni okubuthakathaka, lapho ashonela khona.  E-Almora Boshi wahlangana no-Gertrude Emerson, umhloli wamazwe, umbhali kanye nelungu elisungula le- Society of Woman Geographers .  Ubethweswe iziqu eNyuvesi yaseChicago, engomunye weRoyal Geographical Society aphinde abe ngumhleli we-Asia Magazine. Ngo-1932 uBoshi noGertrude bashada omunye nomunye. Waba uGertrude Emerson Sen. Babenabahlonishwa abaningi njengabajwayelene nabo eKundan House, okuphawuleka kakhulu phakathi kwabo uRabindranath Tagore, imbongi engaqondakali kanye nomklomelo kaNobel, Jawaharlal Nehru, Julian Huxley, umdanso wenothi Uday Shankar, Swami Virajananda, owayeyinhloko yeRamakrishna Order yangaleso sikhathi, uCarl. njll.

Ucwaningo lwesayensi 
I-Great Bengal Famine yango-1943 yayiwushintshile umbono kaSen mayelana nocwaningo futhi kusukela ocwaningweni lweseli yezitshalo ukugxila kwakhe wagxila ekusebenziseni ucwaningo lwezolimo kanye nokukhiqizwa kokusanhlamvu kokudla.Kulolu daba wathonywa kakhulu yimizamo yabantu kanye nemiyalezo kaSwami Vivekananda owahlonza inkinga yokudla njengenye yezinkinga ezinkulu ezikhungethe iBritish India. Ucwaningo lwakhe kwezolimo ezisebenzayo nezisetshenziswayo lwaluhlanganisa ukwethulwa kwezitshalo, ukuzalaniswa kwezitshalo nokukhiqizwa kwembewu eyingxube yommbila, i-jowar, i-bajra, no-anyanisi. Walandela izimangalo zikaTrofim Lysenko zokuthuthukisa izinhlobo zezitshalo ezibizwa nge-vernalized.  Elabhorethri yakhe iVivekananda, uphumelele ekukhiqizeni imbewu yommbila oyingxube kanye no-anyanisi oyingxube. Ngomsebenzi wakhe wokuphayona owamemezela iGreen Revolution eNdiya, waklonyeliswa ngePadma Bhushan ngo-1957 kanye nendondo yeWatmull ngo-1962. Wabelwa umhlaba ukuze andise umsebenzi wakhe nguHulumeni wase-Uttar Pradesh eHawalbagh. Ngo-1959 iLabhorethri yakhe yadluliselwa kuHulumeni we-UP, futhi yabelwa ngama-215 indawo eyi-acre yocwaningo lwesayensi.

Eminye imisebenzi 
Ngo-1939, uSen noGertrude bathatha isinyathelo sokusungula i-Uday Shankar Cultural Centre e-Almora. Kodwa lesi sikhungo sahlala iminyaka emihlanu kuphela. USen naye wayenemvelo ejulile ngokomoya. Wagqugquzelwa izindela zaseRamakrishna MathUke wancelisa uSwami Sadananda ngezinsuku zakhe zokugcina futhi waqalwa nguye. USen wayesondelene no- Swami Brahmananda, umongameli wokuqala we-Ramakrishna Mission.  Wabhala okungenani isihloko esisodwa, esinesihloko esithi “Isayensi Nenkolo”.

Impilo yokugcina 
USen washona ngo-31 Agasti 1971 e-Ranikhet Military Hospital, e-Almora. Ngemuva kokushona kwakhe, i-Vivekananda Laboratory yafakwa eMkhandlwini wase-Indian of Agricultural Research (ICAR) njengophiko oluzimele ngo-1974, futhi yaba neqhaza elikhulu abalibamba ekuxazululeni inkinga yokudla yaseNdiya ngeGreen Revolution. Yaqanjwa kabusha ngokuthi i-Vivekananda Paravatiya Krishi Anisandhan Sanstha.
Abazalwa nge-1887

title: Rosina Umelo
text:
U-Rosina Umelo (owazalwa uRosina Martin, 1930) ungumbhali waseNigeria.Waziwa ngezindaba zakhe ezimfushane, izincwadi zezingane kanye nenganekwane yakhe yabantu abadala.Ubuye washicilela ngaphansi kwegama elithi Adaeze Madu.

Impilo 
URosina "Rose" Martin wazalelwa eCheshire, eNgilandi, futhi wafunda eBedford College, University of London . Washada noJohn Umelo waseNigeria ngo-1961, wahlangana naye eLondon Underground.Ngo-1965, bobabili bathuthela eNigeria . Ufundise isiLatini eQueens School, e- Enugu, kwaze kwaba yilapho kugqashuka iMpi Yombango yaseNigeria (1967-70).Waba yisakhamuzi saseNigeria ngo-1971 ngomshado.Wayengummeli oyinhloko futhi wadala lesiNgisi lwezifundo izinto.  Kamuva, u-Umelo waba umqondisi wesikole.  Umelo unezingane okungenani ezine. 

Umelo uqoqe izindaba zakhe ezimfushane ezingu-12 zabantu abadala engomeni ethi The Man Who Ate the Money (1978), ezinhlanu zazo zawina izindondo. U-Nancy J. Schmidt, ebhalela i- Africa Today, ubize incwadi ka-Umelo kwethi The Man Who Ate the Money ngokuthi “kusha,” nakuba isihloko sakhe sasiphathelene nezindikimba ezivamile ezinganekwaneni zase-Afrika.  Umelo uphinde wabhalela uchungechunge oludumile lwabantu abadala olushicilelwe uMacmillan, olubizwa ngePacesetters Series .  U-Umelo uphinde wadalela abantu abasha imisebenzi yochungechunge oluthi "Heart Beats", olwanyatheliswa ngabashicileli be-Chelsea House ngeminyaka yawo-1990. 

Ngo-1967, Isifunda SaseMpumalanga yeNigeria, inhloko-dolobha yaso kwakuyi- Enugu, sahlukaniswa njengesizwe esisanda kumenyezelwa saseBiafra . Umndeni wakwa-Umelo wabaleka emzini wabo ose-Enugu waya esigodini sakubo ka-John Umelo enkabeni ye-Biafra. Phakathi nempi, uRosina wayegcina amanothi kulokho ayekubonile, awabhala njengendaba ngokushesha ngemva kwempi, eyaphela ngo-1970 kwafa okungenani isigidi. Le akhawunti, ebizwa ngokuthi "A World of our Own," ayizange ishicilelwe kwaze kwaba ngu-2018, lapho yakha umnyombo wencwadi ethi, "Surviving Biafra: A Nigerwife's Story," (Hurst Publishers, London), eyabhalwa ngokuhlanganyela nesazi sesayensi yabantu uS. Elizabeth. Inyoni.

Kamuva empilweni yakhe, u-Umelo wasebenza e- International Institute of Tropical Agriculture, Ibadan.Ngo-2018, wayehlala eduze kwaseLondon e- United Kingdom .

Abazalwa nge-1930

title: Imvimba
text:
Imvimba noma Isoseji wuhlobo lomkhiqizo wenyama ovame ukwenziwa ngenyama egayiwe, ngokuvamile eyengulube, yenkomo, noma yenkukhu, kanye nosawoti, izinongo nokunye ukunambitheka. Ezinye izithako ezifana nezinhlamvu noma imvuthuluka yesinkwa zingase zifakwe njengama-fillers noma izandiso.

Igama elithi imvimba lingabhekisela enyameni exekethile, engakhiwa ibe ama-patties noma igxishwe esikhumbeni. Uma ubizwa ngokuthi "imvimba," umkhiqizo uvame ukuba yisigonqolozi futhi umbozwe esikhumbeni nona ulwelwesini.

Imvamisa, imvimba yakhiwa ku- casing imvama elenziwe kusuka emathunjini kodwa kwesinye isikhathi ngezinto zokwenziwa. Izimvimba zithengiswa ziluhlaza ngoba ziphekwa ngezindlela eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuthosa epanini, ukuqhosa kanye nokosa. Ezinye izimvimba ziphekwa ngesikhathi sokucutshungulwa futhi i-casing ingase isuswe.

Ukwenza imvimba kuyindlela evamile yokugcina ukudla . Izimvimba zingase zilondolozwe ngokuphulukisa, ukomiswa (ngokuvamile ngokuhambisana nokuvutshelwa noma ukukhuliswa, okungaba nomthelela ekulondolozweni), ukubhema, noma ukuqhwa. Ezinye izimvimba ezelashiwe noma ezibhenyiwe zangagcinwa ngaphandle kwesiqandisi. Izimvimba eziningi ezintsha kufanele zibe sesiqandisini noma ziqandiswe zize ziphekwe.
Izimvimba zenziwa ngezinhlobonhlobo zezinhlobonhlobo zikazwelonke nezesifunda, ezihluka ngezinhlobo zenyama esetshenziswayo, izithako zokunambitheka noma izinongo (ugalikhi, upelepele, iwayini, njll.), kanye nendlela yokulungiselela.

igama 
Igama elithi isoseji laqala ukusetshenziswa esiNgisini phakathi nekhulu le-15, i-spelled sawsyge.Leli gama livela ku-Old North French saussiche (i-Modern French saucisse ). Igama lesiFulentshi lavela ku-Vulgar Latin salsica ("isoseji"), lisuka ku- salsicus ("eyoliswe ngosawoti").

Umlando 

Ukwenziwa kwamasoseji kuwumphumela wokudla okunempilo.Ngokwesiko, abenzi bamasoseji babefaka usawoti izicubu nezitho ezihlukahlukene ezifana nezinsalela, inyama yesitho, igazi, namafutha ukuze basize ukuzigcina. Babe sebewahlohla emabhodleleni amashubhu enziwe ngamathumbu ahlanziwe esilwane, akhiqiza umumo oyisilinda. Ngakho, amasoseji, uphudingi, namasalami aphakathi kokudla okudala kakhulu okuphekiwe, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kuphekwe futhi kudliwe ngokushesha noma omisiwe ngamazinga ahlukahlukene.

Ithebhulethi ye-cuneiform yesi-Akkadian irekhoda isidlo esinezimbotshana zamathumbu ezigcwele uhlobo oluthile lwenyama yokuphoqa.

Kuchazwe uhlobo lwesiShayina lwesoseji, i- lup cheong ( pinyin  kusukela Northern futhi amakhosi Southern ( 589 BC – 420 BC ), abenziwe imbuzi nemvu inyama ngosawoti, futhi enongiwe onion eluhlaza, emabhontjisi sauce, ginger, kanye pepper. Uhlobo yesimanje ye Lup Cheong has a eside elithe ukuphila eshalofini, ikakhulu ngenxa wokuqukethwe lelisetulu lactobacilli ; iphakeme kangangokuthi abaningi bayibheka njengomuncu.

Imbongi engumGreki uHomer yakhuluma ngohlobo lwamasoseji egazi e- Odyssey, u- Epicharmus wabhala ihlaya elinesihloko esithi The Sausage, kanti umdlalo ka- Aristophanes othi The Knights ukhuluma ngomthengisi wamasoseji oqokwe njengomholi. Ubufakazi bubonisa ukuthi amasoseji ayesevele ethandwa phakathi kwamaGreki namaRoma asendulo futhi ngokunokwenzeka nezizwe ezihlukahlukene ezazihlala engxenyeni enkulu yeYurophu.

Isoseji elidume kakhulu e-Italy yasendulo lalivela eLucania (i- Basilicata yesimanje) futhi lalibizwa ngokuthi lucanica, igama elihlala ezinhlobonhlobo zamasoseji anamuhla eMedithera.Phakathi nokubusa kombusi waseRoma uNero, amasoseji ayehlotshaniswa nomkhosi weLupercalia.  Ekuqaleni kwekhulu le-10 phakathi noMbuso WaseByzantium, uLeo VI the Wise wakunqabela ukukhiqizwa kwamasoseji egazi ngemva kokungenwa ushevu ekudleni.

Amabhokisi 
Ngokwesiko, ama-sausage casings ayenziwa ngamathumbu ahlanziwe, noma izisu esimweni se- haggis kanye namanye ama-puddings endabuko. Kodwa-ke, namuhla, ama-casings emvelo avame ukushintshwa yi- collagen, i- cellulose, noma ngisho nama-plastic casings, ikakhulukazi uma kwenzeka amasoseji akhiqizwa yizimboni. Ezinye izinhlobo zesoseji, njengesoseji elisikiwe, zilungiswa ngaphandle kwebhokisi. Ukwengeza, inyama yesidlo sasemini nesoseji manje isiyatholakala ngaphandle kwamabhokisi emathini nezimbiza .

Izithako 
Isoseji liqukethe inyama enqunywe ibe yizicucu noma inhlabathi, exutshwe nezinye izithako, bese igcwaliswa ku-casing. Izithako zingase zifake isigcwalisi sesitashi esishibhile njengemvuthuluka yesinkwa noma okusanhlamvu, isinongo nezinongo ezifana nezinongo, futhi kwesinye isikhathi nokunye okufana ne-apula neliki.Inyama ingase ibe eyanoma yisiphi isilwane kodwa ngokuvamile ingulube, yenkomo noma yenkonyane, noma yenkukhu. Isilinganiso senyama ukuya kumafutha ethambile sincike kwisitayela nomkhiqizi. Inyama njengoba ibhaliwe ingase idlule ku-100%, okwenzeka lapho isisindo senyama sidlula isisindo esiphelele sesoseji ngemva kokwenziwa, ngezinye izikhathi kufaka phakathi inqubo yokomisa okunciphisa okuqukethwe kwamanzi.

Izigaba 

Ukuhlukaniswa kwamasoseji kungaphansi kokuhlukana kwemibono yesifunda.Kusetshenziswa amamethrikhi ahlukahlukene njengezinhlobo zezithako, ukungaguquguquki, nokulungiselela.Esikhathini abakhuluma isiNgisi, umahluko elandelayo phakathi fresh, ephekiwe, ayi ezomile ibonakala wamukela ucishe:

 Amasoseji aphekiwe enziwa ngenyama entsha bese ephekwa ngokugcwele. Zidliwa ngokushesha ngemva kokupheka noma kufanele zifakwe esiqandisini. Izibonelo zifaka ama- hot dog, i- Braunschweiger, namasoseji esibindi . Amasoseji enyama nokusanhlamvu afana ne-goetta, i- scrapple, ne- kishka nawo angamasoseji aphekiwe. 
 Amasoseji aphekiwe aphekiwe ayaphekwa bese ayabhenywa noma aphekwe . Zidliwa zishisa noma zibanda kodwa zidinga ukufakwa efrijini. Izibonelo zifaka i- kielbasa ne- mortadella . Amanye aphekwa kancane ngenkathi ebhema, lapho inqubo ithatha izinsuku ezimbalwa noma ngaphezulu, njengekesi le-Gyulai kolbász .
 Amasoseji amasha enziwa ngenyama engakaze ilapheke ngaphambili. Kufanele zifakwe efrijini futhi ziphekwe kahle ngaphambi kokuba zidliwe. Izibonelo zifaka i- Boerewors, isoseji yengulube yase-Italy, siskonmakkara, namasoseji asekuseni .
 Amasoseji amasha ashunqiwe amasoseji amasha abhenywayo futhi alapheka. Ngokuvamile azidingi isiqandisi futhi azidingi ukupheka okwengeziwe ngaphambi kokudla. Izibonelo zibandakanya Mettwurst futhi Teewurst okuyizinto inyama amalungiselelo phama bezinhlamvu isoseji kodwa kukhanywe yaso (njenganoma yimuphi nje omunye ukusabalala kusuka tube).
 Amasoseji omile amasoseji alashiwe abilisiwe futhi omisiwe. Ezinye ziyabhenywa nasekuqaleni kwenqubo yokomisa. Ngokuvamile zidliwa zibandayo futhi zizohlala isikhathi eside. Izibonelo zifaka i- salami, i- Droë wors, i-Finnish meetvursti, i- Sucuk, i- Landjäger (ebhenyiwe), i- Slim Jims, namasoseji ehlobo .
 Amasoseji amaningi, noma ngezinye izikhathi inyama yesoseji noma isoseji elingenasikhumba, lisho inyama eluhlaza, egayiwe, efakwe izinongo, ngokuvamile ethengiswa ngaphandle kwebhokisi.
 I-sausage yemifino yenziwa ngaphandle kwenyama, isibonelo, ngokusekelwe kuphrotheni ye- soya noma i-tofu, ngamakhambi nezinongo. Amanye amasoseji emifino awawona ngempela ama- vegan futhi angase aqukathe izithako ezifana namaqanda .

Afrika

ENyakatho Afrika 
I-Merguez isoseji elibomvu, elibabayo elivela e-Morocco, e-Algeria, e-Tunisia nase-Libya, eNyakatho Afrika. Ibuye idume eFrance, kwa-Israel, nasesifundeni saseJalimane iSaarland, lapho ivamise ukuwoswa ku- Schwenker . I-Merguez yenziwe ngewundlu, inyama yenkomo, noma ingxube yakho kokubili. Ingavuzwa ngezinhlobonhlobo zezinongo, njenge-sumac ye-tartness, kanye ne-paprika, upelepele we-cayenne, noma i- harissa, unamathisele we-chili oshisayo owunikeza umbala obomvu. Igxiliswa egodini lewundlu, esikhundleni sebhokisi lengulube. Ngokwesiko yenziwa isha futhi idliwe yosiwe noma ne-couscous. I-merguez eyomisiwe elangeni isetshenziselwa ukwengeza ukunambitheka kumathegi. Ibuye idliwe kumasemishi.

Iningizimu Afrika 
ENingizimu Afrika, amasoseji endabuko aziwa ngokuthi ama- boerewors, noma amasoseji abalimi. Izithako zifaka igeyimu nenyama yenkomo, ngokuvamile exutshwa nengulube noma yewundlu kanye nephesenti eliphezulu lamafutha. I-Coriander neviniga yizithako ezimbili ezivame kakhulu zesinongo, nakuba kunezinhlobonhlobo eziningi. Imvelo ephansi yenyama kanye nokuvunguza okude okuqhubekayo kwesoseji yizimfanelo zayo ezimbili ezibonakalayo. I-Boerewors ivame ukuphekwa nge- braai (i- barbecue ).

I-Droë wors isoseji elingaphekiwe elifana nama-boerewors enziwe ngenqubo yokomisa efana ne- biltong . Okuhlukile kwasendaweni kwe- hot dog i-Wors roll, noma i-boerewors roll. Leli bhani le-hot dog elinocezu lwe-boerewors, eliphakwa notamatisi no-anyanisi okumnandi okubizwa ngokuthi i-seshebo. I-Seshebo ingafaka upelepele, i-atchaar noma ukhari, kuye ngendawo engaphakathi kwezwe.

E-Asia

I-Brunei 
 is the traditional Bruneian beef sausage. It is made with minced beef and tallow, marinated with garlic, salt, chillies and spices, and stuffed into cow's or buffalo's small intestines. It is then fermented through dehydration. Belutak is a common side dish alongside ambuyat.

China 

Isitayela saseYurophu esibhemayo i-hóng cháng ( simplified Chinese   red sausage ) ikhiqizwa eHarbin, idolobha elikhulu elisenyakatho kakhulu neChina.Ifana namasoseji ase-Lithuanian nase-Polish ahlanganisa i- kiełbasa ne- podhalańska futhi ijwayele ukuba ne-flavour yaseYurophu kunamanye amasoseji aseShayina. Lolu hlobo lwamasoseji lwaqala ukukhiqizwa efektri yaseRussia ebizwa ngokuthi iChurin sausage factory ngo-1909. Isoseji lesitayela se-Harbin selidumile e-China, ikakhulukazi ezifundeni ezisenyakatho. 

I-Lap cheong (futhi i-lap chong, i-lap chung, i-lop chong) amasoseji engulube omisiwe abukeka futhi azizwe njenge-pepperoni kodwa amnandi kakhulu. Eningizimu-ntshonalanga yeChina, amasoseji anongwe ngosawoti, upelepele obomvu nopelepele wasendle. Abantu bavame ukwelapha amasoseji ngokubhema nokomisa umoya.

Japan 

Nakuba iJapane ingaziwa ngokwesiko ngenyama yenkomo, ingulube, inyamazane, noma ngisho namasoseji egazi, amaJapane ayaludla ugodo olusekelwe enhlanzini olubizwa ngokuthi kamaboko, olungase lubhekwe njengohlobo lwamasoseji. I-Kamaboko yenziwe ngenhlanzi egayiwe ebizwa ngokuthi i- surimi . Ivamise ukulolongwa ibe yizinyanga eziwuhhafu phezu kwepulanga elincane lokhuni kanye nengaphandle elidayiwe elibomvana. Uma ikamaboko isisikwa izingcezu ibonakala inoqweqwe oluphinki ngendlela engaqondakali ezungeze ingaphakathi elimhlophe. Ivame ukusikwa ibe yizicucu ezincane futhi yengezwe esobho, amasaladi, i- bento, nezinye izitsha eziningi njengendlela yokuhlobisa. Eminyakeni yakamuva, i-kamaboko nayo ingene emakethe njengokudla okulula. Ngokufanayo ne- Slim Jim, ushizi, amasoseji, nezinti ze-kamaboko ezinephunga lenhlanzi zingatholakala ezitolo ezilula kulo lonke elase-Japan.

Korea 
I-Sundae, uhlobo lwesoseji yegazi, isoseji lendabuko laseKorea. Ukudla okudumile kwasemgwaqweni, i-sundae ivamise ukulungiselelwa ngokushisisa noma ukubilisa amathumbu enkomo noma engulube afakwe izithako ezihlukahlukene.Ukwehluka okuvame kakhulu kwakhiwe igazi lengulube, i- cellophane noodle, isanqante esisikiwe kanye nebhali okugxishwe emathunjini engulube, kodwa okunye ukuhlukahluka kwesifunda kuhlanganisa i- squid noma i- Alaska pollock casings. I-Sundae idliwa nje ngosawoti, isitshulu, noma njengengxenye yokuthosa.

Philippines

Thailand 

Kunezinhlobo eziningi zamasoseji ezaziwa yi- Thai cuisine, ezinye zazo eziyisipesheli sesifunda esithile saseThailand . Kusuka enyakatho yeThailand kufika i- sai ua, isoseji lengulube egayiwe elinongwe nge- curry namakhambi amasha.  Elinye isoseji elosiwe libizwa ngokuthi i- sai krok Isan, isoseji elibilile elinokunambitheka okumuncu okuhlukile okuvela enyakatho-mpumalanga yeThailand (isifunda esaziwa nangokuthi i- Isan ).  Womabili amasoseji avame ukudliwa nerayisi elinamathelayo, imifino emisha, kanye ne- nam phrik entsha (i-Thai chilli paste) noma upelepele wamehlo wenyoni eluhlaza . Angase futhi anikezwe kanye nesaladi eqabulayo yase-Thai njenge- som tum ( isaladi lepapaya eliluhlaza ).

Vietnam

I-Eurasia

ithekhi 
ETurkey, isoseji yaziwa ngokuthi i- sosis, eyenziwe ngenyama yenkomo. Sucuk (tsudjuck evelele noma sujuk ne njengabantu ku ilunga lokugcina) uhlobo isoseji eyenziwe Turkey kanye nomakhelwane lamazwe aseBalkan. Kunezinhlobo eziningi ze-sucuk, kodwa ngokuvamile zenziwe ngenyama yenkomo. Ivutshiwe, inongwe (ngogaliki kanye nopelepele) bese igcwaliswa egodini elingadliwayo elidinga ukuxetshulwa ngaphambi kokudliwa. I-sucuk ebhenywa kancane ibhekwa njengephakeme. Ukunambitheka kuyababa, kunosawoti futhi kuluhlaza kancane, kufana ne-pepperoni. Ezinye izinhlobo zishisa kakhulu futhi/noma zinamafutha. Ezinye zixutshwe ne-turkey, inyama yenyathi yamanzi, amafutha ezimvu noma inkukhu. Kukhona izitsha eziningi ezenziwe nge-sucuk, kodwa i-sucuk eyosiwe isalokhu idume kakhulu. Izinhlobo ezomisiwe zentuthu zidliwa ziluhlaza kumasemishi. I-loop yamathumbu i-sucuk eyodwa. I-sucuk ebhenyiwe ngokuvamile iqondile.

EYurophu

IBrithani ne-Ireland

eMexico 

Isoseji elivame kakhulu laseMexico yi- chorizo . Isha futhi ivamise ukujula ngombala obomvu (eningini le-Latin America, i-chorizo ayinambala futhi iqoshwe ngamaqhafu). Enye i-chorizo ixega kangangokuthi iphuma emgodini wayo ngokushesha nje lapho isikwa; le chorizo echotshoziwe iwukugcwalisa okudumile kwamasemishi e-torta, amaqanda, ama-burritos asekuseni nama- tacos . I-Salchichas, i- longaniza (isoseji yengulube ende, ezacile, efakwe izinongo kancane, eqoshwe emahhadlaweni), i- moronga (uhlobo lwe-blood pudding) kanye noshizi wekhanda nakho kudliwa kakhulu.

El Salvador 

E-El Salvador, ama-chorizos avame kakhulu, futhi lawo avela edolobheni laseCojutepeque aziwa kakhulu lapho. Izixhumanisi, ikakhulukazi zalezo ezivela e-Cojutepeque, zihlukaniswa namakhoba ommbila aboshwe ngamafindo (bheka isithombe). Njengama-chorizos amaningi eLatin America, athengiswa eluhlaza futhi kufanele aphekwe.

Okunye ukuhluka

Izinguqulo ze-Vegetarian 
Amasoseji emifino kanye ne- vegan ayatholakala kwamanye amazwe, noma angenziwa kusukela ekuqaleni ekhaya.Lokhu kungenziwa kusuka ku- tofu, seitan, amantongomane, amapulses, mycoprotein, soya protein, imifino nanoma iyiphi inhlanganisela yezithako ezifanayo ezizobambana ngesikhathi sokupheka.Lamasoseji, njengemikhiqizo eminingi eshintsha inyama, ngokuvamile awela ezigabeni ezimbili: amanye anokwakheka, anombala, anongwe, futhi anongwe ukuze aphindaphinde ukunambitheka nokuthungwa kwenyama ngokunembe ngangokunokwenzeka; amanye anjengamasoseji e- Glamorgan athembele kuzinongo nemifino ukuze abolekise ukunambitheka kwawo kwemvelo emkhiqizweni futhi akukho mzamo owenziwayo wokulingisa inyam.Nakuba ingeyona imifino, isoseji lesoya lasungulwa ngo-1916 eJalimane. Okokuqala eyaziwa ngokuthi u- Kölner Wurst ("Isoseji lase-Cologne") nguShansela waseJalimane kamuva u- Konrad Adenauer (1876-1967).

title: CFD-DEM
text:
Imodeli ye- CFD-DEM, noma imodeli ye-Computational Fluid Dynamics / Discrete Element Method, inqubo esetshenziselwa ukumodela noma ukulingisa amasistimu ahlanganisa uketshezi nezinto eziqinile noma izinhlayiya. Ku-CFD-DEM, ukunyakaza kokuqinile okuqinile noma isigaba sezinhlayiya kutholwa I-Discrete Element Method (DEM) esebenzisa imithetho yokunyakaza ka-Newton kuyo yonke izinhlayiya, kuyilapho ukugeleza koketshezi oluqhubekayo kuchazwa izibalo ezimaphakathi zendawo ze-Navier-Stokes ingaxazululwa kusetshenziswa indlela yendabuko yeComputational Fluid Dynamics (CFD).Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwesigaba soketshezi kanye nesigaba sokuqinile kumodelwa ngokusetshenziswa komthetho wesithathu ka-Newton .

Ukufakwa okuqondile kwe-CFD ku-DEM ukuze kufundwe inqubo ye-gas fluidization kuze kube manje kuzanywe ngu-Tsuji et al.   futhi kamuva nje nguHoomans et al.,  Deb et al.  kanye noPeng et al.  Uhlolojikelele lwakamuva ngezinkambu zezicelo lunikezwe u-Kieckhefen et al.

Ukufana 
I-OpenMP iboniswe iphumelela kakhulu ekwenzeni izibalo ezihlanganisiwe ze-CFD-DEM kuhlaka olufanayo uma kuqhathaniswa ne- MPI ka-Amritkar et al.  Muva nje, kusungulwe isu elihambisanayo lezilinganiso eziningi  . Ngokuvamile, isizinda sokulingisa sihlukaniswe izizinda eziningi ezingaphansi futhi inqubo ngayinye ibala isizinda esisodwa esingaphansi sisebenzisa ulwazi lomngcele oludlula i-MPI; kusizinda ngasinye esingaphansi, ama-CPU asetshenziselwa ukuxazulula isigaba samanzi kuyilapho inhloso evamile ye-GPU isetshenziselwa ukuxazulula ukunyakaza kwezinhlayiya.Kodwa-ke, kule ndlela yokubala ama-CPU nama-GPU asebenza nge-serial. Okusho ukuthi, ama-CPU awasebenzi ngenkathi ama-GPU ebala izinhlayiya eziqinile, futhi ama-GPU awasebenzi lapho ama-CPU ebala isigaba soketshezi.ukuze kuqhutshekwe kusheshiswe ukubala, i-CPU ne-GPU computing ingagqagqana kusetshenziswa inkumbulo eyabiwe yohlelo lwe-Linux. Ngakho, isigaba samanzi kanye nezinhlayiya zingabalwa ngesikhathi esifanayo.

Ukunciphisa izindleko zokubala kusetshenziswa i-Coarse Grained Particles 
Izindleko zokubala ze-CFD-DEM zinkulu ngenxa yenani elikhulu lezinhlayiya kanye nezinyathelo zesikhathi esincane zokuxazulula ukungqubuzana kwezinhlayiyana. Ukunciphisa izindleko zokubala, izinhlayiya eziningi zangempela zingafakwa ku-Coarse Grained Particle (CGP).   Ububanzi be-CGP bubalwa ngesibalo esilandelayo:

 

lapho  inombolo yezinhlayiya zangempela ku-CGP. Ngemuva kwalokho, ukunyakaza kwama-CGP kungalandelelwa kusetshenziswa i-DEM. Ezifanisweni kusetshenziswa Izinhlayiya Eziqinile Ezivuthiwe, izinhlayiya zangempela ku-CGP zingaphansi kwamandla okudonsa afanayo, izinga lokushisa elifanayo kanye nezinhlayiyana zobuningi bezinhlobo ezifanayo. Umfutho, ukushisa nokudluliswa kwenqwaba phakathi koketshezi nezinhlayiya kubalwa kuqala kusetshenziswa ububanzi bezinhlayiya zangempela bese kukalwa  izikhathi. Inani le  ihlobene ngokuqondile nezindleko zokubala kanye nokunemba.  Nini  ilingana nobunye, ukulingisa kuba yimiphumela yokuzuza esuselwe ku-DEM enokunemba okuphezulu kakhulu okunokwenzeka. Njengoba lesi silinganiso sikhula, isivinini sokulingisa sikhuphuka kakhulu kodwa ukunemba kwakho kuyawohloka.Ngaphandle kokwenyuka kwesivinini, imibandela evamile yokukhetha inani lale pharamitha ayikakatholakali.Kodwa-ke, kumasistimu anezakhiwo ze-mesoscale ezihlukile, njengamabhamuza namaqoqo, usayizi wephasela kufanele ube mncane ngokwanele ukuze uxazulule ukuwohloka, ukuhlanganisa, nokuphuka kwamabhamuza noma amaqoqo. Inqubo yokuhlanganisa izinhlayiya ndawonye inciphisa imvamisa yokushayisana, okuthonya ngokuqondile ukuchithwa kwamandla. Ukulandisa ngaleli phutha, i-coefficient yokubuyisela ephumelelayo yahlongozwa ngu-Lu et al.,  ngokusekelwe kumbono we-kinetic wokugeleza kwe-granular, ngokucabangela ukuchithwa kwamandla ngesikhathi sokushayisana kwesistimu yasekuqaleni kanye nesistimu yezinhlamvu ezimahhadla kuyafana.

Isoftware 
Umthombo ovulekile kanye nesofthiwe engeyona eyentengiso:

 I-CFDEMcoupling iyibhokisi lamathuluzi lomthombo ovulekile lokuhlanganisa i-CFD-DEM. Ithuthukiswe yi- DCS Computing GmbH
 I-MFiX (Iphakheji yokulingisa ukugeleza kwe-Open Source multiphase).

Isoftware Yezohwebo

 I-EDEM (DEM Solutions Ltd.  ) 
 I-Rocky DEM - I-Discrete Element Modelling kanye ne-Particle Simulation Software elingisa ngokushesha nangokunembile ukuziphatha kokugeleza.
 I-Flow 3D - engeza i-DEM kumojuli futhi imodeli ngempumelelo izinkinga ze-CFD-DEM
 U-Ansys Uhlakaniphile
