title: WWE Hall of Fame
text:
I- WWE Hall of Fame ihholo lodumo elihlonipha abadlali be- wrestling abangochwepheshe kanye nobuntu bokulwa obuchwepheshile obunakekelwa yi- WWE.Ekuqaleni eyaziwa ngokuthi "i-WWF Hall of Fame", yasungulwa ngo-1993, lapho u-André the Giant efaniswa nephakheji yevidiyo. Imicimbi yango-1994 kanye neka-1995 yabanjwa ngokuhambisana nemicimbi ekhokhelwayo yeNkosi yeRing yaminyaka yonke futhi umcimbi wango-1996 wabanjwa nomcimbi we- Survivor Series.Ngemuva kokumiswa kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili nangemva kokuba iWorld Wrestling Federation (WWF) iqanjwe kabusha yaba yiWorld Wrestling Entertainment (WWE), ukukhushulwa kwaqala kabusha iHholo Lodumo ngo-2004 futhi sekubambe imikhosi ngokubambisana neWrestleMania kusukela ngaleso sikhathi.Kusukela ngo-2005, izingxenye zemikhosi yokungeniswa ziye zasakazwa kumabonakude futhi kusukela ngo-2014, yonke imikhosi isakazwe ku- WWE Network .

Kusukela ngo-2021, sekunabasubathi abangu-228, kunabadlali be-wrestlers abangu-121 ngabanye, ama-Legacy Inductees angu-46, ama-induction amaqembu angu-17 (ahlanganisa ama-wrestlers angu-49 kulawo maqembu), osaziwayo abangu-12, nabathola i-7 Warrior Award.Ama-wrestlers ayisishiyagalombili angeniswe kabili (ngabanye futhi njengengxenye yeqembu/iqembu lamathegi): URic Flair, uShawn Michaels, uBooker T, uBret Hart, uHulk Hogan, uScott Hall, uKevin Nash, noSean Waltman (ukungeniswa okubili kukaWaltman kunjengoba ilungu leqembu, i- D-Generation X kanye ne- New World Order ). Amalungu angama-58 angeniswe esibhedlela ngemuva kokushona.

Umlando 
I- World Wrestling Federation (WWF) yasungula i-WWF Hall of Fame ngo-1993. Kwamenyezelwa okokuqala ngesiqephu sangoMashi 22, 1993 soMsombuluko Night Raw lapho u-André the Giant, owayeshone cishe ezinyangeni ezimbili ezedlule, wamenyezelwa njengowukuphela komfundi. Eminyakeni emibili eqhubekayo, imikhosi yokungeniswa yayibanjwe kanye nemicimbi yaminyaka yonke yeNkosi Yendandatho ekhokha ngokubuka. Umcimbi wango-1996 wenziwa nomcimbi we- Survivor Series, okokuqala ngqa phambi kwezihlwele ezikhokhayo kanjalo nabasubathi, okwathi ngemva kwalokho, i-Hall of Fame yanqamuka.

Umklomelo Weqhawe 

Ngo-2015, i-WWE yethula Umklomelo Weqhawe kulabo "ababonise amandla angenakunyakaziswa kanye nokubekezela, futhi abaphila impilo ngesibindi nozwelo oluhlanganisa umoya ongenakunqotshwa we -Ultimate Warrior ." 

Nakuba i-WWE iphromotha abamukeli Bendondo Yeqhawe njengama-inductees e-Hall of Fame,  abafakiwe esigabeni se-Hall of Fame ku-WWE.com kanye negalari yezithombe ebonisa "yonke i-WWE Hall of Famer" eyenziwayo. ayiqukethe noma yimuphi umamukeli. 

Lo mklomelo udalwe kulandela ukushona kweQhawe Lama-Ultimate. Phakathi nenkulumo yakhe ye-Hall of Fame ka-April 2014 ngaphambi nje kokufa kwakhe, uphakamise ukuthi kube nesigaba esikhethekile esibizwa ngokuthi "i-Jimmy Miranda Award" yabasebenzi base-WWE abangemuva kwesigcawu.  UMiranda, owashona ngo-2002, ubeyingxenye yomnyango wezokuthengisa we-WWE iminyaka engaphezu kwengu-20.Owayengummemezeli weringi we-WWE u-Justin Roberts uzwakalise ukudumala ngendlela i-WWE esebenzise ngayo izingxenye zenkulumo ye-Warrior's Hall of Fame ukuze ikhuthaze umklomelo kodwa wazishiya ngaphandle izinhloso zikaQhawe zokuhlonipha izisebenzi ze-WWE ezingaphandle kwesikrini.I-WWE iphendule yathi, "Kuyacasula ukuphakamisa ukuthi i-WWE kanye nabaphathi bayo bananoma yini, kodwa izinhloso zokuzinikela ekuhlonipheni u- Connor kanye nefa lakhe nge-The Warrior Award", wengeza ngokuthi "ukuqhubekela phambili umklomelo uzonikezwa minyaka yonke ukuze kuqashelwe amanye amaqhawe angakaze abonwe phakathi kweWWE's. abasebenzi nabalandeli".Kusukela ngo-2019 bonke abemukeli bebengabasebenzi be-WWE.

title: WWE Championship
text:
I- WWE Championship iwumpetha womhlaba we-heavyweight odalwe futhi wakhuthazwa i- WWE ekhokhelwayo ye- wrestling yaseMelika, okwamanje evikelekile esigabeni sayo sohlobo lwe- Raw.Ngesinye sezicoco zomhlaba ezintathu ze-WWE, eduze ne- Universal Championship ku- SmackDown kanye ne- NXT Championship ku- NXT . Umpetha wamanje nguBig E, osekubusweni kwakhe kokuqala.

Umqhudelwano wokuqala womhlaba wokuphromotha, wasungulwa yi- World Wide Wrestling Federation (WWWF) ngo-Ephreli 25, 1963, njenge-WWWF World Heavyweight Championship, ngemuva kokukhushulwa kwehlukana ne- National Wrestling Alliance (NWA).Umpetha wokuqala kwakunguBuddy Rogers . Selokhu sasungulwa, isihloko senziwe izinguquko eziningi zamagama ngenxa yokushintshwa kwamagama enkampani kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwesihloko. Umqhudelwano omdala kunayo yonke osebenzayo njengamanje e-WWE, futhi uvezwa njengesicoco esihlonishwa kakhulu sephromoshini, esinamameshi amaningi esihlokweni anesihloko semicimbi ekhokhelwa umuntu ngamunye uma eyibuka – okuhlanganisa nomcimbi ovelele we-WWE i-WrestleMania .Emiqhudelwaneni esezingeni eliphezulu, ithathwa njengomunye wemiqhudelwano ehlonishwayo eyake yabakhona. 

Kusukela ekuqaleni kwayo kuze kube ngu-2001, yathuthukiswa njengokuphela komqhudelwano oyinhloko we-WWE. Isicoco somhlaba esengeziwe, uMqhudelwano we-WCW, sengezwe ngemuva kokuthengwa kweWorld Wrestling Federation yangaleso sikhathi i- World Championship Wrestling ekuqaleni kuka-2001. Lezi zihloko kamuva zahlanganiswa njengoMqhudelwano Ongaphikisiwe . Ngemuva kokuhlukaniswa komkhiqizo wokuqala ngo-2002 kanye nokunyuswa kwegama ku- WWE, ubuqhawe bube obukhethekile ku-SmackDown, futhi i- World Heavyweight Championship yadalelwa i-Raw. I-ECW yaba uhlobo lwesithathu ngo-2006, yengeza umqhudelwano we- ECW . Leso sihloko senziwa sangasebenzi ngo-2010, kwathi iWorld Heavyweight Championship yahlanganiswa kuWWE Championship ngo-2013. Umqhudelwano uphinde waba ukuphela kwesihloko somhlaba se-WWE kwaze kwaba yilapho kwethulwa i-Universal Championship ngokuhlukaniswa kohlobo lwe-2016. Phakathi nokuhlukana kokubili komkhiqizo, i-WWE Championship ishintshe izinhlobo, ngokuvamile ngenxa ye- WWE Draft ; ngo-2019, isihloko sathuthela ku-Raw ngemva kokubusa kuka- Brock Lesnar ukuyeka i-SmackDown kulandela izehlakalo ze- Crown Jewel . I-NXT Championship iphinde yaqashelwa njengesicoco somhlaba sesithathu se-WWE ngalesi sikhathi.

Izimpi Zasebusuku ZangoMsombuluko kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwesihloko 

Ngo-1991, iWorld Championship Wrestling (WCW), eyilungu le-NWA, yasungula iWCW World Heavyweight Championship ukuze ithathe indawo yesicoco somhlaba se-NWA. Ngo-1993, i-WCW yazihlukanisa ne-NWA futhi yakhula yaba yimbangi yokukhushulwa ku-WWF. Zombili izinhlangano zakhula zaba ukuvelela okujwayelekile futhi ekugcineni zahileleka empini yezilinganiso zethelevishini, ebizwa ngokuthi Izimpi Zasebusuku NgoMsombuluko . Ngasekupheleni kwempi yokulinganisa, i-WCW yaqala ukwehla kwezimali, okwafinyelela umvuthwandaba ngokuthi i-WWF ithenge i-WCW ngo-March 2001.  Njengomphumela wokuthenga, i-WWF yazuza, phakathi kwezinye izimpahla, imiqhudelwano ye-WCW . Ngakho-ke, kwakukhona iziqu ezimbili zomhlaba ku-WWF: i-WWF Championship yokuqala kanye ne-WCW Championship, eyagcina iqanjwe kabusha ngokuthi "World Championship".

Izingxabano zobuqhawe

Isihloko sihlanganisiwe futhi nokuhlukaniswa komkhiqizo wesibili 

Ngemva kokuphela kokuhlukaniswa komkhiqizo wokuqala ngo-Agasti 2011, bobabili i-WWE Champion kanye ne-World Heavyweight Champion bangavela kokubili i- Raw ne- SmackDown NgoNovemba 2013, ngobusuku obungemva kochungechunge lwe-Survivor Series, u-John Cena owayephethe i-World Heavyweight Champion wenza inselele ku-WWE Champion u- Randy Orton ukuze anqume umpetha womhlaba ongenambangi we-WWE. U-Orton wehlule u-Cena kumdlalo we- TLC ku- TLC: Tables, Ladders & Chairs pay-per-view ngoDisemba 15, 2013, ukuze kuhlanganiswe lezi zihloko. Kamuva, umqhudelwano obumbene waqanjwa kabusha ngokuthi i-WWE World Heavyweight Championship futhi wagcina uhlu lwe-WWE Championship; iWorld Heavyweight Championship yahoxiswa.  U-Orton kanye nompetha abalandelayo babambe womabili amabhande omqhudelwano kwaze kwanikezwa ibhande elilodwa lobuqhawe u-Brock Lesnar obusayo ngo-August 2014. 

Ngemuva kokuthi uDean Ambrose abe ngumpetha ngoJuni 2016, igama lesicoco labuyiselwa ku-WWE Championship.Ngenxa yokubuya komkhiqizo ohlukaniswe ngenyanga elandelayo, u-Ambrose wabhalwa ku-SmackDown . U-Ambrose wabe esesigcina isicoco sakhe e- Battleground ngoJulayi 24 eqhudelana nabahleli be-Raw u- Seth Rollins kanye ne- Roman Reigns, okwenza isihloko sikhethelwe i-SmackDown kuphela.NgoJulayi 25 isiqephu se- Raw, ukubhekana nokuntuleka kwesihloko somhlaba somkhiqizo, i- WWE Universal Championship yadalwa; U-Finn Bálor ube ngumpetha wokuqala e- SummerSlam .Ngemva kokwembulwa kwesihloko se-Universal, i-WWE Championship yaqanjwa kabusha ngokuthi i-WWE World Championship,kodwa yabuyiselwa ku-WWE Championship ngo-December 2016 ngesikhathi sokubusa kokuqala kwe- AJ Styles. 

Ku- Crown Jewel ngo-Okthoba 31, 2019, i-SmackDown wrestler "The Fiend" uBray Wyatt uwine i-Universal Championship, ngaleyo ndlela edlulisela isicoco ku-SmackDown. Futhi kulowo mcimbi, ngemva kokubusa kwe-WWE Champion u-Brock Lesnar wayenqobe u- Cain Velasquez ukuze agcine isicoco, wahlaselwa ngu-Raw's Rey Mysterio, u-Lesnar ayehlasele emasontweni ambalwa ngaphambili..Ngobusuku obulandelayo ngoLwesihlanu Night SmackDown, U-Lesnar wayeka i-SmackDown futhi waya e-Raw ukuze aqhubeke nokuxabana kwakhe noMysterio, ngaleyo ndlela adlulisele i-WWE Championship ku-Raw.Ngo-2021, umqhudelwano we- NXT, owawusungulelwe i- NXT ngo-2012 (futhi wawuyindawo ethuthukisiwe ye-WWE kwaze kwaba ngu-2019), wawuzoqashelwa njengesicoco somhlaba wesithathu ngesikhathi esisodwa ekunyusweni.

Ukuqokwa komkhiqizo 
Ngokuhlukaniswa komkhiqizo wokuqala, uhlaka lwaminyaka yonke lwasungulwa ngo-2002. Unyaka ngamunye (ngaphandle kuka-2003), Abaphathi-Jikelele babamba iqhaza kulotho esalungiswa lapho amalungu akhethiwe ohlu lwe-WWE abelwa uhlobo. I-ECW evuselelwe yaba uhlobo lwesithathu kusukela ngo-2006 kuya ku-2010. Ngomhla zingama-29 ku-Agasti 2011, i-WWE yaqeda ukunwetshwa komkhiqizo futhi abagijimi (okuhlanganisa nabo bonke ompetha), babe sebekhululekile ukuvela kunoma yiluphi uhlelo.

Imiklamo yebhande lobuqhawe

1963-1982 

Ngenkathi yethulwa ngo-1963, iWWWF World Heavyweight Championship yasekuqaleni yayimelwe yibhande lobuqhawe laseMelika uBuddy Rogers ayelivikele esikhathini esithile ngaphambi kokuba abe ngumpetha womhlaba wokuqala weWWWF. Ipuleti elimaphakathi laleli bhande laliwuhlaka lwezwekazi lase-United States futhi kwakukhona amapuleti asemaceleni amise okwehawu anama-grappler kuwo; amapuleti ayephezu kwebhande lesikhumba elibomvu. Epuletini elimaphakathi, kwakukhona indingilizi ephahlwe ama-grapplers, futhi indilinga yayiklanyelwe ukuqukatha isithombe somnikazi wesihloko. Ngenhla kwesiyingi kwakunehawu elinokhozi phezu kwalo elinezinkanyezi ezinhlangothini eziphambene zesihlangu. Amagama-ncazo "Umpetha Womhlaba" angezwe ngaphansi kombuthano. Leli bhande lesihloko laligqokwe yingqwele yokuqala uBuddy Rogers ngo-1963 kanye nompetha wesibili uBruno Sammartino.  Ngemuva kokuthi u-Sammartino abe ngumpetha, kwasungulwa ibhande lesihloko esisha ngebhande eliluhlaza. Ucezu oluphakathi nendawo olukhulisiwe luqukethe imbulunga enomqhele kanye nama-grapplers amabili, futhi ufundeka "WWWF World Champion"; amapuleti amabili aseceleni abekhumbula ukunqoba kwesicoco sikaSammartino. USammartino wayegqoke le nguqulo isikhathi sokubusa kwakhe kweminyaka eyisikhombisa. Ngemva kokunqoba u-Sammartino ngoJanuwari 1971, u-Ivan Koloff wabamba le nguqulo amasonto amathathu ngaphambi kokuba alahlekelwe nguPedro Morales . 

Ngesikhathi sokubusa kukaMorales, ibhande lobuqhawe labuyekezwa izikhathi ezimbalwa. Okokuqala ngo-1971, lo mklamo wawusebhandeni elinemibala ye-indigo futhi wawuqukethe amapuleti amathathu amise okwehawu. Ngezansi kwepuleti elimaphakathi, elifundeka ngokuthi "World Heavyweight Champion" futhi linesiphambano phakathi nendawo, ipuleti elihlukile elivundlile lifundeka ngokuthi "WWWF". Lokhu kwathathelwa indawo omunye umklamo ngo-1972. Le nguqulo, emgqeni obomvu, ifundeka ngokuthi "WWWF Heavyweight Wrestling Champion" emaphethelweni kunokhozi phakathi nendawo, kanti amapuleti asemaceleni ayisithupha amele amazwe amaningana. Ngo-1973 kwethulwa omunye umklamo ofanayo; lena yayisebhandeni elimnyama futhi iqukethe ama-grappler amabili ngaphezu kokhozi oluklanywe ngendlela ehlukile. Le nguqulo yabe ibanjwe ngu- Stan Stasiak, u-Bruno Sammartino, u- Superstar Billy Graham - owayegqoke ukuhluka kwesikhumba esibomvu - no- Bob Backlund . Ngesikhathi sokubusa kwakamuva, igama lephromoshini lafushaniswa laba yi-World Wrestling Federation (WWF), kodwa ibhande lobuqhawe lomzimba lisafundeka kanje "WWWF".

1982-2005

Imiklamo eyenziwe ngokwezifiso 

Amabhande obuqhawe angokwezifiso adalelwe ukuhlonipha ompetha abathile ababusayo noma ukufanisa abalingisi babo. Phakathi nokubusa kukaHogan ngo-1986, wayenenguqulo eguquliwe ye-Hogan '86 eyenziwe, ehlanganisa isithombe sakhe esikhungweni.Lona bekuwumklamo wangokwezifiso owaphila isikhashana njengoba ebuyela enguqulweni ye-Hogan '86.Inguqulo enkulu kakhulu efana nebhande lobuqhawe lika-Hogan '86 ladalelwa u- André the Giant ngaphambi kwe- WrestleMania III, nakuba engakaze aligqoke njengompetha.

Umbusi 

I-WWE Championship yayiwumqhudelwano wokuqala womhlaba owethulwa ekukhuthazeni ngo-1963. Umpetha wokuqala kwakunguBuddy Rogers, kanti sekube nompetha abasemthethweni abahlukene abangama-54 kanye nezikhala eziyi-11.Umpetha ophethe isikhathi eside kunabo bonke nguBruno Sammartino, obambe lesi sicoco kusukela ngoMeyi 17, 1963, kuya kuJanuwari 18, 1971, ingqikithi yezinsuku eziyi-2,803 (iminyaka eyi-7, izinyanga eziyi-8, nosuku olungu-1); I-Sammartino iphinde ibe nerekhodi lokubusa okude kakhulu okuhlanganisiwe ezinsukwini ezingu-4,040.  U-André the Giant ungumpetha obusayo omfushane kunabo bonke, ubambe ngokusemthethweni isicoco umzuzu ongu-1, imizuzwana engama-48.  Umpetha omncane nguBrock Lesnar, owanqoba lesi sicoco eneminyaka engu-25, kanti umpetha omdala nguMnu McMahon, owasinqoba eneminyaka engu-54. UJohn Cena uphethe irekhodi lokubusa izikhathi eziningi enezingu-13. 

UBig E ungumpetha wamanje ekubuseni kwakhe kokuqala. Uwine isicoco ngokwenza imali ngenkontileka yakhe ethi Money in the Bank futhi ehlula uBobby Lashley ngoSepthemba 13, 2021, isiqephu seRaw eBoston, Massachusetts .I-Big E kuphela i-wrestler yesine yase-Afrika-yaseMelika ukunqoba i-WWE Championship, ngemuva kwe- The Rock ngo-1998, u- Kofi Kingston ngo-2019, no-Bobby Lashley ekuqaleni kuka-2021.

title: IMfundiso neziVumelwano
text: IMfundiso neziVumelwano (ngezinye izikhathi efushanisiwe futhi ekhonjwe ngokuthi D&C noma D. kanye no-C. ) iyingxenye yohlu lwemibhalo engcwele oluvulekile lwamahlelo amaningana enhlangano yabaNgcwele beziNsuku Zokugcina.Ishicilelwe okokuqala ngo-1835 njengeDoctrine and Covenants of the Church of the Latter Day Saints: Ikhethwe Ngokucophelela Ezambulweni ZikaNkulunkulu, izinhlelo zencwadi ziyaqhubeka nokunyatheliswa ikakhulukazi yiBandla likaJesu Kristu Labangcwele Bezinsuku Zokugcina (LDS Church) futhi umphakathi kaKristu (ngaphambili owawuyiBandla LikaJesu Kristu Elihlelelwe Kabusha LamaSanta Ezinsuku Zokugcina [RLDS Church]).

title: Ukwenza amasoseji
text:
Imvelaphi yokulondolozwa kwenyama yalahleka kudala kodwa cishe yaqala lapho abantu beqala ukubona ukubaluleka kokulondoloza usawoti.Ukwenza amasoseji kwasungulwa njengendlela yokugcina nokuthutha inyama .Imiphakathi yasendulo yafunda ukuthi amajikijolo omisiwe nezinongo kwakunganezelwa enyameni eyomisiwe. Inqubo ye ukugxusha inyama ku casings uhlala ngokuyisisekelo elifanayo namuhla, kodwa zokupheka isoseji ziye elicwengisiswe kakhulu futhi ukwenza isoseji isibe ohlonishwa kakhulu ubuciko Culinary. 

Amasoseji atholakala ngezinhlobo ezimbili eziyinhloko: amasha futhi alashiwe.Amasoseji aphulukisiwe angase aphekwe noma omisiwe.Ayi abaningi belashwa kuthiwa ngibhema, kodwa lokhu akuyona impoqo. Inqubo yokwelapha ngokwayo ishintsha inyama futhi inikeze ukunambitheka kwayo.isibonelo umehluko wokunambitha phakathi kwenyama yengulube nenyama yengulube .

Wonke amasoseji abhemayo eselaphekile. Isizathu siwusongo lwe- botulism . I-bacterium enesibopho, i- Clostridium botulinum, itholakala yonke indawo emvelweni, ikhula ngaphansi kwezimo ze -anaerobic ezidalwe ngaphakathi kwesoseji, futhi ikhula kahle izinga lokushisa elivamile endlini yentuthu kanye nesitoreji se-ambient esilandelayo. Ngakho-ke, ngenxa yezizathu zokuphepha, amasoseji aphulukiswa ngaphambi kokubhema.

Izinhlobo zamasoseji nokugcinwa kwazo

Amasoseji amasha 
Amasoseji amasha ayinyama egayiwe ephekwe ngaphambi kokuphakelwa.Amasoseji amasha ngokuvamile awasebenzisi ikhambi (Prague powder #1) nakuba ukwelapha kungasetshenziswa uma uthanda.Ngaphezu kwalokho amasoseji amasha awasebenzisi izinambitheka zentuthu, nakuba intuthu ewuketshezi ingasetshenziswa. Amasoseji amasha awabhenywa kumuntu obhemayo obandayo ngenxa yengozi ye- botulism.

Izinongo eziyinhloko kumasoseji amasha usawoti kanye noshukela kanye namakhambi amnandi nezinongo ezihlukahlukene, futhi ngokuvamile imifino, kuhlanganise no-anyanisi nesweli.

Isoseji elisha laseBrithani ngokuvamile liqukethe cishe u-10% we- butcher rusk, u-10% wamanzi, u-2.5% wezinongo, kanye no-77.5% wenyama.Lapho kudayiswa khona, amasoseji aseBrithani azovame ukulebulwa ngokuthi "okuqukethwe kwenyama yangempela X%".Njengoba inyama ingaba namafutha noma inomzimba omncane, i-X% ibalwa kusetshenziswa amathebula ereferensi ngenhloso yokunikeza ukumeleleka okuhle kokuqukethwe kwenyama "ethambile" ebonakalayo.

Amasoseji aphekiwe aphekiwe 
Amasoseji aphulukisiwe ahlukile kumasoseji amasha ngokufaka amathisipuni amabili okwelapha (impushana yasePrague #1) kwayi-10 amakhilogremu omkhiqizo ophelile.Lokhu kuvame ukutolikwa ngabayi-10 amakhilogremu enyama. Lokhu kusebenza ku-4 ama-ounces wokwelapha angu-100 amakhilogremu amasoseji.

Okulandelayo umkhiqizo ngokuvamile uyashisa. Kodwa-ke, imiphumela efanayo ingafinyelelwa ngokufaka intuthu yoketshezi ku-iresiphi.Amazinga okushisa okubhema ayahluka futhi ngokuvamile angaphans.Ezingeni lokushisa elingu-152 °F (67 °C) lamasoseji asephekwe ngokugcwele.

Kwezinye izimo kusetshenziswa intuthu ebandayo. Uma kunjalo, kungenzeka ukuthi isoseji ibiphekwe ngaphambilini emanzini okugeza aphethwe endaweni yokushisa efanele. Isibonelo sale nqubo ukulungiswa kwe- Braunschweiger . Kulesi sitayela sesoseji, ngemuva kokugxusha   hog buns noma ama-fiberous casings, isoseji licwiliswa  amanzi 2 kuya amahora kuze kufike izinga lokushisa langaphakathi . Kuleli qophelo isoseji kufanele lifakwe emanzini eqhwa, bese kubanda libhenywe ekushiseni  amahora angu-2-3.

Amasoseji omile aphulukisiwe 
Amasoseji omile aphekiwe alungiswa ngendlela efana namasoseji aphekiwe aphekiwe. Umehluko omkhulu wukuthi i-Prague powder #2 izosetshenziswa esikhundleni se-Prague powder #1.Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele kusetshenziswe inyama eqinisekisiwe.Njengoba le mikhiqizo ingashisiswa kuze kufike ezingeni lokushisa elingabulala ama-trichinella parasites, kuyadingeka ukufeza lokhu ngezinye izindlela.Indlela evamile yikuqandisa. Ingulube ingase inikezwe ukuthi yamukeleke ukuthi isetshenziswe kumasoseji omile ngokuyiqandisa.

Imithethonqubo ethile iyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu. Zincike ekushubeni kokusikeka kwenyama, indlela yokupakisha, nezinye izici.Ukwengeza kunezidingo eziqondile kakhulu mayelana nezikhathi emakamelweni okomisa kanye namazinga okushisa emakamelweni entuthu.

Nakuba kungenzeka ukuthi ikhishi elincane lamasoseji noma umuntu wokuzilibazisa akhiqize amasoseji omile apholile, kudingeka ulwazi oluningi lwezobuchwepheshe. Kungenjalo, ingulube eqinisekisiwe ingamane ithengwe.

Izisetshenziswa 

Izisetshenziswa zincike esikalini, umshini wokugaya omncane wasekhaya kanye namanye amathuluzi okulinganisa ayisisekelo angase abe yikho konke okudingekayo.Emsebenzini wokuhweba ngezinga elikhulu, kuyodingeka imishini yevolumu ephezulu.

Kuthathwa njengezingcezu ezintathu zemishini ebaluleke kakhulu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi lingakanani isoseji elenziwayo ithermometer enembile, isikali esilinganisiwe, kanye nomshini wokugaya inyama.Amasoseji abhenyiweyo noma abhemayo/aphekiwe adinga umuntu obhemayo (amaqoqo amancane) noma indawo yokudayisa.Amasoseji aphekiwe ohlobo lwe-emulsion, njenge-frankfurters noma i-bologna, asebenzisa i-chopper yesitsha ukuze enze inhlama yenyama egaywe kahle efakwa emabhokisini bese iphekwa noma ibhenywe.

Inyama nezinye izithako 
A ezihlukahlukene inyama fresh lingasetshenziswa ngokwenza amasosishi ezivamile bavela yenkomo, inyama yengulube, iwundlu, inkukhu, Turkey, futhi umdlalo. Inyama kufanele ibe yintsha, isezingeni eliphezulu, ibe nenani elifanele le-lean-to-fat kanye nezimfanelo ezinhle zokubopha. Inyama akufanele ingcoliswe amagciwane noma amanye ama-microorganisms.Ukuhlanganisa izinongo nezinongo ngamanani ahambisanayo kubalulekile.

Ukwelapha usawoti 
Ukwenza amasoseji omile kuhilela ukuphulukisa usawoti, aqukethe i- sodium nitrite ne- sodium nitrate.Ama-nitrites asetshenziswa kuzo zonke izinhlobo zamasoseji futhi avame kakhulu. Ama-nitrate asetshenziswa kuphela ekulungiseleleni isitayela esomile esiphulukisiwe samasoseji.Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ama-nitrate aguqulwa abe ama-nitrites ngamabhaktheriya angapheli noma angeziwe. 

Isimiso sokugaya ukudla komuntu sikhiqiza ama-nitrites, okucatshangwa ukuthi yilokho okuvimbela i- botulism, eyayizophumelela ezimweni ze- anaerobic kanye nobubanzi bokushisa besistimu yokugaya ( gut ).

Imikhiqizo yenyama eselashiwe ngokuvamile iqukethe ngaphansi kwama-40 ppm nitrites. 

Izengezo ze-Potassium nitrite ne- potassium nitrate zivumela ukukhiqizwa kwamasoseji anamazinga aphansi e-sodium.Uma usebenzisa ifomu le-potassium, kuyadingeka ukufaka ezinye izithako ukuze ufihle ama-flavour ababayo anikezayo. Izindlela zokupheka ezindala zisebenzisa i- saltpetre enganconywa . Isizathu esiyinhloko siwukuthi ngokuvamile lezi zokupheka ezindala ziqukethe izithako ezokwelapha izikhathi eziningi kunalokho ezifanele. Amasu esimanje atholakala kalula futhi enza umsebenzi ongcono kakhulu.

Embonini yesoseji ama-nitrites kanye nama-nitrate akhiwa ngaphambilini abe yimikhiqizo ebizwa ngokuthi i-Prague powder #1 kanye ne-Prague powder #2. I-Prague powder #1 iqukethe u-6.25% we-sodium nitrite kanye ne-93.75% ye-sodium chloride futhi isetshenziselwa ukulungiswa kwazo zonke izinyama namasoseji eselashiwe ngaphandle kohlobo olomile.Iprague powder #2 iqukethe 1 i-ounce ye-sodium nitrite (6.25%) kanye ne-0.64 ama-ounces sodium nitrate (4.0%) ngephawundi ngalinye lomkhiqizo oqediwe (okusele okungu-14.36 ama-ounces yi-sodium chloride) futhi isetshenziselwa ukulungisa amasoseji omile eselashiwe. I-Prague powder #2 akufanele neze isetshenziswe kunoma yimuphi umkhiqizo ozothoswa ekushiseni okuphezulu (isib. ubhekeni ) ngenxa yokwakhiwa kwama- nitrosamines.

Uma usebenzisa ikhambi, kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi ungalokothi udlule inani elinconyiwe elingu-2.5 amagremu e-Prague powder # 1 ku-1 kilogram yenyama (ama-ounces angu-4/100 amakhilogremu).Ngokulinganayo lokhu kungu-10 mL ku-4.5 kg (2 amathisipuni 10 amapondo).Qaphela ukuthi inani eliphakeme elivumelekile le-sodium nitrite ne-potassium nitrite lilawulwa yimithetho futhi likhawulelwe ku-7. amagremu ngama-45 kg (0.25 ama-ounces nge-100 pounds) yenyama eqotshiwe.Njengoba i-Prague powder #1 iyi-dilution engu-1:15 (ku-0.45 kg ye-Prague powder #1 30 amagremu yi-sodium nitrite kanye nama-425 amagremu angusawoti wetafula ovamile), sithola inani elifanele ngenani elingu-114 amagremu engezwe ku-  yenyama.

I-sodium nitrate ne-potassium nitrate ilinganiselwe ku-1.7 igremu ngekhilogremu (ama-ounces angu-2.75 ngamakhilogremu angu-100).

I-sodium ne-potassium nitrite inobuthi impela kubantu futhi umthamo obulalayo ucishe ube ngu-4 amagremu. Kancane kancane njengoba 22 mg/kg wesisindo somzimba ungadala ukufa.Lokhu cishe ku-2.2 amagremu wesisindo somzimba esiyi-100 kg.Ngakho, kukhona i-sodium nitrite eyanele ku-2 ama-ounces e-Prague powder # 1 ukubulala umuntu. 

I-Morton's Tenderquick igama lomkhiqizo lenye ukwakheka kwe-sodium nitrite, enosawoti kanye noshukela. Akukhona ukugxila okufanayo njengokuthi "Prague powder #1 noma #2".Njengoba isiqiniseko mayelana nenani le-nitrite elikhona eresiphi libalulekile ekuphepheni, umuntu akanakuthatha iresiphi eyenzelwe impushana yasePrague futhi amane afake esikhundleni senani lemikhiqizo efana ne-Morton's Tenderquick.Ukwenza kanjalo kungadala ingozi ye-botulism. Ngokufanayo, umuntu akakwazi ukufaka i-Prague powder #1 esikhundleni se-Morton's Tenderquick. Kunoma yikuphi ukushintshwa okunjalo, umuntu kufanele abale inani eliqondile le-nitrite elidingekayo futhi enze izinguquko ezifanele.

Qaphela: Isilinganiso sevolumu nesisindo sisebenza kumakhambi nezinongo kuphela.Lokhu akubonisi neze inani elithile leresiphi enikeziwe.

Isiko 
Ukwenziwa kwamasoseji kwesinye isikhathi kubhekwa njengokungcolile esikweni elibanzi.Kukhona izisho ezivamile njengokuthi "indlela isoseji lenziwa ngayo" ukubhekisela enqubweni omunye umuntu angase angayazi yonke imininingwane ye-gory.Lo mugqa wokucaphuna uvela kumbongi waseMelika uJohn Godfrey Saxe, owathi "Imithetho, njengamasoseji, iyayeka ukukhuthaza inhlonipho ngokulingana njengoba sazi ukuthi yenziwa kanjani" (1869).

title: WWE Niagara Falls
text:
I-WWE Niagara Falls yayiyisitolo sokudayisa esise Niagara Falls, e-Ontario, eCanada . Yayiphethwe futhi isetshenziswa yi-Canadian Niagara Hotels Inc., igama layo kanye nophawu lwayo olunikezwe ilayisense yi-WWE.Bekungokwesibili ukusungulwa kwe-WWE ukuvulwa ngemuva kweThe World ngo-1999, kanye nokusungulwa kwe-WWE yokuqala ukuvula ngaphandle kwe- United States.Ngemuva kokuthi i-The World ivaliwe ngo-2003, yaba ukuphela kwesitolo esisemthethweni se-WWE emhlabeni.

Umlando 
Indawo yamenyezelwa ngesikhathi kunengqungquthela yabezindaba yokufinyelela abalandeli beWrestleMania X8 ngasekuqaleni kuka-2002. Lesi sikhungo savulwa ngoJulayi 2002  njengengxenye yomugqa waseClifton Hill eNiagara Falls.Ibiphethwe yi-Canadian Niagara Hotels Inc. abangabanikazi be-Falls Entertainment Avenue Resort. Indawo kwakungenxa isipho esitolo WWE zenkolo kanye nemibukiso ku isibonisi, ukuthengisa konke kusuka action izibalo kanye t-shirts ukuba izincwadi, ama-DVD, Autographs futhi okukhethekile WWE Niagara Falls okuthengiswayo uphawu.Lesi sitolo besinendawo ekhangayo ebizwa ngokuthi i-Pile Driver, okususelwa kumnyakazo womkhalambazo, ohlanganisa  . Lokhu kukhanga bekuvuliwe kusukela maphakathi noMeyi kuya maphakathi noNovemba ngenxa yesidingo sesizini kanye nezizathu zesimo sezulu.

Le ndawo iphinde ibe nemidlalo yevidiyo kanye ne-pay-per-views edlalwa ukujabulisa izivakashi, kanye nezindikimba eziningi zokungena ze-WWE nomculo womcimbi, ikakhulukazi umsindo okhiqizwa nguJim Johnston . Phakathi neminyaka embalwa yokuqala yokusebenza, okuphakelayo kwevidiyo okuyimizuzu engamashumi ayisithupha kwasebenza kuso sonke isitolo, futhi lokhu kwakutholakala kuwo wonke amahhotela e-Canadian Niagara Hotels Inc. abhalwe njengesiteshi se-WWE - asetshenziselwa ukukhangisa isitolo kubavakashi. Ingxenye engaphezulu yesitolo inombukiso wokukhanya wasendlini wamahhala eminyakeni yawo yokuqala yokusebenza.

Ekuvulweni kwayo, u- Trish Stratus, uChris Benoit, no- Val Venis bafika ukuze basayine ama-autographs kubalandeli futhi bavule ngokusemthethweni isitolo.  Ukusayina kukaStratus esitolo kungabonakala ku-DVD yakhe yango-2003, i-Trish Stratus: 100% Stratusfaction Guaranteed. Ama-wrestlers amaningi avakashele isitolo ngemuva kwalokho, labo okungoJohn Cena, Batista, Rey Mysterio, Randy Orton, Edge, Rob Van Dam, Mr Kennedy, Booker T, Torrie Wilson, Roddy Piper, Lita, Maven, Gene Okerlund, Stacy Keibler noBobby Heenan . Isitolo siphinde saba nomcimbi okhethekile wezoso zikaJim Ross. Ukusayinda kokugcina isitolo esasiphethwe kwakunguGail Kim no- Evan Bourne ngo-Okthoba 2009.

Ifa 
I-WWE Niagara Falls iyeke ukusebenza kusukela ngo-March 31, 2011.  Isitolo savulwa kabusha ngasekupheleni kuka-2011 njengesitolo sezipho sase-Niagara Falls, nakuba sithengisa izinto ezixubile zokulwa ezifana nezibalo nezingubo. Ngo-2015, isitolo sezipho savalwa futhi indawo yaba ikhaya leNkampani yokuphisa iNiagara. Ngemuva kwalokho ibhilidi lashiswa lalungiswa kabusha. Okuphawuleka kakhulu ukuthi ukugibela inqwaba ophahleni kwashintshwa kwafakwa ithala elingaphandle labadlayo. 

NgoMashi 2017, ukugibela kwenqwaba kwahanjiswa kuMagic Land Theme Park e- Amman, Jordan, lapho kuhlala khona.

Ngo-2021, umlobi we-RD Reynolds wewebhusayithi i-WrestleCrap, ufake le ndawo ohlwini lwesayithi "olubi kakhulu ku-pro wrestling".

title: WWE Great Balls of Fire
text:
I-WWE Great Balls of Fire yayiyi- professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) kanye ne- WWE Network umcimbi owenziwe yi- WWE.Yayibanjelwe ngokukhethekile ama-wrestlers aphuma esigabeni se- Raw brand yephromoshini. Umcimbi wenzeka ngoJulayi 9, 2017, e- American Airlines Center eDallas, eTexas.Isihloko somcimbi sibhekise ingoma kaJerry Lee Lewis enegama elifanayo, esetshenziswe njengengoma yetimu yomcimbi. Kwakuwumcimbi owodwa we-WWE, njengoba kulandela i- WrestleMania 34 ngonyaka olandelayo, ama-PPV akhethekile ayekwa, okuholele ekutheni i-WWE yehlise inani lama-PPV akhiqizwa minyaka yonke.

Kulo mcimbi bekuphingiwe imidlalo eyisishiyagalolunye, okuhlanganisa nowomdlalo wangaphambi kombukiso we-Kickoff.Emcimbini omkhulu, u- Brock Lesnar wehlule i- Samoa Joe ukuze igcine i- Universal Championship . Kukhadi elingaphansi, u- Braun Strowman wehlule u- Roman Reigns kumdlalo we- ambulensi, u- Cesaro no-Sheamus bagcine i - Raw Tag Team Championship bedlala ne -Hardy Boyz ( uJeff Hardy no- Matt Hardy ) emdlalweni we- Iron Man wemizuzu engu-30, kwathi empini yokuvula, uBray. U-Wyatt wehlule u- Seth Rollins .

Ukukhiqiza

Ingemuva 
Ku-2017, i- WWE ihlele ama-Great Balls of Fire njengomcimbi omusha we- pay-per-view (PPV) kanye ne- WWE Network ozobanjwa ngoJulayi 9 kusukela e- American Airlines Center e- Dallas, eTexas.Ukuze kuhambisane nesandiso somkhiqizo esethulwe kabusha ngoJulayi 2016, lapho iphromoshini iphinda ihlukanise uhlu lwazo oluyinhloko phakathi kwemikhiqizo ye-Raw ne- SmackDown lapho ama-wrestlers abelwe ukudlala ngokukhethekile,Great Balls of Fire ifake ngokukhethekile ama-wrestlers avela kumkhiqizo we-Raw. .

Isihloko somcimbi sibhekise ingoma kaJerry Lee Lewis enegama elifanayo, eyagcina isetshenziswe njengengoma yetimu yomcimbi. I-WWE Hall of Famer uJerry Lawler uthe ummeli wakhe, naye owayemele uLewis, wayembuzile mayelana nokuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho mayelana nesihloko, kodwa wathi "wababiza futhi walungisa konke," kuhlanganise nokuthola amalungelo okusebenzisa ingoma ngokwayo. ingxenye yomcimbi.Leli gama lithole ukugxekwa okungekuhle ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.

Imigqa yezindaba 
Ikhadi lalihlanganisa okufanayo okuyisishagalolunye, okuhlanganisa owodwa osembukisweni wangaphambili we-Kickoff, obangelwe ezindabeni ezibhaliwe, lapho abadlali be- wrestling babefanekisela abantu ababi, amaqhawe, noma abalingisi abahlukaniseke kakhulu emicimbini ebhaliwe eyakha ukungezwani futhi efinyelele umvuthwandaba ngomdlalo womkhalambazo noma uchungechunge lwamameshi, imiphumela enqunywe kusengaphambili ababhali be-WWE kumkhiqizo we-Raw. Imigqa yezindaba yakhiqizwa ezinhlelweni zikamabonakude zamasonto onke ze-WWE ngoMsombuluko Night Raw kanye ne- 205 Live, eyokugcina okuyi- cruiserweight -exclusive.

Umcimbi

Umbukiso wangaphambili 
Ngesikhathi sombukiso wangaphambili we-Great Balls of Fire Kickoff, u-Neville wavikela i-WWE Cruiserweight Championship ku-Akira Tozawa (no-Titus O'Neil).Ekugcineni, uNeville wenze i-Spinning Back Kick ku-Tozawa ukuze agcine isihloko.

Imidlalo yokuqala 
Ukubuka kwenkokhelo kwangempela kwavulwa uBray Wyatt ebhekene no-Seth Rollins. U-Wyatt uhlohle iso lika-Rollins futhi wabulala u-"Sister Abigail" ku-Rollins ukuze awine umdlalo. 

Okulandelayo, u-Enzo Amore wabhekana neBig Cass. Ngemuva kokubusa wonke umdlalo, uCass wenze i-Big Boot ku-Amore ukuze anqobe. 

Ngemuva kwalokho, u-Cesaro no-Sheamus bavikele i-Raw Tag Team Championship ku-The Hardy Boyz kumdlalo we-Iron Man wemizuzu engu-30. Ekuqaleni komdlalo, ngemuva kokuthi uCesaro ephazamise uMat, uSheamus wenze "i-Brogue Kick" kuMat ukwenza amaphuzu abe ngu-1-0. U-Sheamus no-Cesaro benze inhlanganisela ye-"White Noise/Diving Neckbreaker" ku-Jeff ukuze bathuthukise umphumela waba ngu-2-0. UJeff wenze "i-Twist of Fate" ku-Cesaro ukwenza amaphuzu abe ngu-2-1. Ngemuva kokuthi uCesaro ephonse uMat epalini, okwamenza wopha, uMatt wabalwa ngaphandle, okwenza amaphuzu abe ngu-3–1. Ngosizo lukaMatt, uJeff wanamathisela uCesaro ngephini lemilenze ehlukene ukwenza amaphuzu abe ngu-3-2. UMatt wenze i-Super "Twist of Fate" ku-Sheamus kwaze kwaba namaphuzu 3-3.Ecabanga ukuthi uSheamus wayeyindoda esemthethweni, uJeff wamdlalela "iBhomu le-Swanton", kodwa waphonswa ngokushesha nguCesaro, owayeyindoda esemthethweni, ukwenza amaphuzu abe ngu-4-3.UJeff wenze "i-Twist of Fate" ku-Cesaro, kodwa phakathi nephinikhodi, umkhawulo wesikhathi uphelelwe yisikhathi, okusho ukuthi u-Cesaro no-Sheamus bagcine izihloko. 

Kamuva, u-Alexa Bliss wavikela iRaw Women’s Championship ku-Sasha Banks.UBhange usebenzise "Isitatimende Sebhange" kodwa uBliss wathinta intambo yeringi.U-Bliss wabe esebalwa, okusho ukuthi uBanks uwine umdlalo, kodwa uBliss wasigcina isicoco. Ngemuva komdlalo, uBanks walwa noBliss esiteji futhi wenza i-"Meteora" ku-Bliss etafuleni lezimemezelo zesiNgisi.

Ukwamukela 
Nakuba igama lomcimbi lithole ukugxekwa okukhulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ikhadi nesethulo samukelwe kahle, umcimbi uthathwe njengenye ye-WWE engcono kakhulu yokubuka inkokhelo ngo-2017.

Ngemva kwalokho 
Ukuhlasela kwangemuva komdlalo kwe-Roman Reigns ku-Braun Strowman kwachazwa kabanzi njengokuzama ukubulala.Ngosuku olulandelayo, kwabikwa ukuthi u-Strowman wayenakekelwa udokotela wakhe, kodwa ubukhulu bokulimala kwakhe abuzange buvezwe.

title: Yout
text:
I-A Yout ( Old Norse Yūt ) iwuhlobo lwenganekwane ngomlando wesiFinnish.Kuwuhlobo lwe- gnome sprite oluhlala ezihlahleni.Kuthiwa bayizixhwanguxhwangu ezidukisa abahambi nokuletha amabhadi kulabo abahlose ukulimaza amahlathi abahlala kuwo.

I-etymology ye-Yout iyaphikiswa. Izazi ziye zaphakamisa imibono eyahlukene mayelana nemvelaphi yako, kuhlanganise nokuthi kungenzeka ukuthi yaqala njengemimoya ehlobene nokufa, noma njengengxube yemibono.Isipelingi sesimanje singaphinda sithathelwe i- British back slang yob ngenxa yezinhlamvu ezifanayo. Ukukhulunywa kokuqala okucacile ngentsha kwakungasekuqaleni kwekhulu le-17 lapho uGustavus Adolphus waseSweden eqala ukuqoqa izinganekwane ezihlukahlukene embusweni wakhe. Lokhu kwakuhlanganisa nezingxenye ezikhuluma isiSwidi zaseFinland . Abanye baye basikisela ukuthi kukhona ngisho nobufakazi bentsha ku- Poetic Edda ; nokho, lesi simangalo sichithwa izazi eziningi.

title: Tipos extraliga
text:
I- Tipos Extraliga (i-Slovak Extraliga) iyiligi ye- ice hockey yezinga eliphezulu kakhulu e- Slovakia.Kusukela ngesizini ka-2018-19 kuya kusizini ka-2020-21, iligi ibihlanganisa amaqembu amabili noma elilodwa laseHungary.Ngo-2009, yakleliswa yi- IIHF njengeligi yesihlanu enamandla kunazo zonke eYurophu kwathi ngo-2012, yabalwa yi -Hockey News njengeligi yesithupha enamandla emhlabeni ngemuva kwe- NHL, KHL, Swedish Hockey League, SM-liiga kanye I-Czech Extraliga.Kodwa-ke, yehle kakhulu kusukela ngaleso sikhathi, ne- American Hockey League, i- Swiss National League kanye ne- German DEL, phakathi kwabanye, bonke manje babekwe phezulu.

Igama leligi liqashiselwa abaxhasi futhi lishintsha njalo. Kusukela ngo-1993/94 kuya ku-1997/98, yayibizwa nge- Extraliga, igama lashintsha laba yiWest Extraliga kwaze kwaba sekupheleni kwesizini ka-2000/01.Ngo-2001/02, igama layo laliyi- Boss Extraliga . Kusukela ngesizini ka-2002/03 kuya ku-2004/05, igama laliyi- ST Extraliga kwathi ngo-2005/06 kwaba yi- T-Com Extraliga.Ngomhla ziyi-16 kuMasingana wezi-2007, igama lashintsha laba yi- Slovnaft Extraliga ngesikhathi kusayinwa isivumelwano soxhaso jikelele ne-Slovnaft, ngo-2011/12 yaba i-Tipsport Extraliga kanye ne-Slovnaft Play-off, futhi kusukela ngesizini ka-2015/16 kwaze kwaba yisizini ka-2019/2020. ibibizwa ngeTipsport liga kanye neSlovnaft Play-off.Igama lamanje i-Tipos Extraliga.

I-Slovak Extraliga isekelwe ku- Czechoslovak Extraliga .Isizini ka-1993/94 bekungeyokuqala ye-Slovak Extraliga ngemuva kokuthi iCzechoslovakia ihlukanise iCzech Republic neSlovakia ngo-1 Januwari 1993.

Umdlalo 
Wonke umdlalo wesizini ojwayelekile wakhiwe izikhathi ezintathu eziyimizuzu engama-20, nekhefu elingumkhawulo wemizuzu eyi-18 phakathi kwezinkathi.Uma igeyimu iboshelwe ngokulandela isikhathi sokulawula esiyimizuzu engama-60, kudlalwa isikhathi esengeziwe sokufa okungazelelwe esiyimizuzu emihlanu kokuthathu kokuthathu.Uma igeyimu isaboshelwe ngemuva kwesikhathi esengeziwe, ukudubulana kuzonquma owinile wegeyimu.Lapho kudutshulwana, iqembu elithola amaphenathi amaningi emizameni emihlanu liwina igeyimu. Uma umdlalo usabambene ngemuva kwemizuliswano emihlanu yamaphenathi, ukudutshulwa kuyaqhubeka umjikelezo nomjikelezo, kuze kube iqembu elilodwa lishaya amaphuzu ngenkathi elinye iqembu lihluleka ukushaya amaphuzu.

Isakhiwo sesizini 
Isizini ye-Tipos Extraliga ihlukaniswe yaba isizini ejwayelekile kusukela ngasekupheleni kukaSepthemba kuya ekuqaleni kukaMashi, lapho amaqembu edlala ngokuqhudelana ohlelweni oluchazwe ngaphambilini, kanye nama- playoffs asukela ngoMashi kuya ku-April, okuwumqhudelwano wokuqeda lapho amaqembu amabili edlala khona. omunye nomunye ukuwina uchungechunge oluhamba phambili kwayisikhombisa ukuze badlulele emzuliswaneni olandelayo.Ophumelele kuma-playoffs uthweswe umqhele wokuba ngumpetha waseSlovakia, ( Slovenský majster ngesiSlovak) futhi uthola i-Vladimir Dzurilla Trophy.

Isizini evamile 
Isizini ejwayelekile iyi- round-robin, lapho iqembu ngalinye lidlala imidlalo engama-50.Amaphuzu amathathu anikezwa ngokuwina ngesikhathi somthetho, amaphuzu amabili ngokuwina ngesikhathi esengeziwe noma ukudubulana, iphuzu elilodwa lokulahlekelwa ngesikhathi esengeziwe noma sokudubula, kanye namaphuzu anguziro ngokulahlekelwa ngesikhathi somthetho.Ekupheleni kwesizini ejwayelekile, iqembu eliqede linamaphuzu amaningi lithweswa isicoco sokuba ngompetha beligi.Amaqembu ayisithupha akleliswe phezulu ngamaphuzu angena ngqo kuma-play-offs. Amaqembu amane akleliswe ku-7-10 adlala uchungechunge oluhamba phambili kwamahlanu kanye nokulwela izindawo ezimbili ezisele zama-playoffs. Iqembu elikleliswe endaweni ephansi ngemuva kwesizini evamile lidlala ochungechungeni lokudilika olubizwa ngokuthi i-Play-Out libhekene neqembu elihamba phambili elisuka kuligi yesigaba sesibili i- Slovak 1. I-Liga.Amaqembu amabili alwela ukuwina uchungechunge oluhamba phambili kwayisikhombisa lwe -Play-Out ukuze afanelekele isizini elandelayo ye-Tipos Extraliga.Ngaphambi kwesizini ka-2018-19, amaqembu ayisishiyagalombili akleliswe phezulu afanelekele ama-playoffs.

title: Orewa Speech
text:
I Orewa Speech kwaba inkulumo ayikhululwa ke-umholi we -New Zealand i-National Party Don Brash kuya Orewa rotary Club 27 Januwari 2004.Ikhulume ngendikimba yobudlelwano bezinhlanga eNew Zealand futhi ikakhulukazi isimo esikhethekile sabantu baseMāori.UBrash wasondela esihlokweni esake sasingavunyelwe ngokumela 'umthetho owodwa wabo bonke' futhi waphetha lokho ayekubona njengamalungelo akhethekile amaMāori.

Okuqukethwe 
UBrash ukhulume ngezinto eziningi zobudlelwano be-Māori-Pākehā enkulumweni yakhe. Ugxeke izinqubomgomo akholelwa ukuthi zihlukanisa abantu, njengamazinga adingekayo okumelwa kwe-iwi kumabhodi ezempilo ezifunda kanye nokwabiwa kwezihlalo zabavoti baseMāori ePhalamende - into ayibiza ngokuthi "i-anachronism".Inkulumo ibhekise ikakhulukazi esimeni seLabour Party ngoMthetho Wase- Foreshore and Seabed, uBrash angavumelananga nawo.Uphinde wangabaza ukusetshenziswa kwamasiko angokomoya amaMāori ezenzakalweni ezisemthethweni kanye nemvelo evulekile yenqubo yokuxazulula isivumelwano.

Ukusabela 
Le nkulumo yaholela ekuvukeleni okukhulu kwe-National Party, ebisiphelelwe amandla okhethweni lwango-2002 .Kusukela ku-28% okhethweni lwenyanga ngaphambi kwenkulumo, iNational Party yeqa ku-45% emasontweni amabili ngemuva kwayo: amaphuzu ayishumi ngaphambi kwezabasebenzi.

Ukuvota kwabonisa ukuthi amaMāori amaningi ayenethezekile ngenkulumo kaBrash, futhi Iqembu Lesizwe layisekela ngemva kwayo, kodwa uGeorgina te Heuheu wasuswa njengomkhulumeli wesifazane weNational Māori Affairs ngemva kokuyigxeka.Kube neqhaza elikhulu ekusunguleni igama likaDon Brash, obesanda kuba ngumholi weqembu.

Emuva kwenkulumo, isikhalo sikaBrash esithi "angidingi uhlanga" sathathwa ngolunye uhlangothi loqhekeko lwezepolitiki, umfelandawonye ophethe iLabour - Progressive.Kwenziwa ucwaningo lwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ukuze kubonakale ukuthi azikho yini izinhlelo ezithinta izinhlanga lapho izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zizokwanela.

ONdunankulu abaningi baseNew Zealand bayigxekile le nkulumo ngesikhathi selokhu yethulwa.UJim Bolger uthe engxoxweni eyanyatheliswa ngo-2017 "kuhlaka" olufanayo nomkhankaso kaDonald Trump ka-2016, nokuthi "abanye abantu balandela izinto ezingenangqondo".OwayenguNdunankulu uHelen Clark (Wezabasebenzi) uthe ngezisusa zikaBrash "ubezokwenza ucwaningo oluningi ngalokho, futhi azi ukuthi kuzoshaya indiva".

Ifa 
UBrash ubuyele e-Orewa ngomhla zingama-25 kuJanuwari 2005, ngethemba lokusebenzisa impumelelo yonyaka odlule, futhi wanikeza inkulumo ngezenhlalakahle kanye nokuncika kwezenhlalakahle.Le nkulumo, ebizwa ngokuthi i- Orewa 2, yehlulekile ukuveza eyokuqala.Le nkulumo iphinde yabangela ukususwa komkhulumeli wezenhlalakahle kaZwelonke u- Katherine Rich, ngoba wehlulekile ukuyigunyaza.U-Brash ubuyile ukuzokwenza 'izinkulumo ze-Orewa' zonyaka njalo ngonyaka kusukela, ngezihloko eziningi ezahlukene.

Incwadi ka-Nicky Hager ka-2006 ethi The Hollow Men ithi inkulumo yabhalwa, ngokwengxenye, nguMichael Bassett, isimangalo esinqatshelwe u-Bassett.

title: Rudo
text:
URudo ( Serbian Cyrillic   ) yidolobha nomasipala oseRepublika Srpska, inhlangano yase Bosnia nase Herzegovina.Kusukela ngonyaka ka-2013, inesibalo sabantu abayi-7,963, kanti idolobha laseRudo linabantu abayi-1,949.

Idume kuwo wonke amaRiphabhulikhi aseYugoslavia njengendawo yokuzalwa ye- 1st Proletarian Brigade eyakhiwe ama- Yugoslav Partisans.

Umlando 
Idolobha laseRudo lasungulwa ngo-1555 nguSokollu Mustafa Pasha, isihlobo esiseduze sika-Ottoman Vizier Sokollu Mehmed Pasha.I-mosque yamatshe, ibhuloho phezu kwe-Lim, i- hamam, inn, i- mekteb (isikole), i- tekke, ezinye izitolo nezindlu zakhiw.Kwashiwo ngu- Evliya Çelebi (1611-1682).  Yambozwa yizikhukhula ngo-1896, yabe isinwetshwa yaba yindawo yokuhlala yasemadolobheni.  Ngemva kokuwa kweRiphabhulikhi yase-Užice kanye nesikhathi esichithwe edolobhaneni lase- Drenova umholi wama- Yugoslav Partisans wafika e-Rudo ngomhla zingama-21 kuZibandlela 1941I- 1st Proletarian Brigade of the Yugoslav Partisans yasungulwa eRudo ngomhlaka-22 Disemba 1941.Itshe lesikhumbuzo elinikezelwe ku-Brigade lakhiwa ngo-1961, nomnyuziyamu owabe wavulwa ngemva kweminyaka eyishumi.

title: XEW-AM
text:
I-XEW-AM iyisiteshi somsakazo eMexico City, eMexico, esisakaza nge- AM frequency ka-900. kHz; ibhalwe ngokuthi W Radio.i-XEW-AM isebenza njengesiteshi sokuqala sezinye iziteshi ze-"W-Radio" ezizungeze i-Mexico eziphatha ezinye zezinhlelo zayo. Uhlelo oluku-XEW-AM luphinde lusakazwe esiteshini somsakazo saseMexico City FM i-96.9 XEW-FM.

Umlando 
I-XEW yaqala ukusakazwa okujwayelekile ngo-20:00 CST ngoSepthemba 18, 1930.Ukusakaza kusuka ekamelweni (kamuva okwaba isitudiyo esifanele) e-Olympia Cinema ngo-16 September Street e-Mexico City, ekuqaleni kwakune-5 kuphela. kW amandla okudlulisa, nakuba lokhu kunyuswe kwaba ngu-50 kW ngo-1934.Ngokufakwa kwama-transmitter amasha, amandla aba ngama-250 kW ngo-1935 futhi yahlala lapho iminyaka engaphezu kuka-80, okwenza i-XEW-AM yaba isiteshi somsakazo se-AM esinamandla kunazo zonke eNyakatho Melika.NgoFebhuwari 10, 2016, i-XEW-AM yagunyazwa ukuthi ithuthele isihambisi sayo endaweni ese-Los Reyes Acaquilpan, kuMasipala wase-La Paz, eSifundazweni SaseMexico futhi yehlise ugesi ube ngama-watts angu-100,000.

Bekuyisiteshi sokuqala sase-Mexico City e- Emilio Azcarraga Vidaurreta 's Chain of the Americas, eyandulela i- Televisa yanamuhla umsakazo wayo osengumnikazi we-XEW-AM.I-XEW-AM ekuqaleni ibisebenzisana ne- NBC Radio Networks (NBC kanye neBlue ); iziteshi zayo ezizayo zizoba nobudlelwano namanethiwekhi ezimbangi, i-XEQ-AM ne- CBS kanye ne- XEX-AM ne- Mutual.Njengoba umsakazo e-Mexico uthuthuka ngokukhula kwezwe kanye neziteshi zomsakazo eziningi ezisayiniwe, i-XEW-AM yaba isikhulu kunethiwekhi yomsakazo enkulukazi yezwe.Iziteshi zomsakazo eziningi nethelevishini zithole izimpawu zazo zocingo emsakazweni nakumabonakude we-XEW, zonke zixhumene neTelevisa ngesikhathi esisodwa. 

E-United States, izinhlamvu zekholi ze- KXEW, isiteshi somsakazo se-AM esithengisayo eTucson, e-Arizona, esiphethwe yi-Pan American Radio Corporation, esasakazwa ngoMeyi 10, 1963, zakhethwa umongameli kanye ne-CEO, u-J. Carlos McCormick., ngenxa yokwazisa kwakhe uVidaurreta, ahlangana naye esemncane ngesikhathi evakashele eDolobheni laseMexico ngo-1950.

I-XEW-FM 
Imvamisa ye-FM, i-96.9, ithole imvume yayo ngo-Ephreli 28, 1962; ayizange yethulwe kwaze kwaba ngawo-1970, futhi ekupheleni kwaleyo minyaka eyishumi, yayiphethe ifomethi ye-disco.Ngo-1981, kwase kushintshelwe ku-"Rock Stereo". NgoSepthemba 9, 1985, yaqanjwa kabusha ngokuthi "WFM" ngefomethi ye-English ye-rock ne-pop, okuwumncintiswano oqondile we-XHSON-FM (ngaleso sikhathi eyaziwa ngokuthi "i-Rock 101").Phakathi kwama-DJ ahambisana nesiteshi kwakukhona u-Alejandro González Iñárritu, uMartha Debayle noCharo Fernández .

Ngemva kweminyaka engu-14, ku-1999, isiteshi sashintsha igama kanye nefomethi ku- "W Radical", eqondiswa inhloko yangaphambili ye-"Rock 101", uLuis Gerardo Salas, i-airing electronic music and eurodance .Ngo-2001, yabuyela efomeni yayo yangaphambili ye-WFM nesiqubulo esithi "Frecuencia Adictiva", kodwa ngasekupheleni kuka-2002, ngemuva kwenhlangano yeTelevisa Radio nePRISA, kwanqunywa ukuba kufakwe uhlelo olufanayo ku-AM naku-FM, ngaleyo ndlela i-XEW-FM. yaba inkundla yezindaba nezingxoxo, nakuba izinhlelo zomculo zisengazwakala ngobusuku nangezimpelaviki lapho imidlalo ingekho ehleliwe.

title: Jesus Is King
text: Articles with hAudio microformats Articles with hAudio microformats Jesus Is King yicwecwe lesishiyagalolunye lomculi waseMelika uKanye West.Ikhishwe ngo-Okthoba 25, 2019, ngomculo OKUHLE futhi yasatshalaliswa yi- Def Jam Recordings.I-albhamu ilandela indikimba yobuKristu, ehlukile emsebenzini wakhe ojwayelekile. UWest wakuchaza ngokuthi "inkulumo yevangeli ".Ihlanganisa ukubonakala kwezivakashi ezivela ku- Clipse, Ty Dolla Sign, Kenny G, Fred Hammond, Ant Clemons, kanye ne- Sunday Service Choir.Ukukhiqizwa kufakwe kusukela eNtshonalanga, Federico Vindver, Angel Lopez, BoogzDaBeast, kanye neTimbaland, phakathi kwabanye. U-West waqala ukuqopha i-albhamu ngo-Agasti 2018, ekuqaleni wayimemezela ngokuthi Yandhi.I-albhamu iphuthelwe izinsuku ezimbili zokukhishwa kokuqala ngoSepthemba nangoNovemba 2018 ngaphansi kwesihloko sokuqala, ngaphambi kokuba ibambezeleke unomphela ngenxa yokuvuza.U-West wayesungule iqembu lakhe levangeli i - Sunday Service Choir ngoJanuwari 2019, ecula izingoma zevangeli kanye namakhava ezingoma ezivela ku-discography yaseNtshonalanga.Ingoma ethi " Amanzi " yenziwe bukhoma ngaphambi kokukhishwa yiqembu. Ngo-Agasti 2019, u- Yandhi wamenyezelwa kabusha njengeNkosi uJesu, kodwa waphuthelwa izinsuku ezimbili zokukhululwa ezazihlelelwe ngasekupheleni kukaSepthemba 2019 ngaphansi kwesihloko esisha. Ukukhishwa kokugcina kwe- Jesus Is King kwenzeka kanyekanye nalokho kwefilimu yekhonsathi enegama elifanayo, okuhlanganisa nenani lamathrekhi njengengxenye yeculo.Izingoma ezithi " Landela uNkulunkulu " kanye nethi " Kuvaliwe ngeSonto " zombili zikhishwe ngoNovemba 2019, zaba phezulu kwama-20 e-US Billboard Hot 100 .I-albhamu ithole ukubuyekezwa okuxubile kubagxeki bomculo, abaningi babo beqhathanisa phakathi kwayo ne-albhamu eyedwa yaseNtshonalanga, Ye (2018).Abanye abagxeki bayincoma indlela eyaqanjwa ngayo, kuyilapho abanye bezwakalisa imizwa engemihle mayelana nezosha kanye nokungavumelani kwemibono. U-Jesus Is King uzuze imiklomelo ye-Top Christian Album kanye ne-Top Gospel Album kuma- Billboard Music Awards ka-2020 kanye ne- Best Contemporary Christian Music Album kuma- Grammy Awards angama -63 ngo-202.Imile njengerekhodi laseNtshonalanga elihlanganisa i-albhamu yesishiyagalolunye ilandelana ukuze iqale phezulu ku-US Billboard 200. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iWest yephule amarekhodi amaningana e- Billboard charts.I-albhamu ibihamba phambili eshadini kwamanye amazwe ayisishiyagalolunye, okuhlanganisa i-Australia neCanada, ngenkathi ifinyelela izikhundla ezinhlanu eziphezulu e-Czech Republic, eFinland, e-Ireland, eNetherlands, eSweden nase-United Kingdom.Inikezwe isitifiketi segolide nesiliva e-United States nase-UK yiRecording Industry Association of America (RIAA) kanye neBritish Phonographic Industry (BPI), ngokulandelanayo.I-albhamu engumngane, uJesu Uyazalwa, yakhululwa ngoDisemba 2019 yiKwaya Yenkonzo YangeSonto. Ingemuva nokurekhodwa Agasti–Novemba 2018: Yandhi, Chicago and Uganda Kuwo wonke uMeyi nangoJuni 2018, ama-albhamu amahlanu anamathrekhi ayisikhombisa akhiqizwe uWest epulazini lakhe eliseJackson Hole, eWyoming akhululwa ngokulandelana njengeWyoming Sessions.I-albhamu yesithathu yesitudiyo somrepha waseMelika u-Pusha T u- Daytona ikhishwe kuqala, kwalandelwa i-albhamu yesitudiyo yesishiyagalombili ye-West ethi Ye, i-albhamu yestudiyo ehlangene yase-West ethi Kids See Ghosts, nomrepha waseMelika u- Kid Cudi njenge- Kids See Ghosts, umrepha waseMelika uNas ' i-albhamu yeshumi nambili ethi Nasir, kanye Icwecwe lesibili lesitudiyo somculi waseMelika uTeyana Taylor i-KTSE ; wonke ama-albhamu akhishwe ngo-2018. Ngomhla ziyi-12 kuMfumfu wezi-2018, iWest yafika e- Uganda futhi yaqala kabusha umsebenzi we-albhamu kusitudiyo esimise okwedome esakhiwe e-Chobe Safari Lodge e- Murchison Falls National Park.IWest yafika nabantu ababalelwa ku-50 futhi yaqopha izinsuku ezinhlanu.Udlale umculo omusha, okuhlanganisa nesitudiyo esirekhodiwe se-remix ethi "We Got Love", yeqembu lezingane zesikole zase-Uganda ezingaba ngu-100 ngesikhathi somcimbi wokupha.Engxoxweni yango-Okthoba 21, 2018, umrepha waseMelika uQuavo uthe u- Migos wakhe abathathu uqophe i-albhamu.NgoNovemba 2018, kulandela ukudlala kwe-Kids See Ghosts no-Kid Cudi kumrepha waseMelika u- Tyler, i-Creator 's Camp Flog Gnaw Carnival, u-West wabhala ku-Twitter ukuthi unomuzwa wokuthi u- Yandhi akaqediwe, nokuthi "wayezomemezela idethi yokukhululwa uma isiqedile, " ibambezela i-albhamu unomphela. UMuvhango wumdlalo owuchungechunge kamabonakude waseNingizimu Afrika, owakhiwe nguDuma Ndlovu . Isakazwa esiteshini sikamabonakude somphakathi i- SABC 2, futhi inababukeli abalinganiselwa ku-4 million nsuku zonke.Isiqephu sokuqala sasakazwa ngomhlaka-7 Ephreli 1997. Kwakuwumdlalo kamabonakude wokuqala wolimi lwesiTshivenda kodwa kamuva waba ngezilimi eziningi ukuze kuboniswe ukuthi izilimi namasiko aseNingizimu Afrika kufanele asetshenziselwe ukuhlanganisa kunokuhlukanisa.UMdali kuMuvhango ngum Zulu ngokozalo, kodwa angakhuluma futhi ngokuqephuza ngazo zonke izilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. 

The show is built on a premise that " umuntu ngumuntu ngabantu " meaning that we exist within a context.Uhlelo lunezindaba eziqinile ezigxile emndenini ezifuna ukukhuluma ngokungqubuzana phakathi kwezindlela zendabuko nezesimanje.AbakwaVhakwevho bangababheki bezinto zendabuko kanti indawo yaseGoli igxile ezindleleni zesimanje.

Ngo-2006 lolu chungechunge lwaqokwa njengendondo yeSouth African Film and Television Award emdlalweni owuchungechunge ohamba phambili. 

U-Elsie Rasalanavho kanye no-Maumela Mahuwa yibona abalingisi asebenesikhathi eside kulo mdlalo.Selokhu baqala ukuvela kuMuvhango ngo-1997. Balandelwa uDingaan Khumalo noGabriel Temudzani, asebebekhona kusukela ngo-2000.U-Elsie Rasalanavho ulingisa indawo kaVho-Mukondeleli Mukwevho, uDingaan Khumalo ubambe indawo kasomabhizinisi uJames Motsamai, uGabriel Temudzani indawo yeNduna u-Azwindini Mukwevho, iNduna yakwaThathe kanti uMaumela Mahuwa ubambe indawo kaMongikazi uSusan Mukwevho, unkosikazi omkhulu kaThathe. iNduna yakwaThathe.

Isakhiwo 
Lo mbukiso wenzelwa eGoli naseVenda.EGoli uJames Motsamai, Khakhathi Mulaudzi, Gugu Nkosi-Zikalala, Imani Nkosi, Hangwani Mukhwevho, Rendani Mukhwevho, imindeni yabo nozakwabo babhekene nezindaba zokucwasana, idrama nodlame ezinkampanini.KwaVenda umndeni wakwaMukhwevho uhola abantu baseThathe ekubeni kukhona iminkenke emndenini wabo.

USuzanne Marie Somers ( née Mahoney ; owazalwa ngo-Okthoba 16, 1946) ungumlingisi, umbhali, umculi, usomabhizinisi kanye nomkhulumeli wezempilo waseMelika.Ubonakale endimeni kamabonakude kaChrissy Snow ku- Three's Company nanjengoCarol Foster Lambert on Step by Step.

Kamuva Somers baba nombhali uchungechunge zokuzisiza izincwadi, kufaka phakathi Ageless: The Naked Iqiniso Bioidentical hormone (2006), mayelana bioidentical yokwelapha hormone.Ukhiphe ama-autobiographies amabili, izincwadi ezine zokudla, kanye nencwadi yezinkondlo.

USomers ugxekwe ngemibono yakhe kwezinye izifundo zezokwelapha kanye nokumela kwakhe i- Wiley Protocol, ebizwa ngokuthi "ayinabufakazi ngokwesayensi futhi iyingozi".Ukukhuthazwa kwakhe kwezinye izindlela zokwelapha umdlavuza uthole ukugxekwa yi- American Cancer Society .

Impilo yomuntu siqu 
Uzalelwe uSuzanne Marie Mahoney eSan Bruno, eCalifornia, uSomers wayengowesithathu kwezingane ezine emndenini wamaKhatholika ase-Irish-American.Unina, uMarion Elizabeth (née Turner), wayengunobhala wezokwelapha, kanti uyise, uFrancis Mahoney, wayeyisisebenzi futhi esebenza engadini.Lapho uSuzanne eneminyaka eyisithupha ubudala uyise waba umlutha wotshwala.Ubaba kaSomers wayembiza ngamagama amphoxe. 

U-Somers wafunda eCapuchino High School Wabuye wathi wayengumgqugquzeli we-cheerleader e-Mercy High School e- Burlingame, e-California, futhi wamukelwa e- San Francisco College for Women, ikolishi eliphethwe yi-Catholic Society of the Sacred Heart order.USomer washada noBruce Somers ngo-1965, eneminyaka engu-19, futhi baba nendodana, uBruce Jr., ngoNovemba 1965. Lowo mshado waphela ngo-1968.

USomers waba imodeli yemiklomelo ku- Anniversary Game (1969-70), lapho ahlangana khona nomsingathi u-Alan Hamel . Bashada ngo-1977.

USomer unabazukulu abathathu, uCamelia, uViolet noDaisy Hamel-Buffa.

U-Somers kwatholakala ukuthi unomdlavuza webele wesigaba II ngo-Ephreli 2000, futhi wahlinzwa i- lumpectomy ukuze asuse umdlavuza okwalandelwa ukwelapha ngemisebe, kodwa wanquma ukuyeka ukwelapha ngamakhemikhali ngenxa yokukhishwa kwe-mistletoe ebilile ebizwa ngokuthi i-Iscador. 

NgoJanuwari 9, 2007, i-Associated Press yabika ukuthi umlilo wequbula eSouthern California ucekele phansi ikhaya likaSomers eMalibu.

Abazalwa nge-1946

title: Capuchino High School
text:
Capuchino High School kuyisikolo esiphakeme e San Bruno, California, United States.Isikole sizungezwe idolobha laseMillbrae kuwo wonke amagumbi ngaphandle kwekhona elilodwa.Kungesinye sezikole eziphakeme eziyisikhombisa esifundeni saseSan Mateo Union High School, okuyingxenye yeHhovisi Lezemfundo Lesifunda saseSan Mateo.

Imbangi kaCapuchino yiMills High School eMillbrae.

Ikhampasi engokomzimba,   ngosayizi, ngaphambili kwakuyi-Spanish Rancho del Capuchino.Isikole savulwa ngoSepthemba 1950. Ekuqaleni kwakunesakhiwo esisodwa esinezitezi ezimbili kuphela ekhempasini; ngo-1953 iningi lekhampasi laqedwa.Kwakhiwa ihholo elinezihlalo ezingu-1 000 ngo-1959, lihambisana nethiyetha encane yesikole.Ngonyaka wezifundo ka-1961-62, ngaphambi nje kokuphothulwa kweSikole Samabanga Aphakeme sase-Crestmoor, ukubhaliswa kwabafundi kwedlula i-1,800 futhi cishe yonke indawo etholakalayo yasetshenziselwa amakilasi.  

Ngo-1963, i- KPIX (Channel 5) yathwebula izigcawu, okuhlanganisa ne-pep rally, esikoleni ngohlelo lwayo lwamasonto onke lwe- High School Salute.Umsakazi u- Dick Stewart uphinde waxoxisana nabafundi nobuhlakani ezitudiyo ze-KPIX ngesikhathi sokusakaza.

Ngo-1976, umfundi uPaula Baxter walahleka ngemuva kokuphuma esikoleni samabanga aphezulu kulandela ukuzilolonga.Isidumbu sakhe, ebesigwaziwe sanukubezwa ngokocansi, satholwa ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbili ngemuva kwesonto eMillbrae.

Ngo-1998, abafundi bahamba izinkulungwane zamakhilomitha befunda nge- Civil Rights Movement.

Izakhamizi ze-SMUHSD zagunyaza i-Measure D ngoNovemba 2000, eyagunyaza uxhaso lwezimali lokulungiswa kwezikole nokwenza zibe zesimanjemanje.ICapuchino inophiko lwesayensi olulungisiwe, inkantolo entsha yemimoya kanye nesakhiwo sokudla, kanye namakilasi amasha amaningana asondelene nesakhiwo esisha sokuphatha.

Izimali ze-Measure M zagunyazwa abavoti be-SMUHSD ngo-2006 okwathi ngokwengxenye baxhasa ngezimali ukwakhiwa kwebhilidi elisha lezobuntu, ezobuciko, nesayensi (HASB) kanye nokulungiswa kabusha kwetiyetha.Ngo-April 2012 kwaqedwa i-HASB entsha futhi abafundi bangena ukuze baqedele unyaka wabo wesikole.

Ubuciko obuhle 
Lesi sikole kade saziwa ngomculo nezinhlelo zedrama.

U-Randolph Hunt wayenguthisha wokuqala womculo wesikole; wajoyina ubuhlakani ngo-1950 wabhala ihubo lesikole elithi, "Hail Green and Gold", nezinye izingoma.Washiya iCapuchino ngo-1960 ukuze athole iziqu zakhe zobudokotela.

U-Ralph Bredenberg (1918-2009)  waba umqondisi webhendi ngo-1953 futhi wakha ibhendi ehamba phambili eyayidlala emiqhudelwaneni eminingi, futhi wabonakala ku-Tournament of Roses ePasadena, eCalifornia kanye nombukiso wokuqala kamabonakude ovezwe kuzwelonke. kaJohn F. Kennedy eWashington, DC ngoJanuwari 20, 1961.

Ezemidlalo 
UCapuchino usenesikhathi eside enomnyango wezokusubatha ovelele.Iqale yancintisana kuPeninsula Athletic League, esukela eJefferson High School eDaly City yaya eLincoln High School eSan Jose.Njengoba kwakhiwa izikole eziningi eziphakeme ngeminyaka yawo-1950s nasekuqaleni kwawo-1960, iMid-Peninsula yasungulwa ukuze ifake izikole eziyisikhombisa eziphakeme zeSifunda Sesikole Samabanga Aphakeme saseSan Mateo.ICapuchino ibibusa umqhudelwano weligi eminyakeni edlule, ikakhulukazi ebholeni, ibasketball, ukubhukuda, i-wrestling, i-track, nethenisi.Ngasekupheleni kwawo-1950 isikole sawina umqhudelwano weligi ebholeni lase-varsity, i-basketball, ne-baseball, isikhathi esivame ukubizwa nge-"The Golden Age of Sports."    Abadlali bebaseball beCapuchino uWally Bunker noKeith Hernandez bobabili baqhubekile nomsebenzi kuMajor League baseball .  

Ngawo-1990s, iqembu le-softball lamantombazane eCapuchino lawina imiqhudelwano emihlanu elandelanayo yeCentral Coast Section (CCS) (1993-1997),  futhi labekwa isifundazwe izikhathi ezintathu ngalesi sikhathi.ICapuchino iphinde ibe nerekhodi le-32-9 Central Coast Section Playoff, eyinikeza iphesenti eliwina isibili kuzo zonke izikole ezikulesi sigaba.

Ikharikhulamu 
ICapuchino ukuphela kwesikole eSan Mateo Union High School District esinikeza i- International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme.

Isikole siphinde sinikeze amakilasi e-ROP (Regional Occupational Programme) mahhala.Lokhu kufaka i-CompTIA A+ Certification (noma idizayini yesistimu yekhompyutha), isitifiketi se-CCNA (Cisco Networking Academy), kanye nelebhu ye-Art of Video ethuthukisiwe.

 Abafundi abangu-1,213: 626 abesilisa (51.6%), 587 abesifazane (48.4%)

Cishe u-35.6% wabafundi baseCapuchino bahlinzekwa ngohlelo lwesidlo sasemini lwamahhala noma lwentengo encishisiwe.

title: Millbrae, California
text:
IMillbrae yidolobha elisenyakatho yeSan Mateo County, California, United States.Ngasenyakatho-mpumalanga yayo kuneSikhumulo Sezindiza Samazwe Ngamazwe SaseSan Francisco, iSan Bruno isenyakatho-ntshonalanga, kanye neBurlingame eningizimu-mpumalanga yayo.Izungezwe yiSan Andreas Lake eningizimu-ntshonalanga.Inani labantu lalingama-21,536 ekubalweni kwabantu kwango-2010.

Umlando 
Abantu base- Ohlone sebehlale e- Bay Area amakhulu eminyaka. Amadolobhana aseduze nendawo manje okuthiwa yi-Millbrae atholakala ngasosebeni lwe- San Bruno Creek, futhi aziwa ngokuthi i- Urebure ne-Siplichiquin .Idolobhana lesithathu eliseduze—elingaziwa igama lalo—libizwa ngokuthi i- CA-SMA-299.Abantu bendawo base-Ohlone namuhla babizwa ngokuthi iRamaytush Ohlone, nokho leli gama liyigama lolimi elivele kamuva nje. Ngaphambi kwekoloni, i-Ohlone ayizange isebenze njengeyunithi eyodwa ehlanganisiwe; bona ezikhonjwe ngaphezulu nge isizwe sabo zendawo emzaneni kuka ne isizwe sonkana.Izizwe ezimbalwa zasendaweni ezazihlala endaweni ngaphambi kokwenziwa kwamakholoni zahlangana nabantu besimanje baseRamaytush kulandela ukwehla okukhulu kwenani labantu bakhona ngeminyaka yawo-1800s.

1800s 
Ngo-1827, u-sub-lieutenant u-José Antonio Sánchez, owayesebenza e- Presidio, wanikezwa imvume ngumbusi waseMexico u- José María de Echeandía ukuba athathe i-rancho "ngokwezinjongo zokulima", njengendawo yokuklama i-Mission Dolores kanye ne-Presidio yaseSan Francisco.I-Sixteen Mile House yasekuqaleni, indawo yokudlela yomlando nendawo yokuphumula, yayiyisixhumanisi esiqondile ezinsukwini zokuqala zikaMillbrae.I stop ukuphumula lakhiwa ngo-1872 ngu-amalungu omkhaya Sánchez, landholders okuqala eNhlangano Rancho Buri Buri, okuyinto ngesikhathi esisodwa sakhiwe izingxenye banamuhla Millbrae futhi Burlingame .

title: Ohlone mythology
text:
I izinganekwane we Ohlone (Costanoan) American aboMdabu abantu Northern California zihlanganisa ekudalweni izinganekwane kanye nezinye ezilandisayo lasendulo eziqukethe ezakha inkolelo izinhlelo zabo ezingokomoya futhi zefilosofi, ekukhulelweni yabo emhlabeni jikelele.Izinganekwane zabo zichaza izidalwa ze-anthropomorphic ezingaphezu kwemvelo ezinamagama ezinyoni zesifunda nezilwane, ikakhulukazi ukhozi, iCoyote engukhokho wesintu nomoya wobuqili, kanye nomzwilili.

Inganekwane yamaChochenyo (Chocheño) yase- San Francisco Bay Area inomuntu oqinile wesiko leqhawe okuthiwa u-Kaknu, umzukulu ka-coyote, ongumuntu othanda abantu futhi ofana ngokuseduze nefalcon yeperegrine.

Izindaba zokudala

Rumsen (Coyote, Eagle, Hummingbird) 
Inganekwane eyodwa yokudalwa kwe-Ohlone iqala ngokushabalala kwezwe langaphambili: Lapho libhujiswa, umhlaba wawumbozwe ngokuphelele ngamanzi, ngaphandle kwesiqongo esisodwa, i- Pico Blanco (enyakatho yeBig Sur ) enguqulweni yeRumsien (noma iMount Diablo in the inguqulo ye-northern Ohlone) okwakumi kuyo iCoyote, i-Hummingbird, noKhozi.“Ngesikhathi amanzi ephakama ema ngezinyawo” ukhozi lwabathwala bonke baya eSierra de Gabilin (eduze kwaseFremont) lapho balinda khona “ukuba ehle amanzi” nomhlaba wome.UCoyote uthunywe ukuthi ayophenya athole komile manje. 

Ngemva kukazamcolo, ukhozi lwaholela uCoyote entombazaneni enhle ngaphakathi noma emfuleni futhi wamyala ukuthi "uzoba umkakho ukuze abantu baphinde bavuswe."Ukhozi lwanikeza uCoyote umyalelo wokuthi angamkhulelisa kanjani esiswini sakhe.Lo nkosikazi wokuqala wakhulelwa ngokudla izintwala zikaCoyote, kodwa wesaba waqala ukugijima.I-Coyote ayikwazanga ukumncenga noma ukuyinciphisa ijubane, yagijima yaya olwandle neCoyote imjaha yabe isigxumela olwandle yaphenduka izenze noma izimfanzi. 

UCoyote washada unkosikazi wesibili futhi kulokhu waba nezingane ezaba ngabantu base-Ohlone. Lena yindlela “abantu abaphinde bavuka ngayo”.I-Coyote yafundisa isintu ubuciko bokuphila.

Rumsen (Ukhozi noKlebe) 
Enye inganekwane yendalo iqala ngokuthi umhlaba ugcwele amanzi. Ukhozi lutshela uKlebe ukuthi angene emanzini kazamcolo ukuze athole umhlaba. Uklebe uyatshuza kodwa uyehluleka ukuthola umhlaba ngosuku lokuqala. Aphinde azame ngakusasa, kulokhu ebambe uphaphe oluhlwithwe phakathi kwekhanda loKhozi. Uphaphe lukhula lube lude futhi lusiza uKlebe ukuthi lufinyelele umhlabathi othile ngaphansi kwamanzi. Amanzi agcina ebohlile.

Chochenyo (Coyote kanye nomzukulu Kaknu) 
Izinganekwane zamaChochenyo zichaza "Abantu Bokuqala" noma "Abantu Bakuqala" njengezidalwa ze-anthropomorphic ezingaphezu kwemvelo ezinamagama ezinyoni zesifunda nezilwane.Ezinganekwaneni ezihlukene ezirekhodiwe, i-Coyote yayingumuntu ophakeme kakhulu:"I-Coyote 'yayimanzi', lowo owayala. WayenguNkulunkulu wethu, uNkulunkulu womhlaba wonke.”UCoyote wayengumkhulu, umngane kanye nomeluleki weqhawe lenganekwane likaChochenyo, iKaknu.U_-Kaknu wayengesinye isidalwa esingokwemvelo, esichazwa njengenyoni edla ezinye, esicishe sifane kakhulu ne- peregrine falcon .

Ukwenza umhlaba uphephe

Chochenyo (Kaknu fights Body of Stone) 
"Ekugcineni lapho uKaknu engasafuni ukulwa namuntu, waphenduka ijuba wangena emhlabeni".U-Kaknu wagxumela emhlabeni ngokugoqa amaphiko akhe, wahamba wayobhekana "noMzimba Wetshe" obizwa ngokuthi uWiwe.Umzimba Wetshe wawuyinkosi engaphansi komhlaba, echazwa njengendoda enomzimba wamatshe, eyayiphakela abantu izinceku zayo.Indawo yakhe yayihlakazeke ngamathambo.I-Body of Stone yabamba abaningi "abantu" bakaKaknu ekuthunjweni futhi basiza u-Kaknu empini enkulu.Ngenkathi uKaknu edubula uMzimba Wetshe entanyeni nasenkabeni ngayo yonke imicibisholo yakhe, uMzimba Wetshe wafa futhi waqhuma waba yizicucu, futhi waba wonke amadwala ahlakazeke emhlabeni wonke.I-Kaknu yenza ukuthula nabantu kulo mshoshaphansi owake waba nobutha.

Izindaba zokufa nangemva kokufa

Chochenyo (Land of the Dead) 
Ngokusho kwabakwaChochenyo ukufa kwadalwa nguCoyote ukuze abantu bathole ukudla okwanele kodwa lokhu kwakusho."UKaknu kwadingeka athathe umgwaqo oya ezweni labafileyo... abantu balandele isibonelo sakhe." 

Ngokusho kwamaChochenyo, iZwe Labafileyo lalinomgwaqo owodwa kuphela futhi indoda eyamukela imimoya engenayo.Kukhona igwebu elimhlophe njengolwandle, ngaphambi kwalokhu kukhona izingcezu ezimbili zentuthu nezinkuni ezivuthayo namatshe amabili ayizigodi, elinye ligcwele amanzi, elinye linoshukela, lapho imimoya ingaphuza futhi idle, ngaphambi kokuba ingene egwebu.Izinkuni ezivuthayo ziyisixwayiso, uhlobo lwesixwayiso olungachazwanga.

Umongo 
Lezi zinganekwane ziye zabizwa ngokuthi izingcezu zezindaba ezingaphelele ekudalweni komhlaba. Babelana ngezinto ezithile nabantu abangomakhelwane eCentral naseNyakatho yeCalifornia, njengezinganekwane zeMiwok .Abantu baseBay Miwok nabo babekholelwa ukuthi umhlaba waqala ngamanzi azungeze intaba ende kunazo zonke esifundeni, iMount Diablo.Izinganekwane ze-Ohlone ziqukethe ukufana okuningi kwezinganekwane zaseYokuts kanye ne- cosmogony .

title: Ohlone College
text:
I-Ohlone College (i- Ohlone noma i- OC ) ikolishi lomphakathi elinekhampasi yalo enkulu eFremont, eCalifornia kanye nekhampasi yesibili eNewark.Iyingxenye yeCalifornia Community College System.Isifunda sase-Ohlone Community College sisebenzela amadolobha aseFremont naseNewark, kanye nezingxenye ze- Union City.

I-Ohlone inikeza ama-associate degrees angu-61 aholela ekudluliseleni enyuvesi noma emisebenzini kanye nezinhlelo zezitifiketi zomsebenzi ezingaphezu kwe-100 ezinikeza ukuqeqeshwa kwamakhono emisebenzi.

Umlando 
Yasungulwa njengeCalifornia Community College ngo-1965 kulandela ukuvunywa kwabavoti, i-Ohlone College isebenzela amadolobha aseFremont neNewark kanye nezingxenye ze-Union City esifundeni esiseningizimu-mpumalanga yeSan Francisco Bay.Isifunda sase-Ohlone Community College siyisifunda sekolishi elilodwa elinamakhampasi amabili kanye nekhampasi ye-e ephumelelayo.

Iqanjwe ngokusemthethweni i-Ohlone College ngoJuni 18, 1967, igama lalesi sikhungo lihlonipha abantu base- Ohlone , izindawo zabo ezingagunyaziwe ezihlanganisa indawo yaseFremont neNewark lapho isikole sasungulwa khona, kanye nengxenye enkulu yendawo ezungezile yaseSan Francisco Bay, eyayiphethwe abantu base-Ohlone. amakhulu eminyaka ngaphambi kokufika kwabaseYurophu.

IBhodi Labaphathiswa lakhethwa ngo-1966, elabe seliqasha umongameli owasungula, uDkt. Stephen Epler, ngoJuni 1966.  Ikolishi lavulwa ekwindla ngo-1967 eSerra Center, indawo yesikhashana eWashington Boulevard.Ekugcineni ikolishi laphumela emphakathini ngebhondi engu-$10 million kwathi ngo-1972 laqala ukwakhiwa kwekhempasi entsha yase-Ohlone College eMission Boulevard eFremont.

U-Ernest J. Kump uklame izakhiwo zokuqala eziyisishiyagalolunye ezakha idolobhana lezemfundo.Izakhiwo ezengezwe kamuva kulesi sikhungo zihlanganisa isikhungo sobuciko obudlalwayo, isikhungo sobuchwepheshe, isikhungo sokuthuthukisa izingane kanye nesikhungo sosizo lwabafundi.Ikhampasi yesibili yakhiwa eNewark, CA, I-Ohlone College Newark Center for Health Sciences and Technology, eyavulwa ngo-2008.

Kubandakanya uDkt. Epler, u-Ohlone ube nomongameli abayisikhombisa kuphela emlandweni wawo weminyaka engama-45+.Umongameli wamanje nguDkt Eric Bishop.

Ezokusubatha 
I-Ohlone fields amaqembu emidlalweni engu-7 yase-varsity (abesilisa aba-5, abesifazane abayisi-6) okuhlanganisa ukubhukuda, i-baseball, i-basketball, ibhola likanobhutshuzwayo ne-polo yamanzi, futhi uyilungu le-CCCAA (California Community College Athletics Association) kanye neNkomfa yasoGwini.

Izifundiswa 
I-Ohlone inikeza ama-associate degrees ku-Arts and Sciences (AA kanye ne-AS) alingana nokuqeda izifundo zeminyaka emibili zeziqu ezifundweni eziningi.I-Ohlone iphinde inikeze nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha umsebenzi ezingaqedwa ngaphansi komjikelezo weminyaka emibili odingekayo kanye namayunithi angama-60 ukuthola iziqu.

Isikhungo Sezifundo Zezithulu 
Ngo-1972, i-Ohlone College Centre for Deaf Studies and Special Services yasungulwa lapho iKolishi livula iminyango yalo kubafundi abangu-30 abayiziThulu nabangezwakali.Isikhungo Sezifundo Eziyizithulu sinabafundi abayiziThulu nabangezwa kahle abafika ku-200 ngonyaka owodwa.

I-Biotechnology High School Izinhlelo Zokufinyelela 
I-Learning Alliance for Bioscience (LAB) Programme iwuhlelo oluxhaswa ngezimali yiNational Science Foundation olubeka abafundi bezikole zamabanga aphezulu abavela kubantu abangamelweli kahle endleleni yokufunda ukuze balungiselele amadigri ekolishi ku-biotechnology.

Umnyango Wezokusakaza 
Umsakazo: KOHL 89.3 FM. Ifilimu nomabonakude: ONTV 28, esakazwa kuComcast futhi yasakazwa ku-www.ohlonetv.com

Umsakazo we-KOHL ube ngumsakazi wabantu abagqamile njengesishoshovu samalungelo abantu u- Bobby Seale kanye nomlingisi uRita Moreno.

Umnyango Wobuhlengikazi Obhalisiwe 
I-Ohlone College inikeza i-Associate of Science Degree in Nursing egunyazwe yi- National League for Nursing Accrediting Commission kanye ne- California Board of Registered Nurses . Abafundi abathweswe iziqu kulolu hlelo bafanelekile ukuhlalela i-NCLEX-RN eholela ekutholeni amalayisensi okuba unesi obhalisiwe (RN).

I-Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) uMnyango

Uhlelo lwe-PTA yase-Ohlone College lugunyazwe yiKhomishini Yokugunyazwa Kwezemfundo Yokwelapha Ngomzimba ye- American Physical Therapy Association .

Umnyango Wezokwelapha Eziphefumulayo (RT). 
I-Respiratory Therapist inguchwepheshe wezempilo onelayisense ekuhlolweni kwe-cardio-pulmonary, ukuxilongwa kanye nokwelashwa.

Lapho bephothula uhlelo lwe-Respiratory Therapist abathweswe iziqu bafaneleka ukuhlalela Ukuhlolwa Kwelayisense Yesifunda SaseCalifornia Yomsebenzi Wokunakekela Ukuphefumula (RCP).Uma Isiqinisekiso Se-RCP sesitholakele abathweswe iziqu bayafaneleka ukubhalisela Izivivinyo Zomsebenzi Wezinga Eliphakeme ( RRT ) zeBhodi Likazwelonke Lokunakekelwa Kokuphefumula .

title: Phiwa Nkambule
text:
Articles with hCards
UPhiwa Nkambule (owazalwa ngoJanuwari 24, 1992) ungusomabhizinisi wezobuchwepheshe kanye nesishoshovu se-inthanethi owaziwa kakhulu ngokusungula i- Riovic nokuyihola njenge-CEO yayo.  Phambilini wasungula i-Cybatar  futhi wahlala ebhodini leRoyal Science and Technology Park .

Isiqalo sokuphila 
UPhiwa Nkambule wazalelwa eManzini nokuyilapho akhulela khona.  

Ngo-2006, eneminyaka engu-14 ubudala, waqala ukulungisa nokwakha amakhompyutha nomalume wakhe elokishini elincane eSwazini.  UNkambule udlulele eNingizimu Afrika ngo-2007 ngezinhloso zemfundo.  UPhiwa wayengumfundi wezomthetho eNyuvesi yasePitoli ngaphambi kokuyeka ukuyovula inkampani yakhe yokuqala yezobuchwepheshe i-Cybatar esuka egaraji lakhe ngo-2014.  Kwakusenyuvesi lapho azifundise khona ukuthuthukiswa kwewebhu nohlelo lokusebenza.

Ezamabhizinisi 
Ngaphambi kokushiya iNyuvesi yasePitoli uPhiwa wazama ukusebenzisana neSwaziland National Library kanye neHhovisi Lezemfundo Lesifunda saseManzini ngo-2013 kodwa wenqaba.  Ngemva kokushiya inyuvesi ngo-2014 uNkambule wasungula iCybatar, inkampani yezobuchwepheshe eyayigxile ekuletheni uphethiloli egaraji lakhe elisePitoli, eNingizimu Afrika.   

Ngo-2015 uNkambule wasungula uRiovic, inkampani yobuchwepheshe bomshwalense.       Inkampani ingumnikazi futhi isebenza izinkundla eziku-inthanethi ezixhumanisa abathengi nomshwalense, izikweletu kanye nokutshalwa kwezimali. 

NgoMeyi wezi-2019 uPrincess Sikhanyiso, indodakazi endala yeNkosi uMswati III wase-Eswatini kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezolwazi, Ezokuxhumana Nobuchwepheshe base-Eswatini baqoka uPhiwa ebhodini leRoyal Science and Technology Park, okuyinkampani kahulumeni eyakhiwe ukuze kugqugquzelwe ukwakhiwa kwemikhiqizo eqanjiwe. futhi wenze kube lula ukuphatha kwabo kanye nokusiza ukuhlanganisa izici ezihlukahlukene zeqoqo le-R&D ndawonye.

Ezombusazwe 
NgoSepthemba 2021 uPhiwa Nkambule wathola ukuthi ukhishiwe ebhodini leRoyal Science and Technology Park ngokusebenzisa isizindalwazi senkampani ngaphandle kokuxhumana okusemthethweni kulandela ukweseka kwakhe umphakathi ngokuvalwa kwamaqembu ezepolitiki ngemuva kwezibhelu zezombusazwe ezenzeka ngoJuni 2021 Eswatini . UMnyango Wezolwazi, Ezokuxhumana Nobuchwepheshe uthe isikhathi sakhe seminyaka emithathu esiqale ngoMeyi 2019 sesiphelile.

I-Philanthropy 
Ngomhla zingama-24 kuMfumfu wezi-2015, wakhulula inkundla yokuqala yokuxhasa abafundi imali yokufunda eNingizimu Afrika ngemuva kwemibhikisho ye-FeesMustFall eyavala izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme kuleli ukuze kusizwe abafundi abakweletwayo.    Uphinde wethula inkundla yokufunda yamahhala ku-inthanethi yamakhono edijithali okuhloswe ngayo ukunciphisa izinga lokungasebenzi kwentsha eNingizimu Afrika.

Imiklomelo nokuhlonishwa 
UPhiwa Nkambule umenywe ukuba ethule inkulumo yosuku ngeDigital Technologies in Insurance eNgqungqutheleni ye-13 ye-International Microinsurance ePeru, eNingizimu Melika ngoNovemba 2017.     

NgoJuni 2018, uqokwe ohlwini lweForbes Africa 30 Under 30 losomabhizinisi abathembisayo kakhulu esigabeni sobuchwepheshe.  Ngo-Okthoba 2018 waqanjwa ohlwini lwe- Destiny Man Power of 40, uhlu lwama-trailblazer angu-40 abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-40. 

NgoSepthemba 2020 uNkambule ube ngomunye wosomabhizinisi ababhalwe encwadini enesihloko esithi " Entrepreneurs Who Changed History " eshicilelwe nguDorling Kindersley, echaza abaholi bemboni abangaphezu kuka-90 emhlabeni wonke nakuzo zonke izinkathi - kusukela kosomabhizinisi abasafufusa bezwe lasendulo kanye abathengisi bombuso, kuma-titans embonini kanye nezihlakaniphi zaseSilicon Valley.  

NgoZibandlela wezi-2021, uPhiwa waqokwa njengoMntu Wonyaka Wezokuxhumana Kwezenhlalo yi- Times of Swaziland . Waqashelwa njengomuntu onethonya futhi othandwa kakhulu ku-inthanethi ngenxa yokukhuluma futhi egabadela ngezinxushunxushu zezombusazwe e-Eswatini nge- akhawunti yakhe ye-Twitter eqinisekisiwe yincwadi kazwelonke.

title: Kiswahili
text:
IsiSwahili, esibuye saziwa ngegama laso lesiSwahili, siwulimi lwesiBantu kanye nolimi lwendabuko lwabantu baseSwahili. Ingolunye lwezilimi ezimbili ezisemthethweni (olunye kuyisiNgisi) zamazwe ase-East African Community (EAC), okuyiBurundi, iKenya, iRwanda, iSouth Sudan, iTanzania ne-Uganda. Kuwulimi olusetshenziswa kwezinye izindawo esifundeni sase-Afrika e-Great Lakes naseMpumalanga naseNingizimu Afrika, okuhlanganisa izingxenye ezithile zeDemocratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Malawi, Mozambique, Somalia, kanye neZambia. IsiSwahili siphinde sibe ngolunye lwezilimi ezisetshenziswa yiNhlangano Yamazwe ase-Afrika kanye ne-Southern African Development Community. Inani eliqondile labakhuluma isiSwahili, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi abakhuluma ulimi lwesibili, lilinganiselwa phakathi kwezigidi ezingu-50 kuya kwezingu-150.

Amaphesenti ayishumi nesithupha kuya kwamashumi amabili wesilulumagama sesiSwahili amagama emali ebolekwayo esi-Arabhu, okuhlanganisa negama elithi swahili, elisuka ku-Arabic sawāḥilī. Amagama emalimboleko yesi-Arabhu asukela ekuxhumaneni nabahwebi base-Arabia nabantu baseBantu abahlala ogwini olusempumalanga ye-Afrika emakhulwini amaningi eminyaka, okwakuphinde kube yilapho isiSwahili sivela njengolimi olusetshenziswayo.

Ngo-2018, iNingizimu Afrika yagunyaza ukufundiswa kwesiSwahili ezikoleni njengesifundo ongasikhetha esizoqala ngo-2020. IBotswana yalandela ngo-2020, futhi iNamibia ihlela ukwethula nolimi. IsiShikomor (noma isiComorian), ulimi olusemthethweni eComoros futhi olukhulunywa ngesiMayotte (Shimaore), sihlobene eduze nesiSwahili futhi ngezinye izikhathi sibhekwa njengolimi lwesiSwahili, nakuba ezinye iziphathimandla zisibheka njengolimi oluhlukile.

title: IsiKhuhluzi
text:
IsiKhuhluzi, sibuye saziwe ngokuthi isiHlafuzi, isitsha sasekhishini esisetshenziselwa ukugaya ukudla kube yizicucu ezincanyane. IsiKhuhluzi sesimanje salunjwa ngu-François Boullier ngeminyaka ye-1540s, ngenhloso yokugay uJibini .

Ukusetshenziswa

Ukulungiswa kokudla 

kunezinhlobo ezining zeziKhuhluzi zifaka nobukhulu obahlukahlukene zeziKhuhluzi, ngakho-ke zingasiza ekulungiseni ukudla okuhlukahlukene. Ngokuvamile zisetshenziselwa ukukhuhluza uJibini kanye namakhasi kaLamula noma eWolintshi (ukukhiqiza  uMhlibi ), kanti futhi zingasetshenziswa ukuKhuhluza okunye ukudla okuthambile. Zivame ukusetshenziswa ekulungiseni isinkwa somchachambiso esinoJibini, i- Welsh rarebit, isaladi lamaqanda, nezinye izipheko eziqukethe isoso kaJibini njengeziHashuki noJibini, uJibini wesishimanqi klabishana .

KwiziPheko zamaSlavikhi, iziKhuhluzi zivame ukusetshenziselwa ukuKhuhluza amaZambane ukulungiselela iziPheko, okufaka phakathi idraniki, ibramborak noma ibabka yamaZambane .

Emazweni ashisayo iziKhuhluzi nawo zisetshenziselwa ukuKhuhluza inyama kakhukhunathi. Ezwenikazi laseNdiya, isikhuhluzi sisetshenziselwa ukulungisa isilandeli kudla esithandwayo, Gajali KaHalwa .

IziKhuhluzi zikhiqiza imiHlafuzi emincane ekugcineni kunamaphakathi nendawo. Lokhu kuvumela isiKhuhluzwa ukuthi sincibilike ngezindlela ezingafani ezahlukile kunalapho zinohlonze olulinganayo olukhiqizwe umushume   womushini wokukhuhluza ukudla . Amazambane aKhuhluzwe ngesandla, njengesibonelo, ancibilika ndawonye kalula kuThosi wamaZambane kunezingcezu zamazambane ezikhuhluzwe ngomushini.

EmCulweni 
EJameyikha naseBhelize, iziKhuhluzi zisetshenziswa njengensimbi yomculo yendabuko  (kanye neziGubhu, iFife, nezinye izinsimbi) uma kwenziwa ikumina, ijonkanu, kanye nemento kwezinye izikhathi .

UmLando 
Isikhuhluzi sikaJibini sesimanje salunjwa eFilanci ngeminyaka ye-1540 ilunjwa nguFrançois Boullier. Umklamo wakhe wephwuthi wawuhloselwe ukuguqula uJibini oqinile ube into edlekayo.

Izahluki 
IziNgoqelela izikhuhluzi zemishini ezibucayi. Lezi izinxakanxaka zizungeza ngokuphenduka kwesihleke ukukhiqiza ummombo noma izingoqela.

IziThombe

Esikweni elidumile 

 Usomahlaya uMitch Hedberg wenze ihlaya lapho athi igama eliwumqondophikisa le-cheese grater (isiKhuhluzi sikaJibin) kwakuyoba "umoni wesipontshi". 
 U-Kevin Eastman, owabamba iqhaza ekusungulweni kwamaTeenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, wathola umqondo wezivikeli mzimba zikaShredder ezisusela kwizikhuhluzi zikaJibin ezinkulu azibone ngeso lengqondo ezingalweni zeHilikiqi elizisebenzisa njengezikhali. Ekuqaleni wayebizwa "ngoMkhuhluzi", uShredder waziwa njengeHilikiqi eliyinhloko kuTMNT. 
 Abalandeli bezemidlalo baseWisconsin bavame ukubizwa ngokuthi amaJibini, kanti abanye bagqoka izigqoko zikaJibini. Ngo-2013, abalandeli bezemidlalo baseChicago naseMinnesota baphendula izimbangi zabo ngokugqoka izingubo zemifaniswano zemikhuhluzi.

title: Umchazalwandle
text:
